tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /stod cha'o/ /
༄༅/ /legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /stod cha'o/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho bzhugs so// stod cha'o// (2) bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// phun tshogs mkhyen brtse'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs// rab dkar 'phrin las 'od stong 'phro ba yis// gdul bya gling bzhi'i 'byor pa rgyas mdzad pa// thub dbang nyin byed bzang por gus pas 'dud// rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus pa'i// rgyal sras tshul gyis bskal bzang gdul bya la// rgyal ba'i mdzad pas phan (3) bde stsol mdzad pa'i// rgyal ba byams pa'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud// de sras thu bo thogs med bzang po'i dpal// mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen 'phags pa rnam grol sde// sher phyin bstan pa rgyas mdzad seng bzang zhabs// rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud// sangs rgyas bstan pa lung rtogs dpal gyis brjid// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag shes bya kun rigs zhabs// kun mkhyen gnyis pa rab 'byams (4) chos kyi rje// 'dzam gling rgyan gyur rnam gsum gus pas 'dud// rnam dag lung dang rig pas rab brgyan pa'i// legs par bshad pa lung rigs rgya mtsho che// dang po'i las can rnams la phan pa'i phyir// lhag bsam dag pa'i yid kyis bshad par bya// //'dir mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i don gsal bar byed pa legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'chad pa la/ bshad bya dam pa'i chos ngos bzung*/ de la bshad nyan gyi sgo nas 'jug pa'i tshul/ bshad pa rang gi ngo bo dang gsum/ dang po la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ gnas tshad dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sbyang zhing nyams su blangs pa la brten nas/ lus can rnams kyi sgrib pa zad pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i rnam (5) dkar gyi yon tan no// dam pa'i chos dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so// gnyis pa la/ lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos gnyis te/ mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te// lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do// zhes so// dang po/

lung gi dam chos la/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtogs pa'i dam chos brjod byar ston pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i rnam dkar gyi legs bshad/ gnyis pa la/ bka' dang*/ bstan bcos gnyis te/ lha'i bus zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus// legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel pa// de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa ni// 'jig rten khams 'dir (6) yun ring gnas par 'gyur// zhes so// bka' la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ skabs don ngos bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la brten nas byung ba'i khyad par bzhi ldan gyi rgyal ba'i gsung rab/ de dang lung gi chos 'khor don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so// khyad par bzhi ni/ brjod bya don dang ldan pa/ brjod byed kyi tshig dri ma med pa/ byed las khams gsum gyi nyon mongs spong ba/ 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa'i phan yon ston pa dang bzhi ste/ rgyud blar/ gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing*// khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsungs// zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang*// de ni drang srong (7) gsung yin bzlog pa gzhan// zhes so// gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dus/ brjod bya/ gdul bya/ bdag rkyen/ sde tshan gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang lnga/ dang po la/ bden pa bzhi'i/ mtshan nyid med pa'i/ legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor dang gsum/ gnyis pa la/ brjod bya bden pa gnyis kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang*/ brjod bya bslab pa gsum gyi sgo nas dbye ba la gnyis/ dang po la/ grangs nges kyi mdo gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ mngon pa/ mdo sde/ 'dul ba'i sde snod dang gsum/ chos 'khor gsum dang grangs nges kyi mdo gnyis 'og tu 'chad/ phyi ma gsum gyi mtshan nyid rim bzhin sde snod gsum gyi nang tshan gang zhig lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa/ sems kyi bslab pa/

(8) tshul khrims kyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i rig gnas/ 'di gsum 'gal ba ma yin te/ brjod bya bslab pa gsum po de mi 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ bka' brgyad stong pa lta bu mdo gcig nyid kyang bslab pa gsum ka brjod byar ston pa'i cha nas sde snod gsum gyi mtshan gzhir 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la mos pa'i gdul bya rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'i sde snod/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa la mos pa'i gdul bya rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'i sde snod gnyis te/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi// 'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas// rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes so// bzhi pa la/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka'/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'jam sdud bzang gsum gyi mdo lta bu'o// gnyis (9) pa la/ sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' gsum/ dang po ni/ sa bcu pa'i mdo lta bu/ gnyis pa la/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo lta bu/ gsum pa la/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis/ thugs bden pa'i stobs kyis/ thugs thugs rje'i stobs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sher snying lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyis mthus nam mkha' dang ljon shing sogs las byung ba'i chos kyi sgra lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyis thugs rjes gnod sbyin la sogs pas smras pa'i 'bras bu khyad par can 'grub nus kyi sngags kyis tshig lta bu'o// gsum pa/ rjes gnang ba'i bka' ni/ mdo rnams kyi mgo'i gleng gzhi dang*/ bar gyi mtshams sbyor dang*/ mtha'i mthun 'gyur rjes su yi rang rnams te/ chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag 'di skad bdag (10)

gis thos pa zhes bgyis la/ chos yang dag par bsdu bar bya'o// 'grel dang go rim kyang bstan par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas so// lnga pa la/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis yod de/ brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa snying po mchog las/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung du bstan// tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang*// rtog brjod de lta bu byung dang*// skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang*// rmad byung gtan la phab pa'i sde// gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis so// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ 'dir bshad par bya ba'i bka' ni/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor yin cing*/ de'i mtshan gzhi ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo ji snyed yod pa rnams so// 'di la snga rabs kyi mkhas pa kha cig yum drug dang*/ sras bcu gcig ste/ yum sras bcu bdun du grangs nges par yin cing*/ yum drug la/ rgyas pa skor gsum dang*/ bsdus pa skor gsum/ dang po ni/ stong phrag brgya (11) pa/ nyi khri/ khri brgyad stong pa dang gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ shes rab khri pa/ brgyad stong pa/ sdud pa dang gsum/ sras bcu gcig ni/ sher phyin bdun brgya pa/ lnga brgya pa/ sum brgya pa/ tshul brgya lnga bcu pa lnga bcu pa/ sgo nyer lnga pa/ rab rtsal rnam gnon gyis zhus pa'i mdo/ ko'u shī kas zhus pa'i mdo/ sher snying*/ yi ge nyung ngus/ yi ge gcig ma rnams yin/ zhes zer/ ar na re/ mi 'thad de/ lhag pa dang*/ chad pa dang*/ tha snyad mi 'thad pa'i skyon gsum yod pa'i phyir/ lhag pa'i skyon yod de/ sdud pa khri brgyad stong pa'i nang tshan yin pa'i phyir/ chad pa'i skyon yod de/ sher phyin brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ nyi ma'i snying po zla ba'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po sogs ma 'dus pa'i phyir/ tha snyad nor ba'i skyon yod de/ de 'dra'i yum sras kyis tha snyad rgya 'grel (12) rnams su ma gsung cing*/ don gyi thob pa'i tha snyad kyang ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ rang lugs la/ sher phyin gyi mdo ji snyed yod pa rnams bsdu na/

sher phyin gyi lus yongs rdzogs ston pa'i mdo dang*/ sher phyin gyi don tsam ston pa'i mdo gnyis su 'dus/ dang po ni/ dngos brgyad lus su byas/ don bdun cu yan lag tu byas nas skyon par byed pa'i mdo rnams yin cing*/ de la yang rgyas pa/ 'bring*/ bsdus pa/ bsdus don gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ rgyas pa'i rgyas pa/ rgyas pa'i 'bring*/ rgyas pa'i bsdus pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dri za'i yul na bzhugs pa'i sher phyin bye ba phrag brgya pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ lha'i yul na bzhugs pa'i sher phyin 'bum phrag brgya pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ klu'i yul na bzhugs pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ mi'i 'jig rten du gdan drangs pa'i (13) stong phrag brgya pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa la/ 'bring gi rgyas pa/ 'bring gi 'bring*/ 'bring gi bsdus pa gsum/ dang po ni/ stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ khri brgyad stong pa/ gsum pa ni/ shes rab khri pa lta bu'o// gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ bam po nyer lnga sh+lau ka stong phrag brgyad kyi bdag nyid can brgyad stong pa lta bu'o// bzhi pa ni/ de thams cad kyi don bsdus pa sangs rgyas nyid kyis zhal nas tshigs su bcad pa'i tshul gyis gsung pa mdo sdud pa 'di nyid yin no// gnyis pa sher phyin gyi don tsam ston pa'i mdo ni/ dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa rdzogs par ston pa ma yin kyang*/ lta ba stong pa nyid dang*/ spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi nyams len ston par byed pa sher phyin bdun brgya pa la sogs par sher phyin mdo phran ji snyed yod pa rnams so// gnyis pa bstan bcos la/ rnam bzhag spyir (14) bstan pa dang*/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ngos bzung ba gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya'i sgra bshad/ mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba/ bstan bcos su ldang ba'i tshad dang bzhi/ dang po la/ dgag gzhag gnyis/

dang po la/ kha cig rtsom pa po rnam g.yeng med pa'i yid can gyis bka'i don bshad pa'i ngag gang zhig byed las thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun par zer ba dang*/ rang gi zhe 'dod gzhan la bstan pa'i phyir du bsdebs pa'i ngag rgyun chags pa zer ba dang*/ rang gi grub mtha' gzhan la bstan pa'i phyir du brtsams pa'i ming tshig yi ge du ma 'dus pa/ zer na/ phyi rol pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos chos can/ tshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir te/ bstan bcos ltar snang yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ bstan bcos yin na/ de rnam dag yin dgos par thal/ ma khyab pa de'i phyir/ 'dod (15) na/ grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag yin na/ gang zag tshad ldan yin dgos par thal/ bstan bcos rtsom pa po'i gang zag yin na/ gang zag tshad ldan yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gnyis pa la/ brjod byed tshig don mthun yin na/ bstan bcos yin dgos par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra mi rtag ces pa'i tshig gi ma nges/ 'grel pa don gsal yang chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyun dang bcas pa'i ngag tu thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ khyod sgra gang zhig sgra la rgyun med par bshad pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la/ bka' brgyad stong pa chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ sangs rgyas pa rang gi grub mtha' gzhan la bstan pa'i phyir du rtsom pa po tshad ldan gyis gsungs pa'i lung rnam dag (16) yin pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos rnam dag gi mtshan nyid la kha cig rtsom pa po tshad ldan gyis bka'i don bshad pa'i ngag gang zhig byed las thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa/ zer ba dang*/ rtsom pa po gtso bor gsung rab kyi don la thugs gzhol ba'i yid can gyis bka'i don bshad pa'i ngag gang zhig byed las thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa/ zer ba dang*/ 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i ngag rnam dag

zer ba dang*/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su rnam g.yeng med pa'i yid can gyis thar pa thob pa'i thabs su bka'i don bshad pa'i ngag zer na/ dang po gsum la/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ rtags mgo dang po der thal/ rtsom pa po de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka'i don phyin ci ma log par bstan pa'i lung rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su byung ba'i lung gi dam chos yin na/ (17) bstan bcos rnam dag yin dgos par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su bka' bsdu ba po rnams kyis gsungs pa'i gleng gzhi dang*/ 'tshams sbyar la sogs pa rjes su gnang ba'i mdo chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ khyod rtsom pa po'i gang zag de rnam g.yeng zad par spangs pa'i gang zag tu thal/ khyod bstan bcos rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'grel pa don gsal chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod rtsom pa po'i gang zag de nyon mongs zad par spangs pa'i gang zag du thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod rtsom pa po'i gang zag de theg chen 'phags par thal/ khyod rtsom pa po'i gang zag de nyon mongs zad par spangs shing*/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i (18) rgyal sras yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam pa kun tu bdag gi ni// spyod yul min yang*/ zhes sogs sgra ji bzhin du khas len pa dang 'gal/ gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ gtso bor bstan bcos rtsom pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslang ste/ rang gi zhe 'dod kyi grub mtha' gzhan la bstan pa'i phyir du bsdebs pa'i lung gi chos/ bstan bcos rnam dag gi mtshan nyid ni/ bstan bcos gang zhig khyad par gyi chos bzhi dang ldan pa/ de ltar snang gi mtshan nyid/ bstan bcos gang zhig

khyad par gyi chos bzhi po gang rung dang bral ba/ khyad chos bzhi ni/ bsam pa kun slong gi khyad par/ brjod byed tshig gi khyad par/ brjod bya don gyi khyad par/ dgos pa byed las kyi khyad par ro// dang po ni/ rnam g.yeng sogs nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs pa ma yin par bstan bcos kyi tshig don rtogs pa'i shes rab/ sems can la phan par 'dod (19) pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'o// gnyis pa/ bsdebs sbyor rnam dag dang ldan pa'i tshig snga phyi 'brel chags pa'o// gsum pa ni/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug tu thar pa don gnyer gyi gdul bya la nye bar mkho ba'i thabs ston pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ tshig de la thos bsam byas pa la brten nas mthar thug mya 'das thob pa'i nus pa yod pa'o// rgyud blar/ gang zhig rgyal ba bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad// thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa// de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pas na/ bstan bcos zhes bya ste/ bstan bcos kyi skad dod du shas+t+ra zhes 'byung la/ de yang 'chos pa dang skyob pa la 'jug pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad rig par/ nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang*// ngan 'gro'i

(20) srid las skyob byed gang yin pa// 'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos te// gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med// ces so// gsum pa la/ bshad bya bka'i sgo nas dbye ba/ brjod bya don gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ dgos pa byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ mjug ldog mchog dman gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ rtsam pa po rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas dbye ba/ ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ nam gyi tshe brtsams pa dus kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang bdun/ dang po la/ bka' spyi dang*/ so so'i dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos gnyis/ dang po la/ tshig dang don gyi cha 'grel par byed pa'i bstan bcos gnyis/ dang po ni/ ka la pa sogs sgra'i bstan bcos lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ tshad ma sde bdun lta bu'o// gnyis pa la/ chos 'khor dang po'i/ gnyis pa'i/ gsum pa'i dgongs pa 'grel par byed pa'i bstan bcos dang (21) gsum/ lta ba/ spyod pa/ lta spyod zung 'brel du gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos dang gsum/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ mngon pa mdzod/ mdo rtsa/ bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo lta bu'o// gnyis pa la yang*/ lta ba/ spyod pa/ lta spyod zung 'brel du gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos dang gsum/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ rtsa ba shes rab/ spyod 'jug mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan lta bu'o// gsum pa la/ lta ba/ spyod pa/ lta spyod zung 'brel du gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos dang gsum/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ theg bsdus/ sdom pa nyi shu pa/ mdo sde rgyan lta bu'o// gnyis pa la/ ji lta ba ston pa'i bstan bcos/ ji snyed pa ston pa'i bstan bcos/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i thabs ston pa'i bstan bcos so// dang po ni/ gang (22) zag gi bdag med dang*/ chos kyi bdag med gtso bor gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos rnams so// gnyis pa la/ skye bo gso thigs dang*/ sa skya legs bshad la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi bstan bcos dang*/

rigs pa'i gnas dang po bzhi gtso bor gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos rnam dag gnyis so// gsum pa ni/ spyod 'jug lta bu'o// gsum pa la/ rgya chen po sdud par byed pa'i/ 'khrugs pa go rim du sdebs pa'i/ zab mo rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos dang gsum/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ mngon pa kun btus/ mdo rtsa/ dbu ma rigs tshogs lta bu'o// bzhi pa la/ yang dag gsum/ ltar snang drug tu yod/ sa sde las/ don med don log don dang ldan// ngan g.yo snying bral sdug bsngal spong*// thos rtsod bsgrub pa lhur len pa// bstan bcos rnam pa dgu yin no// zhes so// lnga pa la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs (23) rgyas kyis gsungs pa la bstan bcos su byas pa/ dgra bcom pas gsungs pa la bstan bcos su byas pa/ byang sems 'phags pas gsungs pa la bstan bcos su byas pa/ so so'i skye bo'i paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pas gsungs pa la bstan bcos su byas pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rgyan gnyis/ 'byed gnyis/ rgyud bla ma ste/ byams chos lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ dgra bcom pa bdun gyis mdzad pa'i mngon pa sde bdun lta bu'o// sde bdun ni/ mdzod 'grel las bshad/ chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus// gdag pa'i bstan bcos mo'u 'gal bus// khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos byas// rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis// ye shes la 'jug ka ta'i bus// rab tu byed pa dbyig shes kyis// yang dag 'gro ba'i rnam grangs ni// gsus po che yis byas zhes grags// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ sa gsum pa la gnas pa'i 'phags pa thogs (24) med kyis mdzad pa'i rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga/ bsdus pa'i bstan bcos sdom rnam gnyis lta bu'o// sa sde lnga ni/ rtsa ba lta bu sa'i dngos gzhi/ de'i 'grel pa lta bu gtan phab bsdu ba/ gsung rab rnams sde snod gsum du bsdu tshul ston pa gzhi bsdu ba/ brjod byed ming gi rnam grangs ston pa rnam grangs bsdu ba/

gdul bya la chos 'chad tshul ston pa rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bsdu ba dang lnga yin no// sdom rnam gnyis ni/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i don ston pa theg bsdus/ theg pa thun mong gi don ston pa mngon pa kun las btus/ bzhi pa ni/ mkhas pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i pra ka ra na sde brgyad lta bu'o// sde brgyad ni/ chos thams cad sems tsam du gtan la 'bebs pa sum cu pa/ de nyid rigs pas bsgrub pa nyi shu pa/ de'i gzhi phung po lnga 'thad par ston pa phung po lnga'i rab byed/ sems tsam yin kyang chos 'chad nyan 'thad par (25) ston pa rnam bshad rig pa/ sems tsam yin kyang sgo gsum gyi las 'thad par ston pa las bsgrub pa'i rab byed de/ rang rgyud du brtsams pa lnga/ mdo sde rgyan dang 'byed gnyis kyi 'grel pa gsum ste/ gzhan 'grel du brtsams pa gsum/ drug pa la/ bka' nyid la 'grel par btags pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ bka'i don rang rgyud du brtsams pa'i bstan bcos gnyis/ dang po la/ tshig don gnyis ka zhib tu gtan la 'bebs pa rgya cher 'grel/ tshig gi cha spros pa dang bcas nas 'chad pa'i tshig 'grel/ go dka' ba'i gnas rnam par 'byed pa dka' 'grel/ don gyi gtso bo bsdus te gtan la 'bebs pa bsdus don gyi 'grel pa dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa la/ bka' yongs rdzogs kyi don ston pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ bka' 'thor bu ba sna tshogs kyi don ston pa'i bstan bcos gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan lta bu/ gnyis (26) pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan lta bu'o// bdun pa la/ sprul sku shākya thub pa'i bstan pa gzhir bzhag la/ dus dang por byung ba'i/ bar du byung ba'i/ tha ma la byung ba'i bstan bcos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi lo/ dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas mdzad pa'i bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi brgya lon pa na 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi mdzad pa'i rig tshogs/

bstod tshogs/ gtam gyi tshogs lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo dgu brgya lon pa na/ thogs med dang*/ dbyig gnyen la sogs pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos lta bu'o// bzhi pa ni/ yi ge du ma 'dus pa la ming*/ ming du ma 'dus pa la tshig tshig du ma 'dus pa la sh+lau ka de du ma 'dus pa las rab byed/ le'u/ skabs la sogs pa/ (27) de du ma 'dus pa las bstan bcos kyi lus yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin no// gnyis pa dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ngos bzung ba la/ gzhan lugs dgag rang lugs bzhag rgyan gyi dgongs 'grel ji ltar byung tshul dang gsum/ dang po la kha cig sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs 'grel/ shing rta'i srol 'byed la bzhir ste/ 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rgyan/ klu sgrub kyi rig tshogs/ phyogs glang gis brgyad stong don bsdu/ 'dangs bkra se nas mdzad pa'i stong phrag brgya pa'i rnam bshad rnams su nges pa'i phyir/ zer ba mi 'thad de/ brgyad stong don bsdu dang*/ stong phrag brgya pa'i rnam bshad gnyis po de/ 'phags pa byams pa dang*/ klu sgrub kyi rjes su 'brangs nas sher phyin gyi dgongs pa 'grel byed ma yin pa thal/ de gnyis rgyan dang rtsa sher las don (28) gzhan pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ brgyad stong don bsdu byams pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas sher phyin gyi dgongs pa 'grel par byed pa yin la/ gcig shos ni/ klu sgrub kyi rjes su 'brangs nas sher phyin gyi dgongs pa 'grel byed yin pa'i phyir/ snga ma la khyab pa yod de/ shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi don yang*/ slob dpon snga ma gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs pa tsam ma yin par/ mdo'i don rang stobs kyis 'grel pa la 'dod dgos pa'i phyir/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i don nyams su len pa'i rim pa la/ snying po'i don yid la byed pa'i sgom rim dang*/

mngon par rtogs pa'i don yid la byed pa'i sgom rim gnyis su grangs ma nges par thal/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs pa 'grel par byed pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed la dngos bstan stong nyid kyi cha gsal bar byed pa dbu ma'i bstan bcos dang*/ sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gsal bar (29) byed pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gnyis su ma nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang lugs la/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs 'grel shing rta'i srol 'byed la/ dngos bstan stong nyid kyi cha gsal bar byed pa dbu ma rig tshogs dang*/ sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gnyis su nges pa yin te/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i bstan don nyams len gyi rim pa la/ snying po'i don yid la byed pa'i sgom rim dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i don yid la byed pa'i sgo rim gnyis su nges shing*/ dang po'i lam srol gsar du gtan la 'bebs pa dbu ma rig tshogs/ phyi ma'i lam srol gsar du gtan la 'bebs pa la mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gsungs so// 'di gnyis la shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi don yang tshang ste/ slob dpon snga ma gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs ba tsam ma yin par/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs pa rang (30) stobs kyis 'grel pa'i lam srol so sor gsungs pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rgyal po stobs ldan gyi shing rta'i stobs kyi 'jig rten tha mal pa la grags pa'i lam srol gsar du btod pa bzhin no// gsum pa rgyan gyi dgongs 'grel byung tshul la/ 'bum dang sbyar ba'i/ nyi khri dang sbyar ba'i/ brgyad stong pa dang sbyar ba'i/ sdud pa dang sbyar ba'i/ rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum ka dang sbyar ba'i rnam bshad dang lnga/ dang po la/ dpa' bo dang 'dangs bkra se nas mdzad pa'i rnam bshad/ dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i gnod 'joms gzhung 'grel/ gnod 'joms che ba/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mdzad/

ces grags pa dang bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ thogs med kyi de nyid rnam nges/ dbyig gnyen gyis gzhung 'grel/ 'phags grol gyi nyi khri snang ba/ btsun grol gyi nyi khri rnam 'grel/ shān+ti pa'i dag ldan/ slob dpon gyi (31) le brgyad dam drug gsum pa la/ slob dpon gyi 'grel chen/ shān+ti pa'i snying po mchog a bha ya'i gnad kyi zla zer dang gsum/ bzhi pa la/ kha che dharma shrīs mdzad pa'i sdus pa'i lde mig sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi sdud 'grel rtogs dka' ba/ slob dpon gyi sdud 'grel rtogs sla ba dang gsum/ lnga pa ni/ 'grel pa don gsal lo// 'di'i 'grel bshad la/ chos bshes/ gser gling pa/ sher 'byung blo gros/ kha che gzhon nu dpal gyi mdzad pa'i 'grel bshad du ma yod do// de dag gi nang nas 'dir bka'i dbang du byas na sher phyin gyi mdo/ bstan bcos kyi dbang du byas na mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan/ 'grel pa'i dbang du byas na 'grel pa don gsal/ 'grel bshad rnams kyi legs pa'i cha rnams ni 'dir bshad par bya ba'i dam chos yin no// gnyis pa rtogs (32) pa'i dam chos la/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ spangs rtogs gang rung gis bsdus pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan/ gnyis pa la/ rtogs pa dngos dang*/ rtogs pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i dam chos gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg pa gsum gyi lam lnga gsum bco lnga dang*/ lam ma zhugs kyi bslab pa rin po che gsum lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ lam bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i 'gog bden lta bu'o// gsum pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ cung zad phye ste bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lung gi dam chos thos bsam gyi sgo nas 'dzin pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i dam chos nyams len gyi sgo nas bsgrub pa yod pa de srid du dam pa'i chos gnas te/ mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis de// lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do// de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang*// bsgrub par byed pa kho na yin// zhes so// gnyis

(33) pa la/ spyir bstan pa gnas pa'i yun tshad/ sngar 'das pa'i dus/ ma 'ongs pa na gnas pa'i yun tshad ngos bzung ba'o// dang po la/ ston pa 'dzam bu'i gling du byon tshul/ dka' ba spyad nas byang chub brnyed tshul/ byang chub brnyed nas chos 'khor bskor tshul/ de'i rjes su bstan pa gnas tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ ston pa 'di sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol du bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phangs brnyed du zin kyang*/ sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje'i shugs kyis rab byung gi lo/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nam phyed la/ glang po che'i gzugs kyi yum gyi blo g.yas nas zhugs te/ zla ba bcu rdzogs par yum gyi lhums su gnas nas/ rnam byung gi lo sa pho 'brug gi dbo'i zla ba'i yar tshes bcu'i nyin rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i tshe/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu med (34) pa dang bcas ste/ bkra shis lum bhi'i tshal du sku bltams pa yin te/ rgya cher rol pa las/ dge slong des de ltar dgun 'das te/ dpyid kyi dus dpyi zla tha chung gi tshe/ skar ma sa ga la bab pa'i dus kyi dam pa la/ shing rnams kyi lo ma rgyas shing drang dro dang mun pa dang rdul med cing*/ sa gzhi sngo gzhon nu skyes pas khyab par gnas pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gtso bo/ 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod par 'os pa'i dus la bab pa'i tshod la rnam par gzigs nas/ tshes bco lnga zla ba nya ba'i dus su/ yum gso sbyong blangs pa'i rum du/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa nas 'phos te/ zhes dang*/ de ltar zla ba bcu tshang nas/ ma'i blo g.yas pa nas dran shes bzhin du mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par byung ste/ zhes bshad/ de yang mdo 'dis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i dus/ lhums su (35) 'jug pa'i dus/ sku bltams pa'i dus/ gsum bstan te/ dge slong dag de ltar dgun 'das te/ zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gtso bo/

'jig rten gsum gyis mchod par 'os pa'i dus la bab pa'i tshod la rnam par gzigs nas/ zhes pa'i bar gyis dang po bstan/ tshes bco lnga zhes pa nas/ 'pho ste zhes pa'i bar gyis gnyis pa bstan/ de ltar zhes sogs kyi/ gsum pa bstan/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog las/ 'dren pa khyod ni rgyal la skyes// zhes so// gal te yum gyi lhums su zla ba bcu rdzogs par gnas pa mi 'thad de/ sa ga'i bco lnga nas/ dbo'i tshes bcu'i bar la zhag lnga ma tshang ba'i phyir/ zhe na skyon med de/ chu stod/ khrums smad/ smin drug rgyal/ dbo'i zhag mi thub kyi/ zhag lnga kha skong du yod pa'i phyir ro// 'o na/ gzhung dam pa las/ (36) dpyid zla tha chung la sku bltams par bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ skyon med de/ lhums su zhugs pa la sku bltams pa'i ming btags pa'i phyir gzhan du na zla ba bcu gnyis mngal du gnas par 'gyur te/ sa ga'i zla ba la lhums su zhugs par bshad cing*/ de'i lo phyi ma'i sa ga la sku bltams pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du 'jig rten spyod pas gzhan don mdzad de/ gdong ngan zhes bya ba me pho spre'u'i lo/ mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du rab tu byung nas/ rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams kyis byang chub grub pa la dka' spyad tshad med pa dang du blangs dgos par shes pa'i phyir du lo drug tu dka' ba spyad pa'i tshul bstan/ sum cu rtsa lnga pa dge byed kyi lo chu pho stag gi sa ga'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs kyi cha la bla med byang chub brnyed pa'i tshul bstan pa yin te/ lung gzhi las/ byang chub sems dpa' lo nyi shu rtsa dgu lon nas lo drug tu dka' ba spyod

(37) par 'gyur te/ de nas bdud rtsi rtogs par mthong ngo*// zhes dang*/ mngon par byang chub pa'i mdo las/ nam gyi thun tha ma la/ zag pa zad pa'i shes pa mngon du byas so// zhes dang*/ 'grel chen dri med 'od las/ 'phags pa'i yul 'dir dkar po'i tshes gcig la sogs pa bco lnga'i mthar nag po'i tshes gcig la 'jug pa sa ga'i nya'i skya rengs 'char ba'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ zhes so// gsum pa ni/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du tha mal pa'i ngor chos ma gsung pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ de nas chu stod zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bzhi la/ lnga sde bzang po la chos gsungs pa nas brtsams te/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i bar du rim pa gsum gyi chos 'khor rgyun mi chad par bskor te/ dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa'i tshe/ thams cad 'dul zhes bya (38) ba'i lo/ me pho phag gi sa ga'i tshes bco lnga la mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan te/ myang 'das chen po las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong bye ba phrag brgyad cus bskor cing mdun gyis blta ste/ dpyid zla tha chung gi nya'i nang par yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus dang nye bar gyur pa na/ zhes dang*/ mngon par bye brag tu bshad pa las/ chos 'khor gnas dang yangs pa can// sa dkar can dang lha yi gnas// byis pa gsod dang ko'u sham+bhi// 'brog gnas mchod rten ri dang ni// 'od ma'i grong dang yangs bcas dang*// ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer te// de rnams su ni thub pa yis// skyes mchog lo re lo re bzhugs// nyi shu rtsa gsum mnyan yod du// sman gyi nags su lo bzhi ste// 'bar ba'i phug gi gnas su dang*// rgyal po'i khab kyi grong du lnga// dka' ba spyad pa lo drug ste// nyi shu rtsa dgu khab tu gnas// rgyal ba de ltar brgyad cu la// thub mchog dam (39) pa mya ngan 'das// zhes so// kha che paṇa chen ltar na/

smin drug gi tshes brgyad kyi nam phyed la mya ngan las 'das par bzhed de/ smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes kyi// tshes brgyad nam gung mnyam pa la// zla ba ri bo la nub tshe// thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ spyir ston pa mya ngan las 'das rjes/ dgra bcom/ phyir mi 'ong*/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu la gtso bor spyod pa/ 'bras bu'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum/ shes rab/ ting nge 'dzin/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la gtso bor spyod pa bsgrub pa'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum/ mngon pa/ mdo sde/ 'dul ba'i sde snod la gtso bor spyod pa/ lung gi dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rnal mar med kyang*/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs tsam yod pa/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i lnga brgya pa phrag (40) gcig ste/ lnga brgya pa phrag bcur gnas pa yin no// dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i gnod 'joms las/ stong phrag re re la phyed phyed du bcad pas lnga brgya pa phrag bcu la le'u bcur 'gyur te/ de la lnga brgya pa dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa rnams la rim pa ltar/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ba dang*/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i le'u zhes bya ste/ khong du chud pa'i le'u gsum dang*/ de nas lnga brgya pa bzhi pa dang*/ lnga pa dang*/ drug pa rnams la rim pa ltar/ lhag mthong dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa mang du 'byung bas/ lhag mthong gi le'u dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u dang*/ tshul khrims kyi le'u zhes bya ste/ bsgrub pa'i dus kyi le'u gsum dang*/ de nas lnga brgya pa bdun pa dang*/ brgyad pa dang*/ dgu pa la rim pa ltar/ chos mngon pa dang*/ mdo sde dang*/ 'dul ba ston pa mang du 'byung bas/ mngon (41) pa'i le'u dang*/ mdo sde'i le'u dang*/ 'dul ba'i le'u zhes bya ste/ lung gi le'u gsum dang*/ de nas lnga brgya pa bcu pa ni/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags tsam las lta spyod rnal ma dang mi ldan pas rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i le'u zhes bya ste/

'di nyid la lnga brgya pa tha ma zhes bya'o// zhes so// 'o na/ mdo gzhan las/ lo stong lnga brgya dang*/ stong la sogs par gnas par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ de dag ni don gzhan la dgongs pa'i drang don dgongs pa can yin pas so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba zhes bya ba shing pho rta'i lo yan chad la 'bras bu'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum/ bsgrub pa'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum/ mngon pa'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gcig mdo sde'i dus kyi brgya dang bdun ste/ sum stong drug brgya dang bdun ni sngar 'das pa'i dus yin te/ 'dzin byed kyi lo me pho (42) byi ba la sa skya paṇa chen gyi bstan rtsis mdzad dus sum stong sum brgya zhe dgu 'das par bshad/ de'i rjes su 'phags pas/ dbang phyug gi lo me mo glang la bstan rtsis mdzad dus sum stong bzhi brgya dang bcu 'das par bshad/ de nas shing pho rta'i lo'i bar la brgya dang go bdun 'das pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ mdo sde'i dus kyi bzhi brgya pa dang gsum/ 'dul ba'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gcig rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gcig ste/ chig stong sum brgya dgu cu rtsa gsum ni da phyin chad gnas pa'i bstan pa'i dus yin par sa skya pa gong ma rnams bzhed pa yin no// 'di dag gi steng nas/ shing pho rta nas/ lcags mo bya'i bar la lo nyer brgyad 'das pa yin par shes par bya'o// gnyis pa de la bshad nyan gyi sgo nas 'jug tshul la/ 'chad pa po slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ nyan pa po slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ slob dpon gyis (43) chos 'chad tshul/ slob mas chos nyan tshul/ bshad nyan byas pa'i phan yon dang lnga/ dang po ni/ mdo/ rgyud/ bstan bcos rnams las bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshad kyang*/ mkhas pa'i shes rab/ brtse ba'i bsam pa/ sbyor ba bzod pa gsum dang ldan pa'i dge bshes so// mkhas pa'i shes rab ni/ bshad bya don la mkhas pa/

'chad byed tshig la mkhas pa/ ji ltar du 'chad pa'i tshul la mkhas pa'o// brtse ba'i bsam pa ni/ spyir sems can la phan 'dod/ khyad par gang bshad bya'i slob ma la phan 'dod kyi bsam pa yod pa'o// sbyor ba bzod ldan ni/ phyir rgol gyis rtsod par bzod pa/ slob mas dri bar bzod pa/ chos 'chad pa'i bka' spyad la sran bzod pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ nga rgyal med pa'i gus pa/ brjod don rtogs pa'i shes rab/ don gnyer (44) gyi 'dun pa gsum dang ldan pa'i skyes bu ste/ bzhi brgya pa las/ zur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba// nyan po snod ces bya bar bshad// ces so// gsum pa la/ mdo 'chad pa'i tshul dang*/ mdo bstan bcos thun mong du 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i sgo nas 'chad de/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ 'khor/ ston pa/ gnas/ chos phun sum tshogs pa dang lnga'o// gnyis pa ni/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ gzhung dang sbyar tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ kun btus su/ rnam par bshad pa'i sgo drug dang*/ bcu bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad tshul gsungs pa/ snga rabs pa rnams kyis gleng gzhi brjod pa/ dgos pa brjod pa/ don gyi khog phub pa/ dkyus kyi sa bcad pa/ tshig gi 'bru gnyer ba ste/ 'chad tshul rnam pa lnga gsungs/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ 'chad thabs kyi man ngag rnam pa (45) lnga'i sgo nas mdo bstan bcos 'chad par bshad de/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ gang zhig bdag las blo dman zhing*// mdo rnams 'chad 'dod de dag la// man ngag cung zhig sbyin par bya// mdo don smra ba dag gis ni// dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang*// tshig don bcas shing mtshams sbyar bcas// rgal lan bcas te snyad par byas// zhes so// de yang nyan pa po mdo dang bstan bcos kyi tshig don la gus pa'i sgo nas gtso bor 'jug pa'i ched du dgos don dang por bstan pa yin te/ mdo don che ba nyid mthong zhing*// nyan pa dang ni 'dzin pa la// nyan pa po de gus byed pas// thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa la bstan bcos rtsa ba dang sbyar ba dang*/

'grel pa don gsal dang sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'di yang dgos don (46) sogs 'chad thabs kyi man ngag rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas gsungs pa yin te/ rgyan las gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dgos pa yod tshul sogs kyi/ dgos 'grel gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// zhes sogs kyi sh+lau ka gnyis/ rgyan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo bsdu na/ dngos brgyad don bdun bcur 'dus so// zhes bsdus don 'chad pa ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// zhes sogs sh+lau ka bco lnga/ don bdun bcu'i tshig don zhib tu gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// zhes pa nas/ chos kyi sku yi 'phrin las ni// rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed// ces pa'i bar ro// rgal lan dang 'tshams sbyar ni/ gzhung gi gseb tshags kyi tshul du gnas te/ de yang*/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir// zhes sogs kyi rtsod pa bkod nas/ brten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis// zhes sogs lan gsungs (47) pa lta bu ste/ rtsod lan gyi gzhung ji snyed yod pa rnams so// 'tshams sbyar ni/ de nas thams cad shes pa nyid// de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i// zhes sogs/ gzhung snga phyi'i 'tshams sbyor bar byed pa'i tshig rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ 'grel pa don gsal 'dis/ rgyan gyi sh+lau ka re re 'chad thabs kyi man ngag lnga lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa bzhed de/ mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di 'chad thabs kyi man ngag lnga'i sgo nas bshad cing*/ des lhag ma rnams kyang mtshon par byed pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni/ skyon gsum spangs/ 'du shes drug bstan/ kun spyod rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas chos nyan dgos pa yin no// skyon gsum ni/ dang por/ gsung rab kyi don la rna ba ma gtad pa snod kha sbub lta bu'i skyon/ bar du dran shes kyis mi skyod pa snod zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon// mthar chags sdang kun dkris kyis

(48) zin pa snod dri ma can lta bu'i skyon no// 'du shes drug ni/ chos 'chad pa'i dge bshes la sman pa lta bu'i 'du shes/ rang la nad pa lta bu'i 'du shes/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes/ chos nyan pa la sman bsten pa'i 'du shes/ de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu chen po'i 'du shes/ tshul 'di la brten nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas par 'dod pa'i 'du shes so// kun spyod ni/ skyes rabs las/ rab tu dman pa'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rnam par skyed// dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta// tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin// gus par skyed de rtse gcig btud// rab tu dad la dri med yid// nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan bzhin// rim 'gro skyed la chos nyon cig /ces so// lnga pa la/ chos nyan pa dang bshad pa'i phan yon gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur// (49) thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur// thos pas don ma yin pa spong*// thos pas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob// ces dang*/ skyes rabs las/ thos pas gti mug kun sel sgron me yin// rkun po la sogs me 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin// thabs tshul man ngag ston pa grogs kyi mchog /ces sogs rgyas par bshad do// gnyis pa la/ sangs rgyas la mchod pa bla na med par 'gyur ba'i/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gzhan zil gyis gnon pa'i/ tshe rabs dran pa'i/ mthar thug bla med byang chub brnyed par 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ mdo las/ gang la phan phyir nga yi chos// tshul bzhin bstan pas mchod 'gyur gyi// me tog byugs pa mar me yis// rgyal ba yang dag mchod ma yin// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi (50) khams rin po che sna bdun gyis yongs su bkang ste/ kun slong dad pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas de bzhin gshegs pa la phul ba'i bsod nams las/

kun slong rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam gzhan la bshad pa bsod nams che bar gsungs te/ mdo las/ gang gis gang gi ji snyed sangs rgyas shing*// rin chen bdun gyis yongs su bkang byas nas// dga' rab sems kyi rgyal la phul ba bas// gang gis sems can gcig la tshigs bcad sbyin// rin chen sbyin pa shin tu rgya che des// tshigs bcad sbyin pa snying rjes sgrub de la// char yang mi phod grangs su'ang ma yin na// gnyis dang gsum du bsam du ga la yod// ces so// gsum pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ chos kyi ched dang de bzhin du// gzhung gi don rnams ston pa dang*// chos kyi sbyin pa dri med pas// tshe rabs dran pa thob par 'gyur// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ (51) dang por/ mngon par rtogs pa 'phel bas rang gi rgyud tshim/ bar du snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs kun tu khyab par byed/ tha mar bstan pa bsrung bas chos kyi rgyal po thob par 'gyur ba ni/ chos bshad pa'i phan yon yin no// gsum pa bshad pa rang gi ngo bo la/ rgyan gyi bshad pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag bshad pa nye bar 'god pa/ bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// zhes sogs sh+lau ka brgyad/ 'di la gzhung gi 'grel dang*/ so so'i bka' rnams la khyad par gnyis/ dang po la/ mkhas pa snga ma'i lugs brjod pa dang*/ rang lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gser gling pas btang snyoms kyi bshad pa/ 'bum phrag gsum pa lo chen dang bcas pa'i 'jam po'i bshad pa/ sher 'byung blo gros kyi rtsub mo'i bshad pa mdzad tshul dang gsum/ (52) dang po ni/ gser gling pa'i 'grel par/ sh+lau ka brgyad pa'i don 'chad pa la/ mchod pa brjod pa/ bshad pa'i rnam grangs bkod pa/ rang nyid kyi shes rab kyi che ba ston pa/ mkhas pa gzhan gyis kyang 'grel pa rtsom par rigs pa/ khengs skyungs te 'grel pa rtsom pa la spro ba skyes pa dang lnga ni/

sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ bzhi dang*/ re res rim gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam par dbye/ zhes pa la 'phros nas/ seng ge bzang pos rgyan gyi 'grel pa rtsom pa yin na/ yum don mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rtsom pa yin nam/ bla ma snga ma'i man ngag la brten nas rtsom pa yin zhe na/ phyi ma ltar yin no zhes 'chad pa la/ 'grel chags pas kun chags mdzad/ ces sogs kyi gzhung rnams 'byung bar bzhed/ gsum pa ni/ rnam par dbye zhes pa la 'phros nas rgyan la slob dpon snga mas mdzad pa'i (53) 'grel pa yod dam med/ yod na bzlos skyon yod cing*/ med na rang bzo'i skyon yod do zhe na/ thogs med sogs kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yod pas/ rang bzo'i skyon med zhes 'chad pa la sh+lau ka bzhi byung*/ snga ma'i 'grel pa yod kyang de dag dang bzlos pa'i skyon med de/ 'grel pa snga ma rnams kyis rgyan gyis dgongs pa 'grel pa la/ ma rtog log rtog the tshom rmongs pa'i dri ma sel ma nus la/ 'grel pa don gsal 'di/ 'grel pa gzhan rnams las ya mtshan che ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa ni/ de ltar zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum gyis bstan/ de yang thogs med kyi 'grel pa la ma rtogs pa'i skyon yod de/ mkhyen gsum yan chad la bshad pa mdzad/ sbyor bzhi man chad la bshad pa ma mdzad pa'i phyir/ dbyig gnyen gyi 'grel pa la log rtog gi skyon yod de/ rgyan

(54) gyi dgongs pa dbu mar gnas pa sems tsam du bkral ba'i phyir/ 'phags grol gyi 'grel pa la/ the tshom gyi dri ma sel ma nus pa'i skyon yod do// sangs rgyas kyi sa na sems bskyed med pa dang*/ sku gsum du grangs nges par bshad pa'i phyir/ btsun grol gyi 'grel pa la rmongs pa'i dri ma sel ma nus pa'i skyon yod de/ rgyan gyi tshig don mtha' dag ma rnyed bzhin du rgyan la 'grel pa mdzad pa'i phyir// zhes bzhed/ rang lugs la/ sh+lau ka brgyad kyi don bsdu na/ mchod par brjod cing*/ rtsom pa dam bca' ba/ rgyan gyi bshad pa'i rnam grangs bkod pa/ 'grel pa ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul dang gsum du 'dus par ṭīk+ka las bshad/ de yang cung zad bshad na/ rgyan gyi 'grel pa rtsom pa'i bar chad zhi ba'i phyir du/ gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gsum la mchod par brjod pa 'chad pa ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa (55) la// gus phyag 'tshal/ zhes pas bstan/ yul khyad par can la mchod par brjod nas/ las su bya ba ci byed snyam na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan de nyid rgyas 'bring bsdus pa kun gyi rgyan du shes par bya ba'i phyir du/ 'grel pa rtsom par dam bca' 'chad pa ni/ shes rab/ ces pa nas/ rnam par dbye/ zhes pa'i bar ro// mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rgyas 'bring bsdus pa kun gyi rgyan du shes par bya ba'i phyir du 'grel pa rtsom na/ tshul ci ltar rtsom snyam na/ spyir bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu la/ bla ma snga ma'i man ngag rgyun ma chad pa'i sgo nas yid ches pa'i dad pa dang*/ bstan bcos kyi tshig don rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis dgos/ slob dpon 'di nyid la yang thogs med sogs kyi man ngag rgyun ma chad pa'i sgo nas/ yid ches pa'i dad pa yod tshul 'chad pa ni/ 'grol/ zhes sogs (56) sh+lau ka bzhi'o// de dag bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas bstan bcos kyi tshig don rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'grel pa don gsal 'di nyid mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum ka dang sbyar ba'i rnam bshad yin pas na/

'grel pa gzhan rnams las ya mtshan che ba yin no// zhes 'chad pa ni/ de ltar zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig rgyu de gnyis dang ldan mkhas pa gzhan rnams kyis kyang 'grel pa rtsom rigs so zhes 'chad pa ni/ de ltas zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig yum don blo'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa'i sgo nas 'grel pa rtsom yin snyam na/ nges don la de ltar yin kyang gzhan ngor khengs skyungs nas yum don blo'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul ma yin kyang*/ rang gzhan la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir du/ 'grel pa rtsom pa la spro ba skye tshul 'chad pa ni/ rnam pa kun tu zhes sogs (57) sh+lau ka gcig gnyis pa gzhung so so'i dka' gnas la khyad par 'chad pa ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// zhes sogs kyis skabs su/ mtha' dpyad pa dang*/ ngag don gnyis/ dang po la/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi dgos sogs chos bzhi ngos bzung ba/ gzhung las bstan tshul/ 'phros don gzhan bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ don gsal gyi brjod bya/ gnas skabs kyi dgos pa/ nying dgos/ 'grel pa dang bzhi/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi bshad byar gyur pa'i tshig don gang rung gis bsdus pa'i chos/ dbye na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan lta bu/ tshig gi brjod bya dang*/ dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa lta bu don gyi brjod bya gnyis so// 'grel pa don gsal la thos bsam byas pa la brten nas thob pa'i gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid (58) mtshan gzhi 'grel pa don gsal la thos bsam byas pa la brten nas dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa bde blag tu rtogs pa'i shes rab lta bu'o// 'grel pa don gsal la thos bsam byas pa la brten nas thob pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ 'grel pa don gsal la thos bsam byas pa la brten nas thob pa'i rnam mkhyen lta bu'o// 'grel pa don gsal gyis phan btags pa'i stobs kyis de'i nying dgos de las 'byung dgos pa ni/

de'i nying dgos de la 'brel ba'i mtshan nyid/ rigs 'dra'i dpe ni/ du ba me la 'brel ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// zhes pas brjod bya dang*/ nying dgos bstan/ rnam par dbye zhes pas dgos pa bstan/ 'brel ba shugs bstan la gnas pa yin no// gsum pa la/ kha cig shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// gus phyag 'tshal/ zhes pa'i skabs nas (59) bstan pa'i sher phyin de 'bras bu'i sher phyin kho na yin la/ kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur ba ni rnam par dbye// zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i sher phyin de gzhung sher phyin kho na la byed zer ba mi 'thad de/ 'bras bu sher phyin kho na 'grel pa don gsal gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo yin pa thal/ 'dir bstan gyis bstod yul gyi sher phyin de 'bras bu sher phyin kho na la byed rigs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'dir bstan pa'i mchod brjod ni/ bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan de gzhung sher phyin kho na'i gsal byed du shes pa'i phyir du 'grel pa don gsal brtsams par thal/ rnam par dbye/ zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i sher phyin de gzhung sher phyin kho na la byed rigs pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gsum ka'i gsal byed du shes pa'i phyir (60) du 'grel pa don gsal brtsams pa'i phyir ro// rang lugs ni/ mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' gnyis ka'i skabs nas bstan pa'i sher phyin la gzhung lam 'bras bu'i/ sher phyin gsum ka yod de/ 'dir bstan gyi mchod brjod ni/ bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya dang mthun pa'i mchod yin cing*/ gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gsum ka yang rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i brjod bya yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos bstan bcos rtsom pa'i thog mar/

mchod brjod dang*/ rtsom par dam bca' mdzad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i ched yod yin pa'i phyir/ 'gro la chags pas kun chags mdzad// ces skabs su gnyis kyi dang po la/ bstan bcos spyi'i mtha' dpyad pa/ 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos chen po ngos bzung ba/ zhar byung gi don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po gong (61) du bshad zin/ gnyis pa la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po la/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri nas/ 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos chen po mdo kho na yin te/ thogs med kyi nyi khri de nyid rnam nges rgyan dang ma sbyar bar mdo kho na'i 'grel pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer ro// dar ṭīka pa yang de dang mthun par bzhed de/ dar ṭīka pas/ sgra bshad du yod pas na bstan bcos chen po ste/ mdo'o// zhes zer ba mi 'thad de/ 'dir bstan gyi sh+lau ka bzhi po de rgyan gyi 'grel pa rtsom par dam bca' ba la 'phros nas rgyan gyi bshad pa'i na yams bkod pa'i gzhung ma yin pa thal/ nyi khri de nyid rnam nges de mngon rtogs rgyan nyi khri dang sbyar ba'i 'grel pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ nyi khri kho na'i rnam bshad yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ mkhas pa rnams kyis dbye ba'i rigs/ zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i dbye ba'i (62) rigs rgyu'i bstan bcos dang*/ phan gdags 'dod pas spro ba skyes// zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i spro ba skye/ rgyu'i bstan bcos mdo kho na la byed rigs par 'gyur ro// kha cig 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos chen po rgyan kho na la byed rigs te/ gser gling pas/ mdo'i don ma lus pa sdud par byed pas na bstan bcos chen po ste/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig ṭī ka'i dgongs pa yang 'di kho na ltar yin te/ ṭī ka las/ gang dag 'di'i bstan bcos mdo nyid la 'dod pa ni dgongs pa ma yin te/

'og gi bstan bcos zhes 'byung ba mngon rtogs rgyan yin cing*/ 'di yang de dang don gcig pa'i phyir/ zer ba mi 'thad de/ nyi khri de nyid rnam nges mngon rtogs rgyan kho na'i rnam bshad du thal/ 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos chen po de mngon rtogs rgyan kho na la byed rigs pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ ṭī ka'i (63) dgongs pa 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos chen po mdo kho na la byed rigs par yin te/ bstan bcos chen po ngos 'dzin pa'i skabs su/ gang gi rnam bshad mdzad ce na// bstan bcos chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan mdo dang bcas pa'o// zhes gsungs/ ṭī ka'i lung snga ma'i don ni/ 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos chen po mdo kho na yin pa 'gog pa yin te/ gang dag 'di'i bstan bcos mdo nyid la dgongs pa ma yin te/ zhes pa'i nyid ces pa ni kho na la 'jug pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ de yang*/ ṭī ka las/ ji ltar shes ce na/ sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis/ mdo dang bstan bcos sbyar ba'i 'grel pa mdzad tshul smros nas/ de dag gi rjes su 'brang ste/ rang nyid kyang mdo dang bstan bcos sbyar ba'i 'grel pa byed par don gyi 'phangs pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos chen (64) po sher phyin gyi mdo dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan gnyis ka la byed rigs te/ 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos chen po ni/ nyi khri de nyid rnam nges kyi bshad byar gyur pa'i gsung rab yin la/ de nyid la sher phyin gyi mdo dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir te/ nyi khri de nyid rnam nges de mngon rtogs rgyan sher phyin gyi mdo dang sbyar ba'i rnam bshad yin pa'i phyir/ gser gling pa'i sngar bshad pa'i lung de nyid dang*/ chos bshes kyis/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ni/ 'chos skyob kyi byed pa can yin pas na/ bstan bcos chen po zhes dang*/

ṭī ka las/ gang gi rnam bshad mdzad ce na// bstan bcos chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan mdo dang bcas pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa la/ sher phyin gyi mdo chos can/ bstan bcos chen po yin par thal/ 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos chen po yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ 'phags pa thogs (65) med kyi thugs rgyud kyi snying rje chos can/ chags pa thal/ 'gro la chags pas kun chags mdzad// ces pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i chags pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ gzhung 'di thogs med kyi brtse ba'i yon tan 'chad byed ma yin pa thal lo// gsum pa la/ 'dir bstan gyi slob dpon bzhi dang*/ byams pa'i chos lnga dbu sems gang yin dpyad pa la/ mkhan chen pa na re/ 'dir bstan gyi slob dpon bzhi po dbu ma pa dang*/ byams chos lnga dbu ma'i bstan bcos su bzhed cing*/ mkhas pa red mda' ba na re/ slob dpon bzhi ka yang sems tsam pa dang*/ byams pa'i chos lnga yang sems tsam pa'i bstan bcos su bzhed/ gnyis ka mi 'thad de/ dbyig gnyen gyis rgyan gyi dgongs pa sems tsam du bkral ba mi 'thad par thal ba dang*/ dbu mar bkral ba yin par thal/ de dbu ma pa yin cing*/ rgyan gyi dgongs pa (66) dbu mar gnas pa'i phyir/ mdo sde rgyan du/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub pa drang don dgongs pa can yin pa dang*/ rigs chad kyi sems can yod par bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ de dbu ma'i bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ kha cig dag ni drang phyir dang*// zhes sogs dang*/ dkar po dman pa yod pa rgyu dang bral// zhes pa rang 'gal lo// lugs gnyis pa la/ thogs med dang*/ 'phags grol btsun grol gsum po de stong nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i gang zag ma yin par thal/ de gsum dbu ma'i lta ba rang rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag ma yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang*/ rgyud blar/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i shes pas chos nyid sangs rgyas kyi rigs su bshad pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rigs can du bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/

de gnyis sems tsam pa'i bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir/ (67) 'dod na/ bsgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*// zhes pa dang*/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*// de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*// rigs yod phyir na lus can kun// rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal/ rang lugs ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen sems tsam pa yin te/ des rang lugs su brtsams pa'i bstan bcos yin na/ sems tsam gyi bstan bcos yin dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na/ pra ka ra na sde brgyad bzhin no// ṭī ka dang*/ bla ma'i gsung rgyun de ltar yin pas shin tu legs mod/ 'on kyang*/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen la gnas skabs gsum yod de/ dang por/ mdzod rang 'grel dang bcas pa rtsom pa'i gnas skabs su/ mdo sde pa/ pra ka ra na sde brgyad rtsom pa'i gnas skabs su/ sems tsam pa/ phyis grub chen (68) brgyad cu'i nang tshan du bshad pas/ dbu ma par khas blangs kyang mi rigs pa med dam snyam mo// slob dpon gzhan gsum dbu ma pa yin te/ stong nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i lta ba rang rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ dang po gnyis kyis theg chen gyi mthong lam rang rgyud la thob cing*/ btsun grol theg chen gyi tshogs lam la gnas pa'i gang zag tu bshad pa'i phyir ro// rgyan dang rgyud bla dbu ma'i bstan bcos yin te/ der sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rigs can du gsungs pa dang*/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub pa dang*/ chos thams cad bden med spros bral du gsungs pa'i phyir/ mdo sde rgyan sems tsam gyi bstan bcos yin te/ der gzhi'i dus su chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par ston pa'i lam gyi dus su mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa ston pa'i/ 'bras bu'i dus su mthar thug theg pa gcig tu ston pa'i mdo rnams drang don (69) du bshad pa'i phyir/

rigs chad kyi sems can yang yod par gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'byed gnyis kyang sems tsam gyi bstan bcos su grub ste/ mdo sde rgyan gyi don bsdus nas 'chad pa ni dbus mtha'/ de'i don bsdus nas 'chad pa ni chos nyid rnam 'byed yin pa'i phyir/ yang na/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig de ltar bzhed kyang*/ mdo sde rgyan du/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub pa sogs/ drang don du bshad pa ni/ sems tsam pa dbu ma'i lta ba la kha drang pa'i phyir/ bkod pa yin la/ nges don yin lugs la/ mkhan chen pa'i bzhed pa ltar/ byams pa'i chos lnga car gyi dgongs pa dbu mar gnas pa legs so// gnyis pa bshad pa nye bar dgod pa la/ gus pas 'jug pa'i yan lag mchod brjod/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos 'grel/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya (70) mngon rtogs bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ gzhung spyi'i 'grel dang*/ so so'i dka' gnas la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di 'tshams sbyar sogs 'chad thabs kyi man ngag lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa yin cing*/ 'tshams sbyar la/ rgyu mtshan gyi dgos pa'i/ rtsod pa'i/ dri lan gyis snga 'grel gyi sgo nas 'tshams sbyar ba sogs du ma yod pa'i nang nas 'di dgos pa'i 'tshams sbyar ba yin no// 'o na rgyan rtsom pa'i thog mar/ spyir yul khyad par can la mchod par brjod pa la dgos pa ci yod/ bye brag mkhyen gsum la mchod par brjod pa la dgos pa ci yod snyam na/ 'phags pa byams pa rang nyid skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par rtogs nas/ des brtsams pa'i bstan bcos la gdul bya gzhan thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas 'jug pa'i ched du mchod par brjod pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa ni/ 'phags pa byams

(71) pa zhes sogs kyis bstan/ mkhyen pa gsum gyis mtshon pa'i dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa rgyan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bor rtogs nas rgyan gyi gdul bya yul mkhyen pa gsum la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis zhugs te/ mthar 'bras bu rnams mkhyen thob pa'i phyir du/ bye brag mkhyen gsum la mchod par brjod pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa ni/ gzhan dag ces sogs so// mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di'i don bsdu na/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi spangs rtogs mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi yon tan brjod byar 'dus pa yin no// zhes bsdus don 'chad pa ni/ 'dis ni/ zhes sogs so// mchod brjod kyi tshigs bcad 'di la brten nas rgyan gyi gdul bya dbang rtul myur du mkhyen gsum la dang ba skye ba dang*/ dbang gnon mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don sgrub tshul gyi rgyu mtshan mthong ba la (72) brten nas yum la dad pa skye ba dngos kyi dgos pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa ni/ re shig ces sogs so// de ltar dad pa la brten nas gus/ gus pa la brten nas zhugs/ zhugs pa la brten nas legs pa'i mchog thob par 'gyur ba rgyud pa'am mthar thug gi dgos pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa ni/ de la zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de rnams kyi don bsdu ba ni/ de'i phyir/ zhes sogs so// gal te mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di la bstod grangs nyung ba'i skyon yod de/ 'dir mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka la bstod pa skabs su bab pa gang zhig 'dir mkhyen gsum kho na la bstod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ brgyad ka rgyan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo yin cing*/ 'dir bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod yin pa'i phyir snyam na/ skyon med de/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bsdus (73) pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi mkhyen gsum la bstod pas mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka la bstod par 'gyur ba'i phyir/

zhes dogs gcod kyi sgo nas mkhyen gsum la bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan 'chad pa ni/ de la zhes sogs so// tshig don la bstod pa dang phyag 'tshal ba gnyis/ dang po la/ gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen la bstod pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ rten gyi gang zag thabs gzhi shes/ 'bras bu myang 'das gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad pa yin la/ 'di dag la/ bshad bya'i mdo drang ba dang*/ dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dang sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdo las/ dge slong lnga stong tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs gcig ste/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang du gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu (74) rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed par byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rab tu thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba/ yongs su zad pa/ bka' yang dag pas/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems kyi dbang thams cad la/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob pa sha stag ste/ gang zag gcig ma gtogs pa ni 'di ltar slob pa/ rgyun du zhugs pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo'o// dge slong ma grags 'dzin dang*/ skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo la sogs pa lnga brgya tsam dang*/ dge bsnyen pha dang*/ dge bsnyen ma shin tu mang ba kun kyang chos mthong ba sha stag dang*/ ces so// dang po rten gyi gang zag 'chad pa ni/ de yang*/ dge slong lnga stong tsam gyi zhes pa nas thabs gcig ste zhes pa'i bar gyis/ grangs kyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ dge slong ma zhes pa nas/ chos mthong ba sha stag dang zhes pa'i bar gyis (75) nang tshan gyi dbye ba cung zad bshad/ gnyis pa/ de nyid bstan bcos rtsa bar 'chad pa ni/ nyan thos zhes sogs so// de'i don 'grel pas 'chad pa ni/ nyan thos dang zhes pa nas/ mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pa rnams zhes pa'i bar ro// 'bras bu myang 'das 'chad pa la/ mdo las/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zhes nas/

chos mthong ba sha stag ste/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de'i don rtsa bar 'chad pa/ nyer zhir khrid mdzad gang yin dang*/ de'i don 'grel pas 'chad pa ni/ phung po zhes sogs so// thabs gzhi shes/ mdor sbas don gyi tshul du gnas pa/ bstan bcos su gsal bar byed pa ni/ kun shes nyid/ ces sogs dang*/ gzhi thams cad ces sogs so// gnyis pa lam shes la bstod pa la/ bshad bya'i mdo drang ba dang*/ de nyid bstan bcos dang sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdo las/ byang (76) chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ tshad med grangs med pa thams cad kyang*/ gzungs rab tu thob pa/ ting 'dzin rab tu thob pa/ stong pa nyid kyis rnam par sbyong ba/ mtshan ma med pa'i spyod yul can/ rtog pa med pa'i smon lam dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid kyi bzod pa rab tu thob pa/ thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa/ bstan pa zad mi shes pa la/ so so yang dag par rig pa'i tshul khong du chud pa/ mngon par shes pa chen pos rnam par brtse ba/ mngon par shes pa shin tu ma nyams pa dang*/ mnyan par 'os pa'i tshig dang ldan pa/ le lo med cing*/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa/ lus dang srog la mi lta ba/ tshul 'chos pa med pa/ kha gsag med pa/ grags pa dang*/ khe dang*/ bkur sti'i sems med pa/ zang zing med pa'i chos ston pa/ chos zab mo'i bzod pa dam pa rtogs par khong du chud pa/ mi 'jigs (77) pa chen po thob pa/ yid yongs su zhum pa med pa/ bdud kyi las thams cad yang dag par 'das pa/ zhes pa nas/ ting nge 'dzin brgya stong mngon par sgrub pa la rnam par brtse ba'i ye shes rtogs par bya ba la mkhas pa/ yon tan brjod pa bskal pa mtha' yas par mi zad pa dang ldan pa sha stag dang thabs gcig ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzang skyong dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen 'byung gnas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen snying po dang*/

zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang*/ gzhan yang bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dag dang*/ thabs gcig tu bzhugs so zhes so// gnyis pa la/ rten gyi gang zag thabs lam shes/ 'bras bu 'jig (78) rten gyi don sgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ byang chub sems dpa'/ tshad med grangs med pa/ zhes sogs kyis mdor bstan/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzang skyong*/ zhes sogs kyis rgyas par bshad/ de nyid bstan bcos rtsa ba 'chad pa ni/ 'gro la phan par byed rnams/ mdo bstan bcos gnyis ka'i don 'grel pas 'chad pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs so// gnyis pa mdor sbas don du gnas pa/ bstan bcos su gsal bar 'chad pa ni/ lam shes nyid kyis/ de nyid 'grel pas 'chad pa ni/ lam thams cad ces sogs so// gsum pa/ 'jig rten gyi don sgrub pa'i mdzad pa yon tan dang bcas pa ni/ thams cad kyang gzungs rab tu thob pa zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de nyid bstan bcos rtsa ba 'chad pa ni/ 'jig rten don sgrub ces sogs kyis bstan/ de nyid 'grel (79) pas 'chad pa ni/ 'gro ba mtha' dag zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gsum pa/ rnam mkhyen la bstod pa la/ bshad bya'i mdo drang ba dang*/ de nyid bstan bcos dang sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo las/ de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das nyid gdan seng ge'i khri bshams nas sku drang por bsrang ste/ dgongs pa mngon du bzhag nas/ dkyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs so// der bzhugs nas ting nge 'dzin gang du ting nge 'dzin thams cad 'du ba dang khongs su chud pa dang*/ rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ 'du bar 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba la mnyam par bzhag go /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgongs shing yang dag par mkhyen pas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/

'phrul gyi spyan gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di la rnam par gzigs so// de ltar gzigs nas/ sku (80) thams cad nas 'od zer rab tu bkye ste/ de'i zhabs kyi mthil gnyis kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan pa gnyis las 'od zer bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo*// de bzhin du/ zhabs kyi sor mo bcu las kyang*/ zhabs kyi long bu gnyis/ zhabs byin pa gnyis/ zhabs pus mo gnyis/ zhabs brla gnyis/ sku sta zur gnyis/ sku lte ba'i dkyil 'khor/ sku rtsibs log gnyis/ thugs ka'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dpal gyi be'u/ phyag gi sor mo bcu/ phyag lag ngar gnyis/ sku phrag pa gnyis/ mgur/ tshems mche ba bzhi/ tshems bzhi bcu/ spyan gnyis/ snyan gnyis/ shangs kyi sbubs gnyis/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu/ steng gi spyi gtsug zhal gyi sgo nas kyang 'od zer bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong drug cu byung ste/ 'od zer bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong drug cu po de dag thams cad (81) kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par byas te/ shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so// de bzhin du/ lho phyogs/ nub phyogs/ byang phyogs/ byang shar/ shar lho/ lho nub/ nub byang*/ 'og steng gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams/ gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so// sems can gang gis 'od de mthong ba dang*/ 'od des gang la reg par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to// de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas 'od zer rab tu bkye bar mdzad de/ 'od des kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so// shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams

(82) gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so// de bzhin du/ lho dang*/ nub/ byang*/ byang shar/ shar lho/ lho nub/ nub byang*/ 'og steng gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so// sems can gang gis 'od de mthong ba dang*/ 'od de gang la reg par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to// de nas yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad de/ shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do// de bzhin du/ lho/ nub/ byang*/ byang shar/ shar lho/ lho nub/ nub byang*/ 'og steng gi phyogs su (83) 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do// sems can gang gis 'od de mthong ba dang*/ 'od des gang la reg par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ zhal gyi sgo nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad ljags kyi dbang pos khyab par mdzad nas zhal 'dzum par mdzad do// ljags kyi dbang po de la kyang 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong du ma 'thon te/ 'od zer de dag thams cad la pad+mo mang po rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba gser gyi mdog tu snang ba/ 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa sna tshogs su 'dug pa/ lta na sdug pa/ yid du 'ong ba/ kha dog bzang ba/ dri zhim pa/ 'jam pa/ ka tsa lin di ltar reg (84) na bde bar 'gyur ba sha stag kun nas gnas par gyur te/ pad+mo de dag la yang*/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid ston pa mdzad de/ de dag shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing de dag tu byon nas 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi chos ston to// de bzhin du de dag lho/ nub/ byang*/ byang shar/ shar lho/ lho nub/ nub byang*/ 'og steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gshegs shing de dag tu byon nas 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi chos ston to// sems can gang gis chos de dag thos par gyur pa de thams cad kyang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par gyur to// zhes (85) so// gnyis pa la/ rten gyi gang zag thabs rnam mkhyen/ 'bras bu chos 'khor bskor ba'i mdzad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ pad+mo de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mang po bzhugs shing*/ zhes pas bstan/ de nyid bstan bcos su gsal bar byed pa ni/ thub rnams zhes sogs so// de gnyis ka'i don 'grel pas 'chad pa ni/ sangs rgyas yang dag par ces sogs so// gnyis pa/ mdor sbas don du gnas pa bstan bcos su 'chad pa ni/ gang dang zhes sogs so// de'i don 'grel pas 'chad pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad ces sogs so// gsum pa ni/ 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi chos ston to// zhes pas bstan/ de nyid bstan bcos su gsal bar 'chad pa ni/ rnam pa kun ldan ces sogs so// gnyis ka'i don 'grel pas 'chad (86) pa ni/ spyod pa'i gnyen por ces sogs so// gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ nyan thos byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs rtsa 'grel lo// rgal lan la/ rgal ba dang lan gnyis/ dang po la/

gang la rtsod pa'i yul/ gang gis rtsod pa'i gang zag ji ltar rtsod pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mchod brjod kyi skabs su dngos su mkhyen gsum la bstod phyag byas nas/ shugs la mkhyen gsum brjod byar byas pa'i bstan bcos rtsom par khas blangs ba la'o// gnyis pa ni/ sgra rtog yul la dngos dpang gis 'jug cing*/ gzhi lam rnam gsum 'gal bar khas len pa'i gang zag gis so// gsum pa ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan des yul gzhi lam rnam gsum brjod byar byed par thal/ yul can mkhyen pa gsum brjod byar byed pa gang zhig yul gtan la ma phab par yul can gtan la 'bebs mi nus (87) pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzhi kho na brjod byar byed dam/ rnam pa kho na brjod byar byed la/ gzhi lam rnam gsum yongs rdzogs brjod byar byed/ dang po ltar na/ mngon pa'i mdo dang bzlos pa'i skyon yod de/ de las gzhi phung khams skye mched chos rnams rgyas par bstan zin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ spang bya kun nas nyon mongs pa brjod byar ma bsdus par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyan la brten nas spang gnyen gyi 'brel pa khong du mi chud par 'gyur/ gsum pa ltar na/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi skyes bu la mkho ba'i don cung zad kyang ma bstan par thal/ rnam pa gzhi med tsam brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ltar na/ bstan bcos lus rdzas tha dad pa gsum du 'gyur ba dang*/ mdo dang bzlos skyon yod par 'gyur te/ mdo las/ gzhi lam rnam gsum

(88) rgyas par bstan zin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rgal ba/ 'chad pa ni/ de ltar zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan la/ gzhi lam rnam gsum re re kho na brjod byar bsdus par thal ba'i skyon yod pa ma yin te/ des gzhi lam rnam gsum brjod byar bsdus/ gzhi lam rnam gsum gyis mkhyen gsum bsdus/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rgyan 'di mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag gi rgyan du 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes mdor bstan pa'i tshul gyis 'chad pa ni/ de ni zhes sogs so// 'on kyang lus rdzas tha dad pa gsum du 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa ma yin te/ gzhi lam rnam gsum de gtan la phab par bya ba'i yul de rtogs par byed pa'i lam/ thob bya 'bras (89) bu gsum gyi sgo nas ldog pa tha dad du bstan pa yin gyi/ nang phan tshun 'gal ba'i rdzas gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i lan shugs la bstan/ mdo dang bzlos pa'i skyon yod pa ma yin te/ mdo dang bstan bcos la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa dgos 'brel lo// gnyis pa la/ mdo drang ba dang*/ de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ yul bar ma dang*/ bsdus pa'i mdo drang*/ rgyas pa'i lung khungs smros pa'o// dang po la bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po la/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rgyan 'di mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag gi rgyan du 'thad na/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bsdus pa la shes byed kyi lung rigs ji ltar yod snyam na/ de nyid yum bar (90) ma las bshad tshul mdor bstan pa'i tshul gyis 'chad pa ni/ 'di ltar zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/ gzhi shes kyis theg dman/ lam shes kyis byang 'phags/ rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i dris lan dang gsum/

dang po dri ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das la ni/ theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon par rtogs pa des/ gzhi phung khams skye mched kyi chos rnams gang zag gi bdag med pa dang*/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med par shes kyi/ lam gsum bden pa'i skye ba med pa dang*/ rnam pa'i rdzas rigs ma lus pa mngon sum du mi shes pas na/ gzhi shes kyis theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa 'thad do// zhes 'chad pa ni/ rab 'byor zhes sogs so// gnyis pa/ dri ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das la ni/ byang 'phags kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ theg pa gsum (91) gyis lam gyi bskyed rdzogs la mkhas pa'i shes rab dang*/ rdzogs smin sbyong gsum ma byas par yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i thabs mkhas gnyis dang ldan pas na lam shes kyis de ltar bsdus pa 'thad/ ces 'chad pa ni/ rab 'byor sogs so// gsum pa/ dri ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das la ni/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs ni/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyis bsdus pa'i chos ma lus pa mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa yin pas na/ rnam mkhyen gyi de bsdus pa 'thad/ ces 'chad pa ni/ rab 'byor sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin du sogs so// gsum pa ni/ rgyas pa sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ gzhi shes kyis theg dman/ lam shes kyis byang sems/ rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs bsdus tshul gyi mdo'i don bshad pa dang (92) gsum ni/ rim pa bzhin/ de la sogs so// gsum pa ni/ de lta bas na zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ mkhyen brtse gnyis dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa thogs med chos can/ rgyan gyi rnam bshad mdzad pa yin te/ rgyan gyis rnam bshad nyi khri de nyid rnam nges mdzad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ gzhung so so'i dka' gnas khyad par la/ 'phags pa byams pa/ zhes skabs su gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa byams pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems gang yin khyad par la/ mkhas pa kha cig na re/

de byang chub sems dpa' yin te/ de la sgrub byed yod cing*/ sangs rgyas yin pa la gnod byed yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ gleng gzhir/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang*/ zhes dang*/ mdo bstan bcos gzhan las kyang byang sems su bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi nang (93) tshan yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas yin pa la gnod byed yod de/ bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ bka' yin pa thal/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i lung rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir/ de'i mtshan gzhir yod pa'i phyir/ byams pa mgon po chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul skur thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa gang zhig longs sku ma yin pa'i phyir te/ so so skye bo la dngos su snang ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'dzam bu'i gling du mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pa'i gang zag du thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ zer ro// de la dam bca' mi 'thad pa dang*/ sgrub byed mi 'thad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gdul bya gzhan ngor byang sems kyi tshul bzung ba'i gang zag yin na/ byang sems yin dgos par thal/ dam (94) bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gdul bya gzhan ngor byang sems kyi tshul bzung ba'i skye ba sprul sku ma nges/ gzhan yang gdul bya gzhan ngor dud 'gro'i tshul bzung ba'i skye ba sprul sku rnams dud 'gror thal ba'i skyon gnas so// gnyis pa/ sgrub byed dang po la/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo chos can/ rgyun zhugs su thal/ de ltar du yum gyi gleng gzhir bshad pa'i phyir te/ gang zag gcig ma gtogs pa ni 'di ltar/ slob pa rgyun du zhugs pa tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo'o// zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bcom ldan 'das la theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo dngos su nyan pa'i sgo nas de'i don rtogs pa'i gang zag ma yin par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang 'phags pa shā ri'i bu chos can/

nyan thos su thal/ de ltar du sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi thad du bshad pa'i phyir te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu gal (95) te 'dzam bu'i gling 'di dge slong sha ra dwa ti'i bu dang*/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu lta bu sha stag gis 'di lta ste/ dper na 'dam bu'i tshal lam/ sba'i tshal lam/ bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ smig ma'i tshal lam/ 'bras kyi zhing ngam/ til gyi zhing ltar yongs su gang bar gyur kyang*/ de dag gi shes rab kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o// stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o// brgya phrag stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ bcom ldan 'das la sher phyin gyi mdo dngos su nyan pa'i sgo nas/ stong nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gdul bya gzhan ngor nyan thos kyi tshul bzung ba'i sprul pa'i nyan thos yin pa'i phyir/ (96) gnyis pa la/ byams pa chos can/ sangs rgyas su thal/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi nang tshan yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// zhes pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo chos can/ bstan bcos su thal/ byang sems kyis zhal nas gsungs pa'i lung rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs de byang sems yin pa'i phyir te/ nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi nang tshan yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ sprul sku yin na mchog gi sprul sku yin dgos par thal/ de yin na 'dzam bu gling du mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skye ba sprul sku sogs gzhi ma grub par thal lo// kha cig theg pa thun mong gi skabs su/ mtha' gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa'i (97) skabs su sangs rgyas yin no zhes 'dod pa yang*/

grub mtha' snga ma la sngar bshad pa'i skyon gnas so// rang lugs la/ tha snyad rnam 'jog gdul bya gzhan ngo'i dbang du byas pa dang*/ nges don yin lugs kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas mdo bstan bcos su byang sems su bshad cing*/ des gsungs pa'i byams pa'i chos lnga la bstan bcos kyi ming gis btags pa yin no// gnyis pa'i dbang du byas na/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la gnas pa'i skye ba sprul sku yin te/ lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar du skye ba bzhes pa de nyid 'dzam bu'i gling du babs nas lhums su zhugs pa sogs sangs rgyas kyi mdzad par bshad cing*/ rgyu mtshan de 'phags pa byams pa la yang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ rgyud blar/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen// 'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos (98) par// sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis// skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*// dga' ldan gnas ni 'pho ba dang*// lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang*// bzo'i gnas la mkhas pa dang*// btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang*// nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang*// byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*// bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni// byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*// mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams// yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su// srid pa ji srid gnas par ston// zhes so// gzhan du/ lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar gyi 'dzam bu'i gling du bab ste/ rgyal bu don grub tu skye ba bzhes pa de sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa tsam ma yin par rang rgyud pa yin par thal/ byams pa mgon po ma 'ongs pa na 'dzam bu'i gling du babs te/ skye ba bzhes pa de sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa ma yin par rang rgyud par 'thad pa'i phyir te/ (99) byams pa mgon po skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po las/

bskal pa bye stong bsam gyis mi khyab par// de yi tshad ni nam yang med pa nas// byang chub mchog rab de ni ngas thob ste// nga ni rtag tu chos kyang rab 'chad do// zhes gsungs so// 'di ni shes bya kun rig gi dgongs pa/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi las brgyud pa phyin ci ma log par bkod pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun byams pa mgon pos/ rgyan rtsom pa'i thog mar yul khyad par can la mchod par brjod pa chos can dgos pa yod de/ rang nyid skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun pa dang*/ gdul bya gzhan yum la dang ba'i sgo nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyis 'jug pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid// (100) ces skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ mchod yum la/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ grangs nges pa/ go rim nges pa/ yum sras kyi don la khyad par dang drug dang po la/ mkhas pa snga ma'i bshad pa'i rnam grangs bkod pa mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag 'thad phyogs ngos bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ mkhas pa ar na re/ mchod yum yin na/ 'bras yum yin dgos te/ mchod yum dang sher phyin don gcig sher phyin la 'bras bu sher phyin gyis khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sgo nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bstod do// zhes gsungs so// mkhas pa bu yang de dang mthun par mchod yum la 'bras yum gyis khyab ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma yon tan rin po che// zhes dang*/ de'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das ma la/ zhes/ bcom (101) ldan 'das ma'i sgras gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs des mkhyen pa gsum gyi tshul bzung nas 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don bsgrub pa'i cha nas yum du bzhag pa'i phyir/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid tshul gsum pa can zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes gsung*/ bla ma mkhyen rab dbang phyug la sogs pa mkhas pa mang po'i bzhed pa la mchod yum yin na/

'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pas khyab ste/ 'dir bstan gyi yum yin na/ mkhyen gsum gang rung yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ 'dir mkhyen gsum la bstod phyag byas pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos can/ lam shes nyid kyi zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i mchod yum du thal/ mchod yum gang zhig byang sems kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam (102) shes su thal lo// rtags dang po khas blangs te/ mchod yum la 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ mchod yum yin na/ 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin dgos te/ nyi khri snang ba las/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang du mdzad nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan nye bar bkod pa sngon du 'gro bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs/ bla ma shes bya kun rig gi dgongs pa ṭī ka bar ma'i lugs ltar na/ theg chen gyi lam lnga theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa rnams mchod yum yin te/ rje btsun gyi bstod phyag gi yul du gyur pa'i dngos brgyad gang rung du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mchod brjod kyi skabs su yum du bshad pa de nyid lus rnam bzhag gi skabs su sher phyin gyi sgras smros nas (103) dngos po brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad pa'i phyir/ nyi khri snang ba las/ yum gyi sgras smros pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni brjod par bya'o// de yang gang zhe na/ bshad pa/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po brgyad kyi yang dag bshad// ces gsungs so// ṭī ka las/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis// zhes pa'i 'thad du/ mkhyen gsum du ma zad/ mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po de dag kyang bstod yul gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no// zhes pa'i don legs par bshad pa yin no// bka' 'grel dang de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i mkhas pa rnams na re/
