theg pa gsum gyi lam mtha' dag mchod yum yin te/ so skye'i mngon rtogs rnams bskyed byed kyi yum dang*/ 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs rnams bzhed don bsgrub byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsung ngo*// (104) mkhan chen pa na re/ gzhung lam 'bras bu rang bzhin gyi sher phyin bzhi ka yang mchod yum yin te/ rgyan gyi bstod yul du gyur pa'i sher phyin yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar lugs drug yod pa las/ dang po la/ de'i rgyan tshig le'ur byas pa dag ces pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i sher phyin de 'bras bu sher phyin la byed rigs par thal/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sgo nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bstod do// zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i sher phyin de 'bras bu sher phyin kho na la byed rigs pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ mngon rtogs rgyan de gzhung lam 'bras bu gsum ka gsal bar ston byed ma yin par 'gyur ro// lugs gnyis pa la dam bca' mi 'thad pa dang*/ bsgrub byed mi 'thad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes pa'i gzhung 'di yum la bstod pa'i (105) ngag ma yin par thal/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi mkhyen pa yin na/ mchod yum ma yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ 'di bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod gang zhig skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhyen pa yin na/ mchod yum ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ de bzhin du 'gro la phan par byed rnams zhes pa la sbyar te shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ sa bcu pa'i ye shes chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su thal/ 'das pa sa dgu 'das pa las byung ba'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sa dgu 'das nas ye shes ni// gang gis sangs rgyas sar gnas pa// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba de thub pa'i mngon rtogs su thal/ thub pa'i skad cig gcig pa yi// rtogs pa 'di ni shes par bya// zhes gsungs so// khyab pa

(106) rim bzhin/ khas/ gsum pa la/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i nas bskyed pa la yab rgyal po'i sa bon ma nyams pa sogs chos bzhi pa sngon du 'gro mi dgos par thal/ rgyal sras 'phags pa yin na/ theg chen gyi chos la mos pa sogs chos bzhi ldan gyi yum sngon du 'gro mi dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rgyud bla las/ theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni// sangs rgyas chos skyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi// bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje'i ma ma can// gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras// zhes gsung ngo*// rtsa rtags ma grub na/ sdug bsngal chos bzod thob ma thag pa'i byang sems chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nang 'gal lo// gzhan yang*/ bden pa'i gcig du bral gyi rtags las/ gzhi lam rnam gsum bden pa'i skye med du rtogs pa'i ye shes des/ 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don sgrub pa (107) la gnod byed kyi tshad ma med par mthong ba de mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dbang rnon yum la dang ba skye ba'i rgyu mtshan rnam dag tu mi 'thad par thal/ bden pa'i gcig du bral gyi rtags las gzhi lam rnam gsum bden pa'i skye med du rtogs pa'i ye shes yin na/ mchod yum yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ theg chen so skye'i mkhyen pa yin na/ mchod yum ma yin pas khyab pa gang zhig theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud la de 'dra ba'i ye shes med pa'i phyir/ theg chen 'phags pa yin na rtags la ltos med du gzhi lam rnam gsum bden med du mngon sum du rtogs dgos pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshad mas gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa skye ba med pa yongs su shes pa tshigs su bcad pa'i don gyi mtshan nyid kyi yum la gnod pa ma mthong nas zhes pa dang dngos su 'gal (108) lo// lugs lnga pa la/ theg dman so skye'i mngon rtogs chos can/ dngos brgyad kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa thal/

mchod yum yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa de yum gyi sgras smros pa'i dngos brgyad la mchod par brjod pa'i cha nas bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod ma yin par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang*/ theg dman so skye'i mngon rtogs chos can/ theg chen gyi chos la mos pa sogs chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i yum yin par thal/ bskyed byed kyi yum gang zhig rang dang lhan cig pa'i 'phags pa'i bzhed don bsgrub byed kyi yum ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje khyad par can gnyis ldan du thal lo// drug pa la bka' brgyad stong pa chos can/ 'bras yum du thal/ mchod yum (109) gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen du 'gyur ro// chos rnams kyi gnas lugs de kho na nyid de mchod yum du thal/ snying po don gyi mchod yum yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'thad phyogs ngos bzung ba ni/ lugs bzhi pa shes bya kun rig gi dgongs pa bzhin khas len no// gnyis pa la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la/ rje btsun byams mgon gyi bstod phyag gi yul du gyur pa'i yon tan/ zhes dang*/ de'i bstod phyag gi yul du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa/ zhes dang*/ rang sras 'phags pa'i zag med kyi phung po phyi ma skyed byed dang*/ bzhed don sgrub byed gang rung du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa/ zhes dang rang dang lhan cig pa'i 'phags pa'i bzhed don gtso bor sgrub par byed pa'i mkhyen pa zer ro// dang po la/ bka' brgyad stong pa chos can/ (110) mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ bem po yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa la/ theg dman gyi spyod lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/

'dod na/ sngar bkag zin/ bzhi pa la/ theg chen gyi spyod lam chos mchog skad cig tha ma'i ye shes chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ theg chen gyi chos la mos pa sogs khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rang sras byang sems 'phags pa dngos su bskyed byed kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rang gi dngos 'bras theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi dngos kyi nyer len yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba 'dod na/ 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun byams mgon gyi bstod phyag gi yul du gyur pa'i dngos brgyad (111) kyi nang tshan yang yin/ rang sras 'phags pa'i zag med kyi phung po phyi ma bskyed byed dang*/ bzhed don bsgrub byed gang rung du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa/ gsum pa ni/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i bskyed byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ byang sems 'phags pa yin na/ rang bskyed byed kyi mchod yum las byung bas ma khyab par thal/ nyan thos 'phags pa yin na/ rang bskyed byed kyi mchod yum las byung bas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ nyan thos mthong lam pa chos can/ sras 'phags pa ma yin par thal/ rang rgyu mchod yum las ma byung ba'i phyir/ rtags khas/ zer na/ dang po la/ byang sems 'phags pa yin na/ rang rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa des rang gis don gnyer bya'i gtso bo bla med byang chub tu (112) 'khrid byed yin pas ma khyab par thal/ nyan thos 'phags pa yin na/ rang rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa des rang gi don du gnyer bya'i gtso bo dman pa'i myang 'das su 'khrid byed yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems 'phags pa yin na/ theg chen gyi chos la mos pa sogs khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi mchod yum las byung bas ma khyab par thal/ nyan thos 'phags pa yin na/ de las byung bas ma khyab pa'i phyir/

khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ nyan thos mthong lam pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyan thos so skye'i rgyud la stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje khyad par can gnyis yod par 'gyur ro// thal 'gyur gnyis pa la/ theg chen sems bskyed rang rgyud la thob ma thag pa'i byang sems chos can/ rgyal ba'i sras ma yin par thal/ rang rgyu rgyal ba'i yum (113) las ma byung ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyams thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes pa dang 'gal/ gzhan yang*/ rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po chos can/ ngo bo nyid sku mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin par thal/ ngo bo nyid sku mngon sum du rtogs zin bsgom par byed pa'i lam sngon song ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rim bzhin khas/ ma grub na/ slob lam na ngo bo nyid sku mngon sum du rtogs zin bsgom par byed pa'i lam yod par 'gyur ro// gsum pa la/ mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas/ rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas/ byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ mchod brjod yul du gyur pa'i yum gzhi shes/ (114) lam shes/ rnam mkhyen dang gsum/ mtshan nyid la/ kha cig na re/ gang zag gi bdag med dang gzung ba chos kyi bdag med gang rung mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi theg dman 'phags pa nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa/ zhes dang*/ lam gsum bden pa'i skye med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi byang sems 'phags pa 'jig rten gyi don bsgrub pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i mkhyen pa/ de gnyis kyi mtshan nyid du 'dod do// 'o na theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/

dang po'i mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ mchod yum dang gzhi shes kyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ rang gi skad cig gnyis par theg chen gyi lam du 'jug kha ma'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i mngon rtogs chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ theg dman 'phags pa'i (115) mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag des nyer zhi gnyis su bgrod zin pa'i rjes su gtso bor theg chen gyi lam don du gnyer ba'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gal te mchod yum gzhi shes yin na/ theg dman gyi mngon rtogs yin dgos par thal/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i mchod yum gzhi shes yin na/ theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ mchod yum dang gzhi shes kyi gzhi mthun yin na/ theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs yin dgos par thal/ de'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi mchod yum dang gzhi shes kyi gzhi mthun yin na/ de yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags rtags thogs/ khyab pa khyab thog tu sgrig mtshan nyid gnyis pa la (116) lam shes yin na/ skabs gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bo gyur pa'i lam shes yin dgos par thal/ mchod yum lam shes yin na/ 'gro la phan pa byed rnams lam shes nyid kyi zhes pa'i skabs kyi bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i mchod yum yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ de yin na byang 'phags kyi mngon rtogs yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ lam shes yin na/ rgyu lam shes yin dgos par 'gyur ro// rang lugs ni/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi 'phags pa'i bzhed don gtso bor bsgrub pa'i mkhyen pa/ lam gsum bden pa'i skye med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi theg chen skyes bu'i bzhed don gtso bor bsgrub pa'i mkhyen pa/

rnam pa bden pa'i skye med du mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi sangs rgyas 'phags pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa/ (117) gnyis pa la/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i/ rang rgyal 'phags pa'i/ byang sems 'phags pa'i/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mchod yum dang bzhi/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ mchod yum gang zhig rang rgyud la ldan pa'i nyan thos/ rang rgyal byang sems/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don gtso bor bsgrub pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i mkhyen pa/ mtshan nyid phyi ma la/ kho na re/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ de'i bskyed byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ rgyun mtha' la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi sems bskyed chos can/ sangs rgyas sa'i sems bskyed du thal/ sangs rgyas sa'i sbyor bas bsdus pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ sems bskyed pa gsum ni sbyor ba dang dngos dang mjug gi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus te/ zhes gsung ngo*// byang sems kyi sbyor lam (118) chos can/ byang sems kyi sa yin par thal/ de'i mos spyod kyi sa yin pa'i phyir/ khyad par snga phyi khas/ rgyu lam shes dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ de dang 'bras yum gyi gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te/ de dang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mchod yum gyi gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gsum pa la/ dbye ba so so'i rang bzhin dang*/ nang phan tshun 'gal mi 'gal la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bskyed byed kyi yum dang*/ bzhed don bsgrub byed kyi yum gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid la kha cig mchod yum gang zhig rang sras 'phags pa'i zag med kyi phung po phyi ma bskyed byed/ zhe na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ byang sems bsgom lam pa'i bskyed byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang sras 'phags pa phyi ma'i zag med kyi phung po bskyed

(119) byed yin na/ rang sras 'phags pa'i zag med kyi phung po bskyed byed yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ rang sras 'phags pa'i rgyu yin par thal/ de phyi ma'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig rang sras 'phags pa'i zag med kyi phung po phyi ma bskyed byed kyi mkhyen pa zer na/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ nyan thos mthong lam pa'i zag med kyi phung po bskyed byed kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dngos brgyad gang rung du 'gyur ro// rang lugs/ mchod yum gang zhig rang sras 'phags pa phyi ma'i zag med kyi phung po gtso bor bskyed par byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa rang dang lhan cig pa'i 'phags pa'i bzhed don gtso bor bsgrub pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i mkhyen pa/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig de gnyis 'gal (120) te/ sras 'phags pa gcig la ltos te 'gal ba'i phyir/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i bskyed byed kyi yum yin na/ de'i bzhed don bsgrub byed kyi yum ma yin dgos/ de'i bzhed don bsgrub byed kyi yum yin na/ de bskyed byed kyi yum ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zer ro// bskyed byed kyi yum yin na/ sras 'phags pa mtha' dag gi bskyed byed kyi yum yin pas khyab par thal/ rang sras byang sems bsgom lam pa'i bskyed byed kyi yum yin na/ bskyed byed kyi yum yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ byang sems kyi mthong lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ bzhed don bsgrub byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa dngos/ mnyam bzhag gi mkhyen pa dang*/ rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa gnyis 'gal bar thal/ byang sems gcig gi (121) rgyud la ltos te 'gal ba'i phyir/ khyab pa rim bzhin khas/ rang lugs ni/ spyir de gnyis mi 'gal te/ byang sems kyi mthong lam de de gnyis ka'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/

byang sems mthong lam pa ltos te/ bzhed don bsgrub byed dang*/ bsgom lam pa la ltos te bskyed byed kyi yum yin pa'i phyir/ rten gyi gang zag gcig la ltos na 'gal te/ byang sems mthong lam pa lta bu'i bskyed byed kyi yum yin na/ de'i bzhed don bsgrub byed kyi yum yin dgos pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grangs nges la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bsdus tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mchod brjod kyi skabs 'dir mkhyen gsum la dngos su bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de la bstod pas mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka la bstod par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum// zhes (122) sogs so// gnyis pa la/ mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa dang*/ rang lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ lo chen na re/ mkhyen gsum gyis sbyor bzhi dang 'bras bu chos sku bsdus pa ni/ rgya che bas chung ba bsdus pa'am/ spyis bye brag bsdus pa yin te/ dper na/ nags tshal gyis sha ba bsdus pa dang*/ rgya mtshos chu thigs bsdus pa bzhin no// de yang mkhyen gsum rgya che ste/ thos bsam gyis gtan la phab par bya ba'i yul yin pa'i phyir/ sbyor bzhi dang 'bras bu chos sku rgya chung ste/ rnal 'byor pa rang gis nyams su blang bya dang rang rgyud la thob par bya ba'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ 'o na sbyor bzhi dang*/ chos sku yang rgya che bar thal/ thos bsam gyis gtan la phab par bya ba'i yul yin pa'i phyir/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag gis shes bya thams cad thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs dgos pa'i

(123) phyir/ gzhan yang*/ mkhyen gsum yang rgya chung bar thal/ rnal 'byor pa rang gis nyams su blang bya yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rang gi rgyud la thob bya'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po der thal/ rnal 'byor pas mkhyen pa gsum po de nyid sbyor ba bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blang dgos pa'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don sbyor ba bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blangs pa la brten nas 'bras bu'i dus su mkhyen gsum gyi rtogs pa mthar thug thob dgos pa'i phyir/ yang*/ 'dre chen po na re/ mkhyen gsum gyis sbyor ba bzhi dang 'bras bu chos sku bsdus pa ni/ rang bzhin gyis gnas skabs bsdus pa yin te/ mkhyen gsum ni rang bzhin dang*/ sbyor bzhi dang chos sku de'i gnas skabs yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ sor mos khu tshur bsdus pa bzhin no// zhes gsung ngo*// 'o na/ byang (124) 'phags kyi rgyud la rang bzhin mkhyen gsum yod par thal/ gnas skabs sbyor bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ de des bsdus pa de rang bzhin gyis gnas skabs bsdus pa yin pa 'gal/ yang*/ ar na re/ mkhyen gsum mtshon byed kyi chos sum cu po des sbyor bzhi dang 'bras bu chos sku bsdus pa la mkhyen gsum gyis mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bsdus zhes pa'i tha snyad btags pa yin no// zhes gsung ngo*// 'o na/ mkhyen gsum mtshon byed kyi chos sum cu po chos can/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi mchod yum du thal/ 'dir bstan gyi sdud byed mkhyen gsum yin pa'i phyir/ yang*/ dar ṭīka pa na re/ mkhyen gsum gyis sbyor bzhi dang 'bras bu chos sku bsdus pa ni/ nyams len gyi tshul gyis bsdus pa yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rdzogs par nyams su blangs na sbyor bzhi dang 'bras bu (125) chos sku yang rdzogs par nyams su blangs bar 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ mkhyen gsum la bstod par bzhed nas de gnyis la bstod pa mi bzhed pa'i mkhas pa med pa'i phyir/

zer/ 'o na/ gzhi shes gcig pos sbyor bzhi dang 'bras bu chos sku bsdus par thal/ rtog pa gzhi shes la sbyar te sngar bzhin/ 'dod na/ de'i sdud byed du mkhyen gsum smros par don med par thal lo// bla ma mkhyen rab dbang phyug na re/ mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bsdus kyi/ dngos brgyad yongs rdzogs bsdus pa ma yin te/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba dang*/ gzugs sku gnyis ngo bo nyid sku dang bcas pa ma bsdus pa'i phyir te/ de rnams mkhyen gsum gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams ces sogs kyi skabs su/ mkhyen gsum la dngos su bstod (126) nas/ sbyor bzhi dang 'bras bu chos sku la dngos su ma bstod pa la rgyu mtshan med par thal/ mkhyen gsum gyis dngos brgyad bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de la bstod pas dngos po brgyad ka la bstod par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bka' 'grel las/ gzhi shes kyis theg dman gyi mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag la tha snyad zor yang ba'i phyir du gzhi shes su btags pa de nyid bsdus/ lam shes kyi byang sems kyi mngon rtogs mtha' dag la tha snyad zor yang ba'i phyir du lam shes kyi tha snyad du btags pa de dang sbyor bzhi bsdus/ rnam mkhyen gyis zag med kyi ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig la tha snyad zor yang ba'i phyir du rnam mkhyen gyi tha snyad du btags pa de nyid dang 'bras bu chos sku bsdus pa yin no// des na 'dir bstan gyi sdud bya'i gzhi shes dang lam shes ni so skye'i rgyud la'ang yod pas dngos btags gnyis ka'i cha yod gsung ngo*// 'o na/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po (127) brgyad kyi yang dag bshad// ces pa'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi dngos brgyad kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i gzhi shes dang lam shes gang rung yin na/ de gang rung yin pas ma khyab par thal/

mkhyen gsum gyi sdud byar gyur pa'i gzhi shes dang lam shes yin na/ de gang rung yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skabs gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa'i bstan byar gyur pa'i gzhi shes dang lam shes pa des ma khyab par 'gyur ro// ṭī ka'i dgongs pa ni/ sdud byed mkhyen pa gsum gyis/ bsdu bya dngos po brgyad bsdus pa'i tshul la/ gzhi shes kyis theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs kyis mtshon pa'i gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa rnams rang gi mtshan nyid tshang ba'i tshul gyis bsdus/ lam shes kyis byang 'phags kyi mngon rtogs kyis mtshon pa'i lam gsum bden pa'i skye med du (128) rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa rnams rang gi mtshan nyid tshang ba'i tshul gyis bsdus/ byang 'phags kyis spyod pa rang gi ngo bo dang*/ byang sems so skye'i sbyor ba rang gi rgyu yin pa'i tshul gyis bsdus/ rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mngon par rtogs pas mtshon pa'i rnam pa bden pa'i skye med du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa mtha' dag rang gi mtshan nyid tshang ba'i tshul gyis bsdus/ rtogs pa ye shes chos sku rang gi ngo bo dang*/ gzugs sku rang gang la ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag dang*/ ngo bo nyid sku yon tan yin pa'i tshul gyis bsdus pa yin no// de yang ṭī ka las/ 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs la/ mkhyen gsum du bzhag pa ni/ mkhyen gsum spyi'i bsdus/ sbyor bzhi lam shes kyis bsdus/ chos sku rnam mkhyen gyis bsdus zhes pa'i don legs par bshad pa yin no// lnga pa la/ kha cig 'dir bstan mchod yum gyi go rim ni/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul (129) bya lam la 'jug pa'i rim pa'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ de dang por gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i theg dman gyi lam la 'jug de'i rjes su lam bden pa'i skye med du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi lam la 'jug de'i rjes su 'bras bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mngon du byed par 'gyur ba'i phyir/

zer ro// rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya yin na/ theg dman gyi rigs can yin dgos pa thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ rgyan 'di theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan bcos ma yin par 'gyur ro// rang lugs/ gal te mchod brjod kyi skabs su/ gzhi lam rnam gsum go rim 'di ltar 'chad pa ni mi 'thad de/ bstan bcos lus kyi go rim dang mi mthun pa'i phyir snyam na/ skyon med de/ mchod brjod ni gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa yin cing*/ gleng gzhi'i go rim dang mthun (130) par mchod brjod kyi skabs 'dir yang ston par mdzad pa'i phyir/ de ltar mthun tshul ni/ gzhung 'grel gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar ro// rtags dang po grub ste/ jo bo rjes/ gleng gzhi rgyas par bka' stsal don mchog rnams// legs par sbyar ba phyag 'tshal tshigs bcad yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyan 'dir sher phyin gyis mdo'i don ma lus par bsdus shing*/ mchod brjod las ma gtogs pa'i gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa gzhan med pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ rgyan gyis sher phyin gyi mdo'i don ma lus pa ma bsdus par thal/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i brjod bya dngos brgyad cha shas dang bcas pa ma bsdus pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur slob dpon gyis 'phangs pa don med du thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ la la las don gzhan las tshig /gzhan las rnam grangs ming gis te// mkhas pa rnams kyis yum (131) kun la'ang*// don bsdus de tsam shes par bya// de ltar min na thams cad kyi// rim pa legs par bsdus ma yin// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// drug pa la/ bskyed byed yum sras su 'gyur tshul/ bzhed don bsgrub byed yum sras su 'gyur tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ byang sems kyi bskyed byed kyi yum sras bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ mchod yum gyis rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i rang sras 'phags pa'i zag med kyi phung po bskyed par byed pa'i cha nas yum sras su 'jog pa yin te/

dper mtshon na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyis rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i nyan thos 'phags pa'i zag med kyi phung po phyi ma bskyed par byed pa'i yum yin pa dang*/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i (132) zag med kyi phung po phyi ma bskyed byed kyi yum yin pa dang*/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bskyed byed kyi yum yin par 'gyur ba bzhin no// kho na re/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes dang*/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa yum sras su thal/ de gnyis bskyed byed kyi yum sras yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes 'bras yum du 'gyur ro// snga ma la ma khyab na/ byang sems 'phags pa'i bskyed byed kyi yum sras yin na/ byang sems 'phags pa yum sras yin pas ma khyab par thal/ snga ma de'i phyir/ zer/ rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i byang 'phags dngos su bskyed byed kyi mchod yum yin na/ rang dang lhan cig pa'i byang sems kyi mngon rtogs yin pas ma khyab par thal/ rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa dngos su bskyed byed kyi yum yin na/ rang dang lhan (133) cig pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi ma nges/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung gsob par nus pa'i sras byang sems 'phags pa bskyed pa la khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi yum sngon du 'gro dgos te/ dper na/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i gdung gsob par nus pa'i sras phun sum tshogs par bskyed pa la/ yab rgyal po'i sa bon ma nyams pa/ de nyid 'dzin pa'i bskyed byed kyi ma/ sa bon de nyid mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i mngal/ phyis skyed bsring bar byed pa'i skyong byed kyi ma ma bzhi dgos pa bzhin du/

sras byang sems skyong ba la yang*/ sa bon dang*/ mtshungs pa'i theg chen gyi chos la mos pa'i sems bskyed/ ma dang mtshungs pa'i de nyid kyi rten byed pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab/ mngal dang (134) mtshungs pa'i de nyid mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa'i bsam gtan gyi bde ba/ ma ma dang mtshungs pa'i rgyu de las byung ba/ byang sems kyi spangs rtogs gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i snying rje khyad par can dang bzhi tshang dgos pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla las/ theg mchog la mos zhes sogs dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ chos la mos pa sa bon dang*// pha rol phyin mchog ma las skyes// bsam gtan las byung bde ba'i mngal// snying rje bskyed pa'i ma ma 'o// zhes dang*/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam dag gi /yab ni thabs la mkhas pa ste// yum ni shes rab pha rol phyin// 'dren pa rnams ni de las skyes// zhes so// des na byang sems 'phags pa la khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi yum nges par sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ byang sems so skye'i mngon rtogs mchod yum yin pa dang*/ theg dman 'phags pa la de lta bu'i yum sngon du (135) 'gro mi dgos pas/ theg dman so skye'i mngon rtogs mchod yum ma yin pa'i gnad shes par bya'o// de yang byang sems 'phags pa ni yum dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung gsob par nus pa'i yab kyi cha nas kyang sras su bzhag pa yin la/ byang sems so skye ni sangs rgyas kyi gdung gsob par nus pa'i thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i cha nas sangs rgyas kyi thugs sras su 'khrungs pas na/ yab kyi sgo nas sras kyi tha snyad bzhag pa yin te/ sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi mdor/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yab/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rgyal po// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis// zhes sogs dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gzhi dang ni// zhes so// gnyis pa la/

theg dman gyi yum sras su 'gyur (136) tshul dang*/ theg chen gyi de gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg dman slob pa'i mngon par rtogs pas rang gang la ldan rten gyi gang zag nyer zhi gnyis su khrid par byed pa'i sgo nas bzhed don sgrub par byed pa yin la/ theg dman mi slob pa'i mngon rtogs ni/ rang gang la ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag gi nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i rnam grol gyi bde ba de mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i sgo nas bzhed don bsgrub pa yin te/ kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir khrid mdzad gang yin dang*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyu lam shes kyis rang rgyud ldan gyi byang sems kyi ji ltar bzhed pa'i 'jig rten gyi don bsgrub par mdzad pa'i sgo nas bzhed don bsgrub pa yin te/ lam shes nyid kyi zhes sogs so// rnam mkhyen gyis rang rgyud ldan gyi sangs rgyas 'phags pas/ gdul bya rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen dngos su mdzad pa'i sgo nas bzhed don (137) sgrub par mdzad pa yin te/ gang dang yang dag ces sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ mkhyen gsum chos can/ mchod yum yin te/ rang dang lhan cig pa'i 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dang de'i phyogs su bslan pa/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ rten gyi gang zag thabs gzhi shes/ 'bras bu myang 'das las byung ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ nyan thos kyi sgra 'jug tshul spyir bstan/ 'dir bstan gyi nyan thos ngos bzung ba gnyis/ dang po la/ spyir nyan thos zhes pa'i sgra 'jug pa'i tshul la/ rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa'i nyan thos/ sprul pa'i nyan thos/ lta ba khas len gyi nyan thos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi lam lnga la gnas pa'i gang zag lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ don la theg (138) chen gyi skyes bu yin zhing gzhan ngor nyan thos kyi tshul bzung ba shā ri'i bu dang*/

mo'u 'gal la sogs pa lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ don la theg chen yin yang tha snyad kyi grub mtha' nyan thos sde gnyis ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa 'phags pa yon tan 'od lta bu'o// phyi ma gnyis la nyan thos kyi ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi chos gzhan la sgrogs par byed pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ nyan thos kyi skad dod du shar wa ka zhes pa thos sgrogs la 'jug pa'i don can yin pa'i phyir/ dam chos pad dkar las/ mgon po bdag cag de ring nyan thos 'gyur// byang chub dam pa yang dag snyad par bgyi// byang chub pa yi sgra yang rab tu 'jug /de bas bdag cag nyan thos mi zad 'dra// zhes so// dgos pa ni/ theg dman gyi lam la mos pa'i gang (139) zag 'ga' zhig theg chen la kha drang pa'i ched yin te/ de nyid las/ theg pa brlabs po che'i bsgrags 'gyur zhing*// 'di na sems can dman la mos rig nas// byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag nyan thos 'gyur// rang rgyal byang chub sar yang rab tu ston// zhes so// nyan thos dngos yin pa la gnod byed yod de/ gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pa'i theg chen sems bskyed rgyud ldan yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig 'dir bstan gyi nyan thos yin na/ gnas skabs theg dman du rigs nges pa'i nyan thos slob pa yin dgos te/ de yin na/ theg dman gyi myang 'das don gnyer gyi gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ rtsa bar nyer zhir khrid mdzad gang yin dang*/ zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pa rnams// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//

(140) zhes zer ro// dge slong lnga stong tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang*/ zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi gang zag yin na/ theg dman slob pa yin dgos pa thal/ khas len rtags/ khyab ste/ de gnyis dngos kyi rtsa 'grel yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ 'di'i yon tan 'chad pa na/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ zhes sogs dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir/ des na 'dir dngos bstan gyi nyan thos ni/ sher phyin gyi rtogs pa dngos su skye ba'i snod rung du gyur pa'i nyan thos ma nges pa'i rigs can dang*/ nyan thos kyi ming can gyi theg chen gyi skyes bu gnyis yod de/ gleng gzhi'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi nyan rang gi ming gis btags pa'i gang zag dang*/ byang sems rnams ni ston pa la sher phyin gyis mdo dngos su nyan pa la lhags pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis (141) pa la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ 'dir dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes ngos bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po gnyis gzhan du 'chad/ gsum pa la/ kha cig 'dir dngos bstan gyi gzhi shes yin na/ theg dman slob pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes yin dgos te/ de yin na/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag dman pa'i myang 'das su khrid byed yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir khrid mdzad/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer ba mi 'thad de/ sngar gyi rigs pas khegs shing*/ gzhan yang*/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes bya'i tshigs bcad 'di bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod ma yin par thal/ 'di'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin na/ skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes ma yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ de dang srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i (142) gzhi shes kyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ 'dir tshig zin la bstan pa'i gzhi shes la theg pa che chung gi gzhi shes gsum ka yod cing*/

'di'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes ni/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes su nges te/ 'di bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod gang zhig skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes de theg chen gyi gzhi shes su nges pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ red mda' ba na re/ theg dman la myang 'das mtshan nyid pa med de/ de yin na sgrib gnyis zad par spangs pa'i myang 'das yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla las/ des na sangs rgyas ma thob par// mya ngan 'das pa mi 'thob ste// 'od dang 'od zer spangs nas ni// nyi ma blta bar mi nus bzhin// (143) zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na/ theg dman dgra bcom pa yang srid du skye ba len pa med par thal/ des las nyon spangs pa'i myang 'das mtshan nyid pa thob pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dpal phreng gi mdo las/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang skye ba lhag ma dang bcas pa'i chos can lags so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ theg dman rang lugs kyi bslab bya yongs rdzogs yin na/ bslab bya yongs rdzogs yin dgos par thal/ theg dman rang lugs kyi dgra bcom yin na/ dgra bcom yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ zer/ thar lam yin na/ sgrib gnyis la lus pa rang lam du 'joms nus yin dgos par thal/ thar pa yin na sgrib pa ma lus pa sbyangs dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ der thal/ (144) de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas sgrib gnyis zad par 'gyur ro// dgra bcom pa bsad pa'i 'tshams med kyi las gzhi ma grub par thal/ theg dman dgra bcom bsad pa la der mi 'gyur ba gang zhig theg chen dgra bcom sus kyang gsod mi nus pa'i phyir theg pa yin na/ mthar thug gi theg pa yin dgos par thal/ theg dman gyi theg pas theg pa'i go mi chod pa'i phyir/

de'i mi slob lam gyis mi slob lam gyi go mi chod pa'i phyir/ kha cig 'phags rgyud kyi 'gog bden yin na/ myang 'das yin dgos te/ 'phags rgyud kyi 'gog lam gnyis po myang 'das rgyu 'bras su bshad pa'i phyir/ zer ba mi 'thad de/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa yin na/ 'khor ba yin dgos par thal/ sdug kun gnyis po de 'khor ba rgyu 'bras su bshad pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab sgrig 'dod na/ lhag bcas myang 'das la (145) gnas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i gzugs phung gis ma nges/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i 'gog bden chos can/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su thal/ theg chen gyi myang 'das yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ sgrib gnyis spangs par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa rang lugs la/ mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden kho na'i stengs nas myang 'das kyi mtshan gzhi 'jog cing*/ rgyud bla'i lung don ni theg dman la myang 'das tsam med pa ma yin gyi/ sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i myang 'das med pa la dgongs te/ de'i 'grel par/ de bzhin gshegs pa ma thob par sgrib pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba'i mtshan nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings rtogs pa mngon du byed par mi 'thad de/ 'od dang 'od zer mi mthong bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mi mthong ba bzhin no// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ (146) kha cig sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i so sor rtags 'gog zer na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden gyis ma nges/ kha cig sgrib gnyis gang rung spangs pa'i so sor rtags 'gog zer ba dang*/ nyon sgrib spangs na sgrib gnyis gang rung spangs pa khyab par 'dod pa la/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden gyis ma nges/ kha cig sgrib gnyis gang rung spangs pa'i mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi so sor rtags 'gog zer ro// nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/

mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas de spangs bar thal lo// 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na ma yin par thal/ de gang rung rgyud ldan yin pa'i phyir te/ shes sgrib rgyud ldan yin pa'i phyir/ gal te nyan thos dgra bcom chos can/ de gnyis gang rung spangs par thal/ (147) nyon sgrib spangs pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ de chos can/ de gnyis gang rung rgyud la mi ldan pa'i gang zag du thal/ nyon sgrib rgyud la mi ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de yin par thal/ shes sgrib rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ dgag gzhi sems rgyud kyi steng du 'gog byed bar chad med lam gyis rang gi ngo skal gyi spangs bya spangs ba'i mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi so sor rtags 'gog gsum pa la/ theg dman dang theg chen gyi myang 'das gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ lhag med myang 'das kyi 'dod tshul la dpyad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nyon sgrib zad par spangs pa'i theg dman mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi so sor rtags 'gog gnyis pa la/ theg dman gyi lhag bcas dang*/ lhag med gnyis/ de gnyis kyi mtshan nyid la/ kha cig dbye gzhi gzhir (148) bzhag la/ kun 'byung zad par spangs shing sdug bsngal gyi phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa/ zhes dang*/ de gnyis ka zad par spangs ba zer na lhag bcas myang 'das la gnas pa'i nyan thos kyi dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ mtshan nyid snga ma der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ las kyi kun 'byung ma spangs pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ 'dod chags bral ba'i gnas pa ni// brtse ba'am yang na las kyi yin// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ nyon mongs med kyang de dag la// las kyi nus pa mthong ba yin// zhes so// kha cig dbye gzhi gzhir bzhag la/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa dang*/ ma bcas pa zer na/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi thob la ma nyams pa'i lhag bcas myang 'das la gnas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/

mtshan (149) nyid snga ma der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sdug bsngal ma spangs par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin te/ chos can de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bsam gtan bzhi pa 'chad pa la/ bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing*/ yid bde ba dang*/ mi bde ba snga nas kyang nus pas so// zhes gsungs so// rang lugs la/ rang rgyud las nyon gyi dbang gis byung ba'i zag bcas kyi phung po'i lhag ma dang bcas pa'i theg dman mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi so sor rtags 'gog dang*/ de nyid zad par spangs pa'i theg dman mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi so sor rtags 'gog go /mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ theg dman sgom lam pa'i lus rten gyi rigs 'dra ma dor ba dang*/ dor ba'i theg dman dgra bcom pa'i 'gog bden lta bu'o// gsum pa la/ nyan thos sde gnyis dang*/ sems tsam (150) pa'i lugs la/ theg dman dgra bcom pa sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ste/ sngar gyi lus sems kyi rigs 'dra dor nas 'gog pa 'ba' zhig yan gar du gnas pa la lhag med myang 'das su 'dod de/ gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/ de la don dam pa rnam par bzhag pa ni phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings te/ sems med pa'i sa zhes bya'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ der kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa ma lus pa 'gags pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po'i lugs la/ nyan thos slob pa'i lus rten gyi rigs 'dra dor nas/ ma rig bag chags kyi sas rkyen/ zag pa med pa'i las kyi rgyu byas pa las yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus blangs pa'i theg dman dgra bcom pa'i 'gog bden la lhag med myang 'das su bzhed de/ dpal phreng gi mdo las/ ma rig bag chags kyi sas rkyen dang*/ zag pa med pa'i las kyi (151) rgyu las/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ dbang thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus gsum 'byung ste/ zhes gsungs so// de nyid theg chen gyi lam du 'jug pa'i tshul yang zag med kyi ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag pa la sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer gyis sad par bya ste/

sangs rgyas kyi mdzad spyod la dmigs pa'i dad pa/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsal 'dod kyi snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ tshogs gnyis bsag par byed pa yin te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ ji srid sangs rgyas ma bskul bar// de srid ye shes lus mngon can// ting 'dzin myos pas brgyal gyur te// nyan thos pa dang gnas par 'gyur// bskul nas sna tshogs gzugs kyi sku// sems can don la dga' byed cing*// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags (152) nas// byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la/ kha cig gzugs sku lhag bcas myang 'das dang*/ chos sku lhag med myang 'das yin te/ sku gsum la 'jug pa'i sgor/ phung po dang ni bcas pa'i dbyings// thub sku gnyis la bzhag pa yin// phung po kun dang bral ba'i phyir// chos kyi sku la phung po med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zer/ gzugs sku gnyis chos can/ myang 'das rgyud ldan gyi gang zag ma yin par thal ba dang*/ sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i so sor rtags 'gog tu thal/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa de lhag bcas myang 'das su thal ba dang*/ myang 'das kyi sgra bshad du yod na myang 'das yin dgos par thal/ khas len rtags/ rang lugs ni/ sgrib gnyis zad par spangs pa'i mthar thug gi so sor rtags 'gog (153) theg chen myang 'das kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de dang mi gnas pa'i myang 'das ngo bo nyid sku/ spong ba chen po rnams ming gi rnam grangs so// dbye na/ gzugs sku gnyis kyi myang 'das gnyis so// gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po chos can/ gzhi shes la bstod pa yin te/ rten gyi gang zag thabs gzhi shes/ 'bras bu myang 'das gsum gyi sgo nas gzhi shes kyi yon tan brjod pa'i mkhas mchog yin pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad skye ba med par thugs su chud pa/

zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ mtha' dpyad pa dang*/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs dang*/ theg pa chen po'i lugs gnyis/ dang po la/ lung dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo dang*/ ji ltar bskor tshul lo// dang po ni/ bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor tsam du nges par 'dod de/ theg (154) chen gyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum gtso bor ston pa'i chos 'khor phyi ma gnyis/ rang lugs su khas mi len pa'i phyir/ gzhi'i dus su chos nyid bden med spros bral yin pa dang*/ lam gyi dus su gnyen po sa bcu/ 'bras bu'i dus su sku gsum gyi rnam bzhag khas mi len pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs dang*/ mdo sde pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ bzlas pa gsum dang*/ rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bskor bar 'dod cing*/ bzlas pa gsum ni/ ngo bo la bzlas pa/ byed pa la bzlas pa/ bya ba 'bras bu la bzlas pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bden pa bzhi'i ngo bo tsam ston par byed pa'i 'dul ba lung gi mdo lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sdug bsngal shes bya/ kun 'byung spang bya/ 'gog pa mngon du bya rgyu/ lam rten byar ston pa'i 'dul ba lung gi mdo lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ sdug bsngal shes par bya/ slar shes par bya rgyu (155) gzhan med/ kun 'byung spangs bar bya/ slar spang bar bya rgyu gzhan med/ 'gog pa mngon du byas/ slar mngon du bya rgyu gzhan med/ lam rgyud la bsten par byas/ slar rgyud la bsten par bya rgyu gzhan med/ ces pa la sogs pa mi slob lam gyi dbang du byas nas gsungs pa'i 'dul ba lung gi mdo lta bu'o// rnam pa bcu gnyis ni/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i ngo bo la bzlas pa'i tshe/ rig pa/ blo/ mig shes pa skye ba bzhi/ de bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i khyad par la bzhi/ bya ba 'bras bu la bzhi ste bcu gnyis/ de bzhin du kun 'byung 'gog pa/ lam la yang bcu gnyis bcu gnyis te/ bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad yod kyang bcu gnyis tshan du chos mthun pas na rnam pa bcu gnyis zhes bya ste/

gnas bdun la mkhas pa'i dge slong bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ mdo sde pa ni/ bzlas pa gsum dang rnam pa bcu gnyis (156) ming gi rnam grangs su 'dod de/ bden bzhi'i ngo bo/ byed pa/ bya ba 'bras bu la bzlas pa'i cha nas bzhi po de re re la yang gsum gsum ste/ bcu gnyis su 'gyur bas so// zhes so// gnyis pa/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor la/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs dang*/ btsun pa dbyangs sgrogs kyi lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga tsam du 'dod de/ lung dang rigs pa gnyis kyi ma grub pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor nas lnga sde bzang po la mthong lam gyi rtogs pa skyes pa'i tshe/ lha rnams kyis 'jig rten na lhar gyur pa'am/ mir gyur pa sus kyang ma bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor zhes grags pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa grub ste/ rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'khor lo rin po che de yul gzhan du

(157) myur du bgrod par byed/ mnga' 'bangs ma rgyal ba las rgyal bar byed/ rgyal ba rnal du 'god par byed/ gzhan du bgrod pa'i tshe/ mtho ba la 'phar zhing dma' ba la 'bab par byed pa ltar/ mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga yang bar ma chad du myur du skye/ mthong lam bar chad med lam gyis mthong spangs 'joms par byed/ rnam grol lam gyis de spangs ba'i bral thob kyi rten byed/ khams gong ma'i bden pa bzhi la dmigs nas 'phar zhing*/ 'og ma'i bden pa bzhi la dmigs nas 'bab pa dang*/ chos mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ gnyis pa ni/ mthong lam gyis bsdus pa'i 'phags lam yan lag brgyad yin te/ de dang 'khor lo rin po che gnyis chos mtshungs rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas chos mtshungs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar mtshungs na/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ tshul (158) khrims/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum du 'dus/ 'khor lo rin po che la/ brten par byed pa'i lte ba/ sdud par byed pa'i mu khyud/ gcod par byed pa'i rtsibs gsum yod cing*/ tshul khrims ni lte ba dang mtshungs te/ bslab pa phyi ma gsum gyi rten byed pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin mu khyud dang mtshungs te/ dmigs pa la sems nang du gnas par byed pa'i phyir/ shes rab ni rtsibs dang mtshungs te/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin 'joms par byed pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ chos kyi 'khor lo mthong ba'i lam// myur bar 'gro sogs rtsibs sogs kyis// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa/ theg pa chen po'i lugs la/ mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya'i sgra bshad/ mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la/ kha cig ston (159) pas gsungs pa'i dam chos gang zhig bshad pas gdul bya'i rgyud la 'pho bya 'pho byed gang rung du snang ba de zer na/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i rgyud kyi rnam mkhyen chos can/ mtshan nyid kyi zur phyi ma der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/

'dod na gdul bya'i rgyud la 'pho bar snang bar thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig rtogs pa'i chos 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gdul bya'i rgyud la 'phos pa'i skabs srid par thal lo// yang*/ kha cig ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos gang zhig mi mthun phyogs 'joms byed ces dang*/ mi mthun phyogs gcod byed zer/ 'grel pa don gsal chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ rtags dang po der thal/ dam chos gang zhig ston pas gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen (160) gyi bar gyi chos thams cad sher phyin gyi mdo'i brjod bya ma yin par thal/ de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ gzhi grub na ston pas gsungs pas khyab par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'grel pa don gsal chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtsa rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ bka' brgyad stong pa mi mthun phyogs 'joms byed ma yin par thal/ 'grel pa don gsal de de ma yin pa gang zhig de gnyis la thos bsam byas pa la brten nas mi mthun phyogs 'joms nus kyi shes rab skye bar mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rtsa ba'i mtshan nyid dang 'gal/ kha cig lung rtogs gang rung gis bsdus pa'i ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos/ zer na/ 'grel pa don gsal chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ lung (161) gis bsdus pa gang zhig ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ lung gi chos 'khor dang rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gang rung gis bsdus pa'i ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos/ kho na re/ chos 'khor chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lung gi chos 'khor yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig rtogs pa'i chos 'khor ma yin pa'i phyir zer/ lung gi chos 'khor chos can/ lung gi chos 'khor gyi bye brag tu thal/ de gnyis gang rung gi bye brag yin pa gang zhig rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gyi bye brag ma yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che dang chos mtshungs pas na chos 'khor zhes bya'o// rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che mnga' 'bangs la dbang bsgyur ba'i phyir du yul gzhan dang gzhan du 'pho bar byed pa bzhin (162) du ston pas chos 'khor bskor ba la brten nas ston pa'i thugs rgyud kyi rtogs pa'i chos 'khor dang cha 'dra ba'i rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gdul bya gzhan rgyud la 'pho bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na/ thel tshe la sogs pa'i rgya dang*/ mar me la sogs pa dngos gzhan du 'pho ba yin kyang de'i cha 'dra gzhan du 'pho ba bzhin du'o// rgyud las/ kha ton mar me me long rgya// me shel skyur dang brag cha dang*// phung po nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe// mi 'pho bar ni mkhas rtogs bya// zhes so// gsum pa la/ rtogs pa'i dang*/ lung gi chos 'khor gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid la/ kha cig chos 'khor gang zhig lung gi chos 'khor gyi brjod byar gyur pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan/ zer na bka' brgyad stong pa chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ lung gi chos 'khor gyi brjod bya gang zhig rnam dkar (163) gyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ de gang zhig spangs rtogs gang rung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan de la dbye na/ rtogs pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i chos 'khor dang*/ rtogs pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i chos 'khor gnyis/ dang po la/ thar lam lnga gsum bco lnga lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ 'gog bden mtha' dag go /kho na re/ 'gog bden chos can/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po yin par thal/ chos 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ spyod pa'i gnyen por/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ rtogs par thal/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ lung gi chos 'khor yin na lung yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zer na/ dang po la/ bka' brgyad stong pa chos can/ der thal/

de'i phyir/ 'dod (164) na/ ma yin par thal/ bem po yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ gnyis pa la/ zag bcas sgom lam yin na/ zag bcas yin dgos par thal/ zag med sgom lam yin na/ zag med yin dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ gnyis pa lung gi chos 'khor la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ dogs gcod dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ kha cig rtogs pa'i chos 'khor brjod byar ston pa'i legs bshad/ ce na/ 'grel pa don gsal chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor yin par thal/ dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i lung gi chos 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ma yin par 'gyur ro// rang lugs ni/ chos 'khor gang zhig rtogs pa'i (165) chos 'khor brjod byar ston pa'i legs bshad/ de dang sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin khyab mnyam/ 'dod na/ bka' dang po bden bzhi'i/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor dang gsum/ gsum pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig lung gi chos 'khor gang zhig gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du ston pas sku tshe'i stod la gsungs pa/ zhes dang*/ de gang zhig gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du sku tshe'i dkyil la gsungs pa zhes dang*/ de gang zhig theg pa thams cad la zhugs pa'i gdul bya rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du sku tshe'i smad la gsungs pa zer na/ chos 'khor dang po yin na/ sku tshe'i stod la gsungs pas ma khyab par thal/ ston pa mya ngan las 'da' khar kun tu rgyu rab bzang dang*/ dri za'i rgyal (166) po rab dga' la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gsungs nas rim bzhin/ dgra bcom dang*/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu la bkod par gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ ston pas sku tshe'i smad la theg dman du rigs nges pa'i gang zag gi don dngos su ma mdzad par thal/

de 'dra'i gang zag la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor dngos su gsungs pa gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ chos 'khor bar pa yin na sku tshe'i dkyil la gsungs pas khyab pa yang med de/ ston pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas yun ring por ma lon par/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// zhes gsungs pa de nyid chos 'khor bar pa'i nang tshan yin pa'i phyir/ chos 'khor tha ma yin na/ theg pa thun mong pa'i mdo yin dgos par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas phal po che dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo la sogs pas ma nges so// gnyis pa la/ bshad bya'i lung (167) drang ba dang*/ de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la/ don dam yang dag 'phags kyis 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das kyis dang por yul wa ra na se'i drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rnam par bstan pas chos kyi 'khor lo ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sngon lhar gyur pa'am/ mir gyur pa sus kyang chos dang mthun pa 'jig rten du ma bskor ba cig rab tu bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de yang*/ bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang pa'i don/ rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa lags so// bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa nyid las brtsams te/ skye ba ma mchis pa dang*/ 'gag pa ma mchis pa dang*/ bzod (168) ma nas zhi ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa nyid las brtsams nas theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la stong pa nyid smros pa'i rnam pas chos ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de yang*/ bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang pa'i don/

rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa nyid las brtsams te/ skye ba ma mchis pa dang*/ 'gag pa ma mchis pa dang*/ bzod ma nas zhi ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyi yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa nyid las brtsams nas theg pa thams cad la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la legs par rnam par phye ba dang ldan pa shin tu ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsum pa bskor ro// bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor (169) ba 'di ni/ bla na ma mchis pa/ skabs ma mchis pa/ drang pa'i don lags te/ rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su ma gyur pa lags so// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/ gang gis bskor ba'i ston pa/ gang bskor bar bya ba'i chos/ gnas gang du gang zag gang la bskor tshul/ gang gi phyir du bskor ba'i dgos pa/ ji srid du bskor ba'i yun tshad dang lnga/ dang po dang*/ spyir chos 'khor ba'i gang zag la/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i chos 'khor 'ba' zhig gsung ba po'i longs sku dang*/ theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i chos 'khor gsung ba po'i sprul sku gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma nyid do// gnyis pa la/ dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ rang rigs la chos 'khor phyi ma gnyis po gang rung med pa'i lung gi chos 'khor gsum gyi nang tshan gang zhig gdul bya theg dman gyi rigs (170) can la bden bzhi rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed pa'i phyir du gtso bor gsungs pa'i rigs gnas/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rtsa ba'i lung so so thar pa'i mdo dang*/ bshad pa'i lung sde bzhi lta bu'o// dbye na/ chos 'khor dang po'i dang po/ dang po'i bar pa/ dang po'i tha ma dang gsum/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ bden bzhi tshig zin la ston pa'i/ stong nyid tshig zin la ston pa'i/ mtshan nyid gsum tshig zin la ston pa'i 'dul ba lung gi mdo lta bu'o// de yang chos 'khor dang po la/ bla na mchis pa zhes bya ste/ de las mchog tu gyur pa'i chos 'khor gnyis pa bskor du yod pa'i phyir/

rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir na skabs mchis pa zhes kyang bya/ drang ba'i don zhes kyang bya ste/ chos 'khor dang pos ma smin pa'i gdul bya rnams gnyis pa sogs la kha drang du yod pa'i phyir/ rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa zhes bya ste/ der (171) bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs bzhed kyi lta spyod mthar thug ma bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rigs la chos 'khor thog mtha' gnyis po gang rung med pa'i lung gi chos 'khor gsum gyi nang tshan gang zhig theg chen gyi rigs can rnams mthar thug theg chen gyi rtogs pa khyad par can la 'god pa'i phyir du gtso bor gsungs pa'i rigs gnas/ mtshan gzhi sher phyin gyi mdo mtha' dag go /dbye na/ bar pa'i dang po sogs gsum/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ bden bzhi/ stong nyid/ mtshan nyid gsum tshig zin la ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo lta bu'o// chos 'khor gnyis pa 'di la/ bla na mchis pa dang*/ drang ba'i don zhes bya ste/ 'dir ma smin pa'i gdul bya rnams la chos 'khor phyi ma la kha drang du yod pa'i phyir/ de nyid kyi phyir na skabs mchis pa zhes kyang bya/ rtsod pa'i gzhi'i (172) gnas su gyur pa zhes kyang bya ste/ dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa la dngos smra ba rnams kyis rtsod pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid rang rigs la chos 'khor dang po gnyis po gang rung med pa'i lung gi chos 'khor gsum gyi nang tshan gang zhig gdul bya ma nges pa'i rigs can dang*/ theg chen gyi rigs can ci rigs pa/ mthar thug gi rtogs pa la 'god pa'i phyir du gtso bor gsungs pa'i rigs gnas/ dbye na/ mtshan gzhi dang*/ brjod bya'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ theg pa thun mong pa dang*/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i chos la sogs tha ma gnyis/ dang po ni/ bskal bzang*/ rgya che rol pa/ lang kar gshegs pa la sogs pa mdo mangs kyi mdo phal cher ro// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas phal po che dang*/

dkon mchog brtsegs pa/ sa bcu pa la sogs pa rnams so// gnyis pa la tha ma'i dang po (173) sogs gsum/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ bden bzhi/ stong nyid/ mtshan nyid gsum tshig zin la bstan pa'i mdo mangs kyi mdo lta bu'o// chos 'khor gsum pa 'di la bla na ma mchis pa zhes bya ste/ 'dis ma smin pa'i gdul bya la chos 'khor bzhi pa la sogs bskor du med pa'i phyir/ de nyid kyi phyir na skabs ma mchis pa zhes kyang bya ste/ nges don dang*/ rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su ma gyur pa zhes bya/ mtshan nyid gsum gyi sgo nas kun rdzob tu chos thams cad yod pa dang*/ don dam pa spros bral yin pa sogs bden gnyis so sor phye nas gsungs pa gdul bya rnams kyi rtogs sla ba la dgongs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ chos 'khor dang po'i dbang du byas pa/ gnyis pa'i/ gsum pa'i de dang gsum/ dang po la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ de nyid cung zad bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ yul wa ra (174) na ser 'khor gyi gtso bo kun shes ko'u di n+ya dang*/ rta thul/ blangs pa/ ming chen/ bzang ldan te/ lnga sde bzang po la sogs pa gtso bo theg dman gyi rigs can rnams la gsungs so// gnyis pa la/ dang por snod rtag pa'i phyir du btang snyoms su mdzad tshul gdul bya gzhan gtso bor 'jug pa'i phyir du gzhan gyi gsol ba btab tshul/ zhal gyis bzhes nas chos 'khor ji ltar bskor tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs kyi cha la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun phrag bdun la gzhan gyi snang ngor chos ma gsung bar btang snyoms su bzhugs par mdzad pa yin te/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos zhig kho bos rnyed// su la bstan kyang go ba mi nus pas// mi smra nags 'dab dag tu gnas par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//

(175) de yang bdun phrag dang po la byang chub shing drung du bzhugs/ gnyis pa la/ stong gsum rgyang ring du 'chag gsum pa la/ byang chub shing la spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs/ bzhi pa la/ shar nub kyi rgya mtsho'i bar du 'chag par mdzad/ lnga pa la/ klu btang bzung gi gnas su bzhugs/ drug pa la/ shing n+ya gro ta'i drung du bzhugs/ bdun pa la/ shing grol rgyu'i drung du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ tshong pa ga gon dang*/ bzang pos/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ bu ram shing phul ba na/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pas snod ji lta bur bsod snyoms bzhes snyam pa dang*/ rgyal chen bzhis/ rdo'i lhung bzed bzhi phul bas/ bde bar gshegs la lhung bzed phul cig la// khyed ni theg pa mchog gi snod du 'gyur// nga 'dra dag la lhung bzed phul ba ni// dran dang blo gros rnams kyang nyams mi (176) 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ lhung bzed cig tu byin gyis brlabs te/ sbrang rtsi la sogs pa der bzhes/ tshong pa gnyis la yang*/ lha yi bkra shis don grub cing*// phyogs rnams bkra shis byed pa des// khyod kyi don rnams 'grub 'gyur cing*// thams cad myur du mthun par shog /ces gsungs te/ sbrang rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyal bar lung bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa la/ gzhan gyis gsol ba btab pa mi ltos par gdul bya la chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor bar bzhed pa yin kyang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin la sogs pas gsol ba btab na gzhan ches cher 'jug pa la dgongs nas de bzhin gshegs pas 'od zer bkye bas/ tshangs pa gtsug phud can/ 'khor tshangs pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad dang bcas pa lhags te/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa de bzhin gshegs pa la phul nas 'di skad ces smras te/ ye shes chen po (177) mchog gi dkyil 'khor bsgrub nas ni// phyogs bcu dag tu 'od zer rnam par bkye mdzad de// ye shes zer gyis mi yi pad+ma kha 'byed nas// smra ba'i nyi ma de ring ci slad btang snyoms bzhugs// zhes so// yang brgya byin 'khor dang bcas pa sbran te/

gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa phul nas/ zla ba nya ba gza' las thar ba ltar// khyod kyi thugs ni rnam par grol ba lags// g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba bzhengs su gsol// 'jig rten mun par shes rab 'od phyung gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas chos 'khor bskor bar zhal gyis bzhes pa yin te/ 'jig rten kun la snying rje mtha' yas pas// gzhan gyi gsol ba btab la nga mi ltos// skye bo 'di dag tshangs la dad pa ste// de yi gsol ba btab nas chos 'khor bskor// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes (178) bco lnga nas brtsams te zhag bdun phrag bdun 'das pa'i tshe/ yul wa ra na ser byon nas/ sangs rgyas stong gi rin po che'i khri yod pa'i dang po gsum la phyag dang bskor ba sogs mdzad de/ bzhi pa'i steng du bzhugs nas/ chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi la/ lnga sde bzang po la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gsungs nas mthong lam gyi rtogs pa la bkod/ gnyis pa ni/ bya rgod phung po'i ri dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ yum gyi gleng gzhi las gsungs pa ltar/ nyan thos kyi ming can lnga stong tsam dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong mang po la gsungs/ gsum pa ni/ ri bo ma la ya dang*/ grong khyer yangs pa can la sogs par theg pa mtha' dag la zhugs pa ste/ ma nges pa'i rigs can dang*/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya ci rigs pa la gsungs so// bzhi pa la/ (179) gdul bya rnams 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la zhen pa bzlog nas 'khor ba spangs pa'i myang 'das la 'god pa'i phyir du dang po/ 'khor 'das la blang dor tha dad du 'dzin pa'i zhen pa log nas mtha' bral rtogs pa'i dbu ma'i lam la 'god pa'i phyir du bar pa/ ma nges pa'i rigs can theg chen du kha drang pa dang*/ theg chen du nges zin pa rnams mthar thug gi rtogs pa la 'god pa'i phyir du gsum pa gsungs pa yin te/

dper na/ nor bu mkhan mkhas pas nor bu sbyong ba'i tshe/ dang por lan tshwa'i chu la sbangs nas skra'i re bas sbyang ngo*// de'i rjes su nya'i khu ba la sogs pas sbangs nas/ bal gyi la bas sbyong*/ de'i rjes su sman gyi khu bas sbangs nas/ ras srab mos sbyang ste/ dri ma dang bral ba'i nor bu 'byung ba bzhin no// de skad du/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mod las/ rigs kyi bu dper na 'di lta ste/ nor bu (180) mkhan mkhas pa nor bu sbyang ba'i tshul legs par shes pa des/ nor bu rin po che'i rigs nas yongs su ma dag pa'i nor bu rin po che blangs te/ lan tshwa'i chu rnon pos sbangs nas skra'i re bas yongs su sbyong bas sbyong bar byed do// de tsam gyi brtson pa yongs su dor ba yang ma yin te/ de'i 'og tu zas kyi khu ba rnon pos sbangs nas bal gyi la bas yongs su sbyong bas sbyong bar byed do// de tsam gyis brtson pa 'dor ba yang ma yin te/ de'i 'og tu sman chen po'i khu bas sbangs nas ras srab mos yongs su sbyong bas sbyong bar byed do// yongs su byang ste dri ma dang bral ba ni/ bai ḍūr+ya'i rigs chen po zhes brjod do// rigs kyi bu de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas yang yongs su ma dag pa'i sems can gyi khams mkhyen nas/ mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ bdag med pa dang*/ mi gtsang ba dang yid 'byung ba'i gtam gyis 'khor ba la/ dga' ba'i sems can rnams skyo ba bskyed par mdzad de/ (181) 'phags pa'i chos 'dul ba la 'dzud par mdzad do// de tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa brtson pa 'dor ba yang ma yin te/ de'i 'og tu stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa'i gtam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul rtogs par mdzad do// de tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa brtson pa 'dor ba yang ma yin te/ de'i 'og tu phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i gtam 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i gtam gyi rang bzhin sna tshogs kyi rgyu can ni sems can de dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la 'dzud par mdzad do// zhugs par gyur zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid rtogs na ni bla na med pa'i yon gnas zhes brjod do// zhes so// lnga pa la/

'chims na re/ dang po lo bdun/ gnyis pa lo nyer bdun/ gsum pa lo bcu gnyis kyi ring la bskor zhes gsungs/ mkhas pa bu na re/ dang po sku tshe'i stod/ (182) gnyis pa dkyil/ gsum pa sku tshe'i smad la gsungs par mngon/ zhes gsungs/ rang lugs/ lo ngo bzhi bcu rtsa drug gi bar la gdul bya rigs can gsum la chos 'khor gsum/ rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par rgyun mi chad pa'i tshul du gsungs pa yin te/ chu pho stag gi lo'i chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi nas brtsams te dgung lo brgyad cu pa la sa mo phag gi bar du chos gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ chos 'khor bskor tshul la sbyang pa/ grangs nges la sbyang pa/ chos phung gi rnam bzhag la dpyad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ kha cig chos 'khor gsum cig char du bskor te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gcig nyid gsungs pa la/ gdul bya rnams la go tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gsung gcig nyid du gsungs mod kyi// du ma nyid du so sor go /zhes gsungs so// gzhan du na/ theg pa gsum rim gyi (183) 'byung bar thal/ chos 'khor gsum rim can du bskor ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngar lung ma bstan lhan cig byung*// zhes pa dang 'gal lo// zer na/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gcig nyid la chos 'khor gsum gyi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ de gsum cig char du bskor ba'i phyir ro// sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams la rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos so sor gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ de rim can du ma bskor ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ ji ltar nad par nad pa la// sman pas sman ni gtong ba ltar// de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la// ji tsam bzod pas chos ston no// zhes pa dang 'gal/ kha cig sangs rgyas rang snang la cig char gdul bya gzhan snang la rim can du bskor bar 'dod pa dang*/ gzhan dag dbang rnon la cig char/ dbang rtul la rim can du bskor ba (184)

'dod pa yang sngar bshad pa'i rigs pas khegs so// rang lugs/ de gsum rim gyis bskor te/ de gsum gang la bskor ba'i gdul bya/ gang du bskor ba'i gnas/ gang gi ched du bskor ba'i dgos pa/ mi 'dra ba sogs du ma yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig thog mtha' gnyis mtha' cig tu drang don/ bar pa mtha' cig tu nges don yin zer/ kha cig dang po gnyis/ mtha' cig tu drang don yin te/ de gnyis la drang ba'i don/ rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mtha' gcig tu nges don gyi mdo yin te/ de la nges pa'i don rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su ma gyur pa lags/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer/ lugs dang po mi 'thad de/ chos 'khor thog mtha' gnyis dang nges don gyi mdo'i gzhi mthun yod/ bar pa dang drang don gyi mdo'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub (185) ste/ de dang stong nyid brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i mdo'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te/ nyan thos kyi lung las/ gzugs ni dbu ba rdos pa 'dra// tshor ba chu yi chu bur bzhin// 'du shes smig rgyu lta bu ste// 'du byed rnams ni chu shing bzhin// rnam par shes pa sgyu ma ltar// nyi ma'i gnyen gyis bka' stsal to// zhes dang*/ rab dbye las/ 'dul ba lung la sogs pa ru// stong pa nyid dang skye med dang*// mkha' dang lag mthil mnyam pa sogs// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs pa'ang gsungs// zhes so// gnyis pa grub ste/ de dang stong nyid brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i mdo'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ de dang kun rdzob bden pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i mdo'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te/ chos thams cad rnam (186) pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o// zhes pa 'di theg chen sems bskyed brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i chos 'khor bar pa'i mdo yin pa'i phyir/

lugs gnyis pa'ang mi 'thad de/ mdo dang po gnyis dang nges don gyi mdo'i gzhi mthun yod cing*/ phyi ma dang drang don gyi mdo'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te/ de dang kun rdzob bden pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i mdo'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ thog mtha' gnyis ka la drang don gtso che/ de dang nges don gyi mdo'i gzhi mthun yang yod/ bar pa nges don gtso che/ de dang drang don gyi mdo'i gzhi mthun yang yod pa yin no// gsum pa la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ mtshan gzhi dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rtogs pa'i chos rgya chen po brjod byar ston pa'i lung gi dam chos du ma 'dus pa'o// gnyis pa la/ (187) theg chen ltar na/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug dug gsum cha mnyam pa la spyod pa nyi khri chig stong gi gnyen por chos kyi phung po'ang grangs de snyed de/ brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo*// theg dman ltar na/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khrir tshad bzhed/ gsum pa la/ kha cig shā ri'i bus mdzad pa'i bstan bcos las chos kyi phung po sh+lau ka drug stong yod pa tshad du bzhed/ kha cig phung khams skye mched dam rten 'brel sogs don tshan re re rdzogs par ston pa'i gtam gyi tshogs la bzhed/ dbyig gnyen ltar na 'dod chags la spyod pa sogs nyon mongs pa sna re spong bar byed pa'i gnyen po rdzogs par ston pa'i gtam tshogs la bzhed de/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri mthun par gsungs pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ kha cig bstan bcos tshad ces zer// phung po (188) la sogs gtam re yin// spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni// chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ mdo sde pa yan chad ltar na/ gzugs kyi phung pos bsdus te/ brjod byed kyi tshig tu 'dod pa'i phyir/ bye brag smra ba ltar na/ 'du byed kyi phung pos bsdus te/ ming spyi ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed du 'dod pa'i phyir te/

chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dag /gang rnams thub pas gsung de dag /tshig gam ming yin de dag ni// gzugs dang 'du byed dag tu 'dus// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun byams mgon chos can rnam mkhyen la bstod pa yin te/ rten gyi gang zag thabs rnam mkhyen/ 'bras bu chos 'khor bskor ba'i mdzad pa gsum gyi sgo nas rnam mkhyen gyi yon tan brjod pa'i mkhas mchog yin pa'i phyir/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni nyan thos kyi lam gang (189) yin pa dang*/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ mtha' dpyad pa la/ shes bya lam gsum ngos bzung*/ nyan rang gi spang rtogs rdzogs tshul/ rdzogs smin sbyong gsum byas pa'i tshad/ yang dag mtha' ngos bzung*/ de mngon du byas pa'i tshad dang lnga/ dang po skabs gnyis par 'chad/ gnyis pa la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la kha cig nyan rang dgra bcom gyi spangs rtogs kyi rigs rnam mkhyen skad cig dang por thob pa dang dus mnyam du rdzogs te/ der nyon sgrib zad par spangs/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i phyir/ snga rol du ma yin te/ nyon sgrib ma spangs pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ byang 'phags kyis shes sgrib spangs par thal/ des nyon sgrib spangs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ kun btus las/ de byang chub thob pa na nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ (190) shes bya'i sgrib pa cig char spong ngo*// cig char dgra bcom pa dang de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang byang 'phags kyis nyon sgrib ma spangs kyang nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa mi bskyed pa dang*/ sngags dang sman gyis bsad pa'i dug gis dug gi nyes pa mi bskyed pa dpe don du sbyar nas bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ des nyon sgrib spangs ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de nyon mongs pa ma spangs su zin kyang sngags dang sman gyis sod pa'i dug lta bu dang dper na spangs pa'i dgra bcom pa ltar sa thams cad du nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa mi bskyed do// zhes dang*/

gzhan yang mos spyod du nga rgyal mang*/ ma dag par nga rgyal phra/ dag pa sar nga rgyal med par bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ byang 'phags kyis nyon sgrib spangs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nga rgyal mang ba dang*/ nga rgyal phra ba dang*/ nga rgyal med par 'dod/ ces pa dang 'gal/ zer/ mi 'thad de/ (191) gnod byed yod cing*/ sgrub byed med pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags de/ nyon mongs mtshan nyid par thal/ byang 'phags kyis 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs spangs pa gang zhig de'i rgyud la nyon sgrib yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems 'phags pas gzhan don du skye ba blangs pa'i skye ba rang rgyu las nyon gyi dbang gis byung bar thal/ de'i rgyur gyur pa'i bag chags de nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'phags pas 'chi dang na ba dang*// zhes sogs dang 'gal/ gzhan yang*/ theg dman dgra bcom pa dang*/ byang 'phags kyis nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ma spangs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gtsang ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos sku ma thob par bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ theg dman dgra bcom gyis nyon mongs pa'i bag chags spangs pa'i phyir te/ de nyon sgrib mtshan

(192) nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ thogs med kyi rgyud bla'i 'grel par/ de la dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ dbang thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis ma spangs pas ni/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dri nga ba'i bag chags thams cad dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gtsang ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa rab kyi mthar phyin pa mi 'thob bo zhes dang*/ 'bum ṭīka las/ dgra bcom pas ma rig pa'i bag chags ma spangs la/ de ma spangs pas nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi bag chags ma spangs so// zhes pa dang 'gal/ gzhan yang*/ 'phags pa rab 'byor dang*/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gnyis nyon mongs pa spangs par chos mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis mthong lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag de 'phags pa rab 'byor gyis 'doms par bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ byang 'phags (193) kyi rgyud la nyon sgrib yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyi khri snang bar/ ci'i phyir/ gnas brtan rab 'byor gyi kha nyid nas ston par mdzad ce na/ de ni nyon mongs pa med pa'i gnas pa'i mchog tu gyur pa nyid kyis nyon mongs pa dang bral ba'i skal ba mnyam pa lhag pa'i phyir mthong ba'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa'i ston pa po nyid yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa dang 'gal/ gnyis pa la/ thal 'gyur gyi lan dang*/ lung don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ nyon sgrib spangs na/ shes sgrib spangs pas khyab pa dang*/ dgra bcom thob na de bzhin gshegs pa thob pas khyab pa thal/ sgrub byed de 'thad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa chos can/ nyon mongs kyi nyes pa bskyed par thal/ nyon mongs kyi don byed nus pa'i phyir te/ nyon mongs pa mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ (194) gsum pa la/ mos spyod du chos sku med pa dang*/ sbyor lam du sku dang bcas pa dang*/ ma dag sar chos sku thob pa dang*/

dag pa sar chos sku rdzogs par yin par thal/ sku med pa dang bcas dang sku thob pa dang*/ sku yongs rdzogs dang*/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// khyab pa khas/ gnyis pa ni/ lung dang po'i don/ sgrib pa gnyis kyi bag chags cig char du spong ba la dgongs/ gnyis pa'i don byang sems 'phags pas nyon mongs pa ched du gnyer nas ma spangs kyang nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa mi bskyed pa la dgongs/ gsum pa'i don ni/ mos spyod du nga rgyal mang ba bshad pa nga rgyal mtshan nyid pa yod pa dang*/ ma dag sar nga rgyal phra mo yod par bshad pa ni/ nga rgyal gyi bag la nyal rags pa la nga rgyal gyi ming gis btags pa yin no// yang kha cig nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i spangs rtogs kyi rigs mtha' dag sa brgyad pa nas rdzogs te/ der nyon (195) sgrib spangs shing gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i phyir zer/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags de nyon sgrib mtshan nyid pa yin nam ma yin// yin na sa brgyad pa nas nyon sgrib ma spangs par thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dag pa sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sa nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi dbang gis gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba len dgos pa'i phyir/ de nyon sgrib ma yin na/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud la nyon sgrib yod pa dang 'gal/ gzhan yang*/ ar dang*/ nya dbon la sogs pa'i mkhas pa kha cig rtogs pa sa dang po nas rdzogs te/ der gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i phyir/ spangs pa sa brgyad pa nas rdzogs ste/ der nyon sgrib spang pa'i phyir/ zer ba mi 'thad de/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i gang zag yin na/ shes sgrib spangs (196) pas ma khyab par thal ba dang*/ nyon sgrib de rang rgyu gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba can gyi sgrib pa ma yin par thal/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug na nyon sgrib spangs pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ yang*/ mkhan chen pa na re/ spangs rtogs gnyis ka sa dang po nas rdzogs te/

theg dman dgra bcom pa dang*/ sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems gnyis kas 'khor ba 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs spangs/ nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal ma spangs par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dang*/ de gnyis kas nyon sgrib spang pa ma yin te/ nyon sgrib kyi bag chags yang nyon sgrib mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer ba mi 'thad de/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa ma yin par thal ba dang*/ theg dman la thar pa mtshan nyid pa med par thal/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas nyon sgrib (197) ma spangs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs zin rgyun ldan du bsgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi bsgom lam yod par thal/ theg chen bsgom lam gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i phyir te/ nyon sgrib ma spangs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ nyan thos kyi lam ni byang chub sems dpas yongs su shes par bya ba yin gyi/ mngon du bya ba ni ma yin pas bsgom pa'i lam ni ma bstan to// zhes pa dang 'gal/ gnyis pa rang lugs/ dman lam sngon du song ba dang*/ ma song ba'i dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas kyang nyan rang gi spangs rtogs kyi rigs rdzogs par yod de/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen tshogs lam pa des nyon sgrib zad par spangs shing*/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa (198) mthar thug pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod nas rdzogs te/ sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems dang*/ theg dman dgra bcom pa gnyis nyon sgrib zad par spangs shing*/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug par mtshungs pa'i phyir dang*/ mdo las/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi shes pa dang*/ spong ba gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i bzod pa'o// zhes dang*/

de'i 'grel par/ nyi khri snang bar/ bzod pa de yang gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa'o// zhes gsung ngo*// gsum pa la/ kha cig sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rgyud kyi 'gog pa chos can/ nyon sgrib kyi sa bon dngos su spong bar byed pa'i bar chad med pa la sngon song yin par thal/ nyon sgrib (199) kyis sa bon spangs pa'i 'gog pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ yang*/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod chos can/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs zin sgom par byed pa'i lam sngon song du thal/ de rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir zer/ 'o na/ dang po la/ sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi 'gog pa chos can/ 'khor ba 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs kyi sa bon spong ba'i bar chad med lam sngon song yin par thal/ de spangs pa'i 'gog pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po chos can/ ngo bo nyid sku mngon sum du rtogs zin rgyun ldan du bsgom par byed pa'i las sngon song yin par thal/ de rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gsum las/ dang po smon lam (200) rdzogs pa'i tshad ma/ kha cig rang gis btab pa'i smon lam thams cad 'grub pa de'i tshad yin zer/ ston pa shākya thub pa chos can/ rang gis btab pa'i smon lam thams cad grub par thal/ smon lam rdzogs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral zin par thal/ 'dod pa de gang zhig des sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa'i phyir/ dar ṭīka pa na re/ rang nyid gang du sangs rgyas pa'i zhing der mngon par shes pa dang mi ldan pa'i sems can med par ma gyur pa de srid du sangs mi rgya bar dam bcas pa'i dam bca'i gzhan don grub pa lta bu'o// zer na/

ston pa shākya thub pa de smon lam rdzogs pa'i gang zag ma yin par thal/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i zhing khams na mngon par shes pa dang mi ldan pa'i sems can yod pa'i phyir/ khyab (201) pa khas/ rang lugs/ smon lam gyi gtso bo gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i don grub pa smon lam rdzogs pa'i tshad yin te/ smon lam gyi mchog yongs su rdzogs pa nyid kyis dbu shin tu rgyas pa nyid/ ces bshad pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa/ sems can smin par bya ba'i tshad la/ dgag bzhag spangs gsum/ dang po la kha cig rang gi gdul bya sgrib pa spangs rung dang gnyen po skye rung du byas pa de'i tshad yin/ zer na/ 'o na/ byang sems mthong lam pa de sems can smin par byed pa'i gang zag du thal lo// yang*/ kha cig rang gi gdul bya sgrib pa dngos su spang rung dang*/ gnyen po dngos su skye rung du byas pa de'i tshad yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ ston pa shākya thub pa/ sems can smin par byas pa'i gang zag ma yin par thal ba'i skyon gnas so// kha cig sems (202) can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa'i nus pa mthar thug thob pa de'i tshad yin/ zer ba mi 'thad de/ de 'dra'i nus pa mthar thug gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir te/ sems can thams cad sbyor lam la dngos su 'god pa'i nus pa gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ smin pa'i sems can ngos bzung ba dang*/ de nyid smin par byas pa'i tshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrib pa dngos su spang rung dang*/ gnyen po dngos su skye rung gi sgo nas theg pa rang lugs kyi sbyor lam thob pa ni/ smin pa'i sems can yin la/ des mthong bsgom gyi rtogs pa'i tshe/ smin pa grol ba'i lam la gnas pa yin/ des mi slob lam gyi rtogs pa thob pa'i tshe/ grol ba mthar phyin pa'i lam la gnas pa yin no// gnyis pa la mkhan chen pa ltar na/ sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su sems can smin par byed pa'i phrin las la goms par byas pa'i stobs kyi nam
