(203) zhig sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin du sems can 'khor du ma bsdus pa bsdus/ bsdus pa smin/ smin pa grol/ grol ba rnams mthar phyin pa'i lam la 'god pa'i nus pa mthar thug thob pa la bzhed/ ṭī kas/ rang gi sku dngos kyi gdul bya'i sgrib pa dngos su spong rung dang*/ gnyen po dngos su skye rung du byas pa/ de'i tshad du byas pa legs te/ rgyan las/ ji ltar rma dang zas la de dag gi /gzag dang spyad du rung bas smin 'dod ltar// de bzhin rten 'dir phyogs gnyis zhi ba dang*// de bzhin spyod pa nyid du smin pa bstan// zhes so// yang*/ kha cig ston pa shākya thub pa la chos dngos su nyan pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag chos can/ sgrib pa dngos su spang rung dang*/ gnyen po dngos su skye rung du thal/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i sku dngos kyi gdul bya yin pa'i phyir te/ (204) de la chos dngos su nyan pa'i gdul bya yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ 'o na/ ston pa shākya thub pa la klan ka tshol ba'i bsam pas chos dngos su nyan pa'i phyi rol pa'i gang zag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de la dad ldan gyi gang zag tu 'gyur ro// gsum pa zhing sbyangs pa'i tshad ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing phun tshogs 'grub pa'i rgyu dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs par bsags pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas rang snang la snod bcud kyi/ zhing dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig du snang ba de de'i tshad yin te/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du// snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa// de la dag par bsgrub pa yis// sangs rgyas zhing ni dag pa nyid// ces so// de la kha cig ma dag pa'i shes bya rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la mi snang bar thal ba dang*/ de sangs rgyas la dag par snang bar thal/ rtsa ba'i dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma dag pa'i shes bya gzhi ma grub pa dang (205) ma dag pa dag par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la mi gsal ba mi snang ba dang*/

mi gsal ba gsal bar snang bar thal/ de la shes bya thams cad snang ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi gsal ba gzhi ma grub pa dang*/ mi gsal ba gsal bar 'gyur ro// gzhan yang*/ slob lam du snod bcud kyi zhing dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig du bsgom pa'i zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba dgos med du thal/ de ltar bsgoms pa la brten nas snod bcud kyi zhing dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig du snang ba'i sangs rgyas gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir dang*/ ro thams cad zhim po'i mchog tu snang ba'i sangs rgyas gzhi ma grub par thal/ snod bcud kyi zhing dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig du snang ba'i sangs rgyas gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'di la ro mi zhim pa ro mchog snang*// zhes pa dang 'gal/ bzhi pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ kha cig dman pa'i (206) myang 'das skabs 'dir bstan gyi yang dag mtha' yin te/ chos bshes kyis de ltar du bshad pa dang*/ 'grel chen las/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byed cing*/ zhes pa ni/ dman pa'i myang 'das thob par byed pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ byang sems 'phags pas rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum byas nas dman pa'i myang 'das mngon du byed par thal/ de'i phyir/ kha cig ngo bo nyid sku skabs 'dir bstan gyi yang dag mtha' yin te/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' rtogs pa dang*/ bag chags kyi 'tshams sbyor ba nyid spangs ba can yin/ zhes dang*/ 'grel chen las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de yang dag pa'i mtha' rab tu phye ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ 'o na/ byang sems 'phags pas rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du byed pa'i nus pa med par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ longs skus byang 'phags rdzogs (207) smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon sum cig ces pa'i mdo/ 'dom pa la dngos med du 'gyur ro// dar ṭīka pas/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i dbyings 'dir bstan gyi yang dag mthar 'dod pa yang de nyid kyis khegs so// rang lugs/

chos nyid de bzhin nyid de 'dir bstan gyi yang dag mtha' yin te/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du ni mi bya'o// zhes pa'i mdo'i don 'chad pa la/ de kho na nyid mngon sum du mi byed pa'i rten can zhes dang*/ gnas skabs thams cad du de bzhin nyid goms kyang de mngon du mi byed ces bya ba de bzhin nyid dang*/ zhes dang*/ dbus mthar/ stong pa nyid ni mngon bsdu na// de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'// mtshan ma med dang don dam dang*// chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so// zhes so// lnga pa la/ kha cig yang dag mtha' la rtse gcig tu mnyam (208) par bzhag pa de'i tshad du bzhed pa mi 'thad de/ stong nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ yang dag mtha' mngon du byas pa'i gang zag du thal/ yang dag mtha' la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum byas par thal lo// rang lugs chos nyid de bzhin nyid la spang ba med pa'i tshul gyis dus rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa de'i tshad yin te/ thugs ni chos rnams thams cad la// rtse gcig phyir na mnyam pa nyid// ces gsungs so// de la kha cig rgyun mtha' la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ yang dag mtha' mngon du byas par thal/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid la dus rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ de la mnyam par

(209) bzhag pa'i gang zag gang zhig de las ldang ba'i dus mi srid pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' ba de sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa'i yon tan ma yin par thal/ rgyun mtha' la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de chos nyid la dus rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa dgongs 'grel la/ gzhung gi 'grel dang*/ 'grel pa can gyi dka' ba'i gnas la dpyad pa/ ngag don dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams// zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ yul khyad par can la mchod par brjod nas/ dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa brjod byar byas pa'i bstan bcos rtsom pa la dgos pa nying dgos ji ltar yod snyam na rgyan la 'jug pa'i gegs log rtog mngon 'gyur ba bzhi bsal nas/ rgyan gyi gdul bya rgyan la thos bsam bsgom gsum gyis 'jug (210) pa'i ched du dgos 'grel gyi ngag 'di gsungs pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ lam shes yin te/ theg pa gsum gyi lam gyi bskyed rdzogs la mkhas pa'i shes rab dang*/ rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i mkhas gnyis dang ldan pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ de yang cung zad bshad na/ mngon pa'i rtogs pa'i rgyan chos can/ rtogs ldan mkhas pa rnams kyis 'jug par bya ba ma yin te/ brjod bya med pa'i tshig yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ smyon pa'i ngag bzhin no// zhes pa'i log rtog bsal nas/ dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa brgyan gyi brjod byar shes pa'i phyir du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las/ zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsungs/ yang de chos can/ snga ma de ma yin te/ dgos pa med pa'i tshig yin pa'i (211) phyir/ dper na/ bya rog so rtog gi bstan bcos bzhin no// zhes pa'i log rtog bsal nas/ rgyan la thos bsam byas pa la brten nas dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa bde blag tu rtogs pa'i shes rab de rgyan gyi dgos pa yin no// zhes 'chad pa ni bde blag tu ni/

zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsungs/ de chos can/ snga ma de ma yin te/ gnas skabs kyi dgos pa tsam yod kyang nying dgos med pa'i tshig yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ kla klo'i ma bag mar len pa'i bstan bcos bzhin no// zhes pa'i log rtog bsal nas/ rgyan la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa la brten nas thob pa'i rnam mkhyen/ rgyan gyi nying dgos yin zhes 'chad pa ni/ gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te/ zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsungs/ de chos can/ snga ma de ma yin (212) te/ khyod dang khyod kyi nying dgos gnyis la 'brel pa med pa'i phyir/ dper na/ 'jog po'i gtsug rgyan gyi nor bu len pa'i man ngag bzhin no// zhes pa'i log rtog bsal nas/ rgyan dang rgyan gyi nying dgos la thabs dang thabs byung gi 'brel pa yod tshul rtsa ba'i shugs la gnas pa/ 'grel pa dngos su 'chad pa ni/ brjod par byed la zhes sogs kyi bstan/ de yang rtsa bar 'grel pa yongs su dngos su mi 'chad pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ brjod bya sogs gsum dngos su bstan pas 'grel pa shugs la go nus pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos dang ni dgos pa'i don// 'grel pa'i gzhi ni gnyis la gnas// der bstan 'dus pa de'i phyir ro// dgos pa logs shig ma bstan to// 'brel pa ston par byed pa'i sku// dngos su yod pa ma yin yang*// 'on kyang de ni rnam dpyad las// don gyi go bar bstan pa yin// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ spyir ngag tsam la yod pa'i dgos 'grel ngag la yod pa'i (213) bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi/ gzhung gi bstan tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ spyir brjod byed kyi ngag don mthun yin na/ dgos sogs chos bzhi dang ldan pas khyab ste/ dper na/ bum par chu lon cig ces pa'i ngag la mtshon na/ bum pa chu dang bcas pa de'i brjod bya/ ngag de la brten nas bum par chu len dgos par shes pa de'i dgos pa bum pa chu dang bcas pa thob ste/

skyes bu'i btung ba sogs kyi bya ba byed pa de'i nying dgos/ 'brel pa spyi dang mthun no// gnyis pa dgos 'brel gyi ngag la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// zhes sogs kyi gzhung 'di yang*/ brjod byar dgos pa/ nying dgos 'brel pa bzhi dang ldan te/ dang po ni bstan bcos lus kyi dgos sogs chos bzhi lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ ngag 'di la brten nas/ rgyan la dgos sogs chos bzhi med dam snyam (214) pa'i log rtog bsal nas/ chos bzhi yod par shes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ rgyan gyi gdul bya rgyan la dgos sogs chos bzhi yod par shes te/ rgyan la thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi 'jug pa lta bu/ 'grel pa spyi dang mthun/ gsum pa la bzhi las/ dang po/ rgyan gyi brjod bya'i mtshan nyid/ rgyan gyi bshad byar gyur pa'i tshig don gang rung gis bsdus pa'i chos/ dbye na/ tshig dang don gyi brjod bya gnyis/ dang po ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo lta bu/ gnyis pa dngos brgyad don bdun bcu lta bu'o// gnas skabs kyi dgos pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyan la thos bsam sgom gsum ci rigs pa byas pa la brten nas/ thob pa'i rgyan gyi gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu/ mtshan gzhi/ rgyan la thos bsam bsgom gsum byas pa la brten nas dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa bde blag tu rtogs pa'i shes rab lta bu/ ngo bo nying dgos kyi mtshan nyid/ (215) de la thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa la brten nas thob pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu/ mtshan gzhi/ de la thos bsam byas pa la brten nas thob pa'i rnam mkhyen lta bu'o// rgyan gyi nying dgos rgyan la 'brel ba'i mtshan nyid/ des de la phan btags pa'i stobs kyis rgyan bkag na de'i nying dgos khegs dgos pa/ rigs 'dra'i dpe ni/ du ba me la 'brel pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ tshig dang po gnyis kyis brjod bya/ de nas bzhi yis nying dgos/ de nas gnyis kyis dgos pa bstan/

'brel ba shugs la bstan te/ dang po gsum dngos su bstan pas rgyan dang rgyan gyi nying dgos la thabs thabs byung gi 'brel pa yod par don gyi go nus pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ bstan bcos dang ni dgos pa'i don// zhes sogs so// gsum pa ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan chos can/ khyod la dgos sogs chos bzhi dang mi ldan pa'i (216) skyon med de/ dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa brjod bya/ de la thos bsam byas pa las/ thob pa'i shes rab dgos pa/ de la brtson nas thob pa'i rnam mkhyen nying dgos/ des phan btags stobs kyis de'i nyid dgos bshad dgos pa'i 'brel pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa la/ lus rnam bzhag pa dang*/ yan lag rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ bshad bya sher phyin gyi mtha' dpyad pa dang*/ 'chad byed dngos brgyad kyi mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya'i sgra bshad/ mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba/ dngos btags kyi khyad par dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed/ srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa mthar thug pa'i blo/ gnyis pa ni/ ji lta ji snyed kyi chos rab tu (217) rnam par 'byed pas na shes rab/ spangs rtogs mthar thug pa'i sangs rgyas ni so so'i skye bo la ltos te/ pha rol yin la/ de nyid du son pas na pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ste/ 'jug 'grel du/ pha rol ni nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus pa spangs ba mnga' ba'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas yin la/ phyin pa ni der son pa'o// zhes so// gsum pa la/ mtshan gzhi la dogs gcod dang*/ dbye ba dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig theg dman gyi rgyud la sher phyin yod de/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo yod pa'i phyir dang*/

mdo las/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o// zhes bshad pas so zer/ theg dman gyi lam de thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i lam yin par thal/ (218) khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ sdud pa las/ thabs med shes rab bral ba nyan thos nyid du ltung*// zhes dang*/ srid dang zhi bar ltung ba'i phyir// rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni// zhes dang*/ bshad sbyar las/ bse ru lta bu rnams la ni// pha rol phyin drug ming yang med// bcom ldan nyag cig pha rol phyin// drug gi spyi la bzhugs pa lags// zhes so// kha cig theg dman la med kyang*/ byang sems kyi rgyud la sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yod de/ de'i rgyud la phyin drug ngo bo ji lta ba bzhin du nyams su len pa'i nyams len yod pa'i phyir te/ go sgrub yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs// zhes so// yang de'i rgyud la de yod de/ de'i rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi lam yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam la/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ste/ zhes so// yang de'i rgyud la de (219) yod de/ dus gsum bden med du rtogs pa'i shes rab yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mdo las/ gang tshe 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang dkar nag chos// shes rab kyi ni bshig na rdul tsam mi dmigs tshe// 'jig rten dag na shes rab pha rol phyin grangs 'gro// zhes dang*/ dus rnams mnyam pa nyid shes phyir// shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod// ces dang*/ 'jug par/ sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos stong*// 'jig rten 'das kyi pha rol phyin ces bya// zhes bshad pas so zer/ lam sher phyin yin na sher phyin yin dgos par thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod mi nus te/ gzhung lam gnyis sher phyin btags pa pa yin par 'grel chen las bshad pa'i phyir/ bka' brgyad stong pa chos can/

chos skur thal/ rgyu mthun gyi chos sku yin pa'i phyir/ zab mo stong pa nyid brjod (220) byar ston pa'i mdo yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rgyud blar/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste// chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang*// de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang*// sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa'o// zhes so// sgrub byed rnams la rim bzhin/ slob lam na mkhyen gsum yod par thal/ de ngo bo ji lta ba bzhin du nyams su len pa'i nyams len yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum bsgom par byed pas rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa/ zhes so// phyir mi 'ong gi snyoms 'jug dag pa ba chos can/ 'das lam du thal/ 'phags rgyud kyi snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ zhes so// rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi sa yin par thal/ 'das pa sa dgu (221) 'das pa las byung ba'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sa dgu 'das nas ye shes ni// gang gis sangs rgyas sar gnas pa// zhes so// khyab pa rnams rim bzhin khas/ gnyis pa la/ gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sher phyin brjod byar ston pa'i legs bshad/ mtshan gzhi bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos so// gnyis pa la/ mtshan gzhi dang*/ mtshan nyid gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig theg chen gyi slob lam bzhi dang lam sher phyin yin te/ 'bras bu'i sher phyin thob par byed pa'i thar lam yin pa'i phyir/ zer ba mi 'thad de/ tshogs sbyor gnyis lam sher phyin ma yin te/ lam sher phyin la mthong lam gyi rtogs pa thob pa cig dgos pa'i phyir te/ 'grel chen las/ mthong ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid (222) can gyi lam la yang*/ zhes so// bsgrub byed kyang mi 'thad de/ theg dman gyi mthong lam yang der thal/

de'i phyir/ des na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dang bsgom lam mtshan gzhir 'thad do// gnyis pa ni/ 'bras bu sher phyin du bgrod par byed pa'i theg chen slob pa 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ lam sher phyin bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes/ bzhi pa la/ mkhas pa snga ma'i lugs/ brjod pa mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag pa/ rang lugs bzhag pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'bras bu sher phyin sher phyin mtshan nyid par 'dod pa'i/ lam sher phyin der 'dod pa'i/ 'bras lam gnyis ka der 'dod pa'i lugs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ phyogs glang dang*/ slob dpon/ dpal ldan zla grags rnams kyi bzhed pa yin te/ shes byed rim bzhin/ brgyad stong don bsdus su/ shes rab pha rol phyin (223) gnyis med// ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs// bsgrub bya'i don de dang ldan pas// gzhung lam dag la de sgras btags// zhes dang*/ 'grel chen las/ de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu ni dngos yin la/ de thob pa dang rjes su mthun pa nyid kyis na tshig dang ngag gi tshogs kyi gzhung dang mthong ba la sogs pa mtshan nyid can gyi lam la yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni btags pa'o// zhes dang*/ 'jug 'grel las/ pha rol ni/ zhes sogs bshad pas so// gnyis pa ni/ 'bum ṭīka mkhan po na re/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kho na sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yin gyi/ tshogs sbyor rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa ni btags pa bar bzhed de/ yum gsum gnod 'joms las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu (224) phyin pa zhes bya ba ni/ de la don dam pa smon pa dang*/ brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ las dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ 'khor ba dang*/ rnam par rtog pa dang*/ yon tan dang*/ shes par bya ba dang*/ rnam pa 'di dgu'i pha rol tu song ba'i phyir/

'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bsdus pa la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya'o// de nas de'i rjes la thob pa rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes me long lta bu dang*/ mnyam pa nyid dang*/ so sor rtog pa dang*/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rnams kyang de'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ 'bras bu la rgyur btags te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par btags so// zhes so// shān+ti pa na re/ sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kho na sher phyin yin cing*/ 'bras bu sher phyin dang so skye'i mngon rtogs ni sher phyin (225) btags pa bar bzhed de/ dag ldan las/ sbyor ba'i lam ci'i phyir sher phyin zhes bya zhe na/ de'i rgyu'i phyir ro// chos sku 'phrin las dang bcas pa la/ ci'i phyir sher phyin zhes bya zhe na/ de'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// rnam par mi rtog ye shes te// rnam par g.yeng ba'i rnam par rtog pa sa bcu'i gnyen po zhes gsungs/ gsum pa ni/ 'phags pas mkhyen pa gsum ka sher phyin mtshan nyid pa bzhed de/ nyi snang las/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang du mdzad nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan nye bar dgod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs na re/ theg chen gyi lam lnga ka sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yin par bzhed de/ de'i 'grel par/ de la

(226) shes rab ni chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yin la/ pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ mos pas spyod pa na/ chos thams cad bden par yid ches pa yin la/ rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa ni rnam par rtog pas dben pa yin no// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ lugs phyi ma gnyis mi 'thad de/ sngar mtshan gzhi'i skabs su dgag pa brjod zin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ sher phyin gyi sgra 'jug tshul spyir bstan pa dang*/ dngos btags kyi khyad par la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bdag med rtogs pa'i lam tsam la sher phyin du bshad tshul/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes la bshad tshul/ spangs rtogs mthar thug pa'i ye shes la bshad tshul dang gsum/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob pa 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o// zhes sogs dang*/ sdud pa las/ rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon phyogs bcur gang bzhugs pa// kun lam (227) pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin med par yongs su shes gyur pa// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// zhes dang*/ gang tshe 'dus byas zhes pa nas/ nam mkha' gang la cung zad mi gnas de dang 'dra// zhes dang*/ chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin dag cing yongs dag par// byang chub sems dpa' shes rab pha rol phyin lta na// byed pa po yang mi dmigs chos kun mi dmigs te// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// zhes dang*/ dus rnams mnyam pa nyid shes phyir// shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod// ces pa ltar ro// gsum pa ni/ sngar drangs pa'i brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs las bshad pa ltar ro// des na/ dang po ni/ bdag med la blo kha ma phyogs pa'i 'jig rten phal pa'i blo las mchog gam pha rol tu phyin pas na (228) pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgras smros/ gnyis pa ni/ nyan rang gi blo las mchog gam pha rol tu phyin pas na de'i sgras smros so// gsum pa ni/

'bras bu sher phyin sher phyin mtshan nyid pa yin zhing*/ gzhung lam gnyis btags pa ba yin te/ de'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ btags pa'i dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed kyi chos gsum tshang ba'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ gzhung sher phyin sher phyin gyi brjod byed dang*/ lam sher phyin sher phyin thob par byed pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ sher phyin don gnyer gyi gang zag gis gzhung sher phyin la thos bsam dang*/ lam sher phyin la nyams len byed dgos pa shes pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ spangs rtogs mthar thug pa'i shes rab ma thob pa'i phyir/ gal te byang 'phags kyi rgyud la rang rgyud kyi sbyin pa bla med byang chub tu 'khrid par byed pa'i lam la rtsom pa med pa thal/ de'i (229) rgyud la sher phyin med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sdud par/ dmus long smig bu med pa bye ba phrag khrig rnams// lam yang mi shes grong khyer 'jug par ga la nus// shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'dis// smig bu med pas byang chub reg par nus ma yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ skyon med de/ lung de ni bla med byang chub bgrod pa la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin dgos pa tsam la dgongs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dngos brgyad kyi mtha' dpyad pa la/ so so'i rang bzhin/ grangs nges pa go rim nges pa/ bzlos skyon spang ba dang bzhi/ dang po la/ mkhyen gsum/ sbyor bzhi/ 'bras bu chos sku bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ lo chen na re/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag med tsam mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ (230) theg pa gsum ka'i rgyud la yod pa gsum/ lam bden pa'i skye mched tsam mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes/ lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ byang sems dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la yod pa gnyis/ bden gnyis kyi rnam pa ma lus pa mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes de yang sangs rgyas kyi sa na mkhyen pa gsum sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka ltar ngo bo tha dad pa'i tshul gyis yod de/

sangs rgyas sa'i gzhi shes nges gzhi shes kyi lam dang rnam pa mi shes/ lam shes kyis gzhi lam gnyis shes kyang*/ rnam pa mi shes/ rnam mkhyen gyis gsum ka shes kyang gzhi shes pa'i cha nas gzhi shes su mi 'jog lam shes pa'i cha nas lam shes su mi 'jog rnam pa mkhyen pa'i cha nas rnam mkhyen du 'jog pa yin no// dper na/ tshig gsum rim gyis nos pa'i dge slong gi rgyud la sdom pa gsum ka yod kyang*/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i cha nas dge (231) bsnyen du mi 'jog dge tshul gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i cha nas dge tshul du mi 'jog dge slong gi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i cha nas dge slong du 'jog pa bzhin no zer/ sangs rgyas sa'i gzhi shes chos can/ shes bya thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa la sgrib byed kyi dri ma zad par spangs pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin par thal/ shes bya thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na nyon sgrib spangs pa'i spangs pa nyi tshe ba yod par thal/ khas len rtags/ bu na re/ gzhi shes yin na/ theg dman gyi mngon rtogs yin dgos/ lam shes yin na/ byang sems kyi mngon rtogs yin dgos te/ mdo las/ rab 'byor gyi gsol pa/ mkhyen pa gsum la bye brag dang khyad par ci zhig mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan thos dang (232) rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no// lam shes pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yin no// zhes dang*/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyi nyer zhir khrid mdzad gang yin dang*// 'gro la phan par byed rnams lam shes nyid kyis ces dang*/ nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam// de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod// byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi// lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad// ces zer na/ dang zhes bya ba'i sgras bsdus par/ lam shes pa ba nyid la sogs pa sngar bshad pa dag kyang yin te/

zhes pa'i gzhung de rnam pa mkhyen nyid dang*/ ces pa'i sgras/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na mkhyen pa snga ma gnyis yod par bstan pa mi 'thad par thal ba dang*/ skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin na/ gzhi shes ma yin dgos par thal/ khas len rtags/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas nyams su blangs pa don med par thal/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa la brten nas 'bras (233) bu'i dus su mkhyen gsum mthar thug thogs pa med pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ kha cig tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs na mkhyen gsum yod de/ gzhi lam rnam gsum bden pa'i skye med du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yod pa'i phyir zer/ tshogs sbyor na mthong lam bsgom yod par thal/ gnas lugs kyi don mthong ba dang bsgom pa'i mkhyen pa yod pa'i phyir/ dar ṭīka pa na re/ rnam mkhyen/ lam shes gzhi shes gsum gyi mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ sems bskyed la sogs pa'i chos bcu mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de'i rgyud kyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i theg pa chen po'i gang zag gi mngon rtogs dang*/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i ye shes gang zhig nyan thos kyi mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas (234) pa zhes dang*/ mos bsngo rjes su yi rang rtogs par 'dod pa ni nang 'gal te/ sa gnyis pa'i mos pa bsgom lam chos can/ lam shes kyi mtshan nyid der thal/ lam shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod rgyu ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud la stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab yod par thal/ de yang 'dod na/ mos pa bsgom lam dang*/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gzhi mthun yod par 'gyur ro// mtshan nyid gsum pa ni/ nyan thos kyi bsgom lam rjes thob ye shes chos can/

mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rtog pa yin pa dang 'gal lo// gnyis pa rang lugs/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa/ dbye na/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes sogs drug lam gsum bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i (235) mkhyen pa/ dbye na/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ theg chen gyi lam/ shes pa'i lam shes dang gsum/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyis bsdus pa'i chos ma lus pa mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug gi ye shes/ dbye na/ ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ chos can ji snyed pa mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes so// gnyis pa sbyor bzhi la/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam par bsdus nas bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga'o// mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus nas bsgom pa tshogs lam chen po las rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na sbyor lam rtse (236) sbyor sogs bzhi/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa ltar na/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ slob dpon ltar na/ rtse sbyor gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na/ phar phyin drug rjes su dran pa'i/ rjes dran drug rjes su dran pa'i/ dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba dang bcu gsum/ sa mtshams/ 'phags pa ltar na/ mthar gyis pa'i bya ba tshogs lam/ de'i bslab pa sbyor lam/ de'i bsgrub pa 'phags lam na yod par bzhed/

slob dpon ltar na/ dang po sbyor lam/ gnyis pa mthong lam/ gsum pa bsgom lam na yod par bzhed/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa dus skad cig ma cig la bsgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rnam par (237) smin pa ma yin pa'i rnam par smin pa'o// mtshan nyid med pa'i/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang bzhi/ sa mtshams/ lo chen/ sa bdun pa nas bcu pa'i bar du yod par bzhed/ kha cig sa bcu pa na yod kyang*/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyis ma khyab ste/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i skad cig ma de bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma yin par slob dpon chos bshes kyi bshad pa'i phyir zer/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i gzhi mthun yod par thal/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba de skad cig snga phyi'i rgyun dang bcas pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba skad cig ma dang po chos can/ rang 'bras chos sku'i dngos rgyu yin par thal/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ khyab ste/ skad cig ma gcig pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i skad cig ma gnyis pa la chos kyi sku mngon (238) par rdzogs pa byang chub pa yin te/ zhes so// rang lugs/ rgyun mtha' kho na na yod/ gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ sbyor bzhi bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i bla na med pa'i byang chub/ dbye na bzhi/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo la dngos brgyad cha shas dang bcas pa grangs nges pa yin te/ rgyan 'dis theg chen gyi rigs can sangs rgya ba'i lam gyi yan lag grangs tshang la ngo bo ma nor bar bstan tshul phyin ci ma log pa bstan pa gang zhig de la dngos brgyad cha shas dang bcas pa dgos pa'i phyir te/ de nyid la thos bsam gyis gtan la phab par bya ba'i yul/ nyams len gyi spyod pa/ thob bya'i 'bras bu gsum du dgos shing dang po'i dbang du byas nas mkhyen gsum/

gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas sbyor bzhi/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas sku bzhi 'phrin las dang bcas pa bzhag pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang (239) zag gis/ dang por shes bya'i yul thos bsam gyis gtan la phab/ de'i don sbyor gyis nyams su blangs pa la brten nas don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byed dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na/ 'bras bu ston thog don du gnyer ba'i gang zag gis/ dang por so nam sbyor thabs legs par shes par byed/ shes pa ltar lag len byas pa la brten nas ston thog phun sum tshogs pa thob par byed pa bzhin no// rtags mgo gnyis pa grub ste/ theg chen gyis rigs can gyis shes bya thams cad thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i cha/ dang por bdag gis thob par bya ba'i 'bras bu ni gang yin/ 'bras bu de thob par bya ba'i rgyu ni gang yin/ rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa'i rab dbye gang yin snyam du dpyod par byed cing*/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas mtshon byed kyi chos bcu'i sgo nas rnam mkhyen/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig gi sgo nas (240) lam shes/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas mtshon byed kyi chos bcu'i sgo nas gzhi shes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtags gsum pa grub ste/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyi gtan la phab pa'i don nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ dang por gzhi lam rnam gsum bden pa'i skye med du bsdus nas nyams su len pa dang*/ de nyid tshogs lam las rab tu gyur pa'i tshul gyi nyams su len pa dang*/ de spangs rtogs mthar thug gi bar du rim can du nyams su len pa dang*/ slob pa'i rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i cha/ dus skad cig ma gcig la nyams su len pa'i tshul dang bzhi yod cing*/ de'i dbang du byas nas sbyor bzhi rim bzhin bzhag pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa ltar na/ nyams len gyi spyod pa la bzhir 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

thob bya'i 'bras bu la spangs pa mthar thug dang*/ rtogs pa mthar thug gnyis su yod cing*/ dang po thob par byed pa'i dbang du (241) byas nas sbyor ba snga ma gnyis bzhag phyi ma thob par byed pa'i dbang du byas nas phyi ma gnyis bzhag pa'i phyir te/ spangs pa mthar thug thob pa la mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag sel ba'i rtse sbyor dgos/ de thob pa la rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ rtogs pa mthar thug thob pa la ye shes skad cig ma gcig gis mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa cig car du bsgom pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor bar dgos/ de thob pa la mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu la chos skur 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sbyor ba bzhi nyams su blangs pa la brten nas ji lta ji snyed kyi chos rnams mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ de nyid la glo bur gyi dri ma ma lus pa dang bral ba'i bral cha gdul bya las dag pa la mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i gzugs skur snang*/ dag ma dag sna tshogs la sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs (242)

su snang ba ste/ khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// zhar la mngon rtogs rkyang pa dang khug pa'i don bshad pa la/ rgyan gyi 'brel byed kha cig rnam mkhyen tshogs lam/ lam shes sbyor lam nas sa dang po'i bar du/ gzhi shes sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar du/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sa brgyad pa/ rtse sbyor sa dgu pa/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba sa bcu pa'i dkyil stod/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba sa bcu pa'i dkyil smad du nyams su blangs pa la brten nas 'bras bu chos mngon du byed pa ni mngon par rtogs pa rkyang pa'i lam rim yin zhing*/ de nyid rgyan gyi dgongs pa yin zhes zer/ khug pa'i don ni mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don sbyor ba bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blangs pa las 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byed pa yin no// rtsa ba'i dgongs par khug par bzhi ste/ yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu// sbyor ba bzhi yi (243) bdag nyid dang*// chos sku 'phrin las 'bras bu ni// don gsum gzhan ste rnam pa gsum// zhes so// yul dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ 'bras bu ni rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim yin te/ dang por mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don sbyor ba bzhis nyams su blangs pa la brten nas 'bras bu chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum ni/ bshad pa'i rim pa yin no// ci'i phyir bshad pa'i rim pa zhes bya zhe na/ brjod bya'i don la snga phyi'i rim pa med kyang*/ bshad pa gang la brten nas brjod bya'i don de gdul bya rnams kyis bde blag tu rtogs sla ba ni bshad pa'i rim pa zhes bya'o// de yang dang por rnam mkhyen gyi yon tan brjod pas de thob bya'i 'bras bu phun tshogs su shes nas de'i rgyu lam shes la 'jug 'dod kyi blo skye/ de yang byang sems lta spyod kyis bsdus pa'i gnyen po gzhi shes sogs rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu

(244) snal ma dang*/ rang don yid byed kyi bsam pas bcings pa'i theg dman gyi lam sogs de'i rgyu snal ma min par shes par bya ste/ rgyu ma yin pa la 'jug pa spangs nas/ rgyu snal ma nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu rnam mkhyen mngon du byed par 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na/ dang por 'bras kyi yon tan brjod pas 'bras de thob bya'i ston thog phun tshogs su mthong nas/ de'i rgyu tshol ba la 'jug de yang 'dam rdzab che zhing dro sar skye/ de las gzhan par mi skye ba sogs rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa'i rab dbye shes par bya ste/ 'bras kyi so nam tshul bzhin du byas pas 'bras kyi ston thog thob par 'gyur ba bzhin no// sbyor ba bzhi ni/ rgyu 'bras don gyi rim pa yin te/ snga ma snga ma la bsten nas phyi ma phyi ma 'byung ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ rnam mkhyen/ lam shes la/ lam shes dang*/ gzhi shes la/ mkhyen gsum dang*/ sbyor bzhi la/ rnam mkhyen (245) dang chos sku la bzlos pa spang ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ skabs dang po gnyis la bzlos skyon yod de/ de gnyis ka la sa bcu dang lam lnga sogs byang sems kyi mkhyen pa gtso bor bstan pa'i phyir/ zhe na skyon med de/ skabs dang por rnam mkhyen mtshon par byed pa'i chos kyi ldog pa nas bstan cing*/ gnyis par de thob par byed pa'i rgyu'i ldog pa nas bstan pas bstan tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ lam shes dang gzhi shes 'chad pa'i gzhung la bzlos skyon yod de/ de gnyis kar theg dman gyi mngon par rtogs pa bstan par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zhe na skyon med de/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su theg dman gyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir shes par bya ba yul gyi ldog pa nas bstan/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs su rang don yid byed kyis bcings pa'i theg dman gyi lam rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu snal ma ma yin (246) pa shes pa'i phyir du lam shes kyi gol sa'i ldog pa nas bstan pas bstan tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ mkhyen gsum dang sbyor bzhi la bzlos skyon med de/ sbyor bzhi 'chad pa'i skabs su mkhyen gsum bstan pa'i phyir te/ kun mkhyen nyid ni rnam gsum phyir// de ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod// ces dang*/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi// yongs su rdzogs pa bla med pa// zhes gsungs pas so// ce na skyon med de/ skabs dang po gsum du thos bsam gyis gtan la phab par bya ba'i yul gyi ldog pa nas bstan cing*/ sbyor bzhi 'chad pa'i skabs su nyams su blang bya'i ldog pa nas bstan pas bstan tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ skabs dang po dang brgyad pa la bzlos skyon yod de/ de gnyis kar sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i chos sku bstan par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zhe na skyon med de/ dang por thos bsam (247) gyis gtan la phab par bya ba'i yul gyi ldog pa nas bstan cing*/ brgyad par thob bya'i 'bras bu'i ldog pa nas bstan pas bstan tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad la/ thos bsam gyis gtan la phab par bya ba'i yul/ nyams len gyi sbyor ba/ thob bya'i 'bras bu dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen/ rgyu lam shes/ blang dor bya ba'i yul gzhi shes/ dang po la/ 'brel bkod pa'i sgo nas 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar bsdus pa'i don kun bstan nas/ zhes sogs kyi bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sems bskyed la sogs pa mtshon byed kyi chos bcu yod cing*/ 'di dag la bsdu ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ dka' ba'i gnas bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ lo (248) chen na re/ chos bcu po bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag dang*/ de'i rgyud la yod pa'i sgrub gnyis su 'dus/ dang po ni/ chos bzhi dang ldan te/ bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ sbyor ba de bzhin gshegs pa la gdam ngag nyan pa/

gdam ngag gi 'bras bu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi rtog pa rang rgyud la thob pa/ rkyen theg pa chen por rigs sad pa'o// gnyis pa la/ sgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ de'i ched du bya ba/ de rang gi ngo bo dang gsum/ 'dre ltar na/ sgrub pa rgyud la skyed par byed pa dang*/ bsgrub pa gsal bar byed pa'i chos gnyis su 'dus/ dang po la/ sems bskyed nas gdam ngag tshol ba dang*/ gdam ngag gi 'bras bu nges 'byed cha mthun rang rgyud la bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa la/ sgrub pa'i rten/ dmigs pa/ ched du bya ba/ ngo bo dang bzhi yod do gsung ngo*// rang lugs/ bsam pa sems bskyed pa dang*/ sbyor ba lam la 'jug pa'i (249) tshul gnyis su 'dus/ dang po la/ sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis 'chad/ de'i dmigs yul gzhan don dang byang chub ni/ de dang de ni/ zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis 'chad/ mtshon byed kyi dpe/ mtshungs ldan gyis grogs/ chos mthun gyi gtan tshigs gsum gyi sgo nas nyer gnyis su yod tshul 'chad pa ni/ de yang sa gser zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis 'chad/ de dag gi sa mtshams 'grel pas kha bkang ste 'chad pa ni/ de la dang po gsum ni/ zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ bsgrub pa'i thabs ston pa'i rgyu gdam ngag thob bya sgrub pa'i 'bras bu nges 'byed cha mthun/ 'jug bya sgrub pa'i yan lag gi chos dang gsum/ dang po la/ gdam ngag bcu spyir bstan pa ni/ bsgrub dang zhes sogs kyis bstan/ rtogs dka' ba dge (250) 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ dbang po rtul dang*/ zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ ngo bo mdor bstan pa dang*/ khyad chos rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dmigs pa dang ni/ zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ gsum las/ dang po dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khyad chos ni/ dmigs pa mi rtags la sogs pa// zhes sogs kyis bstan/

gnyis pa la/ gzhi dang de yi gnyen po yis// zhes sogs kyis gzung rtog gnyis dang*/ rdzas dang btags pa'i rten can gyi// zhes sogs kyis 'dzin rtogs gnyis te/ spang bya rtog pa'i khyad chos dang*/ gsum pa yongs 'dzin gyi khyad chos ni/ sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gsum pa la/ sgrub pa'i rten rigs/ de'i dmigs pa/ ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo dang bzhi/ dang po la/ rigs kyi dbye ba (251) dang*/ rtsod spang gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtags pa yi ni chos drug dang*// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ rtsod pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ lan la 'thad pa'i sgo nas chos dbyings rigs su bsgrub pa dang*/ dpe'i sgo nas rigs la dbye ba 'thad tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ji ltar nyan thos kyi theg pa la sogs pa zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ sems can kun mchog sogs kyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ go cha'i/ 'jug pa'i/ tshogs kyi/ nges 'byung gi bsgrub pa bzhi rim bzhin de dag so sor/ bsam gtan gzugs med/ brtse dang sbyin la/ ched du bya dang*/ zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis bstan/ de dag ni bshad (252) pa'i rim pa yin cing*/ rkyen theg chen du rigs sad pa'i gang zag gis bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas sbyor ba de bzhin gshegs pa la theg chen gyi gdam ngag nyan te/ nges 'byed cha mthun gyi rtogs pa rang rgyud la skyed par byed/ de ltar bskyed pa'i gang zag des/ bsam pas go cha gyon/ sbyor bas lam la 'jug cing*/ tshogs gnyis kyi dpung rgya chen po bsags te/ 'khor ba spangs pa'i myang 'das su nges par 'byung ba'i bsgrub pa dang bzhis/ dmigs pa bcu gcig la dmigs nas nyams su blangs pas mthar thug gi 'bras bu ched du bya ba gsum rang rgyud la mngon du byed pa ni/

nyams len gyi rim pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan chos can/ sher phyir bshad pa yin te/ dngos po brgyad kyi sgo nas de phyin ci ma log par bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bsam pa sems bskyed pa dang*/ sbyor ba bsgrub pa la 'jug tshul (253) gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po theg chen sems bskyed la/ lus rten/ bsam pa'i rten/ brten pa sems bskyed dang gsum/ dang po la/ dngos dang*/ dogs spong gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'du shes med pa dang*/ gzugs med kyi sems can ma gtogs pa 'gro ba gzhan rnams ni rang stobs dang gzhan stobs ci rigs pa'i sgo nas theg chen sems bskyed dngos su skye ba'i rten du rung ba yin no// de yang dang po la/ dngos su mi skye ste/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa gsal po mngon gyur ba rgyun chags su med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dngos su mi skye ste/ gzugs med khams pa'i sems can ni phan tshun gcig gis gcig yul du mi 'gyur bas/ gzhan sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba mthong ste/ de dang bral 'dod kyi blo dngos su skye ba med pa'i phyir/ ngan song gsum gyi rten (254) la dngos su skye ba yod de/ drin lan gsab pa las/ ston pa sngon dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ grogs la snying rje skyes nas byang chub sems bskyed par bshad pa dang*/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo las/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis/ yi dwags mang po bden pa mthong ba la bkod par bshad pa dang*/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ klu nyi khri chig stong gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir/ lha mi'i rten la dngos su skye bar rung ste/ mdo las/ de tshe lha mi stong phrag brgya// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// zhes so// sdom gsum las/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed 'di// sems can kun gyi legs thob na// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhes// mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las gsungs// zhes so// gnyis pa la/

ngan song gi rten la theg chen sems bskyed dngos su skye ba med (255) de/ lung dang rig pa gnyis kyi gnod pa'i phyir/ lung gi gnod de/ lam sgron las/ so so thar pa rigs bdun gyi// rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min// zhes gsung zhing*/ ngan 'gro'i rgyud la so thar gyi sdom pa dngos su skye ba med pa'i phyir/ rigs pas gnod de/ dmyal ba'i rten can gyi byang chub sems dpa' chos can/ bde 'gro bar thal/ byang chub sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ lung gis mi gnod de/ lung de ni sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi sdom pa'i rten tsam la dgongs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yang mi 'thad de/ byang chub sems dpas gzhan don gtso bor sgrub pa ma yin par thal/ gzhan don du dngos su dmyal ba 'jug nus kyi byang sems med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ dmyal ba'i rten can gyi (256) byang sems yod par 'gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ rkyen theg pa chen por rigs sad pa'i stobs kyis sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsal 'dod kyi snying rje dang rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mdzad spyod la dmigs pa'i dad pa ni bsam pa'i rten du dgos te/ de yod na/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob 'dod kyi blo ngang gis skye ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog sgron me'i mdo las/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing*// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la'ang dad byed pa// byang chub bla na med la dad gyur na// skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sems skye'o// zhes dang*/ rin chen phreng bar/ de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems// ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang*// phyogs mthas gtugs pa'i snying rje dang*// gnyis la mi rten ye shes lags// zhes dang*/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ de la dang por rigs nus pas// snying rje'i sa bon rab sad cing*// sbyor dang bsam pa phun tshogs pas// byang chub

(257) sems ni yongs su gzung*// zhes so// gsum pa la/ sems bskyed kyi rang bzhin/ bslab bya/ phan yon dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so// dang po la/ bshad tshul spyir bstan pa dang*/ 'thad phyogs ngos bzung ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ thogs med sku mched kyis sems byung la bzhed de/ byang sar/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam gyi mchog ni sems bskyed pa'o// zhes gsung zhing*/ smon lam yang don gnyer gyi 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa la 'dod de/ rgyan las/ brtan pa rnams kyi smon lam ni// sems pa 'dun dang bcas pa ste// zhes dang*/ spro ba che dang rtsom pa che// don che ba dang 'byung ba che// byang chub sems dpa' sems pa ste// don gnyis ldan pa'i sems 'byung ba// zhes pa'o// 'grel par/ dbyig gnyen gyis (258) yon tan gsum dang gnyis la dmigs pa dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' ni sems bskyed pa zhes bya'o// zhes so// 'phags seng gnyis ltar na/ sems sems byung gnyis kyi nang nas gtso bo sems/ de la yang tshogs brgyad yod pa'i nang nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ de la yang rigs du ma yod pa'i nang nas stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin zhing*/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa dge ba la 'dod de/ nyi snang las/ sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba la sems ni rnam par shes pa ste rnam par rig pa'o// rnam par shes pa gang yin zhe na/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste dkar po'i chos thams cad la dmigs pa ni de la srid pa'i phyir ro// zhes dang*/ don gsal las/ bden mod kyi 'on kyang zhes sems bskyed yin na sems byung ma yin pas khyab pa la bden lan bshad pa'i phyir/ ṭī kas/ sems sems byung gnyis ka la sems bskyed kyi sgra

(259) bshad du yod de/ sems rang gi bskyed par bya ba yin pas na sems bskyed ces bya ba la bshad na gtso bo sems dang*/ sems kyis bskyed par byed pas na sems bskyed ces byed pa la bshad na sems byung la gnas pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags seng gnyis kyi lugs ltar 'thad de/ 'grel pa don gsal 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ de yang slob lam du yid kyi rnam par shes pa tsam la 'jog cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sar tshogs drug ka sems bskyed du 'gyur ba mi 'gal te/ don dam sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid tshang ba'i phyir te/ chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas de la mnyam par bzhag pa'i gtso bo sems yin pa'i phyir dang*/ sems chen por bshad pa'i phyir/ nyi snang gi don yang gtso che ba'am slob pa'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin no// gnyis pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig rdzogs pa'i (260) byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i gtso bo rnam rig ces dang*/ kha cig gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang*/ mtshungs ldan gyi gtso bo rnam rig kha cig gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i thar lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gtso bo rnam rig zhes dang*/ yang kha cig gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la myong ba thon pa'i tshul gyis dmigs pa'i theg chen skyes bu'i rgyud kyi gtso bo rnam rig zer ro// dang po la/ sangs rgyas sa'i sems bskyed chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de thob zin pa ma yin par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan lnga mtshungs du 'grub bo// gsum pa la/ theg chen (261) gyi tshogs lam du dngos su 'jug kha ma'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la theg chen sems bskyed yod par thal/

mtshan nyid de yod pa'i phyir te/ theg chen sems bskyed yin na/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi blo sngon song yin dgos pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa la/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la myong ba thon pa'i tshul gyis dmigs pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi kun gzhi'i rnam shes chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de 'dra ba'i gang zag chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi kun gzhi'i rnam shes de/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi gtso bo sems yin par thal/ khyod sems can yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la myong ba thon pa'i tshul gyis dmigs pa'i theg chen gyi thar lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gtso bo rnam rig gsum pa la/ (262) mtshan gzhi/ phra rags/ cho ga sems bskyed tshul/ dpe grogs/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang drug dang po la/ smon 'jug gnyis/ 'di la dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la/ kha cig theg chen sems bskyed gang zhig theg chen gyi 'phags lam ma thob pa dang*/ de gang zhig de thob pa'i sgo nas bslab bya la slob par byed pa rim bzhin mtshan nyid yin te/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems ni 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi yin la/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba nas bzung ste/ zhes dang*/ lo chen gyis/ byang chub ma thob pa thob par 'dod pa'i smon sems dang*/ byang chub thob nas bslab bya la slob pa 'jug sems yin no// zhes bshad cing*/ byang chub kyang 'phags lam la bzhed pa'i phyir/ zer/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud la/ byang sems kyi sdom pas ma zin (263) pa'i sems bskyed yod par thal/ de'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed mtha' dag smon sems yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi don dam sems bskyed chos can/ 'jug sems su thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ kun rdzob sems bskyed du 'gyur ro// kha cig

theg chen tshogs lam pa'i sems bskyed mtha' dag smon sems dang*/ sbyor lam yan chad kyi sems bskyed 'jug sems yin te/ paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes grags kyis/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi dang po gsum smon sems dang*/ phyi ma bcu dgu 'jug sems su bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dun sogs gsum gyi dbye ba yis// smon pa'i sems ni rnam pa gsum// 'jug par zhes bya'i bdag nyid ni// bcu dgu dag tu shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud la byang sems kyi sdom pas zin pa'i sems bskyed med pa (264) thal ba dang*/ don dam sems bskyed kun rdzob sems bskyed du thal ba'i skyon gnas so// kha cig smon 'jug gnyis mi 'gal te gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par smon pa'i cha nas smon sems dang*/ de thob phyir du bslab bya la slob pa'i cha nas 'jug sems su bshad pa'i phyir/ zer/ kun rdzob bden pa rtogs pa'i sems bskyed tsam la dang po dang*/ don dam bden pa rtogs pa'i sems bskyed tsam la gnyis par 'jog dgos pa'i phyir ro// dar ṭīka pas/ theg chen sems bskyed gang zhig sbyor ba nyams len gyi dus su dngos su ma zin pa dang*/ zin pa la 'dod cing*/ de'i don yang*/ rnam mkhyen don gnyer gyi dran 'dun du re ba yod med la byed cing*/ sa mtshams kyang smon sems tshogs lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar du yod/ 'jug sems tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod zer/ mi 'thad de/ dngos stobs kyi rigs pa/ khas blangs dang 'gal/ yid ches (265) pa'i lung gis gnod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ rang don du byang chub don du gnyer ba'i byang 'phags yod par thal/ byang 'phags yin na/ gzhan don du rnam mkhyen don du gnyer bas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ de'i sems bskyed yin na/ gzhan don du rnam mkhyen don gnyer gyi bsam pas zin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/

gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na rnam mkhyen ma thob pa thob 'dod kyi blo yod par thal/ de ni rnam mkhyen don gnyer gyi dran 'dun du re ba'i bya ba dang dngos su ldan pa'i sems bskyed yod pa'i phyir te/ 'jug sems yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na bla med byang chub tu 'gro bar byed pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ byang chub thob phyir du chas pa'i sems bskyed yod par thal/ de ni 'jug sems yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu sems (266) can gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon pa de dag kyang dkon no// rigs kyi bu de bas kyang sems can gyi ris na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu chas pa ni shin tu dkon no// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yis// bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar// de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi// bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bzhed pa la smon pa'i sems/ smon pa'i sems bskyed/ smon pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i bslab bya/ 'jug pa'i sems/ 'jug pa'i sems bskyed 'jug pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i bslab bya dang gsum yod cing*/ smon pa sems bskyed kyang sdom pas zin par bzhed do// rang lugs ni/ rang dang lhan cig pa'i byang sems kyi sdom pas ma zin pa'i kun rdzob sems bskyed dang*/ rang dang lhan cig pa'i byang sems kyi bslab pa'i grogs kyis zin (267) pa'i kun rdzob sems bskyed/ rim bzhin mtshan nyid yin/ dang po ni/ byang sems kyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga sngon du ma song bar byang sems kyi tshogs lam thob ma thag pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ kun dkris chen pos bcad pa'i rtsa ltung gis byang sems kyi sdom pa las nyams pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i sems bskyed lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/

byang sems kyi sdom pa rgyud la ldan pa'i byang sems so skye'i sems bskyed mtha' dag dang*/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rjes thob kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sems bskyed lta bu'o// de yang dang po sbyor lam yan chad du 'gro ba mi srid de/ de yan chad na sdom pas ma zin pa'i sems bskyed med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gnas skabs na med de/ de kun rdzob sems bskyed du nges pa'i phyir/ des na sdom pas zin ma zin gyi sgo nas smon 'jug (268) gi khyad par 'jog pa 'thad de/ smon sems byang sems kyi sdom pas ma zin pas bsod nams rgyun chags su mi 'byung ba dang*/ 'jug sems ngos zin pas bsod nams rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub smon pa'i sems pas ni// 'khor tshem 'bras bu che 'byung yang*// ji ltar 'jug pa'i sems bzhin du// bsod nams rgyun chags 'byung ba min// gang nas bzung ste sems can khams// mtha' yas rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir// mi ldog pa'i sems kyis su// sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa// de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam// bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shug /rgyun mi chad pa du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung*// zhes dang*/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis/ smon pa ni smon pa tsam ste/ sems bskyed pa'i cho ga tsam yang blang bar ma byas pa'o// zhes dang*/ bsgom rim bar par/ dang por 'gro ba mtha' dag la (269) phan pa'i phyir du sangs rgyas su gyur cig zhes gang thog mar don du gnyer ba ni/ smon pa'i sems so// gang phan chad sdom pa blangs pa nas bzung ste/ tshogs rnams la zhugs pa ni 'jug pa'i sems so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ smon sems sdom pas ma zin pa med de/ byang sems yin na/ byang sems kyi sdom pa rgyud ldan yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ dge slong yin na/ dge slong gi sdom pa rgyud ldan yin dgos pa'i phyir/

theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs na/ 'jug sems med pa mi 'thad de/ theg chen sems bskyed la smon 'jug gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdus na// rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni// byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ (270) byang sems sdom pa'i rtsa ltung phog pa'i dbang gi ngan song du skye nges kyi byang sems gzhi ma grub par thal/ rtsa ltung gi dbang gis byang sems kyi sdom pa las nyams nas smon sems yan gar du gnas pa gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ spyod 'jug las/ de ltar ltung ba stobs ldan dang*// byang chub sems stobs ldan pa dag /'khor bar res kyis 'dre byed na// sa thob pa la yun rings thogs// zhes pa dang 'gal/ gnyis pa la/ dam pa'i chos la bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su grangs nges par thal/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gal te/ skyon med de/ lung gi dam chos la de gnyis su grangs nges pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ snga ma la yang skyon med de/ kun rdzob sems bskyed la smon 'jug gnyis su grangs nges pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ (271) gnyis pa la/ rags pa brda' las byung ba'i dang*/ phra ba chos nyid kyi thob pa'i sems bskyed gnyis/ dang po kun rdzob sems bskyed dang don gcig phyi ma don dam sems bskyed dang don cig 'di dag la mi 'thad pa'i cha dbang ba dang*/ rang lugs gnyis dang po la/ kha cig theg chen sems bskyed gang zhig kun rdzob bden pa 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byed pa dang*/ don dam bden pa 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byed pa mtshan nyid du 'jog na/ kun rdzob bden pa 'dzin stangs yul du byed pa'i sangs rgyas sa'i sems bskyed dang*/ chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed kyis rim bzhin ma nges/

rang lugs la/ gnyis las/ dang po kun rdzob sems bskyed la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ rang rigs la chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag la shes med cing gzhan don (272) du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i theg chen slob pa'i sems bskyed/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen tshogs sbyor ba'i sems bskyed rnams dang*/ byang 'phags kyi rjes thob kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sems bskyed lta bu'o// de la'ang byang sems kyi rjes thob kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sems bskyed rnams ni/ 'dzin stangs kyi yul gyi sgo nas kun rdzob sems bskyed du rtogs te/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa tsam 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byed pa'i theg chen sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ mnyam bzhag la gnas pa'i byang sems so skye'i sems bskyed rnams ni/ rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas kun rdzob sems bskyed du rtog ste/ kun rdzob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ don dam sems bskyed dang rgyud la ma thob pa'i byang sems kyi sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ don dam sems bskyed thob pa'i byang sems la don dam pa'i byang chub sems dpar bshad pa'i phyir (273) 'jug par/ de nas bzung ste de ni de thob par 'gyur pa yis/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'i sgra nyid kyis snyad do// zhes so// gsum pa la/ grogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi stobs las/ rgyu theg chen gyi rigs sad pa las/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po goms pa las/ theg chen sems bskyed ston pa'i gsung rab mang po thos pa las/ dge ba theg chen sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa goms pa las thob pa'i sems bskyed dang lnga/ dang po mi brtan pa'i sems bskyed yin te/ grogs gzhan la rag las pa'i phyir/ phyi ma rnams brtan pa'i sems bskyed yin te/ mi mthun phyogs kyis nyams dka' ba'i phyir/

rgyan las/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs// thos stobs dge ba goms pa dang*// mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba// gzhan gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad// ces so// gnyis pa/ (274) don dam sems bskyed la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sgra bshad/ sa mtshams dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sems bskyed/ dbye na/ 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma dang bcas pa/ de med pa'i sems bskyed/ sgrib pa spang pa'i don dam sems bskyed dang gsum/ gsum pa ni/ yongs su 'dzin pa dam pa/ rjes su sgrub pa dam pa/ rtogs pa dam pa ste/ dam pa gsum dang ldan pas na don dam sems bskyed ces bya'o// dang po ni/ bskal pa grangs med gcig tu yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas brgya yan chad bsnyen bkur gyi sgo nas mnyes par byas pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bskal pa grangs med gcig tu tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags pa'o// gsum pa ni/ chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa yin te/ rgyan las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes bya// bsod nams (275) ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces so// bzhi pa ni/ sa dang po nas thob ste/ der chos thams cad bden med mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum rtogs pa'i mi rtog ye shes thob pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/ chos dang sems can rnams dang ni// de yi bya ba sangs rgyas nyid// mchog la sems mnyam rnyed pa'i phyir// de yi rab dga' khyad par 'phags// zhes pa/ gsum pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ khyad chos bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dbu ma lugs kyi cho ga la brten pa'i sems bskyed/ sems tsam lugs kyi cho ga la brten pa'i sems bskyed gnyis/ dang po ni/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs nas/ klu sgrub yab sras la brgyud pa/ bslab btus dang spyod 'jug tu bkod pa'i phyag srol jo bo puṇ+ye shān+ti las brgyud de/
sa skya pa rnams kyis gtso bor

(276) phyag len du mdzad pa 'di nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun byams pa nas/ thogs med sku mched la brgyud pa/ byang sa dang sdom pa nyi shu pa sogs la bkod pa'i phyag srol/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdams pa rnams kyis phyag len du mdzad pa 'di nyid do// de la kha cig bslab spyod du bshad pa'i sems bskyed 'bogs pa'i cho ga la/ dbu ma lugs dang*/ byang sar bshad pa'i de 'bogs pa'i cho ga la sems tsam lugs kyi cho ga zhes so sor bshad pa mi 'thad de/ dbu ma pas kyang*/ de gnyis ka nyams su blang du rung*/ sems tsam pas kyang de'i phyir zer/ 'o na khyod kyi lugs la/ klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i lam rim la/ zab mo lta ba'i lam rim dang*/ thogs med nas brgyud pa'i de la/ rgya chen spyod pa'i lam rim/ zhes so sor bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ klu sgrub kyi rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang de gnyis ka nyams su blang du rung*/ (277) thogs med kyi rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang de'i phyir/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i lam rim la/ byams pa nas brgyud pa'i sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i lam rim dang*/ klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i dngos bstan stong nyid kyi don gsal bar byed pa'i lam rim gnyis su yod pa bshad pa yang mi 'thad par thal lo// gzhan yang dbu ma pa yin na/ sems tsam pa'i gzhung lugs nas bshad pa'i lam nyams su ma len pas khyab pa dang*/ sems tsam pa yin na/ dbu ma pa'i gzhung lugs nas bshad pa'i lam nyams su mi len pas khyab par thal/ sgrub byed de 'thad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ gang la blang pa'i yul/ gang gis len pa'i gang zag ji ltar len pa'i cho ga de ltar blangs pa'i bslab bya'i khyad par ro// dang po ni/ byang sems kyi sdom pa dang ldan zhing*/ de (278) 'bogs pa'i cho ga la mkhas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du len te/ spyod 'jug las/

rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// theg chen don la mkhas pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi btang ngo*// zhes dang*/ sdom pa nyi shu par/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan la blang bar bya// zhes so// de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dngos su ma 'byor na/ rten la sogs pa'i drung du blangs pas kyang skye ste/ de ltar bslab btus dang byang sar bshad pa'i phyir/ sems tsam pa'i lugs la nyams na phyir gso ba la/ bla ma nges par brten dgos te/ de ltar gnas brtan byang bzang gis bshad pa'i phyir/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la de ltar mi dgos par mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa dngos su skye rung du yod pa'i gang zag thams cad la (279) skye bar bzhed de/ dbu ma pa gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa yin pa dang*/ so thar gyi sdom pa rten du nges par mi dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na/ nas kyi sa bon yul grang dro kun du skye ba ltar ro// sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med ma rtogs 'gro ba gzhan la dngos su mi skye ste/ de kun du so thar rigs bdun gang rung dgos la/ rigs bdun 'gro ba gzhan gyi rten la dngos su skye bar mi rung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ so sor thar pa'i rim pa bdun gyi/ zhes sogs dang*/ mdo rtsar/ mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba pa dang*/ byang sgra mi snyan pa gnyis ni sdom pa'i zhing nyid ma yin no// zhes so// dper na/ 'bras kyi sa bon yul grang ba'i gnas su mi smin pa bzhin no// sdom gsum las/ ji ltar nas kyi sa bon ni// grang dro gang du'ang skye ba ltar// de bzhin dbu ma'i sems bskyed kyang*// (280) sdig pa yod med kun la skye// ji ltar 'bras kyi sa bon ni// grang ba'i yul du mi skye ba// de bzhin sems tsam pa yi yang*// sems bskyed sdig can la mi skye// zhes so// gsum pa la/

sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi cho ga'i khyad par ro// dang po ni/ dbu ma lugs la/ spyod 'jug nas bshad pa ltar kyi mchod pa/ skyabs 'gro/ sdig bshags/ rjes su yi rang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa/ dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba ste/ yan lag bdun pa byed par bshad/ sems tsam pa'i lugs la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa 'bul ba gnyis kyis chog par bshad de/ sdom pa nyi shu par/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// gus pas phyag 'tshal ci nus mchod// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sems tsam pa'i dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs (281) gnyis/ dang po ni/ thog mar so thar gyi sdom pa len/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bslabs nas/ phyis sems bskyed kyi sdom pa cho ga'i sgo nas len par bzhed de/ sdom gsum las/ des na sems tsam pa'i lugs// gal te sems bskyed de 'dod na// thog mar so so thar pa long*// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod slobs// dad cing bsgrub pa nus gyur na// phyi nas sems bskyed sdom pa long*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i yan lag bdun pa sngon du btang ste/ gzhan don du byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems (282) dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslabs pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyi bar du brjod pa'o// de yang tshigs bcad dang pos sdom pa blangs pa'i rten bstan/

gnyis pas sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sems bskyed cho ga'i sgo nas blangs nas/ de'i bslab bya la tshul bzhin du slob pa dper bstan/ gsum pas/ rang nyid kyis de ltar sgrub dgos pa'i don bstan pa yin no// dper na gsol gzhi'i cho gas dge slong gi sdom pa thob rjes su de'i bslab bya tshul bzhin du slob dgos pa bzhin no// gsum pa mjug gi khyad par yang*/ sems tsam pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mkhyen par gsol bar tsam bshad/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la/ spyod 'jug las/ deng dus bdag (283) tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su bdag deng gyur// zhes rang dga' ba bsgom pa dang*/ bdag gi de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes gzhan dga' ba bsgom pa gnyis bshad/ bzhi pa la/ sems tsam lugs la/ sdom pa nyi shu pa nas bshad pa ltar gyi rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba zhe lnga/ spong ba la bslab dgos/ dbu ma lugs la/ nam mkha'i snying po nas bshad pa'i rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo nas bshad pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi spong ba la bslab dgos pa yin no// des na sems tsam pa lta ba dma' bas de dang mthun pa spyod pa sgo dog pa'i cho ga dang*/ dbu ma pa lta ba mtho bas de dang mthun par spyod pa (284) sgo yangs pa'i tshig gnyis sangs rgyas kyis gsungs shing*/ de dang mthun par rjes 'jug gi mkhas grub rnams kyis kyang bkral ba yin te/ rab dbye las/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la// dbu ma sems tsam rnam pa gnyis// de gnyis lta ba tha dad pas// cho ga yang ni tha dad yin// ltung ba dang ni phyir bcos dang*// bslab par bya ba'ang so sor yod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa la/ rgyal po lta bu'i/ rdzi bo lta bu'i/ mnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang gsum/ dang po ni/ thog mar rang nyid sangs rgyas nas de'i rjes su sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par 'dod pa'i sems bskyed lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ thog mar sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod nas rang nyid sangs rgya bar 'dod pa'i sems bskyed lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ rang dang sems can dus mnyam du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i sems bskyed (285) lta bu/ lnga pa la/ tshogs lam gyis bsdus pa'i sems bskyed gsum/ sbyor lam gyis bsdus pa gcig mthong sgom gyis bsdus pa bcu/ khyad par lam gyis bsdus pa lnga/ sangs rgyas sas bsdus pa gsum ste nyer gnyis so// dang po ni/ sa lta bus mtshon pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ mtshungs ldan gyis sems bskyed/ gser lta bus mtshon pa'i bsam pa/ zla ba tshes pa lta bus mtshon pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed/ gnyis pa ni/ me lta bus mtshon pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ gsum pa ni/ gter chen po/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs/ rgya mtsho chen po/ rdo rje/ ri'i rgyal po/ sman/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ nyi ma/ chos kyi glu dbyangs lta bu bcus mtshon pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang*/ mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed do// bzhi pa ni/ (286) rgyal po chen po/ bang mdzod/ bam po che/ bzhon pa bzang po/ bkod ma'i chu lta bu lngas mtshon pa'i/ mngon shes/ tshogs gnyis/ byang chub phyogs mthun/ snying rje lhag mthong*/ gzungs spobs dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed do// lnga pa ni/ sgra snyan pa/ chu bo'i rgyun/ sprin lta bu gsum gyis mtshon pa'i/ chos kyi dga' ston/ bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ chos sku dang*/ mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed do// drug pa la/ mos pas spyod pa'i/ lhag bsam rnam dag gi rnam par smin pa'i/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed dang bzhi/

theg chen so skye'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed rnams ni dad pa'i mtshan gzhi yin te/ chos kyi bdag med la don spyi'i tshul du mos pa byed pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ ma dag pa'i sems bskyed rnams ni gnyis pa'i mtshan gzhi yin te/ 'bad rtsol gyi (287) mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ dag pa'i sems bskyed ni/ gsum pa'i mtshan gzhi yin te/ 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma dang bral zhing sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags ma spangs pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas sa'i sems bskyed ni bzhi pa yin te/ sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags zad par spangs pa'i sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la// mos dang lhag bsam dag pa la// rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod// de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o// zhes so// bzhi pa la/ mkhan chen pa na re/ lam ma zhugs na theg chen sems bskyed yod de/ ston pa 'di sngon dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ grogs la snying rje skyes nas byang chub mchog tu (288) sems bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ lam ma zhugs na sems bskyed kyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i byed pa don yod cing*/ zhes gsung ngo*// lam ma zhugs na bden pa mngon rtogs yod par thal/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis yi dwags mang po bden pa mthong ba la bkod par bshad pa'i phyir/ de na tshogs lam yod par thal/ de na sangs rgyas thob phyir du tshogs gsog pa yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ de yang sa gser zla ba me// zhes sogs kyis theg chen sems bskyed kyi dbye ba rdzogs par ma bsten pa thal/ lam ma zhugs na theg chen sems bskyed yod cing*/ de na de nyer gnyis gang rung med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ 'dun ldan sems bskyed yod par 'gyur zhing*/ 'dod na tshogs lam chung ngu yod par 'gyur ro// khyab ste/

de la dang po gsum ni chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po nyid kyis las dang po pa'i sas bsdus so// zhes (289) bshad pa'i phyir/ red mda' ba na re/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na theg chen sems bskyed med de/ der sems bskyed khas blangs pa dus las 'das pa dang*/ de'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs med pa dang*/ sems sems byung gnas gyur pa'i phyir te/ 'jug pa las/ shes bya'i bud shing skam po ma lus pa// bsreg pas zhi de rgyal rnams chos sku ste// de tshe skye ba med cing 'gag pa med// sems 'gags pa de sku yis mngon sum mdzad// ces gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na gdul bya rigs can gsum la chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen med pa dang*/ zag med kyi ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig gzhi ma grub pa dang*/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed gzhi ma grub pa sogs kyi skyon gnas so// rang lugs/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam sangs rgyas sa'i bar du yod de/ sems bskyed pa'i rab tu dbye ba ni/ las dang po (290) pa'i sa nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar gyis bsdus pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bslab bya la/ mi nyams pa'i rgyu bsten dgos pa/ nyams pa'i rgyu ngos bzung ba/ rtsa ltung sdom pa'i gtong rgyu yin min dpyad pa'o// dang po la/ tshe 'dir mi nyams pa'i rgyu dran pa gsum/ phyi mar mi nyams pa'i rgyu thabs gsum/ gnyis kar mi nyams pa'i rgyu 'dun pa sogs lnga'o// dang po ni/ sems bskyed skyes pa'i phan yon/ nyams pa'i nyes dmigs/ rnyed pa dka' ba yang dang yang du yid la dran par byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ yan lag bdun pa dus gsum du byed pa/ rgyal ba sras bcas la gsol ba 'debs pa/ chos dang 'gal ba'i bdud las spong ba'o// gsum pa ni/ sems can chos/ byang chub kyi sems/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gces spras su 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'dod pa'o// gnyis pa la/

bslab (291) btus nas bshad tshul dang*/ sdom pa nyi shu pa nas bshad tshul lo// dang po la/ rgyas par phye na/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo nas bshad pa ltar/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi yod kyang bsdu na thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las bshad pa ltar rnam pa bzhir 'dus te/ gzhan don du byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa 'dor ba dang*/ yo byad la ma chags pa'i ser snas gzhan la cung zad kyang sbyin mi nus pa dang*/ kun slong dga' spro dang ldan pas bzod par gsol yang bsam pas khro zhing sbyor bas rdeg 'tshog byed pa dang*/ rnyed bskur la chags pa'i dbang gis chos ltar snang ston par byed pa yin te/ bslab btus las/ byang chub sems ni yang 'dor dang*// chags dang ser sna mi zad pas// slong la sbyin par mi byed dang*// sgrims te dga' bar byed pa na// sems can la ni mi bzod par// khros pas sems can rdeg pa dang*// nyon mongs pa dang gzhan mthun pas// (292) chos ltar bcos pa ston pa po// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ rnyed dang bkur sti chags pa yis// bdag bstod gzhan la smad pa dang*// sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la// ser snas chos nor mi ster dang*// gzhan gyis bshad par mi nyan pas// khros pas gzhan la 'tshog pa dang*// theg pa chen po spong byed cing*// dam chos 'drar snang ston pa'o// zhes so// gsum pa la kha cig byang sems kyi rtsa ltung byang sdom gyi gtong rgyu yin te/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa'i rtsa ltung de'i gtong rgyu dang*/ gsang sngags sdom pa'i rtsa ltung de'i gtong rgyu yin par bshad pa'i phyir/ zer/ byang sems kyi rgyud la 'byung ba'i rtsa ltung yin na/ kun dkris chen pos spyad pa'i rtsa ltung yin dgos pa thal/ de yin na/ de'i gtong rgyu yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ spyir rtsa ltung tsam gyis byang sems kyi sdom pa gtong mi nus te/ kun dkris chung

(293) ngu dang 'bring gi dbang gis spyad pa'i rtsa ltung gis de gtong mi nus pa'i phyir/ des na/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi byang chub kyi sems 'dor ba'i rtsa ltung dang*/ kun dkris chen pos spyad pa'i rtsa ltung ni de'i gtong rgyu yin te/ dang po ni/ theg chen sems bskyed mtha' dag gtong rgyu yin/ phyi ma ni 'jug sdom gyi gtong rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ sdud pa las/ gal te bskal pa bye bar dge ba'i las lam bcu// spyod kyang dgra bcom rang rgyal nyid du 'dod skyed na// de tshe tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyams pa yin// sems bskyed de ni phas pham bas kyang shin tu lci// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' la// ltung ba'i nang nas lci ba ste// 'di ltar de ni byung gyur na// sems can kun gyis don la dman// zhes dang*/ byang sa las/ mdor bsdu na rgyu gnyis kho (294) nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa btang bar 'gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon pa yongs su btang ba dang*/ pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos kyi kun nas dkris pa chen po kun tu spyod pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kun dkris che 'bring chung ngu'i khyad par gang zhe na/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba rgyun du spyod pa dang*/ ngo tsha khrel yod dang chung zhing de la dga' spro byed pa dang*/ de nyid la yon tan can du lta ba ste/ yan lag gsum ldan chen po/ gnyis ldan 'bring*/ gcig ldan chung ngu yin te/ byang sar/ gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpas pham pa'i gnas lta bu'i chos bzhi po 'di dag rgyun ma chad par kun tu spyod pa dang*/ ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa chung ngu tsam yang mi bskyed pa dang*/ des mgu bar byed cing de la dga' ba dang*/ de nyid la yon tan du lta ba can du gyur pa 'di nas kun nas dkris pa chen po

(295) yin par rig par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i lugs la 'bring dang chung ngu yang mtshon pa yin no// gsum pa la/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi phan yon no// dang po la sdig pa zad pa'i dang*/ bsod nams rlabs po che thob pa'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ spyod 'jug las/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang*// dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar// gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba// de la bag yod rnams kyis cis mi brten// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ dpal sbyin gyi zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*// gal te de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang nas// de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems 'dis mi gtsang ba'i lus mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lus su bsgyur te/ rnam mkhyen (296) mngon du byed pa'i 'bras bu dang ldan te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyu las byung ba snying rje'i rtsa ba can thabs kyi mthar phyin pa yin no// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na// byang chub sems su bya bar rab brten zung*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi bdun ldan sems bskyed chos can/ theg chen sems bskyed yin te/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la myong ba thon pa'i tshul gyis dmigs pa'i theg chen lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gtso bo rnam rig yin pa'i phyir/ de dang de ni mdo bzhin du// zhes skabs su/ mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi dmigs yul gzhan don dang byang chub phyin ci ma log par bshad pa yin te/ (297) mdo bzhin du rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad pa'i phyir/

de ltar na sems bskyed pa'i rab tu dbye ba zhes skabs su/ theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ theg chen las dang po pa'i sa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar gyis bsdus pa yin te/ de'i tshogs lam chung ngu nas sangs rgyas kyi rjes thob kyi bar gyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sgrub pa'i thabs smon pa'i rgyu gdam ngag thob bya sgrub pa'i 'bras bu nges 'byed cha mthun/ 'jug bya sgrub pa'i yan lag gi chos bshad pa'o// dang po la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ gdam ngag gi yul so sor bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ dbye ba zhar la brjod/ ces skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po gdam ngag la/ gang la nyan pa'i yul/ gang gis nyan pa'i gang zag nam gyi tshe nyan pa'i dus/ gang la brten nas nyan pa'i rgyu/ nyan par bya ba gdams ngag gi rang bzhin no// dang (298) po ni/ sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpas ni longs sku dang*/ so skye las dag pa dang*/ theg dman gyi sprul sku la nyan zhing*/ da ltar gyi skyes bu rnams ni mkhas pa'i shes rab sogs khyad chos gsum ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la nyan pa yin no// rgyud yongs su smin pa'i gdul byas ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ltos med du thos pa'ang yod de/ nam mkha' dang ljon shing sogs las byung ba'i chos kyi sgras rgyud smin pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig de bzhin gshegs pa la theg chen gyi gdam ngag dngos su nyan pa'i gang zag yin na/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gcig dgos te/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems dang po la sogs pa bskyed pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer/ bcom ldan 'das la lam shes kyi mdo dngos su nyan pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi lha'i bu chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sher phyin gyi mdo dngos su (299) nyan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ gal te/ ma khyab ste/ de de la gdam ngag du ma song ba'i phyir te/ des de'i don ji lta ba bzhin du nyams su len mi nus pa'i phyir/

zhe na/ de la chos nyan pa po yang ma yin par thal/ de de la chos su ma song ba'i phyir te/ des de'i don ji lta ba bzhin du nyams su len mi nus pa'i phyir/ kha cig rgyun mtha'i byang sems kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la gdams ngag dngos su nyan pa po yin te/ de ltar nyan nus shing nyan dgos pa'i phyir te/ spangs rtogs mthar ma thug pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ rgyun mtha'i byang sems kyis gdams ngag la ltos med du rnam mkhyen mngon du byed mi nus par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ slob dpon gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ltos med du rang rgyal gyi byang chub mngon du byed nus kyi rang rgyal sgom lam pa med par thal ba dang*/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis/ bar (300) chad med pa'i lam la ni de don gnyer ba med de/ rang byung gi ye shes mngon du byed nus pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa dang 'gal/ des na gdams ngag la don gnyer gyi 'dun pa/ gdams ngag gi don rtogs pa'i shes rab/ nga rgyal med pa'i gus pa gsum dang ldan pa'i skyes bu ni/ gdams ngag nyan pa'i gang zag yin cing*/ sa mtshams lam ma zhugs nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bar na yod do// gsum pa ni/ gdams ngag la don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang ldan zhing spangs rtogs mthar ma thug pa'i gnas skabs su'o// bzhi pa la/ spyi'i rgyu dang*/ rten khyad par can gyis gdams ngag khyad par can nyan pa'i rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ rigs sad pa las byung ba'i gdams ngag don gnyer gyi 'dun pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin yin te/ de la brten nas gsung rab kyi tshig don dpag tu med pa 'dzin nus pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ de tshe chos kyi rgyun la ni// (301) sangs rgyas rnams la zhi gnas dang*// ye shes yangs ba thob bya'i phyir// gdams ngag rgya chen rnyed par 'gyur// zhes so// 'o na/ chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gang la byed snyam na/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas gsung rab dpag tu med pa'i tshig don 'dzin par nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yin la/
