sa mtshams ni tshogs lam nas kyang yod de/ de ltar du 'grel chen las bshad pa'i phyir/ lnga pa la/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ grangs nges/ go rim dang lnga/ dang po la/ kha cig gdams ngag la/ brjod bya don gyi dang*/ brjod byed tshig gi gdams ngag gnyis yod cing*/ dang po ni/ gdams ngag gi don nyams su len par byed pa'i sgrub pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos lta bu/ gnyis ka'ang gdams (302) ngag mtshan nyid pa yin te/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis/ gdams ngag yang 'di yin la/ gdams pa ltar nyams su len pa yang 'di gtso bor gyur pa'i gdams ngag go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ lung gi dam chos kyi brjod byar gyur pa'i nyams len/ lung gi dam chos dang*/ lung gi chos 'khor gyi brjod byar gyur pa'i nyams len lung gi chos 'khor du thal ba'i skyon yod de/ lung de'i don ni/ gdams ngag gi 'bras bur gyur pa'i nyams len la gdams ngag gi ming gi btags pa la dgongs so// bla ma mkhyen rab dbang phyug na re/ gdams ngag yin na ngag yin pas ma khyab ste/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pas rang gi gdul bya la sgra med lus kyi rig byed kyi sgo nas gdams ngag ston pa yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i sgo nas chos ston pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa de nyan thos dgra bcom pa las chos ston tshul gyi sgo nas (303) khyad par du 'phags pa ma yin par thal ba dang*/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir// zhes sogs dang*/ gang gang don ni gang gang la// zhes sogs dang 'gal lo// zhes gsung ngo*// de la kha cig na re/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya la sngon gyis smon lam gyi mthus sgra med par chos ston pa'i lus kyi rig byed theg chen gyi gdams ngag du thal/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pas rang gi gdul bya la de ltar ston pa gdams ngag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de bas na sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i phyir/

zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ lung gi dam chos su thal lo// de yang 'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi bkar thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bstan bcos ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ chos rnams thams cad (304) bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus/ zhes pa dang 'gal/ ṭī kas/ gdams ngag yin na/ ngag yin dgos te/ lung rigs gnyis kyis grub pa'i phyir te/ lung 'bogs pa dkon mchog gsum la 'doms/ zhes dang*/ 'jug 'grel las/ khong du chud pa'i ched du chos ston pa ni gdams ngag go /zhes dang*/ jo bo rjes/ gdams ngag rnam pa bcu yin te// ngo bo ngag gi 'khor lor bzhed// tshogs la gsum dang sbyor la lnga// mthong bsgom lam la re re 'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rigs pas grub ste gdams pa'i tshig yin na/ tshig yin dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ lung gi dam chos yin na/ lung yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gal te yang dag pa'i ngag yin na/ ngag yin dgos par thal/ gdams ngag yin na/ ngag yin dgos pa'i phyir ro// chos ston pa ngag gi (305) chos ston dgos par thal/ gdams ngag ston na ngag gis ston pas khyab pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa yin na/ rtog pa yin dgos par thal/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa yin na/ rtog pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ chos ston na ngag gi sgo nas ston dgos par thal/ lung gi chos 'khor bskor na ngag gi sgo nas bskor dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs gtso bor ston pa'i lung gis dam chos/ zhes dang*/ mngon mtho dang nges legs gang rung sgrub pa'i thabs ston pa'i lung gi dam chos zer/ dang po la/ gdams ngag yin na/ nges legs kyis gdams ngag yin pas khyab par thal ba'i skyon gnas so// gnyis pa la/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i phyi rol pa med par thal/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i thabs gtso bor ston

(306) pa'i phyi rol pa'i gdams ngag med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rang lugs/ rang gi gdams bya'i don gtso bor ston pa'i lung gi chos/ gsum pa la/ brjod bya/ dgos pa/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ mngon mtho'i dang*/ nges legs kyi gdams ngag gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid gtso bor mngon mtho sgrub pa'i thabs ston pa'i lung gi dam chos/ mtshan gzhi/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs gtso bor sgrub pa'i phyir du dge ba bcu'i las lam ston pa'i bstan bcos lta bu'o// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs gtso bor ston pa'i lung gi dam chos/ dbye na/ theg pa che chung gi gdams ngag gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs gtso bor ston pa'i lung gi dam chos/ mtshan gzhi/ sher phyin (307) gyi mdo dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ theg dman gyi byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs gtso bor ston pa'i lung gi dam chos/ mtshan gzhi/ 'dul ba lung dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa lta bu'o// gal te 'dul ba lung chos can theg dman gyi gdams ngag ma yin par thal/ theg chen gyi de yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas kyi de yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chos can/ theg dman gyi rigs ma yin par thal/ theg chen gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ theg dman du rigs nges pa'i tshogs lam pa chos can/ theg dman du rigs nges pa ma yin par thal/ theg chen du rigs nges pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgya bar rigs nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ gdams pa'i dang*/ rjes bstan gyi gdams ngag gnyis/ 'di dag (308) la/ bshad tshul spyir bstan pa dang*/ 'gal mi 'gal la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'grel chen gnyis ltar na/ thob zin gyi yon tan mi nyams par 'phel ba'i phyir du 'doms pa'i gdams ngag ni dang po'o// de'i rjes su sngar ma thob pa'i yon tan gsar du thob phyir du 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gnyis par bzhed de/

nyi khri snang ba las/ yang dag par thob pa'i yon tan yongs su bskyang bar bya ba'i phyir yongs su mi nyams pa nye bar bzung nas gdams pa yin pas de'i rjes su lam thob pa'i yon tan thob pa yin pa'i phyir rjes su gdams pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir brgyad stong 'grel chen las kyang de dang mthun par gsungs pa'i phyir/ don gsal 'dir/ go rim de las bzlog te bstan no// byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ des 'phangs pa'i chos 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ yon tan thob pa yongs su bsrung ba'i don gyis mngon par 'phel bar bya ba'i (309) phyir/ 'doms pa ni gdams ngag ste// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ des 'phangs pa'i chos 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ 'doms pa ni gdams ngag ste/ zhes pas dang po bstan/ yon tan thob pa zhes sogs kyi gnyis pa bstan pa yin no// des na/ sngar ma thob pa'i yon tan 'ga' zhig thob phyir du gtso bor 'doms pa'i gdams ngag dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi tshig don mi shes pa'i gang zag la/ rgyan bshad pa'i tshe rgyan lta bu'o// thob zin gyi yon tan mi nyams zhing 'phel bar 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ rgyan gyi tshig don rags pa shes pa'i gang zag la rgyan bshad pa'i tshe rgyan lta bu'o// 'di dag ni/ ṭī ka las bshad pa'i tshul yin la/ mkhas pa bu na re/ don gsal las/

(310) byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ zhes sogs gzhung snga mas rjes bstan dang*/ des 'phangs pa'i chos 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ zhes sogs kyis gdams pa'i gdams ngag bstan pas 'grel chen gnyis dang mthun par 'chad pa ni mkhas pa'i legs bshad do// gnyis pa la/ kha cig de gnyis gal te/ gang zag gcig la ltos te 'gal ba'i phyir zhe na/ gang zag gcig la ltos ste gdams pa'i gdams ngag yin na/ de yin pas khyab pa dang*/ gang zag gcig la ltos te rjes bstan gyi gdams ngag yin na/ de yin dgos par thal/ sgrub byed de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ dang po der thal/ de'i phyir te/ rgyan gyi tshig don mi shes pa'i gang zag la ltos te/ der 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nang 'gal lo// des na de gnyis spyir mi 'gal te/ rgyud so so la ltos nas de gnyis kyi (311) gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ gang zag gcig la ltos na 'gal te/ de la ltos te de gnyis kyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag sogs bcu/ bzhi pa ni/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag la 'dir bstan gyi gdams ngag bcur grangs nges/ bcu po 'dis theg chen skyes bu'i bzhed don phun sum tshogs pa sgrub nus te/ 'di tsam kho nas don thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur bas gdams ngag ni rnam pa bcu'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i gang zag gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa la theg chen gyi gdams ngag nyan nas thabs khyad par can gyis bsgrub pas/ dmigs yul bden pa bzhi la dmigs/ rten dkon mchog gsum la brten te/ brtson 'grus (312) rnam pa gsum gyis bya ba ngan pa la zhen pa/ sgyid lug pa sems zhum pa'i le lo gsum bcom nas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu khyad par can spyan dang mngon shes mngon du byas te/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu mthong sgom gyi sgrib pa mtha' dag las grol ba'i rnam mkhyen mngon du byed pa ni/

'dir bstan gyi gdams ngag bcu nyams su len pa'i rim pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi 'og tu gdams ngag bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i gang zag gis/ yul de bzhin gshegs pa la gdams ngag nyan nas nyams su len dgos par shes pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo/ dmigs yul bden pa bzhi/ rten dkon mchog gsum/ de'i yon tan spyan dang mngon shes bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bsgrub dang bden pa rnams dang ni// zhes (313) sogs kyi skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ yul can sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yul bden pa gnyis bshad pa'o// dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ gzhung gi bstan tshul lo// dang po la/ kha cig yul bden gnyis las mi 'da' bar yul can thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas sgrub pa nyams su len tshul ston pa'i lung gi dam chos zer/ grub pa yin na/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa yin dgos par thal/ de rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag yin na/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i lung gi dam chos/ dbye na/ theg pa che chung gi de gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ yul bden pa gnyis la mi 'da' bar yul (314) can thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas theg chen gyi sgrub pa nyams su len tshul ston pa'i theg chen gyi lung gi dam chos/ theg dman rang lugs kyi thabs shes gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas theg dman gyi sgrub pa nyams su len tshul ston pa'i theg dman gyi lung gi dam chos/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ theg pa che chung gi slob lam bzhi nyams su len tshul ston pa'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ sgrub dang*/ zhes sogs kyi rtsa ba'i dngos bstan gyi gdams ngag la bkas khyab ste/

mngon rtogs rgyun sher phyin gyi mdo'i dngos kyi dgongs 'grel yin pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rab tu dbye ba zhes sogs 'grel pa'i dngos bstan la bstan bcos yod de/ don gsal ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo dang rgyan gnyis ka'i dngos kyi rnam bshad yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo*// phye ba'i don/ rang (315) bzhin/ gtan la 'bebs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po la lo chen na re/ shes bya bden gnyis kyi dbye gzhi ma yin te/ mdo las/ lha'i bu dag don dam pa'i bden pa lus dang ngag dang yid kyi rang bzhin du gyur na ni don dam pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su mi 'gro ste/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa zhes bya ba nyid du 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ rdo rje gcod pa las/ chos nyid shes par bya min pas// de ni rnam par shes mi nus// zhes dang*/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min// blo ni kun rdzob yin par brjod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ mi 'thad de/ lung rigs gnyis kyis gnod pa'i phyir te/ dang po ni/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pas kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis thugs su chud de/ shes par bya ba yang kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa 'di gnyis su zad do// (316) zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam de chos nyid mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i lam ma yin pa dang*/ theg chen gyi sgom lam de chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du sgom par byed pa'i lam ma yin par 'gyur ro// rang lugs/ shes bya/ rten 'brel/ bden pa tsam dbye gzhi'o// gal te mi 'thad de/ bden pa med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ bden par grub pa'i chos yod pa dang*/ gzhi grub na bden med yin pas ma khyab par 'gyur ro// zer/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i chos yod pa dang*/ gzhi grub na rang bzhin gyis med pas ma khyab par thal/

rang bzhin yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa dang*/ rang gi ngo bos grub pa la yang sbyar ro// gzhan yang*/ rgyu dge ba spyad pa la 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba sogs las 'bras mi bslu bar bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ (317) las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag mi bden pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag bden pa grub pa dang*/ gzhi grub na las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag bden med yin pas ma khyab par thal lo// gnyis pa la/ snang ba kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang*/ gnas lugs don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis te/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ 'jig rten mkhyen pas gzhan la ma gsan par// bden pa 'di gnyis kyis ni ston par mdzad// gang gi kun rdzob de bzhin don dam ste// bden pa gsum pa nam yang yod ma mchis// zhes dang*/ rtsa sher las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten// 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang*// dam pa'i don gyis bden pa'o// zhes so// gsum pa la/ bden pa gnyis po de/ dngos po dang dngos med bzhin du/ gcig (318) pa bkag pa'i tha dad yin nam/ bum snam bzhin du ngo bo tha dad yin nam/ byas mi rtag bzhin du ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad du phye ba gang yin zhe na/ dang po gnyis ma yin te/ de gnyis dngos med yin pa'i phyir dang*/ de gnyis la bdag gcig gi 'brel pa grub pa'i phyir/ kha cig gsum pa ltar ma yin te/ bden gnyis kyi ngo bo med pa'i phyir te/ ngo bo'i sgo nas med pa'i phyir zer/ bden gnyis kyi rang bzhin med par thal/ de gnyis rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ des na/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad yin te/ kun rdzob las ngo bo tha dad du gyur pa'i don dam bden pa rigs pas spyad na mi rnyed pa'i phyir dang*/ blos mthong tshul tha dad du med pa'i phyir te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ kun rdzob las ni tha dad par// de nyid dmigs pa ma yin te// kun rdzob stong pa nyid du bshad// stong nyid kho na

(319) kun rdzob yin// med na mi 'byung nges pa'i phyir// byas dang mi rtag ji bzhin no// zhes dang*/ mdo las/ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no// stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas dag ngo bo gcig pa nyid kyis phan tshun tha dad par gdags par mi nus pa bzhin no// zhes so// gnas tshul sems pa'i rigs ngor/ bden gnyis gcig dang tha dad gang rung du dpyad par bya ba ma yin te/ de dag la skyon bzhi bzhi yod par dgongs 'grel du bshad pa'i phyir/ gcig pa la skyon bzhi ni/ kun rdzob mthong bas gtso bor don dam bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ kun rdzob la dmigs nas/ kun nas nyon mongs 'phel ba ltar/ don dam la dmigs nas kyang de 'phel bar thal ba dang*/ kun rdzob las logs su don dam btsal (320) du med par thal ba dang*/ kun rdzob bden pa spros pa sna tshogs dang bcas pa bzhin du don dam yang der 'gyur ro// tha dad pa'i skyon bzhi ni/ don dam snang ba'i chos nyid ma yin par thal ba dang*/ don dam rtogs pas snang ba la bden zhen gyis sgro 'dogs mi chod par thal ba dang*/ kun rdzob rigs pas mi rnyed pa'i de kho na nyid don de ma yin par thal ba dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs dang*/ rnam byang gcig tu thal ba'o// de'i don yang*/ bden gnyis ngo bo tha dad du rigs pas dpyad pa'i tshe grub na/ don dam rtogs kyang kun rdzob la sgro 'dogs ma chod pas kun nas nyon mongs pa 'phel ba dang*/ don dam la dmigs nas rnam byang 'phel ba dus gcig du thal ba'o// 'di dag gi don la/ kha cig ngo bo gcig dang ngo bo tha dad gang rung ma yin pa'i don du 'chad/ kha cig ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad yin pa'i don du 'chad pa yod kyang*/ gnas tshul sems (321) pa'i rigs ngor/ gcig dang tha dad gnyis ka bkag pa yin te/

dgongs 'grel las/ 'du byed khams dang don dam mtshan nyid de// gcig dang tha dad bral ba'i mtshan nyid can// gcig dang tha dad nyid du gang sems pa// de dag tshul min yid byed zhugs pa yin// zhes so// bzhi pa la/ mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya'i sgra bshad/ mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba/ bden gnyis nges 'byed kyi tshad ma bshad pa'o// dang po la/ bye brag tu smra ba/ mdo sde pa/ sems tsam pa/ dbu ma pa'i 'dod tshul lo// dang po ni/ bcom pa'am bshigs pa na rang 'dzin gyi blo 'dor ba'i chos/ kun rdzob kyi mtshan nyid/ de la bcom pa na rang 'dzin blo 'dor ba dang*/ blos rnam par bshig pa na rang 'dzin blo 'dor ba rnam pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bum pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ bum nang gi chu lta bu'o// bcom pa'am (322) blos bshig pa na rang 'dzin gyi blo ma 'dor ba/ don dam gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi rdul phran dang*/ shes pa lta bu'o// mdzod las/ gang la bcom dang blo yi gzhan// bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa// bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu// yod de don dam yod gzhan no// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rtog pas sgro btags pa'i don byed mi nus pa'i chos dang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i don byed nus pa mtshan nyid du 'dod cing*/ spyi mtshan dang kun rdzob bden pa don gcig rang mtshan don dam bden pa/ dngos po rnams don gcig du 'dod de/ rnam 'grel las/ don dam don byed nus pa gang*// de 'dir don dam yod pa yin// gzhan ni kun rdzob yod pa ste// de dag rang spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad// ces so// gsum pa ni/ rtog pas sgro btags pa dang*/ gzhan dbang gang rung gis bsdus pa'i chos dang*/ rigs pas dpyad bzod du grub pa'i de kho na nyid (323) rim bzhin mtshan nyid dang*/ kun btags dang gzhan dbang dang po'i mtshan gzhi/ yongs grub gnyis pa'i mtshan gzhir 'dod do// bzhi pa la/ mtshan nyid mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag

bshad tshul spyir bstan/ rang lugs kyi mtshan nyid bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang po la/ tha snyad pa'i tshad mas rnyed pa'i rnyed don gang zhig tha snyad pa'i tshad ma de khyod la ltos te/ tha snyad pa'i tshad mar song ba dang*/ rigs shes tshad mas rnyed pa'i rnyed don gang zhig rigs shes tshad ma de khyod la ltos te/ rigs shes tshad mar song ba/ rim bzhin mtshan nyid yin cing*/ tha snyad pa'i tshad mas rnyed pa'i rnyed don dang*/ rigs shes tshad mas rnyed pa'i rnyed don/ bden gnyis kyi mtshan nyid du 'dod pa la/ bum pas ma nges so// zhes skyon brjod pa ni nang 'gal te/ bum pa'i chos nyid chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i (324) phyir/ tha snyad pa'i tshad ma de khyod la tshad mar song ba gang zhig de khyod la rigs shes tshad mar ma song ba'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ de'i rnyed don yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ tha snyad pa'i tshad ma rigs shes tshad mar 'gyur ro// mtshan nyid de chos can/ bum pa'i chos nyid de khyod yin na/ de kun rdzob bden pa yin dgos par thal/ khyod de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bum pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ mtshan nyid gnyis pa la yang*/ rigs bsgre/ kha cig rang dngos rtogs kyi tshad mas gnyis snang dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa bya ba'i rigs su gnas pa dang*/ rang dngos rtogs kyi tshad mas gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis rtogs bya gang zhig sgrub pa'i rnam par rtogs bya ma yin pa/ zer na/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam mkhyen rang las tha mi dad du ma rtogs pa thal/ des de gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul du ma rtogs pa'i phyir (325) te/ des de gnyis snang dang bcas pa'i tshul du rtogs pa'i phyir te/ des de kun rdzob bden par dngos su 'jal ba'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ don dam bden pa dngos su rtogs pa'i tshad ma yin na/ rang las rdzas gzhan pa'i gzugs sogs 'jal byed ma yin dgos par thal/ de yin na/ gnyis snang can gyi shes pa ma yin dgos pa'i phyir te/

don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ don dam bden pa yin na/ med dgag yin dgos par thal/ de yin na sgrub pa'i rnam par rtogs bya ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ kha cig khyod gang gis rnyed pa'i tshad ma de khyod la tha snyad gcod byed du song ba dang*/ khyod gang gis rnyed pa'i tshad ma de/ khyod la don dam gcod byed du song ba zer na/ mtshan nyid dang po de chos can/ khyod kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid ma yin na/ de la mtshan nyid med dgos par thal/ khyod de'i (326) mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bum pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ gang zag gi bdag gis ma nges/ gnyis pa yang des khegs/ bla ma mkhyen rab dbang phyug na re/ rang dngos rtogs kyi tshad mas snang rung gis spros pa dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis rnyed pa'i rnyed don dang*/ rang dngos rtogs kyi tshad mas snang rung gi spros pa 'ga' yang ma mthong ba'i tshul gyis rnyed pa'i rnyed don/ zer/ snang rung gi spros pa dang bcas pa yin na/ kun rdzob bden pa yin dgos par thal/ mtshan nyid dang po de 'thad pa'i phyir/ de yang 'dod na/ snang rung gi spros pa dang ldan pa yin na/ de yin dgos par thal/ de yang 'dod na/ snang rung gi spros pa bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid kyis ma nges/ gnyis pa la/ don dam bden pa chos can/ khyod dngos rtogs kyi tshad ma yin na/ snang rung gi spros pa ma mthong bas khyab par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/

(327) rtags khas/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen gyis ma nges/ gung ru rgyal bzang na re/ tha snyad pa'i tshad mas rnyed pa'i rnyed don gang zhig bslu ba'i chos/ rigs shes tshad mas rnyed pa'i rnyed don gang zhig mi bslu ba zer na/ rgyu dge ba spyad pa la 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba'i las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag chos can/ mi bslu ba ma yin par thal/ bslu ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir te/ kun rdzob bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yang des khegs/ gnyis pa la/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i lugs la/ 'jig rten pa'i blo'i yul du gyur pa'i snang tsam gyi chos dang*/ de las 'das pa'i de kho na nyid la bden gnyis su bzhed de/ spyod 'jug las/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam ste// 'di ni bden pa gnyis su 'dod// ces sogs so// zla ba grags pa ltar na/ mthong ba yang dag pa/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi 'dzin (328) stangs kyi yul la don dam bden pa dang*/ mthong ba brdzun pa'i 'jig rten pa'i blo'i 'dzin stangs kyi yul la kun rdzob bden pa 'dod de/ 'jug par/ dngos kun yang dag brdzun pa mthong ba yis// dngos rnyed ngo bo gnyis ni 'dzin par 'gyur// yang dag mthong yul gang de de nyid de// mthong ba brdzun pa kun rdzob bden par gsungs// zhes so// slob dpon ye shes snying po ltar na/ 'jig rten pa'i tha snyad kyi yul du gyur pa'i snang tsam gyi chos dang*/ de las 'das pa'i de kho na nyid la bden gnyis su bzhed de/ mdo las/ kun rdzob bden pa gang zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi tha snyad btags pa dang*/ yi ge dang*/ sgra dang*/ brdas bstan pa dag go /don dam pa'i bden pa ni/ gang la sems kyi rgyu ba yang med na/ yi ge rnams lta smros kyang ci dgos/ zhes gsungs pa la brten nas bden gnyis kyi rnam bzhag mdzad pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la/ tha snyad (329) pa'i tshad ma'i yul gyi gtso bor gyur pa'i snang tsam gyi chos dang*/ rig shes tshad ma'i yul gyi gtso bor gyur pa'i de kho na nyid rim bzhin mtshan nyid yin te/

dbu ma bden gnyis las/ ji ltar snang ba 'di kho na/ kun rdzob gzhan ni gcig shos yin zhes so// gnyis pa la/ kun rdzob bden pa'i sgra bshad pa dang*/ don dam bden pa'i de gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun rdzob ni nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma rigs pas bsdus pa'i bden 'dzin yin la/ des bden par bzung ba'i don gyis na de skad ces bya ste/ 'jug par/ gti mug rang bzhin sgrib phyir kun rdzob ste// des gar bcos ma bden par snang de ni// kun rdzob bden zhes thub pa des gsungs te// bcos mar gyur pa'i dngos ni kun rdzob tu'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa don dam ni/ rtags la brten pa'i rig shes rjes dpag dang*/ sgom byung gi mnyam (330) bzhag ye shes yin la/ de'i yul du gnas pa la rigs pa gzhan gyis gnod pa med pas na de skad ces bya'o// yang na chos nyid de bzhin nyid don dam pa dang bden pa'i gzhi mthun du mnyam bzhag gi ngor snang bas na de skad ces bya ste/ tshig gsal las/ don yang de yin la/ dam pa yang de yin pas na don dam pa zhes bya'o// de nyid bden pa yin pas na don dam pa'i bden pa zhes bya'o// zhes so// gsum pa la/ kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ bshad tshul spyir bstan pa dang*/ mtshan nyid bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang po la/ thal 'gyur ba dang*/ rang rgyud pa'i bzhed tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ yul can yang dag pa dang*/ log pa'i kun rdzob bden pa gnyis/ yul yang dag pa dang*/ log pa'i kun rdzob bden pa'o// dang po ni/ shes pa rang la snang ba'i don snang ba ltar grub pa la tha snyad pa'i tshad mas gnod pa (331) med pa'i mthong ba brdzun pa'i blo/ gnyis pa ni/ shes pa rang la snang ba'i don snang ba ltar grub pa la tha snyad pa'i tshad mas gnod pa 'bab pa'i mthong ba brdzun pa'i blor 'dod de/ 'jug pa las/ mthong ba brdzun pa'ang rnam pa gnyis 'dod de/ dbang po gsal dang dbang po skyon ldan no// skyon ldan dbang can rnams kyis shes pa ni// dbang po legs gyur shes ltos log par 'dod// ces/

shes pa de gnyis kyi 'dzin stangs kyi yul yang log du 'dod do// 'jug par/ gnod pa med pa'i dbang po drug rnams kyis// bzung ba gang zhig 'jig rten gyis rtogs te// 'jig rten nyid las bden yin lhag ma ni// 'jig rten nyid las log par rnam par bzhag /ces so// gnyis pa ni/ snang zhing snang ba ltar du grub pa la tshad mas gnod pa med pa'i kun rdzob ni yang dag kun rdzob yin la/ snang zhing snang ba ltar grub pa (332) la tshad ma gzhan gyis gnod pa 'bab pa'i kun rdzob ni log pa'i kun rdzob tu bzhed de/ bden gnyis las/ snang du 'dra yang don byed dag /nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyir// yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i// kun rdzob kyis ni dbye ba byas// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ kha cig gnod pa dang bcas pa'i shes pas rnyed pa'i rnyed don dang*/ gnod pa med pa'i mthong ba brdzun pas rnyed pa'i rnyed don/ mtshan nyid du 'dod/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin chos can/ yang dag kun rdzob tu thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ tha snyad pa'i tshad mas rnyed pa'i rnyed don yin pa'i phyir 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ yul can log pa'i kun rdzob yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig kun rdzob bden pa gang zhig snang ba ltar du don byed nus pa dang mi nus pa zer/ gang zag gi bdag med chos can/ snang ba ltar don byed nus pa thal/ yang dag kun rdzob yin (333) pa'i phyir/ gang zag gi rang 'dzin chos can/ snang ba ltar don byed mi nus par thal/ log pa'i kun rdzob yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nus par thal/ tshad ma la snang zhing snang ba ltar don byed nus pa'i phyir/ kha cig dbu ma pa rang lugs la yang dag pa'i kun rdzob bden pa dang*/ log pa'i kun rdzob bden pa'i dbye ba med de/ kun rdzob la tha snyad du yang bden rdzun gyi khyad par med pa'i phyir/ des na 'di dag 'jig rten pa'i blo kho na la ltos nas 'jog ste/ 'jig rten nyid las bden yin lhag ma ni// 'jig rten nyid la log par rnam par bzhag

/ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na/ gzugs kyi skye mched yang dag pa'i kun rdzob bden par thal/ de'i mtshan gzhi yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ yang dag par grub pa thal ba dang*/ bden par grub par thal/ (334) 'dod pa de'i phyir/ zhes zer/ dbu ma pas bdag 'dzin de yul gyi gnas tshul la ma zhugs pa'i blo dang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab de yul gyi gnas tshul la zhugs pa'i blor khas mi len par thal/ de gnyis yul can log pa dang*/ yang dag kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan gzhir khas mi len pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang dbu ma pas/ tshur mthong gi mig shes ma 'khrul ba yul la 'jug tshul mi bslu ba yin pa dang*/ dbang shes 'khrul pa yul la 'jug tshul bslu bar khas mi len par thal/ de gnyis yul can yang dag pa dang log pa'i kun rdzob bden par khas mi len pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang dbu ma pas/ tha snyad du las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag mi bslu bar bshad pa bden pa dang*/ de las gzhan du 'chad pa rdzun par khas mi len par thal/ tha snyad du bden rdzun gyi dbye ba khas mi len pa'i phyir/ bsgrub byed gnyis kyang mi (335) 'thad de/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid chos can/ don dam par grub par thal ba dang*/ bden par grub par thal/ don dam bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig de gnyis mi 'gal te/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin de de gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir te/ yul can log pa'i kun rdzob dang*/ yul yang dag pa'i kun rdzob yin pa'i phyir/ rang 'dzin tshad ma la ltos te yul yang dag pa'i kun rdzob yin pa'i phyir/ rang 'dzin tshad ma la snang zhing snang ba ltar don byed nus pa'i phyir/ zhe na de chos can/ yul can yang dag pa'i kun rdzob tu thal/ yul can dang yang dag pa'i kun rdzob kyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod kyi 'dzin stangs kyi yul gzhi grub par 'gyur ro// rang lugs/ yang log gnyis kyi nang tshan gang zhig tha snyad du mi bslu ba'i chos/

yang dag kun rdzob kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ yul can dang*/ yul yang dag pa'i (336) kun rdzob gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbang po skyon med la brten nas gzugs sogs 'jal ba'i shes pa dang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ blo de dag gi yul du gyur pa'i rang mtshan lta bu'o// yang log gnyis kyi nang tshan gang zhig tha snyad du'ang rdzun pa bslu ba'i chos can du snang ba/ log pa'i kun rdzob kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ yul can dang yul log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbang po skyon ldan gyi shes pa dang*/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ dbang shes 'khrul pa la snang ba'i chu nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dang*/ bdag 'dzin rtog pa la bdag tu snang ba lta bu'o// bden gnyis las/ kun rdzob rnam pa gnyis 'dod de// log pa dang ni yang dag go /dang po gnyis te chu zla dang*// grub mtha' ngan pa'i rtog pa'o// gnyis pa la/ rten chos can (337) gyi dang*/ ming tsam mthun pa'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyas par phye na/ stong nyid nyi shu dang*/ bco brgyad dang*/ bcu drug tu yod la/ 'bring du na/ dngos po dang*/ dngos po med pa dang*/ rang gi dang*/ gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid dang bzhi/ bsdu na/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gis stong pa'i stong nyid gnyis te/ 'jug par/ bdag med 'di ni 'gro ba rnam grol phyir// chos dang gang zag dbye bas rnam gnyis gsungs// de ltar ston pas slar yang 'di nyid ni// gdul bya rnams la phye ste rnam mang gsungs// spros dang bcas pa stong pa nyid// bcu drug bshad nas mdor bsdus te// slar yang bzhir bshad de dag ni// theg chen du yang bzhed pa yin// zhes dang*/ nang dang phyi rol rnams dang ni// zhes pa nas/ stong pa nyid ni nyi shur 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa la/ rnam grangs pa'i/ rnam grangs pa ma yin pa'i (338) don dam bden pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ myu gu bdag las skye ba med pa lta bu/

gnyis pa ni/ chos can so so la yod pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid lta bu'o// bzhi pa la/ kun rdzob bden pa nges 'byed kyi tshad ma dang*/ don dam bden pa nges 'byed kyi tshad ma'o// dang po la/ gzhi ldog dang*/ rang ldog nges 'byed kyi tshad ma gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngon po la sogs pa gzugs kyi skye mched 'jal byed kyi dbang shes ma 'khrul ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'dus byas snang la rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi rjes thob ye shes lta bu'o// gnyis pa la/ gzhi ldog dang*/ rang ldog nges 'byed kyi tshad ma gnyis/ dang po ni/ bden pa'i gcig tu bral gyi rtags las snang ba bden med du rtogs pa'i rigs shes rjes dpag lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ spros bral stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes lta bu'o// lnga pa la/ ma rtogs pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ rtogs (339) pa'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag gis bden gnyis thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs dgos te/ kun rdzob bden pa la sgro 'dogs ma chod par don dam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs mi nus/ de ma rtogs par mthar thug sangs rgyas thob mi nus pa'i phyir te/ rtsa sher las/ gang dag bden pa de gnyis kyi// rnam dbye rnam par ma shes pa// de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa ni// zab mo'i de nyid rnam mi shes// tha snyad la ni ma brten par// dam pa'i don ni bstan mi nus// dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs par// mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ 'jug pa las/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni// phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do// de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams// de las nyams pas thar pa grub yod min// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ bden (340) gnyis rtogs pa ni phan yon chen po dang ldan te/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa rtogs pas drang don gyi mdo'i don shes te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags nas gzugs sku 'grub par bshad/

don dam bden pa rtogs pas nges don gyi mdo'i don shes te/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags nas chos sku 'grub par bshad pa'i phyir te/ bden gnyis las/ bden gnyis rnam dbye shes pa dag /thub pa'i bka' la mi rmongs te// de dag ma lus tshogs bsags nas// phun tshogs pha rol 'gro bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ yul bden gnyis las mi 'da' bar yul can thabs shes zung 'brel du nyams su len tshul shes pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bden pa rnams dang ni/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ bden pa bzhi la/ rang (341) bzhin/ grangs nges/ go rim/ bden bzhi rtogs pa la 'jug tshul/ dang po la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la bzhi las/ dang po sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/ zag bcas 'bras bsdus dang rang rgyu las nyon gang rung gi 'bras bur gyur pa'i zag bcas dang*/ 'khor bas bsdus pa'i zag bcas dang*/ mi rtag sdug bsngal/ stong*/ bdag med kyi rnam pa can gyi chos/ zer na/ dang po la/ shes sgrib chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na ma yin par thal/ sdug bsngal bden pa spangs pa'i dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la khyod yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyon mongs pa la dmigs nas bden 'dzin gyi blo skye ba med par thal/ nyon mongs pa'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i shes sgrib rtog pa gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub na des chos can/ (342) mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin te/ theg dman gyi lhag med myang 'das su sdug bsngal bden pa spangs kyang*/ shes sgrib cung zad kyang ma spangs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ lhag bcas myang 'das la gnas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i gzugs phung chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/

'khor ba spangs pa'i dgra bcom la yang khyod yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig zag bcas yin na/ sdug bsngal bden pa yin pas khyab ste/ mdo las/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ zer na/ lam (343) bden ma yin pa'i 'dus byas yin na/ zag bcas yin dgos par thal/ lam ma rtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams// zag bcas gang phyir de dag la// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin na/ sdug bsngal yin dgos par thal/ dam bca' de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde bas ma nges/ kha cig sdug bsngal bden pa yin na/ 'khor ba yin dgos te/ sdug kun gnyis po de 'khor ba'i mtshan gzhir bshad pa'i phyir zer/ khams gsum gang rung gi bsdus pa'i zag bcas yin na/ 'khor ba yin dgos par thal/ khams gsum po de 'khor ba'i mtshan gzhir bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sa brgyad pa'i gnas skabs kyi gzugs kyi sas bsdus kyi shes sgrib kyi ma nges/ gzhan yang*/ theg dman gyi myang 'das myang 'das mtshan nyid pa

(344) ma yin par thal/ de yin na 'khor ba las grol bas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa yin na/ 'khor ba spangs pas khyab par thal/ de yang 'dod na/ las kyi kun 'byung rgyud ldan gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi las kyi kun 'byung de 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de sdug bsngal bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kun 'byung bden pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi mi 'thad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ zag bcas rgyus bsdus dang*/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa'i las nyon gang rung gis bsdus pa dang*/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal bden pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i las nyon gang rung gis bsdus pa dang*/ rgyu kun 'byung rab skye rkyen bzhi'i rnam pa can gyi chos zer/ dang po la/ sems can dmyal ba'i gzugs phung gis ma nges/ (345) gnyis pa la/ rang gi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu bde ba skyed par byed pa'i las kyi kun 'byung gi ngo bor gyur pa'i dge las chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir te/ las kyi kun 'byung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ lhag med du mya ngan las 'da' kha ma'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi las kyi kun 'byung chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lhag med myang 'das kyi gnas skabs na sdug bsngal bden pa yod par thal lo// bzhi pa la skyon sngar bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ kha cig kun 'byung bden pa yin na/ shes pa yin mi dgos te/ zag bcas kyi las yin na/ de yin mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ khong khros kun nas bslangs pa'i srog gcod pa'i lus kyi rig byed de las yin pa'i (346) phyir te/ lus kyi las yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i mtshan gzhi yod pa'i phyir zer/ gzhan la yo byad kyi dngos po ster bar byed pa'i lus kyi rig byed de sbyin par yin par thal/

lus kyi rig byed dang dge las kyi gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang bem po'i gzhi mthun yod par 'gyur ro// des na bye brag tu smra bas/ lus kyi rig byed dang las kyi gzhi mthun khas len kyang*/ mdo sde pa yan gyi las thams cad shes par 'dod de/ lus kyi rig byed dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i sems byung sems pa la de dang de'i las su 'dod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'gog bden la/ mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi mi 'thad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ zag med 'bras bsdus dang*/ rang rgyu lam bden gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i so sor rtags 'gog dang*/ 'dus ma byas su gyur pa'i zag med rnam byang gi bden pa dang*/ 'gog pa zhi ba gya nom nges (347) 'byung gi rnam pa can gyi chos zer/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen gyis ma nges/ gnyis pa la/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i sdug bsngal chos bzod thob ma thag pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi 'gog bden gyi ma nges/ gsum pa la/ rang don chos sku'i rigs pa byed pa'ang yod/ bzhi pa la/ sngar bzhin/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig 'phags rgyud kyi 'gog pa yin na 'gog bden yin dgos te/ 'phags rgyud kyi lam yin na/ lam bden yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zer/ sdug bsngal chos bzod thob ma thag pa'i nyan thos 'phags pa'i 'gog pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ so sor rtags 'gog tu thal/ 'dod na/ rang gi ngo skal gyi sgrib pa'i sa bon las grol ba'i 'gog par 'gyur ro// 'phags rgyud kyi 'gog bden yin na/ thar pa yin dgos par thal/ 'phags rgyud kyi lam (348) bden yin na/ thar lam yin dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ bzhi pa lam bden la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi mi 'thad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ zag med rgyus bsdus dang*/ 'dus byas su gyur pa'i zag med rnam byang gi bden pa dang*/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ lam rigs bsgrub pa nges 'byin gyi rnam pa can gyi chos zer/

dang po gnyis la/ ston pa shākya thub pas ma nges/ gsum pa la/ theg chen mthong lam pa'i don dam sems bskyed chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ mtshungs ldan gyi gtso sems su thal/ gtso sems gang zhig 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de dang mtshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs su thal lo// bzhi pa la/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ lam rigs (349) pa sgrub pa nges 'byin gyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ thar lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa der thal/ mi rigs pa spong ba'i gnyen por byed pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa der thal/ sems rgyud phyin ci ma log par sgrub par byed pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa der thal/ 'khor ba spangs pa'i myang 'das su 'byin par byed pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig tshogs sbyor gnyis lam bden yin te/ lung rigs gnyis kyis grub pa'i phyir/ kun btus las/ lam gyi bden pa gang zhe na/ lam gang gi sdug bsngal yongs su shes pa dang*/ kun 'byung ba spang ba dang*/ 'gog pa mngon du byed pa dang*/ lam bsgom pa ste/ 'di ni lam gyi mtshan nyid mdor bsdus pa'o// yang lam rnam pa lnga ste/ tshogs kyi lam dang*/ sbyor ba'i lam dang*/ mthong ba'i lam dang*/ bsgom pa'i lam dang*/ mthar phyin pa'i lam mo// (350) zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rigs pa ni/ tshogs lam chos can/ lam bden yin te/ bden bzhi gang rung gang zhig dang po gsum po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po der thal/ thar pa don gnyer gyi shes bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de la bden pa bzhir grangs nges par bshad pa'i phyir zer/ tshogs lam chos can/ chos dkon mchog tu thal/ lam bden yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos// chags bral nyid ni 'gog pa dang*// lam gyi bden pa dag gis bsdus// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// lung gi shes byed mi 'thad de/

lam bden 'khor bcas la dgongs pa'i phyir te/ rgyal sras mar/ rab tu dbye ba 'di yang lam gyi bden pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas nas rig par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rigs pa'i sgrub byed la/ ston pa shākya thub pas ma nges/ kha cig rnam mkhyen lam ma yin te/ lam bden ma (351) yin pa'i phyir te/ der bgrod byed ma yin pa'i phyir te/ der bgrod zin pa'i phyir/ zer/ lam bden mthar thug gzhi ma grub pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sa'i chos dkon mchog la 'gog bden gyis khyab pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa lam zhugs ma yin par 'gyur ro// rang lugs/ dor bya sdug kun gyi rang bzhin dang*/ blang bya 'gog lam gyi bden pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya'i sgra bshad/ mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba/ bcom pa'i sa mtshams dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sdug kun gnyis kyi nang tshan gang zhig rang rgyud las nyon gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i zag bcas/ de gang zhig zag bcas kyi las dang nyon mongs gang rung gis bsdus pa/ gnyis pa ni/ sdug kun gnyis la byis pa'i bden pa zhes mi brjod par 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sdug kun gnyis byis pa (352) rnams kyis bzung ba ltar ma grub la/ 'phags pas gzigs pa ltar du gnas pa'i phyir/ byis pas sdug bsngal la bde ba dang*/ kun 'byung la der 'khrid byed du bzung la/ 'phags pas khams gsum po 'di ni sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin can dang*/ las nyon gnyis po der khrid byed du gzigs pa'i phyir/ dper na/ lag mthil gyi spu dang*/ mig gi nang gi spu sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi byed pa dang byed par snang ba bzhin no// mdzod 'grel las/ byis pa lag mthil 'dra ba yis// sdug bsngal 'du byed spu mi rtogs// 'phags pa mig dang 'dra ba ni// de yis shin tu yid kyang 'byung*// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ sdug bsngal bden pa la rten dang brten pa'i sgo nas dbye na/

snod kyi 'jig rten dang*/ bcud kyi sems can gnyis su yod de/ kun btus las/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa gang zhe na/ de ni sems can skye ba dang skye ba'i gnas kyis kyang rig par bya'o// zhes so// 'dod gzugs kyis bsdus (353) pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten/ dang po'i mtshan gzhi/ khams gsum du las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba blangs pa'i gang zag gnyis pa'i mtshan gzhi yin te/ kun btus su/ sems can 'jig rten gang yin pa dang*/ snod kyi 'jig rten gang yin pa las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba 'di mtha' dag ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'o// zhes so// bde ba can dang*/ 'og min la sogs pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ma yin te/ las nyon gyi dbang gis byung ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing phun sum tshogs pa 'grub pa'i smon lam dang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i dbang gi byung ba'i phyir te/ kun btus las/ yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ma yin pa blta ste/ de dag las dang nyon mongs pas skyed pa ma yin/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba ma yin gyi/ smon lam dang dge (354) ba'i rtsa ba'i dbang gis byung ba dag go /zhes so// mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas dbye na/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal lo// dang po ni/ tshor ba sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba btang snyoms rgyu dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor bas bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi dngos po lta bu/ kun 'byung la dbye na/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ las kyi kun 'byung gnyis su yod de/ kun btus su/ kun 'byung gi bden pa gang zhe na/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i las so// zhes so// dbye gzhi gang zhig

sems rgyud rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa'i nyon mongs pas bsdus pa dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ rtsa ba dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa/ de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung lta bu'o// de gang zhig (355) rang rgyu nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i zag bcas kyi las/ dbye na/ ngan song gsum du 'phen par byed pa'i mi dge ba'i las dang*/ bde 'gror 'phen par byed pa'i dge ba'i las gnyis so// bzhi pa la/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi bcom pa'i sa mtshams gnyis so// dang po ni/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung dgra bcom thob tsam nas spangs shing*/ las kyi kun 'byung lhag bcas myang 'das kyi gnas skabs su spangs ma spangs gnyis ka yod la/ lhag med myang 'das thob nas sdug kun gnyis ka spangs pa yin no// 'khor ba ni dgra bcom pa mtha' dag gi spangs te/ 'khor ba ma spangs par thar pa thob mi nus pa'i phyir/ gal te lhag bcas myang 'das la gnas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i gzugs phung de 'khor bar thal/ nyan thos sgom lam pa'i gzugs phung 'khor bar gang zhig gnyis ka sdug bsngal gyi bden par mtshungs pa'i (356) phyir zer/ lhag bcas myang 'das la gnas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i gzugs phung 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs pa dang bcas par thal/ nyan thos sgom lam pa'i gzugs phung 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa gang zhig de gnyis sdug bsngal bden par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ des na/ de gnyis rang rgyu las nyon gyi 'bras bu mtshungs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi bden pa yin min gyi khyad par med kyang*/ 'khor ba 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs pa las grol ma grol gyi dbang gis 'khor ba yin min gyi khyad par yod par yin no// rgyu mtshan des na/ sa dang po yan chad du 'khor ba med par shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ dman lam sngon du song ba la/ tshogs lam nas kyang sdug kun gnyis ka spangs ba yod la/

ma song ba la kun 'byung gi bden pa sa dang po nas spong ste/ zag bcas kyi las nyon gnyis ka spangs ba'i phyir/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa sa brgyad pa'i (357) bar 'gro yang srid de/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i lus rten gyi rigs 'dra ma dor ba'i ngang la ma dag sa bdun gyi rtogs pa mngon du byed pa srid pa'i phyir/ sa brgyad pa thob nas zad par spang ste/ sa brgyad par mi rtog ye shes la dbang bsgyur thob pa'i stobs kyis zag bcas kyi lus zag med du gnas gyur te/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la dbang 'byor ba thob par bshad pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ dbang po lnga rnams gzhan gyur na// don kun 'jug dang thams cad la// yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung*// 'byor pa dam pa thob par 'gyur// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ thob pa'i sa mtshams so// dang po ni/ dgag gzhi sems rgyud kyi steng du/ 'gog byed bar chad med lam gyis rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon bkag pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i so sor rtags 'gog go /bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i zag med rnam byang (358) gi bden pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'gog lam 'di dag la byis pa'i bden pa zhes mi brjod par/ 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ byis pas bzung ba ltar du ma grub la/ 'phags pas gzigs pa ltar du gnas pa'i phyir/ byis pas 'gog bden g.yang sa dang*/ lam ni der 'khrid byed kyi gshed ma lta bur bzung la/ 'phags pas 'gog pa ni/ zag med kyi bde ba dang ldan pa'i yon tan can dang*/ lam ni der 'khrid byed du gzigs pa'i phyir/ mdzod 'grel las/ 'phags pas bden par gang gsungs pa// de ni gzhan gyis sdug bsngal rig /gzhan gyis bde bar gang smras pa// de ni 'phags pas sdug bsngal rig /ces so// gsum pa la/ 'gog bden dang*/ lam bden gyi dbye ba gnyis/

dang po la/ theg pa'i sgo nas gsum/ spang bya'i sgo nas sgrib pa gsum las grol ba'i 'gog pa gsum/ ming tsam mthun pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ (359) brda'i/ don dam pa'i/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i/ ma rdzogs pa'i/ rgyan bcas/ rgyan med kyi/ so sor rtags pa'i/ so sor rtags min gyi 'gog pa'o// dang po gnyis ni/ so skye dang*/ 'phags rgyud kyi 'gog pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa gnyis ni/ mi slob pa dang*/ slob pa'i 'gog pa lta bu/ gsum pa gnyis ni/ spyan dang mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang*/ mi ldan pa'i 'gog pa lta bu'o// bzhi pa gnyis ni/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon las grol ba dang*/ ma grol ba'i 'gog pa lta bu/ gnyis pa la/ theg pa'i sgo nas gsum/ mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum/ bzhi pa la/ 'gog bden dang*/ lam bden gyi sa mtshams gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg dman gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod thob ma thag pa'i gnas skabs na 'gog bden med de/ spang bya'i sa bon (360)

cung zad kyang ma spangs pa'i phyir/ des na theg dman la sdug bsngal chos shes mi slob lam gyi bar/ theg chen la 'phags pa mtha' dag gis rgyud la yod/ gal te/ rgyu dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang*// zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i bden bzhi'i go rim de rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim ma yin par thal/ lam bden gyi 'og tu 'gog bden bshad pa/ rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim ma yin pa'i phyir te/ 'gog bden yin na/ rang rgyu lam bden sngon song yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir zhe na/ dam bca' der thal/ kun 'byung bden pa'i 'og tu sdug bsngal bden pa bshad pa de rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim ma yin pa'i phyir te/ kun 'byung bden pa yin na/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal bden pa'i rgyu yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rim bzhin khas/ gnyis pa ni/ thar pa don gnyer gyi shes bya'i gtso bo la bden bzhi 'khor dang bcas par grangs nges te/ de la blang (361) bya rgyu 'bras gnyis su nges shing*/ dang po la/ rgyu'i dbang du byas nas lam bden/ 'bras bu'i dbang du byas nas 'gog bden/ gnyis pa'i rgyu'i dbang du byas nas kun 'byung bden pa/ 'bras bu'i dbang du byas nas sdug bsngal bden pa bzhag pa'i phyir/ shes bya thams cad 'dir 'dus pa ma yin te/ tshogs sbyor/ 'khor ba spangs pa'i gang zag so sor rtag min gyi 'gog pa/ 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha' la sogs pa der ma 'dus pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ blang dang dor bya'i de nyid ni// thabs bcas rab tu nges pa yis// gtso bo'i don la mi bslu'i phyir// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ 'dir bstan bden pa bzhi'i go rim ni mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa yin te/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag gis shes bya gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshe/ dang po khams gsum po 'di sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can du shes par byed/ de'i rjes su sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun 'byung (362)

la spong 'dod kyi blo skye/ de'i rjes su sdug kun spangs pa'i 'gog pa la don gnyer gyi blo skye/ de'i rjes su 'gog pa thob phyir du/ lam la nan tan gyi sgo nas 'jug par byed pa'i phyir/ dper na/ nad pa shes rab can 'ga' zhig gis/ dang por/ lus la yod pa'i nad rang gis ngo shes par byed/ de'i rjes su de'i rgyu spong 'dod kyi blo skye/ de'i rjes su nad spangs pa'i lus kyi bde ba la don gnyer gyi blo skye/ de'i rjes su bde ba de thob phyir du sman dang sman pa sogs bsten pa la 'jug pa bzhin no// mdzod las/ de dag ji ltar mngon rtogs rim// zhes dang*/ rgyud blar/ nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la// bder gnas thob bya sman ni brten par bya ba ltar// sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam// shes bya spang bya reg par bya zhing bsten par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas nas dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i (363) ting nge 'dzin gyis bslab pa skye/ de la brten nas gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa skye/ des sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba kun 'byung gi bsdus pa'i bdag 'dzin rtsa ba nas bcad/ sdug kun spangs pa'i thar pa myang 'das mngon du byed pa ni bden bzhi rtogs pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bden pa bzhi la 'doms pa'i gdam ngag gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dor bya sdug kun dang blang bya 'gog lam gyi blang dor phyin ci ma log par shes pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum// zhes sogs/ rtsa 'grel las/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul/ de ltar skyabs su song ba'i phan yon no// dang po la/ theg pa dman pa'i/ theg pa thun mong ba'i/ theg pa chen po'i lugs so// dang po ni/

skyabs 'gro'i yul (364) dkon mchog gsum/ 'gog lam kho na'i steng du 'jog ste/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gdul bya gzhan ngor sangs rgyas su mtshon par byed pa'i theg chen mi slob pa'i lam bden/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gdul bya gzhan ngor dge 'dun du mtshon par byed pa'i theg chen slob pa'i lam bden dang theg dman mi slob pa'i lam bden/ dge 'dun dkon mchog myang 'das kyis bsdus pa'i 'gog bden/ chos dkon mchog du 'dod pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ gang zhig gsum la skyabs 'gro de// sangs rgyas dge 'dun byed pa'i chos// mi slob pa dang gnyis ka dang*// mya ngan 'das la skyabs su 'gro// zhes so// kha cig 'dir skyabs 'gro'i yul du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ sangs rgyas don mi gcig ste/ sangs rgyas la gzugs sku dang chos sku gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs dang ni// chos sku 'gro ba'i (365) don spyod pas// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ gnyis pa ni/ sku gsum/ myang 'das rgyu 'bras/ skyes bu zung bzhi/ gang zag ya brgyad/ skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum du bzhed de/ skyabs gsum bdun bcu pa las/ sangs rgyas de'i chos dge 'dun ni// thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis skyabs// zhes dang*/ thub dbang gi ni sku gsum dang*// mya ngan 'das dang gang zag brgyad// ces so// byang sems 'phags pa ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi khongs su gtogs par bzhed de/ shar ri'i sde pa'i lung las/ theg dman dgra bcom pas de la phyag byas par bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes bzhed de/ de nyid las/ shar ri'i lung las dgra bcom pas// byang chub sems dpa' phyag byas nyid// 'di dag dkon mchog gsum gzhan min// sangs rgyas khongs su gtogs par 'dod// ces so// gsum pa la/ so so'i rang bzhin/ gnas skabs skyabs gsum du bzhag tshul/ (366)

mthar thug skyabs gcig tu sgrub pa/ dkon mchog gi sgra don no// dang po la gsum las/ dang po sangs rgyas dkon mchog la/ mtshan nyid ni/ yon tan drug dang ldan pa'i mthar thug gi skyabs gnas/ mtshan gzhi/ rang don chos sku dang*/ gzhan don gzugs sku lta bu'o// yon tan drug ni/ rang don chos sku la gtso bor ldan pa'i yon tan gsum/ gzhan don gzugs sku la gtso bor ldan pa'i yon tan gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dus ma byas pa/ lhun gyis grub pa/ gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs pa ma yin pa'i yon tan no// gnyis pa ni/ mkhyen pa/ brtse ba/ nus pa'i yon tan yin te/ rgyud blar/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa// mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan// don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// ces so// gnyis pa chos dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid la/ kha cig yon tan drug dang ldan pa'i zag med rnam byang gi (367) bden pa/ zhes dang*/ 'gog lam gang rung gis bsdus pa'i zag med kyi yon tan zer/ dang po la/ chos dkon mchog yin na/ theg chen gyi chos dkon mchog yin dgos par thal ba'i skyon gnas so// gnyis pa la/ byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi bden 'dzin mngon 'gyur ba 'gag pa'i 'gog pas ma nges/ rang lugs/ 'gog bden dang*/ lam bden gang rung gis bsdus pa'i zag med rnam byang gis bden pa/ dbye na/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi chos dkon mchog gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ theg dman gyi rgyud kyi 'gog bden dang*/ lam bden gang rung gis bsdus pa'i zag med rnam byang gi bden pa/ mtshan gzhi/ theg dman 'phags pa'i 'gog bden lta bu'o// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ yon tan drug dang ldan pa'i theg chen zag med rnam byang gi bden pa/ mtshan gzhi/ theg chen 'phags (368) pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden dang lam bden lta bu'o// yon tan drug ni/ 'gog bden la gtso bor ldan pa'i yon tan gsum/

lam bden la gtso bor ldan pa'i yon tan gsum mo// dang po ni/ rtog ge'i blos bsam du med pa/ las nyon gnyis med pa/ rnam rtog gi dngos yul las 'das pa'i yon tan no// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya cung zad spangs pa dag pa'i yon tan/ bdag med rtogs pa gsal ba'i yon tan/ mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa gnyen po'i yon tan no// rgyud blar/ bsam med gnyis med rtog med pa// dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis// gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba// bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos// chags bral nyid ni 'gog pa dang*// lam gyi bden pa dag gis bsdus// go rim ji bzhin de dag kyang*// yon tan gsum gsum gyis rig bya// zhes so// gsum pa dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid la/ kha cig rig grol (369) gyi yon tan gnyis dang*/ dad ldan pa'i rgyal sras 'phags pa/ zhes dang*/ kha cig de nyid theg chen gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid yin zer/ dang po la/ nyan thos mthong lam pa dang*/ gnyis pa la/ ston pa shākya thub pas ma nges/ rang lugs chos dkon mchog rgyud la ldan pa'i skyes bu/ dbye na/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ chos dkon mchog rgyud la ldan bzhin pa'i theg dman gyi skyes bu/ mtshan gzhi/ theg dman mthong lam pa/ sgom lam pa/ dgra bcom pa lta bu/ dbye na/ rgyun zhugs zhugs gnas gnyis/ phyir 'ong zhugs gnas/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs gnas/ dgra bcom zhugs gnas gnyis te brgyad do// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos dkon mchog rgyud la ldan bzhin pa'i theg chen gyi skyes bu/ mtshan gzhi/ theg chen (370) 'phags pa mtha' dag go /rig grol gyi yon tan drug dang ldan pa'i rgyal sras 'phags pa de/ 'dir dngos bstan gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ yon tan drug ni/ rig pa'i yon tan gsum/ grol ba'i yon tan gsum/ dang po ni/

ji lta ba rig pa/ ji snyed pa rig pa/ nang rig pa'i yon tan no// gnyis pa ni/ chags pa'i/ thogs pa'i/ dman pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba'i yon tan no// rgyud blar/ ji bzhin ji snyed nang gi ni// ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir// blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// zhes so// kha cig ston pa shākya thub pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa dang dge 'dun dkon mchog gi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der (371) thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ thogs pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba'i yon tan dang ldan par thal/ de yang 'dod na thogs pa'i sgrib pa las grol bar thal lo zer/ lam shes nyid la mthong ba'i lam// zhes pa'i skabs su dngos su bstan pa dang*/ theg dman gyi mthong lam gyi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ de'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi mthong lam yin na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ mthong lam gyi rigs pa byed pa'ang yod/ ston pa shākya thub pa chos can/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /ces sogs kyi skabs nas bstan pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog du thal/ skabs 'dir dngos bstan gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ de gnyis dngos kyi mdor bstan rgyas bshad ma yin par thal lo// 'dod na/ de dag gi skabs su dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi ming can gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog dngos su 'chad (372) rigs par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la/ nyan thos sgom lam pa'i zag zad kyi mngon shes chos can/ zag pa zad par thal/ zag zad kyi mngon shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod na/ nyon mongs pa zad par thal lo// gnyis pa la/ nges legs don gnyer gyi dbang du byas nas skyabs gsum du bzhag tshul dang*/

mngon mtho don gnyer gyi dbang du byas nas skyabs gsum bzhag tshul lo// dang po ni/ nges legs don gnyer gyi gang zag de la rigs can gsum yod cing*/ de yang theg chen gyi rigs can gyi dbang du byas nas/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog skyabs gnas su bzhag ste/ des gzhan don du sangs rgyas don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can gyi dbang du byas nas chos dkon mchog skyabs gnas su bzhag ste/ des rten 'brel zab mo rtogs pa'i chos don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi rigs can gyi dbang du byas nas dge 'dun dkon mchog skyabs gnas su bzhag ste/ (373) des dge 'dun gyi dngos po don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mngon mtho don gnyer gyi dbang du byas nas skyabs gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mngon mtho don gnyer gyi gang zag de la skye ba phyi mar mngon mtho'i phun tshogs sgrub par bya ba'i phyir du sangs rgyas la/ chos la/ dge 'dun la bya ba byed par mos pa gsum du yod cing*/ dang po'i dbang du byas na sangs rgyas/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas na chos/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas na dge 'dun dkon mchog skyabs gnas su bzhag pa'i phyir te/ rgyud blar/ ston pas bstan pa slob don gyis// theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la// mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas// skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ lung gi chos rnams ni mthar thug gi skyabs ma yin te/ mthar thug gi rtogs pa thob par byed pa'i thabs tsam yin gyis/ de thob pa na/ chu las sgrol ba'i (374) gzings ltar du dor bya yin pa'i phyir/ theg dman dang theg chen slob pa'i lam bden rnams kyang mthar thug skyabs ma yin te/ spangs rtogs gong nas gong du 'phel dgos pas bslu ba'i chos can lta bur snang ba'i phyir/ theg dman dang theg chen slob pa'i 'gog bden yang mthar thug gi skyabs ma yin te/

rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya cung zad med pas rab tu phye ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ theg dman dang theg chen slob pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyang de yin te/ sgrib gnyis ci rigs pa'i 'jigs pa dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud blar/ spang phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir// med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir// chos rnams gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no// zhes so// des na mthar thug gi skyabs gnas ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu nges te/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni/ gdul bya rnams gnas skabs kyi nyer 'tshe las skyob pa dang*/ mthar thug ji ltar (375) 'dod pa'i don bsgrub pa'i nus ldan yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud blar/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi// skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin// thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir// tshogs kyang de'i mthar thug phyir// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ rgyud blar/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir// mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi// rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir// 'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid// ces pa ltar ro// gnyis pa la/ skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bye brag tu smra ba ltar na/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i ngag gi rig byed kun slong dang bcas pa la 'dod/ theg chen gyi lugs la/ dkon mchog gsum la dmigs te yid ches kyi dad pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i skyabs gnas su khas len pa'i sems pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o// gnyis pa la/ 'bras bu dang*/ dmigs yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po

(376) la/ mngon mtho dang*/ nges legs kyi gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs tsam sgrub phyir du/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khor ba spangs pa'i myang 'das thob phyir du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lta bu'o// de la yang theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang don du 'khor ba spangs pa'i myang 'das thob phyir du/ gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral 'dod kyi bsam pas skyabs su 'gro ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa la/ rgyu'i dang*/ 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan rgyud la grub zin pa'i dkon mchog gsum la dmigs nas/ gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyud la 'byung rung gi dkon mchog gsum la dmigs nas skyabs su 'gro ba lta bu'o// gsum pa la/ yul/ rgyu/ dus/ bslab bya'i khyad par ro// dang po ni/ 'jig rten tha mal pa rnams ni/ ri dang nags tshal sogs la gnas pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lha la skyabs su 'gro ba yin kyang*/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag gi skyabs (377) yul ma yin te/ 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob mi nus pa'i phyir te/ rang nyid 'khor bas bcings pa'i phyir// mdo las/ 'jigs pas skrag pa'i mi rnams ni// phal cher ri dang nags tshal dang*// ljon shing dag la skyabs 'gro ste// skyabs de gtso bo ma yin te// skyabs de dag la brten nas ni// 'jigs pa kun las thar mi 'gyur// zhes so// des na rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag gi skyabs yul ni/ dkon mchog gsum yin te/ des gnas skabs 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob nus/ mthar thug nges legs la 'god nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dkon mchog la yid ches pa'i dad pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ sngon chad khyod kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes so// theg pa chen po

(378) pas/ de'i steng du gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsal 'dod kyi snying rje la brten nas skyabs su 'gro ste/ rgyan las/ 'di ni de dngos 'dod pas khas len de yang snying brtse las rig bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ theg dman ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du skyabs su 'gro ste/ rab dbye las/ nyan thos rnams kyi skyabs 'gro nas// dge slong gi ni sdom pa'i bar// ji srid 'tsho'i bar du yin// zhes so// theg chen ni/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du ste/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni/ thun mong gi dang*/ so so'i bslab bya'o// dang po ni/ skyes bu dam pa la brten pa/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa/ chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos sgrub pa'o// gnyis pa la dgag pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i bslab bya'o// dang po la/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas/ phyi rol pa'i lha dbang phyug chen po sogs skyabs gnas su khas mi len/ (379) chos la skyabs su song nas/ sems can la gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa spong*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas/ mu stegs can sogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ma dad pa grogs su mi brten pa la bslab dgos te/ myang 'das chen po las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba// de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te// nam du'ang lha ni gzhan dag la// skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin no// dam pa'i chos la skyabs song nas// 'tshe zhing gsod pa'i sems dang bral// dge 'dun la'ang skyabs song nas// mu stegs can dang 'grogs mi bya// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan tsam la yang sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed nas gus par byed pa dang*/ yi ge 'bru gcig yan chad la yang dam pa'i chos dngos kyi 'du shes skyed nas gus par byed pa dang*/ rab byung gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa la yang dge 'dun dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes skyed nas gus par byed pa'o// gsum pa ni/

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su (380) song ba ni phan yon chen po dang ldan te/ gnas skabs kyi nyer 'tshe mtha' dag las skyob nus pa dang*/ mthar thug gi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad sgrub nus pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ 'jig rten ji srid sems can gyis// gnod dang phun sum tshogs pa kun// bzlog cing 'byor par bya ba'i phyir// sangs rgyas skyabs chen nyid du 'dod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de don dam par dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas yin nam snyam pa'i log rtog bkag nas kun rdzob tu skyabs gnas su shes pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ sha'i dang*/ rnam par smin pa/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ spyan lnga la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu dang gsum/ dang po la/ thun mong gi dang*/ so so'i rgyu gnyis/ dang po la/ spyir spyan tsam gyi dang*/ theg chen gyi de'i rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyis dngos gzhi'i sems la brten (381) dgos te/ mngon shes bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten par bshad cing*/ mngon shes thob pa'i gang zag gis spyan lnga sgrub dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la brten no// mdo las/ mig lnga thob par 'dod pa dang sbyar bar 'dod pas kyang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslab par bya'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ spyan lnga'i rgyu/ go rim bzhin/ bsam gtan gyis sbyangs pa'i dbang po gzugs can pa/ skye ba snga ma mar me sogs phul ba'i dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin dang*/ bsam gtan gnyis ka'i stobs las byung ba'i dbang po gzugs can pa/ lam zhugs so skyes mnyam bzhag du ji lta ba rtse gcig tu bsgom pa dang*/ des rjes thob tu ji snyed pa thos bsam gyi gtan la 'bebs pa dang*/ slob lam du tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsog pa'o// gnyis pa la/

dgag gzhag gnyis las/ dang po la/ spyan lnga'i nang tshan gang (382) zhig dpag tshad brgya nas stong gsum tshun chad kyi dngos po so sor rig pa'i yul can/ de gang zhig sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mngon sum du rig pa'i yul can/ de gang zhig chos thams cad la bdag gnyis su rnam par mi rtog pa'i yul can/ de gang zhig 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang po'i dbye ba mngon sum du rig pa'i yul can/ de gang zhig chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can/ rim pa bzhin mtshan nyid yin zer na/ dang po gnyis la/ sa bcu pa'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa la skyes par 'gyur ro// gsum pa la/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i sha'i spyan chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ chos thams cad bdag gnyis su rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ yul can gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ des der mi rtog pa gang zhig yul can yin pa'i phyir/ (383) dang po ma grub na/ der 'dzin par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa la/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i chos kyi spyan chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i dbang po'i dbye ba mngon sum du rig par thal lo// lnga pa la/ lam shes chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ khyod kyi mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i chos gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ gzhi grub na khyod kyis mngon sum du rtogs pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen du 'gyur ro// kha cig mtshan nyid kyi zur phyi ma sngar dang 'dra ba la/ spyan lnga'i nang nas dang po gang zhig ces sogs zer na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i spyan gyis dpag tshad brgya mthong ba yod do// stong mthong ba yod do// stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams mthong ba yod do// stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mthong bar yod do// zhes yul mthong tshul so sor bshad

(384) pa mi 'thad par thal/ dpag tshad brgya tshun chad mthong ba'i sha'i spyan gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub na de chos can/ mtshan nyid dang po der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ stong gsum mthong bar thal lo// gzhan yang sha'i spyan yin na/ stong gsum las lhag pa mi mthong bas khyab par thal/ de'i mtshan nyid kyi zur du stong gsum tshun chad ces smros pa la rnam bcad kyi dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi sha'i spyan gyis ma nges/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi lha'i spyan chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems can thams cad mngon sum du rig par thal/ de yang 'dod na/ longs sku la chos dngos su nyan bzhin pa'i byang sems 'phags pa mngon sum du rig par thal/ 'dod na/ byang sems 'phags pa la chos dngos su gsung pa po'i longs sku mngon sum du rig par thal lo// gsum pa la/ shes rab kyi spyan yin na/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs (385) pas khyab par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob la ma nyams pa'i nyan thos kyi sgom lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma gnyis la skyon sngar bzhin no// kha cig bsam gtan gyis sbyangs pa'i dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas dpag tshad brgya la sogs pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen skyes bu'i rgyud kyi yon tan dang*/ bsam gtan gyi sas bsdus pa'i dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas/ sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ skye ba mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen sbyor lam pa yan chad kyi yon tan dang*/ chos thams cad la bdag gnyis su rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mnyam bzhag gis bsdus pa'i yon tan dang*/ rang dang rgyud tshod mnyam pa man chad kyi 'phags pa'i gang zag gi dbang po'i dbye ba mngon sum du rig

(386) pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i yon tan dang*/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par byang chub pa'i ye shes zer/ dang po la/ bsam gtan gyi sbyangs pa'i dbang po gzugs can pa'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i sa dang po'i ye shes chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dbang shes su 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la/ sems can thams cad mtshan nyid kyi zur du yod pa la/ skyon sngar bzhin no// gsum pa la/ sa dang po'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas/ chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzod pa'i gzugs yin na/ mnyam bzhag ye shes yin dgos par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rang dang rgyud tshod mnyam pa man chad (387) kyi 'phags pa'i dbang po'i dbye ba mngon sum du rig pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ grangs nges/ sa mtshams so// dang po ni/ rang nyid spyan du 'grub byed kyi rgyu phun tshogs la brten nas rang yul gyi gtso bo mngon sum du rig pa'i yul can/ dbye na/ sha'i/ lha'i/ shes rab kyi/ chos kyi/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan no// gsum pa ni/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ spyan lnga'i nang tshan gang zhig rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyis sbyangs pa'i dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas dpag tshad brgya la sogs pa'i dngos po so sor rig pa'i yul can/ dbye na/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi sha'i spyan gnyis/ spyan lnga'i nang tshan gang zhig rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen sngon gyi dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin las byung ba'i dbang po gzugs can la brten nas/

sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mngon (388) sum du rig pa'i yul can/ dbye na/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi lha'i spyan gnyis/ de gang zhig bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes/ dbye na/ gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi spyan dang*/ chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i de gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa mtha' dag go /de gang zhig bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rang dang rgyud tshod mnyam pa man chad kyi 'phags pa'i dbang po'i dbye ba mngon sum du rig pa'i yul can/ dbye na/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen chos kyi spyan gnyis/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i rjes thob ye shes dang*/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rjes thob ye shes lta bu'o// (389) ming tsam mthun pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ lung gi chos kyi spyan dang*/ rtogs pa'i de gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsung rab dpag tu med pa'i tshig don 'dzin par nus pa'i tshig gzungs dang don gzungs lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'phags rgyud kyi gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes lta bu'o// chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ dbye na/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan rjes mthun pa dang*/ mtshan nyid pa gnyis/ bzhi pa la/ yul rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas spyan la lngar bzhag pa yin te/ de la chos thams cad kyi yul can dang*/ de las gzhan gnyis su nges la/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan/ gnyis pa la/ ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa'i yul can gnyis su nges/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas shes rab kyi spyan/ gnyis pa la/ rten snod kyi 'jig rten 'jal ba'i dbang du byas nas sha'i spyan/ brten pa sems can gyi khyad chos 'jal ba'i dbang du byas nas

(390) lha'i spyan/ gzhan rgyud kyi dbang po'i rab dbye 'jal ba'i dbang du byas nas chos kyi spyan bzhag pa'i phyir/ ngo bo'i sgo nas bsdu na/ dbang shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i spyan dang*/ yid shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i spyan gnyis su 'dus/ de yang spyan dang po gnyis mtha' gcig tu dbang shes/ slob pa'i rgyud kyi bar pa gnyis yid shes/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan la gnyis ka yod/ des na spyan dang po gnyis mi 'gal te/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa gcig nyid dpag tshad brgya la sogs pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten rig pa'i cha nas spyan dang po dang*/ der gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mngon sum du rig pa'i cha nas gnyis par bzhag pa'i phyir/ bar pa gnyis mi 'gal te/ byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa 'di chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas shes rab kyi spyan dang*/ gzhan rgyud kyi dbang po'i dbye ba mngon sum du rig pa'i

(391) cha nas chos kyi spyan du bzhag pa'i phyir/ slob lam du dang po gnyis dang bar pa gnyis 'gal te/ dang po gnyis dbang shes dang*/ phyi ma gnyis yid shes su bzhag pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sar lnga ka mi 'gal te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa la spyan lnga ka'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i phyir/ lnga pa la/ gtso che ba'i sa mtshams dang*/ thob pa'i sa mtshams gnyis/ dang po ni/ rim bzhin/ tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ 'phags rgyud kyi mnyam bzhag de'i rjes thob/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na'o// de yang lha'i spyan sbyor lam na gtso che ste/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i sbyor lam pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pas sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ skye ba mngon sum du rig pa'i tshul tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs las lhag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi spyan mnyam bzhag du gtso che ste/ der ji lta ba la gtso bor mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyir/ chos kyi spyan rjes thob du gtso che ste/ (392) de ji snyed pa rtogs tshul mnyam bzhag las lhag pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'di tsam la dgongs nas ṭī kar sa mtshams so sor bshad par yin no// gnyis pa ni/ spyan dang po gnyis bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i tshogs lam nas yod/ bar pa gnyis de thob pa'i 'phags pa mtha' dag gi rgyud la yod/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan rjes mthun pa sa bdun pa nas yod de/ sa bdun pa'i yongs sbyong gi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i thogs pa med pa'i ye shes gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan no// zhes so// mkhan chen pa na re/ sa dang po nas kyang yod de/ der chos dbyings kun 'gro'i tshul du rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes gsung ngo*// rang lugs/ sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na na yod de/ de rjes mthun pa sangs rgyas kyi spyan btags pa pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyan lnga'i sgo nas gzhan don byed tshul phyin ci ma log par shes te/

gdams ngag ston (393) pa la gzhan gyis drin mi 'jog par shes te/ gzhan gyi drin mi 'jog par 'gro ba nyid kyi rgyu gang yin pa spyan lnga dang zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ bla na med pa'i 'bras bu 'grub par byed de/ mdo las/ mig lnga po 'di dag la bslab nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ spyan lnga la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ spyan lnga yul dang bcas pa bden stong du nyams su len par shes pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ mngon shes drug la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu'o// dang po la/ lus kyi rten/ sems kyi rten/ rnam smin gyi rgyu dang gsum/ dang po la/ khams gang du thob pa dang*/ gang zag gang gis thob pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sngar med (394) gsar du bsgrub pa dang*/ thob zin gnas pa'i dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod pa'i rten la sgrub dgos te/ gtso bor lung gi mthu la brten nas skye dgos pa'i phyir/ zag zad kyi mngon shes ni/ gzugs kyi rten la yang dngos su skye ba yod/ gnyis pa ni/ dang po lnga 'dod gzugs gnyis ka'i rten la skye ba yod la/ drug pa gzugs med khams na yang yod/ zhib tu phye na/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes dang*/ sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes gzugs med kyi rten la yang yod srid de/ gzugs med kyi rten can gyi nyan thos 'phags pa'i mkhyen pas gang zag gzhan rgyud kyi dbang po'i dbye ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs snga phyi mngon sum du shes pa yod pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i phyi rol pa dang*/ lam ma zhugs mtha' dag gi rgyud la dngos su skye rung ste/ de ltar du kun btus su bshad pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la/ spyir (395) bstan pa dang*/ theg chen gyi mngon par shes pa'i rten bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon shes dang po lnga bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi tsam dang*/ drug pa bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten par bshad de/ kun btus su tshad med rnam thar zil gnon/ zad par/ nyon mongs pa/ smon nas shes pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa/ mngon par shes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan bcu dgu bshad nas de'i lus rten dang*/ sems rten 'chad ba'i skabs su/ yon tan 'di rnams ji ltar mngon par sgrub ce na/ phyi rol pa'am/ nyan thos sam byang chub sems dpa' yang rung ste/ dag sa'i bsam gtan bzhi la brten nas/ tshad med pa rnams mngon par bsgrub bo// tshad med pa rnams ji lta bar mngon par shes pa lnga yang de bzhin no// yon tan lhag ma rnams ni nyan thos sam/ byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa yang rung ste/ (396) rab kyi mthar phyin pa'i bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten nas mngon par sgrub bo// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan bzhi pa/ grogs stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab/ mngon shes kyi dmigs rnam ji ltar gnas pa bzhin yid la byed pa'i khyad par gsum la brten par bzhed de/ rgyan las/ bsam gtan bzhi pa shin tu dbang thob nas// mi rtog ye shes yongs su bzung ba dang*// ji ltar rnam gnas yid la byed pa las// mthu grub pa yi dam pa thob par 'gyur// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ lham dang bzhon pa bzang po gzhan la sbyin par byed pa sogs dang po'i rnam smin gyi rgyu ste/ rin chen phreng bar/ lham dang bzhon pa byin pa dang*// nyam chung bkur ba byas pa dang*// gzhon pas bla ma bkur ba yis// mkhas pa rdzu 'phrul 'thob par 'gyur// zhes so// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten la rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs 'bul ba ni gnyis pa'i (397) rgyu ste/ mchod rten mchod pa'i rol mo dang*// dril bu dag ni phul ba dang*// dung dang rnga ni rab phul bas// lha'i rna ba 'thob par 'gyur// zhes so// gzhan gyi skyon mi brjod par sems srung ba ni/
