gsum pa'i rgyu ste/ gzhan gyi/ gleng zhing*/ yan lag nyams pa rnams mi brjod// sems ni rjes su bsrungs bas ni// gzhan gyi sems ni shes par 'thob// zhes so// chos kyi sbyin pa ster bar byed pa ni bzhi pa'i rgyu ste/ chos kyi ched dang de bzhin du// chos gzhung don dag 'dren pa dang*// chos kyi sbyin pa dri med pas// tshe rabs dran pa 'thob par 'gyur// zhes so// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten la mar me sogs 'bul ba ni lnga pa'i rgyu ste/ mchod rten mar me phreng ba dang*// mun pa dag tu sgron me dang*// mar me 'bru mar byin pa yis// lha'i mig ni 'thob par 'gyur// zhes so// bdag med thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa ni drug pa'i rgyu ste/ (398) dngos rnams ngo bo nyid med par// yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes pas// mngon shes drug pa zag pa kun// zad pa mchog ni 'thob par 'gyur// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ khyad chos so// dang po ni/ rang nyid mngon shes su 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu phun tshogs la brten nas rang yul gyi gtso bo mngon sum du rig pa'i yul can/ gnyis pa la/ rdzu 'phrul/ lha'i rna ba/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i lha'i mig gi zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes so// gsum pa la/ drug las/ dang po/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid ni/ mngon shes drug gi nang tshan gang zhig rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas/ sa g.yo ba la sogs pa rdzu 'khrul sna tshogs dngos su ston nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ rdzu 'phrul tsam gyis dbye ba dang*/ mngon (399) shes kyi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ skyes stobs kyi/ las la skyes pa'i/ sngags la/ sman la/ ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa'i/ rdzu 'phrul dang lnga/ dang po ni/ 'dod gzugs kyi lha dang*/

sha za la sogs pa'i/ gnyis pa ni/ bar srid kyi/ gsum pa ni/ sngags 'ga' zhig la brten nas lus la sprul bsgyur sna tshogs nus pa'i/ bzhi pa ni/ sman/ 'ga' zhig lus la byug pa la brten nas 'phur ba la sogs pa'i/ lnga pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta bu'o// de yang dang po bzhi mngon shes ma yin te/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi ma thob pa'i gang zag la'ang ldan pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ mngon shes kyang yin no// gnyis pa ni/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis ma zin pa dang*/ zin pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes gnyis/ dang po (400) ni/ phyi rol pa'i rgyud kyi mngon shes lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ lam zhugs skyes bu'i rgyud kyi mngon shes lta bu'o// dbye ba 'di bar pa bzhi la'ang rigs bsgre/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi sbyangs pa'i rna dbang gzugs can pa la brten nas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sgra phra rags thos pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ lha'i rna ba'i dbye ba dang*/ mngon par shes pa'i dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ skyes thob kyi/ las la skyes pa'i/ ting nge 'dzin la brten pa'i lha'i rna ba'o// dang po ni/ 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i rna dbang gzugs can pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rna dbang lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i rna dbang lta bu'o// gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas gzhan rgyud kyi sems (401) 'dod chags dang bcas pa la sogs pa mngon sum du rig pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ gzhan sems shes pa tsam gyi dbye ba dang*/ de'i mngon shes kyi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ skyes thob/ rtog ge sngags/ ting nge 'dzin la brten pa'i gzhan sems shes pa'o// dang po ni/

lha klu la sogs pas gzhan rgyud kyi sems shes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ da ltar ba'i gang zag 'ga' zhig gis phyi'i lus ngag gi rig byed la brten nas gzhan gyi sems shes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ sngags 'ga' zhig bzlas pa brten nas pha rol gyi sems shes pa lta bu'o// bzhi pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas pha rol gyi sems mngon sum du shes pa lta bu'o// 'di ni mngon shes mtshan nyid pa yang yin no// bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas (402) rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs snga ma du ma mngon sum du dran par nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ sngon gnas rjes dran tsam la dbye na/ skyes thob/ las la skyes pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dod gzugs kyi lha dang*/ dmyal ba skyes ma thag pa'i gang zag gis skye ba snga ma rjes su dran pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ da ltar ba'i mi 'ga' zhig rang gis skye ba snga ma dran pa lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas de ltar shes pa lta bu'o// lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi sbyangs pa'i mig dbang gzugs can pa la brten nas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs phra rags mngon sum du mthong ba'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ lha'i rna ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar ro// lha'i rna ba'i dang*/ mig gi mngon shes 'di dag gi bdag (403) rkyen rna dbang dang*/ mig dbang de dag lha'i rna dbang dang mig dbang mtshan nyid pa yin nam/ de dang cha 'dra bas ming gi btags pa gang yin snyam na/ mtshan nyid pa yin te/ de dag ni bsam gtan gyis bsdus pa'i rna ba'i dbang po dang mig gis dbang po la 'dod pa'i phyir/ de yang khyad chos bzhi dang ldan te/

ngo bo'i khyad par/ bsam gtan gyi sas bsdus pa'i nang gi gzugs dang ba/ rten gyi khyad par rnam shes kyi rten dus rtag tu byed pa/ yon tan gyi khyad par rang gang la ldan pa'i gang zag dbang po ma tshang ba med pa/ byed las kyi khyad par 'jig rten tha mal pa las lkog tu gyur pa'i thag ring ba'i yul phra mo mthong ba'i rten byed de/ mdzod las/ lha yi mig dang rna ba yin// bsam gtan sa pa'i gzugs dang ba// rtag tu rten bcas ma tshang med// thag ring phra sogs spyod yul can// zhes so// drug pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig bdag rkyen bsam (404) gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas/ zag pa zad pa dang*/ zag pa zad pa'i thabs gang rung mngon sum du shes pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ zag pa zad pa'i thabs shes pa'i mngon shes dang*/ zag pa zad pa rang gi ngo bo shes pa'i de gnyis/ dang po la/ nyon sgrib kyi zag pa zad pa'i thabs shes pa'i mngon shes dang*/ shes sgrib kyi zag pa zad pa'i thabs shes pa'i mngon shes gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i nyan thos slob pa 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen slob pa 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa la/ nyon sgrib kyi/ shes sgrib kyi zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i theg dman dgra bcom pa'i mkhyen pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam mkhyen lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ bsdu ba/ grangs nges/ sa mtshams dang gsum/ dang po la/ 'jig rten (405) las 'das pa'i mngon shes dang*/ 'jig rten pa dang thun mong pa'i mngon shes gnyis su 'dus/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas zag zad bzhag gnyis pa la/ dbang shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i lung ma bstan gyi mngon shes dang*/ yid shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dge ba'i mngon shes gnyis/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas lha'i mig gi dang*/ rna ba'i mngon shes bzhag

gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas lhag ma gsum bzhag ste/ mdzod las/ mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes ni// lung du ma bstan lhag rnams dge /zhes so// dang po gnyis lung ma bstan gtso che ba yin gyi mtha' gcig tu ma nges so// slob lam na'ang de gnyis dang dge ba'i gzhi mthun yong ba'i phyir/ phyi ma gsum yid shes su bshad pa'ang slob pa'i gnas skabs la dgongs so// gnyis pa ni/ gzhan don phun tshogs gtso bor sgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas mngon shes la drug tu bzhag ste/ (406) gdul bya gang na yod pa'i gnas su rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas thogs pa med par 'gro ba'i dbang du byas nas mngon shes dang po/ der gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa'i dbye ba mngon sum du shes par byed pa'i dbang du byas nas gzhan sems shes pa/ gdul bya rang gi skad dang mthun par chos ston pa'i dbang du byas nas lha'i rna ba/ gdul bya rnams kyi tshe rabs snga ma'i bag chags dang mthun par don byed pa'i dbang du byas nas sngon gnas rjes su dran pa/ skye ba phyi ma'i gdul bya smin pa dang*/ mthun par don byed pa'i dbang du byas nas lha'i mig chags sdang la sogs pa spangs pa'i nges 'byung gi lam 'bras mthong ba'i dbang du byas nas zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes bzhag pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon shes drug gi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de// de dag skad kyis sems can gyi// 'ong dang 'gro dang nges 'byung la// legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// gsum pa ni/

(407) dang po lnga lam ma zhugs na'ang yod de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i phyi rol pa sogs kyi rgyud la yod par bshad pa'i phyir te/ mya ngan bsal ba'i mdo las/ drang srong chen po lnga mngon shes// mkha' la rgyang ring 'gro ba yang*// gang na spyod yul 'chi med par// des na 'gro bar nus pa med// ces so// drug pa/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i 'phags pa mtha' dag gi rgyud la yod/ gal te theg dman slob pa'i rgyud la zag zad kyi mngon shes med de/ de yin na zag pa ma zad pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ de yin na nyon mongs pa ma spangs pas khyab pa'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rgyud la zag med kyi lam med par thal/ de yin na zag pa dang bcas pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ de min na nyon sgrib dang bcas pas khyab pa'i phyir/ des na theg dman slob pa'i rgyud la zag pa zad pa rang gi ngo bo shes pa'i mngon shes med kyang*/ (408) zag pa zad pa'i thabs shes pa'i mngon shes yod de/ de ltar du mdzod las bshad pa'i phyir/ ji ltar bshad snyam na/ mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi mngon shes phyi ma gsum la rig pa'i mngon shes zhes bya ste/ de gsum gyis gdul bya rnams kyi tshe rabs snga ma'i gnas tshul/ phyi ma'i gnas tshul rnams mngon sum du rig pa'i phyir te/ ma rig pa spangs pa'i mngon shes yin pa'i phyir/ slob pa'i rgyud la de gsum yod kyang*/ rig pa'i mngon shes su ma 'jog ste/ slob pa na sems rgyud ma rig pa dang bcas pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ gsum ni rig pa sngon mtha' sogs// ma rig pa ni bzlog phyir ro// slob la 'dod de ma rig dang*// bcas rgyud phyir na rig ma bshad// ces so// gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa'i gnas pa rnam thar sgo gsum/ lha'i gnas pa bsam gtan gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug tshangs pa'i gnas pa tshad med bzhi mngon du byas te/ gnas skabs su sangs rgyas yod pa'i phyogs su (409) song nas de la mchod par byed/

sems can yod pa'i phyogs su song nas de'i don bya ste/ mthar thug rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i 'bras bu dang ldan te/ rgyan las/ gang gis 'phags dang lha dang tshangs pa yi// gnas pa dpe med rgya ches rtag tu gnas// phyogs su de song sangs rgyas sems can dag /yang dag mchod byed rnam par dag par bskyed// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ mngon shes drug la 'doms pa'i gdam ngag gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ mngon shes drug yul dang bcas pa bden stong du nyams su len par shes pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang*// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po sbyor lam la gsum/ lus rten/ sems rten/ brten pa sbyor lam gyi rang bzhin no// dang po ni/ tshogs lam chen po'i rtogs pa thob la ma btang ba'i 'dod gzugs kyi rten la dngos su skye ba yod kyi/ gzugs med kyi rten la dngos su skye ba med de/ (410) sbyor lam ni tshogs lam gyi rten la dngos su skye dgos shing*/ de na tshogs la dngos su skye ba med pa'i phyir/ tshogs lam ni thos bsam gyi mthu las skye dgos shing*/ de na gsung rab la thos bsam byed pa med pa'i phyir/ 'o na gzugs khams na'ang de dngos su skye ba med par thal/ sgrub byed de 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ skyon med de/ gzugs khams rang na gsung rab la thos bsam gtso bor byed pa med kyang*/ gzugs kyi rten can gyi gang zag 'dod pa'i khams su rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis lhag ste/ sangs rgyas byang sems la chos nyan pa yod par sher phyin gyi mdo las bshad pa'i phyir/ gal te gzugs med kyi rten gyi byang sems tshogs lam pa yod par thal/ der skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las gsog pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa yod pa gang zhig byang sems so skye rnams skye ba la dbang ma thob pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ gzugs med kyi rten can gyi chos mchog la gnas pa'i byang sems yod par thal/

sgrub byed de 'thad pa'i (411) phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rten la theg chen gyi mthong lam dngos su skye ba yod par thal lo// gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi sems rten bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bsam gtan sa drug gang rung la brten par 'dod de/ mdzod las/ nges 'byed cha mthun rnam pa bzhi// bsgoms byung mi lcogs med pa dang*// khyad par bsam gtan sa pa'o// zhes dang*/ bsdu ba las/ sa drug la brten par bshad pa'i phyir/ gzugs med dngos su mi brten te/ de nas lhag mthong shas chung bas zhi lhag cha mi mnyam pa'i stobs kyis lam sgrub dka' ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa yan chad kyi nyer rdog la mi brten te/ dang po'i dngos gzhi ma thob par de thob mi nus la/ lam sgrub sla ba dngos gzhi la dbang bzhin du/ sgrub dka' ba nyer rdog la brten pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sems la (412) brten nas theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa dngos su skye ba gtso che ste/ der bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sems la brten par nus shing*/ de la brten nas sgrub sla ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la/ kha cig bdag med don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ tshogs lam rdzogs rjes su byung zhing mthong lam ma skyes gong gi mngon par rtogs pa dang*/ so so skye bo'i rgyud kyi thar lam gang zhig thar pa cha mthun las 'das pa zer/ dang po la/ thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyor lam gyis ma nges/ gnyis pa la/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na ma yin par thal/ mthong lam gyi rtogs pa sngon song gi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ sbyor lam yin na/

thar pa cha mthun don du mi gnyer bas khyab par thal/ (413) mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun gtso bor thob phyir du brtson pa'i theg dman gyi sbyor lam gyi ma nges/ rang lugs/ theg pa rang lugs kyis tshogs lam rdzogs rjes su byung zhing theg pa rang lugs kyi mthong lam ma skyes gong gi don mngon rtogs/ de yang sbyor lam/ nges 'byed cha mthun/ nges 'byed yan lag don mngon rtogs rnams ming gi rnam grangs so// dbye na/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ theg chen gyi dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chen po rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam ma skyes gong gi nyan thos kyi nges 'byed yan lag dbye na/ drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi/ nang tshan gyi sgo nas de re re la yang chung*/ 'bring*/ chen po gsum gsum mo// kha cig theg dman gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chung 'bring chen po gsum gyi dbye ba yod de/ de skad cig ma gcig yin par mdzod las bshad (414) pa'i phyir zer ba mi 'thad de/ theg dman gyi lugs la de ltar yin kyang*/ theg dman gyi rgyud la de ltar skye ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ srid rtse'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug de'i lugs la zag bcas kho nar bshad kyang*/ de dang zag med kyi gzhi mthun yod pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ des rigs 'gre/ gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ grangs nges/ blo rigs/ khyad chos dang drug dang po la/ kha cig rang rgyud theg chen gyi tshogs lam rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ theg chen gyi mthong lam ma skyes gong gi theg chen skyes bu'i mngon rtogs/ zhe na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chen po skad cig ma gnyis pas ma nges/ rang lugs/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa la sogs pa khyad chos lnga ldan gyi theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag dbye na/ drod sogs bzhi/ gsum pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/

dang po la/ kha cig theg chen gyi sbyor lam gang zhig kun (415) nas nyon mongs kyi/ rnam byang gi bzung ba/ gang zag rdzas yod kyi/ skyes bu btags yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang gtso bor thob pa/ zer/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod de kun nas nyon mongs kyi bzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang gtso bor thob pa gang zhig de'i rtogs pa sngon song gi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan rnams la rigs bsgre/ kha cig de gang zhig kun nas nyon mongs kyi bzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang dang por thob pa sogs zer na/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod chen po chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod chung ngus kun nas nyon mongs kyi bzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang dang por thob zin pa ma yin par 'gyur ro// kha (416) cig de gang zhig mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye ba'i snga ltas su gyur pa dang*/ dge rtsa mi mthun phyogs kyi g.yo bar nus pa rnams kyi nang nas rtse mor gyur pa dang*/ stong pa nyid la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa dang*/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ zer/ dang po la/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi dngos rgyur gyur pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ de chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'jig rten pa'i dge rtsa mtha' dag gi nang nas rtse mor gyur pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la yang des ma nges/ bzhi pa la/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chung ngu chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/

mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ khyod (417) las mchog tu gyur pa'i lam yod pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam rtse mo ma skyes gong gi nges 'byed cha mthun gang zhig kun nas nyon mongs kyi bzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang gtso bor thob pa/ dbye na/ drod chung ngus/ 'bring*/ chen po gsum/ 'di gsum gyi khyad par la/ mkhas pa kha cig byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud la/ dang por skyes pa'i drod/ bar du/ tha mar skyes pa gsum la rim bzhin bzhed/ kha cig dbang po rtul po/ 'bring po/ rnon po'i drod gsum la rim bzhin 'dod/ kha cig de gnyis ka'i gzhi mthun khas len zer ro// lugs gnyis pa mi 'thad de/ theg chen sgom lam pa dbang rnon gyi rgyud kyi sgom lam yin na/ theg chen gyi sgom lam chen po yin dgos par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sa gnyis pa la gnas pa'i byang sems dbang rnon gyi mkhyen pa sgom lam chen por thal lo// gsum pa la/ (418) byang sems sbyor lam pa dbang rnon gyi rgyud la dang por skyes pa'i drod chos can/ drod chung ngur thal/ byang sems kyi rgyud la dang por skyes pa'i drod yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chen por thal/ byang sems dbang rnon gyi drod yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nang 'gal lo// khyab pa gnyis ka dngos/ rang lugs/ lugs snga ma de nyid 'thad phyogs yin no// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod rdzogs rjes su byung zhing bzod pa ma skyes gong gi nges 'byed cha mthun gang zhig rnam byang gi bzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang gtso bor thob pa/ dbye na gsum/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam rtse mo rdzogs rjes su byung zhing chos mchog ma skyes gong gi nges 'byed cha mthun gang zhig gang zag rdzas yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang gtso bor thob pa/ dbye na/

gsum/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa rdzogs rjes su byung ba'i nges 'byed cha mthun gang zhig (419) skyes bu btags yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang gtso bor thob pa/ dbye na/ gsum/ bzhi pa ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam spang bya rtogs pa'i sgo nas bzhir nges pa yin te/ drod kyi kun nas nyon mongs kyi bzung rtogs gtso bor 'joms pa nas/ chos mchog gis btags 'dzin rtogs pa gtso bor 'joms pa'i phyir te/ de lta bu'i rnam par rtog pa bzhi dang nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa bzhi po grangs bzhin du ldan pa yin no// zhes so// lnga pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ lo chen na re/ chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam de chos nyid la/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin te/ chos nyid la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos nyid gsal bar snang ba'i sgo nas chos nyid rtogs pa'i rig pa yin pa'i phyir zer/ des chos nyid mngon sum rtogs par thal/ de chos nyid la rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de (420) chos nyid la mos spyod kyi sa ma yin pa thal ba dang*/ theg chen gyi mthong lam de chos nyid mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i lam ma yin par thal lo// kha cig tshogs sbyor gnyis ka rtog pa 'khrul shes yin te/ so so skye bo phyin ci log /bden pa mthong la bzlog pa ste// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam de byang chub du bgrod byed kyi lam ma yin par thal ba dang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin par thal lo// kha cig sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog med yin te/ rang yul gsal bar snang ba'i phyir/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog bcas yin te/ rang yul don spyi'i tshul du 'dzin pa'i phyir zer/ de chos nyid la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i rig par thal/ de de la sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral zhing*/

ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de de la mngon sum du 'gyur ro// rang lugs/ spyi don che chung gi dngos bstan ltar na dman lam sngon du ma (421) song ba'i tshogs sbyor mtha' dag rtog pa yin te/ rang yul don spyi'i tshul du 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ theg dman 'phags pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor ni rnal 'byor mngon sum yin te/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ ṭī ka'i dgongs pa rtogs par bzhed de/ chos kyi bdag med don spyi'i tshul du 'dzin pa'i blor bzhed pa'i phyir/ chos nyid kyi don spyi 'dzin pa dang*/ ming dang spros pa'i sgo nas yul 'dzin pas rtog pa ste/ kun las btus rtsa 'grel gnyis char las ming dang spros pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi la bkra bar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes ṭī ka las bshad pa'i phyir ro// kha cig theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos can/ rang yul gsal bar snang ba'i blo ma yin par thal/ rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rnam 'grel las/ rnam par rtog dang rjes 'brel ni// don gsal snang ba can ma yin// zhes (422) gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ skyon med de/ lung gi don ni/ rtog pa la rang yul mngon sum du gsal bar snang ba med pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ kha cig rjes thob ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i theg chen sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes chos can/ rtog par thal/ sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ zer/ de chos can/ theg dman gyi sbyor lam las dmigs rnam gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i sbyor lam du thal/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ rtags chos can dang bcas pa khas/ 'dod na/ chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ de'i rnam pa can gyi mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/
gzhan yang*/ de chos can/ chos kyi bdag med don spyi'i tshul du rtogs par thal/ de rtogs pa'i sbyor lam gang zhig de mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang yul don spyi'i tshul

(423) du rtogs par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang yul mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ gzhan rgyud kyi sems mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ des na/ tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs su gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes sogs yon tan du ma yod kyang lam gyi ngo bor skye ba ma yin no// drug pa la/ dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khyad chos/ spang bya rtogs pa'i khyad chos/ yongs 'dzin gyi khyad chos so// dang po la/ dmigs rnam dang*/ rgyu byed tshul gyi khyad chos gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg dman gyi sbyor lam las dmigs pa dmigs tshul dang*/ rnam pa rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags te/ bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug la dmigs nas/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rnam pa can du shes pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi rgyu byed pa tsam gyi sgo nas khyad chos su 'gyur ba ma yin te/ theg dman gyi sbyor (424) lam gyis kyang de'i rgyu byed nus pa'i phyir/ dngos rgyu byed pa'i sgo nas khyad chos su 'gyur ba ma yin te/ drod sogs gsum po la ma khyab pa'i phyir/ des na theg chen gyi sbyor lam de/ theg dman gyi sbyor lam las rgyu byed tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags te/ des theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs tshang ba'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu theg pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par byed nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam de theg dman gyi sbyor lam las/ rtog pa spong tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags te/ des gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang gtso bor thob pa'i stobs kyis 'dir bstan rtog pa mngon 'gyur dngos su spong zhing*/ sa bon mgo gnon pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ slob dpon gyi lugs dang*/ 'phags pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam de theg dman gyi sbyor lam las yongs su 'dzin tshul gyi sgo

(425) nas khyad par du 'phags te/ khyad chos gsum ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi theg dman du mi ltung bar theg pa chen por dngos su 'dzin pa'i phyir/ khyad chos gsum ni/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi// gzhan la chos ston nus pa yi// ser sna la sogs pa dang*/ bral ba mi mthun phyogs spangs pa'i khyad par ro// de yang*/ sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs// zhes pa'i tshig rkang dang po gsum gyi khyad chos gsum rim bzhin bstan/ tshig rkang bzhi pas khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'i yongs 'dzin dge bshes kyi ngo bo bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ sbyor lam pa rang rgyud kyi thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang ldan zhing mi mthun phyogs ser sna sogs dang bral bas khyad par du byas pa'i mkhyen pa ni/ nang gi yongs 'dzin dge bshes yin la/ chos ston pa dang*/ mi mthun phyogs dang bral ba'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i dge bshes ni/ phyi'i yongs 'dzin du bzhed/ de (426) yang dang po ni/ sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs// de yi mi mthun phyogs bor ba// rnam pa kun tu yongs 'dzin yin// zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo nyid med sogs ston byed// zhes sogs kyi bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos can/ theg dman gyi sbyor lam las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ theg dman gyi sbyor lam las/ dmigs pa dmigs tshul/ rnam par rtogs tshul/ rgyu byed tshul/ yongs su 'dzin tshul/ spangs bya spong tshul sogs khyad chos lnga'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ sgrub pa'i rten rigs/ sgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ ji ltar nyan thos kyi theg pa la sogs pa/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs la/ dngos smra ba'i lugs dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po la bye brag tu smra ba'i/ mdo sde pa'i/ sems tsam (427)

pa'i lugs dang gsum/ dang po la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ grangs nges/ byed las so// dang po ni/ srid pa dang*/ srid pa'i yo byad la ma chags pa'i sems byung la 'dod/ gnyis pa la/ chos gos/ bsod snyoms/ gnas mal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa'i 'phags pa'i rigs/ spong ba dang bsgom pa la rab tu dga' ba'i 'phags pa'i rigs dang bzhi/ dang po gsum gyis tshul dang*/ phyi mas las bstan te/ yo byad ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa'i tshul de la gnas nas spong ba dang sgom pa la rab tu dga' ba'i las de bsgrubs pas 'phags pa'i chos myur du 'grub par byed pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ ma chags 'phags rigs de dag las// gsum gyi tshul bstan tha mas las// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ de la bzhir 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sred pa de la longs spyod la chags pa'i sred pa dang*/ phung po la chags pa'i sred pa gnyis su yod la/ (428) dang po'i gnyen po'i dbang du byas nas dang po gsum bzhag gnyis pa'i gnyen po'i dbang du byas nas phyi ma bzhag pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ sred pa skye ba'i gnyen po'i phyir// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ dang po gsum gyis/ bdag gi bar 'dzin pa re zhig zhi bar byed/ bzhi pas de dang bdag tu 'dzin pa gnyis ka gtan du zhi bar byed pa'i sgo nas byang chub sgrub pa'i rgyu byed de/ bdag gir bdag 'dzin dngos 'dod pa// de yi dus dang gtan zhi'i phyir// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ zag med kyi ye shes 'byung rung gi sems rgyud kyi nus pa la 'dod/ rgyal po sras kyis/ mdo sde pa dag gi rigs zhes bya ba ni sems kyi sa bon nus pa yin te/ so so skye bo dang slob pa'i gnas skabs na yang yongs su nyams pa'i chos can gyi sa bon la rigs shes bya'o// zhes so// gsum pa la/ phyogs glang dang*/ thogs med kyi bzhed tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu dus kyi brtse ba dang shes rab kyis bsdus pa'i dge rtsa la rigs su 'dod de/

(429) don bsdu las/ 'di ltar rnam shes rang bzhin rigs// brtse dang shes rab bdag nyid yin// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ ngo bo/ rnam grangs/ rigs chad 'dod tshul/ ma nges pa theg chen lam du 'jug pa'i sa mtshams dang lnga/ dang po ni/ kun gzhi'i steng gi zag med kyi ye shes 'byung rung gi nus pa la 'dod de/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rigs de ni thog ma med pa nas 'ongs ba/ chos nyid kyis thob pa'i skye mched drug gi khyad par gang yin pa ste/ ces pa'i don 'chad pa na/ byang sa'i 'grel pa rgya mtsho sprin las/ skye mched drug gi khyad par ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes la gnas pa'i sa bon zag pa med pa'i chos bskyed par byed pa'i nus pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ skye mched drug gi khyad par/ zag pa med pa'i sa bon/ sgrib pa spang rung*/ thos pa'i bag chags rnams su bshad/ de la skye mched drug gi khyad par zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod do// (430) skye mched drug la btags pa'i theg pa gsum gyi/ gang zag rnams rigs can so sor 'byed par byed pa'i phyir/ zag pa med pa'i sa bon zhes bya ste/ zag med kyi ye shes skyed pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ sgrib pa spang rung zhes bya ste/ lam gyi rkyen dang phrad pa na/ dri ma dang bral nas ye shes skye rung gi nus pa gnas pa'i phyir/ thos pa'i bag chags zhes bya ste/ gsung rab thos pa'i rkyen gyis goms par byas pa'i phyir/ de la thos pa'i bag chags chung 'bring chen po gsum yod de/ theg bsdus las/ thos pa'i bag chags chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po gang yin pa de yang chos kyi sku'i sa bon no// dang po ni/ dbang brtul gyi rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med tsam thos pa'i/ gnyis pa ni/ dbang 'bring gi rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med tsam thos pa'i/ gsum pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i rgyud kyi shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod thos pa'i rkyen gyis gso bar byed pa'i sa bon lta bu/

(431) chos sku'i sa bon du bshad pa 'di nyid yin no// gsum pa la/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis/ dang po ni/ thog ma med pa nas sems rgyud la gnas pa'i zag med kyi ye shes 'byung rung gi nus pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon smon lam la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas sems rgyud la bzhag pa'i zag med kyi ye shes 'byung rung gi nus pa la 'dod de/ byang sa las/ de la rigs gang zhe na/ mdor na rnam pa gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyi gnas pa dang*/ yang dag par bsgrubs pa'o// de la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i rigs ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi skye mched drug gi khyad par gang yin pa ste/ de ni gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de/ 'ongs pa thog ma med pa'i dus can chos nyid kyis thob pa de lta bu yin no// de la yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i rigs ni/ sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba goms par (432) byas pa las thob pa gang yin pa ste/ zhes so// bzhi pa la/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs chad pa dang*/ rang bzhin gnas rigs chad pa gnyis su yod la/ dang po ni/ rgyan las/ la la thar pa cha mthun dge ba med// ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dkar po dman pa yod pa rgyu dang bral// zhes pas bstan/ 'grel par/ gtan yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i chos can ni rgyu dang bral ba ste/ gang la yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i rigs nyid med pa'o// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ theg dman nges pa'i rigs can/ theg dman gyi tshogs lam thob nas theg chen lam du mi 'jug ste/ mthar thug theg dman gyi theg pa grub par 'dod pa'i phyir/ ma nges pa'i rigs can ni lhag bcas myang 'das thob nas kyang 'jug pa yod la/ lhag med myang 'das thob nas 'jug pa med de/ der 'dus byas kyi 'jug pa rgyun chad pas byang chub sgrub pa'i 'bad rtsol med pa'i phyir/ bsdu ba las/ nyan (433) thos byang chub tu 'gyur ba ci/ phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa dang lhag ma med pa'i dbyings gang la sangs rgyas bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub ce na/

lhag bcas la gnas te sgrub bo// lhag med ni brtson pa thams cad dang bral zhing 'bad pa thams cad rgyun chad pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad dang gsum/ dang po la/ kha cig dri ma dang bcas pa'i shes pa'i chos nyid sangs rgyas kyi rigs ma yin te/ rigs la sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yin pa cig dgos la/ rgyu la 'dus byas kyi khyab pa'i phyir/ zer ba mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin na/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin dgos par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rigs can ma yin par thal lo// gzhan yang*/ sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang (434) bzhin dang*// zhes sogs kyis gnod do// kha cig sangs rgyas kyi rigs dang*/ bde gshegs snying po don gcig ste// rgyud blar/ rigs yod phyir na lus can kun// rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ bde gshegs snying por thal/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bde gshegs snying po'i steng gi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa'i dge rtsa ma yin par thal lo// khyab ste/ rab dbye las/ kha cig bde gshegs snying po'i sgra// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po'i don// 'di ni bde gshegs snying po'i khams// sbyong byed yin gyi khams dngos min// zhes so// kha cig de dang rang bzhin gnas rigs don gcig tu 'dod pa la/ ngo bo nyid sku rang bzhin gnas rigs su thal ba'i skyon gnas so// rang lugs/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi yid kyi rnam par shes pa gsal rig de'i chos nyid/ byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pas zin pa'i dge (435) rtsa rnams mtshan gzhi yin no// gnyis pa la/ kha cig dri med du gnas gyur pa na 'bras bu chos skur 'gyur rung dang*/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gang rung gis bsdus pa'i sems chos zer/

dang po la/ rgyun mtha'i byang sems chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ rang 'bras chos sku'i dngos kyi nyer len yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i 'gog bden chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ dri med du gnas gyur pa na rang don chos skur 'gyur nges kyi dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang bzhin gnas rigs su thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam bsgom stobs kyis gsar du thob pa ma yin par thal lo// rang lugs/ dngos btags ma phye ba'i rgyur gyur gyi dge ba (436) gang zhig dri med du gnas gyur pa na rang don chos skur 'gyur rung*/ kho na re/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i shes pa'i chos nyid chos can/ mtshan nyid kyi zur dang po der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dge bar thal/ rgyur gyur gyi dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/ mtshan nyid kyi zur dang po der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ dngos btags phye ba'i dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ dge ba mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ dang po la/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid chos can/ dge bar thal/ don dam pa'i dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sa gnyis pa'i mos pa sgom lam chos can/ zag bcas sgom lam ma yin par thal/ zag bcas ma yin pa'i sgom lam yin pa'i phyir te/ zag bcas ma yin pa dang sgom lam gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rim bzhin khas/ yang na (437) rtsod dor/ gang gi sgo nas rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi rigs su bzhag du rung ba'i rang 'bras bla med byang chub kyi rgyur gyur pa'i sems chos/ gsum pa ni/ yon tan sgrol ba'i don gyis na rigs zhes bya ste/ de'i skad dod du/ gu na ta ra zhes 'byung la/ de yang yon tan sgrol ba la 'jug pa'i don can yin pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/

rang bzhin dang ni rgyas pa dang*// de ni rten dang brten pa dang*// yod med nyid dang yon tan ni// sgrol ba'i don du shes par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ mtshan gzhi'i theg pa'i/ byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ bde gshegs snying po'i dbye ba bye brag tu bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ mkhas pa snga ma'i lugs brjod pa dang*/ rang lugs bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po (438) la/ chos dbyings tsam la 'dod tshul/ gsal rig tsam la 'dod tshul/ gnyis ka la 'dod tshul lo// dang po ni/ snga rabs pa kha cig rang bzhin gnas rigs ni chos nyid kho na yin te/ rtsa bar/ sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*// zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kho na la rig zhes bstan to// zhes dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyu'i ngo bo rnam par 'jog pa'i sgo nas rigs nyid du tha snyad 'dogs so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ gnyis pa ni/ mkha' reg pa byang gzhon na re/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i shes pa'i chos nyid sangs rgyas kyi rigs ma yin te/ gal te yin na/ bum pa'i chos nyid kyang sangs rgyas kyi rigs su thal/ de gang zhig chos nyid la rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ des na dri bcas kyi sems gsal rig kho na rang bzhin gnas rigs yin zer/ gsum pa ni/ gsang

(439) phu ba blo gros mtshungs med na re/ de gnyis ka rang bzhin gnas rigs yin/ de yang dri bcas kyi sems rig cing gsal tsam rang bzhin yin te/ de sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi nye bar len pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir te/ sa ra has/ sems nyid gcig po kun gyi sa bon te// ga la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer/ ṭī ka mdzad pa yang de bzhin du bzhed cing dri bcas kyi sems rig cing gsal tsam rang bzhin gnas rigs yin te/ lung dang rig pa gnyis kyis grub pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ rgyud blar/ rig khams sbrang rtsi dang 'dra 'di gzigs nas// zhes dang*/ rgyas bshad du/ lus can la yod zag pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra'o// zhes dang*/ bstod tshogs las/ bde legs sems la sangs rgyas 'byung*// rang sems de la (440) phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ nyon mongs nang nas ye shes kyang*// de bzhin dri ma med par gnas// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ de chos can/ rang bzhin gnas rigs yin te/ rang gi rigs 'dra thog ma med pa nas gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ de la rtsod pa spang ba la/ lung dang*/ rigs pa dang 'gal ba spangs pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dus byas rang bzhin gnas rigs yod pa la lung gis gnod de/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kho na la rigs zhes bstan to// zhes dang*/ nyi snang las/ gzhan dag ni rigs ni skye mched drug gi khyad par yin no// de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rgyun gyis yang dag par blangs pa dang*/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'o zhes zer ro// de dag gis ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs la rang bzhin du gnas pa'i don brjod dgos so// rgyu'i rnam grangs yin no zhe na/ rkyen gyis yang dag par blangs pa yang de yin pa nges na don gyi khyad par ci yod/ (441)

ces sems tsam pas 'dus byas rang bzhin gnas rigs khas blangs pa la skyon brjod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de chos can/ rang bzhin gnas rigs ma yin par thal/ khyod la rang bzhin du gnas pa'i don ma tshang ba'i phyir te/ rgyu rkyen gyi bcos ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rtsa sher las/ rang bzhin dang ni bcos min dang*// gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin// zhes so// de chos can/ dri med du gnas gyur pa na ngo bo nyid skur 'gyur rung du thal/ rang bzhin gnas rigs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rgyud blar/ rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi// sku gsum mthong bar 'dod pa yin// dang pos sku ni dang po ste// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dri bral gyi sems ngo bo nyid skur 'gyur ro// rgyun mtha' la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi yid kyi rnam par shes pa gsal rig chos can/ rang bzhin gnas rigs ma yin par thal/ (442) rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir ro// bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ theg chen gyi sgom lam mtha' dag rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam yang de yin/ zag med sgom lam yang de yin/ de gnyis ma rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam med pa'i phyir zer/ lung dang pos mi gnod de/ 'dus byas kho na la rigs su 'dod pa'i dngos smra ba dang*/ chos dbyings la yang rigs su 'dod pa'i dbu ma pa gnyis kyi nang nas lugs phyi ma 'di kho na 'thad zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ lung gnyis pa'i don/ sems tsam pas 'dod pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs chos can/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i don ma tshang bar thal/ rang gi rigs 'dra sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i rigs ma yin pa'i phyir/ gal te de'i don tshang ste/ byang chub kyi rgyu byed pa'i rigs yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ rgyas (443) 'gyur gyi rigs yang der 'gyur bas/ de gnyis la khyad par med par 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i don yin no// rigs pa dang po la/

dri bcas kyi sems rig cing gsal tsam chos can/ khyod kyi rigs 'dra thog ma nas gnas pa ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi rigs 'dra la de'i don ma tshang ba'i phyir te/ de rkyen gyis gsar du blangs pa las byung ba'i phyir te/ de 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ des na sems gsal rig la rang bzhin du gnas pa'i don tshang ste/ byang chub kyi rgyu byed nus kyi gsal rig tsam gyi ngo bo rkyen gyis gzhan du bsgyur bar mi nus pa'i phyir te/ chags sogs dri mas sems nyon mongs can du byas pa'i tshe byang chub kyi rgyu byed nus kyi gsal rig gi ngo bo 'dor ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ dper na 'jig rten na tsha ba me'i rang bzhin du brjod pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs chos can/ dri med du gnas gyur pa na/ (444) gzhan don gzugs skur 'gyur rung du thal/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dri ma dang bral ba'i dge ba gzugs skur 'gyur ro// gsum pa la/ rgyun mtha'i byang sems kyi yid kyi rnam par shes pa rigs gsal chos can/ rang gi rigs 'dra thog med nas gnas pa'i rigs ma yin par thal/ rang gi rigs 'dra rkyen gyis gsar du blangs pa'i rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ theg chen gyi sgom lam mtha' dag de yin pa'i phyir/ zag bcas sgom lam yang de yin/ zag med sgom lam yang de yin/ de gnyis ma rtogs pa theg chen gyi sgom lam med pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rnams rim bzhin khas/ gnyis pa rang lugs la/ ṭī ka ltar 'thad cing*/ de yang sems can gyi rgyud kyi sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi chos dbyings (445) la rang bzhin gnas rigs/ khams bde gshegs snying po rgyu dus kyi bde gshegs snying por 'jog la/ de la chos can gsal rig gi ldog pa nas rigs su bshad tshul dang*/

chos nyid stong pa nyid kyi ldog pa nas rigs su bshad tshul dang*/ zung 'jug chos dbyings kyi ldog pa nas rigs su bshad tshul gsum yod de/ de yang*/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi chos dbyings/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po/ kun gzhi'i ye shes rnams ming gi rnam grangs yin zhing*/ de dag la/ gzhi dus kyi/ lam dus/ 'bras dus gsum gsum yod de/ de ltar yang rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ sa rnams sna tshogs kun gzhi ste// bde gshegs snying po dge ba'ang de// snying po de la kun gzhi'i sgras// de bzhin gshegs pas ston par mdzad// snying po kun gzhir bstan pa yang*// blo chung rnams kyis mi shes so// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// de bzhin (446) gshegs pa'i snying po dge /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// dang po/ chos can gsal rig ldog pa nas rang bzhin gnas rigs su bshad tshul ni/ rgyud bla dang*/ sa ra ha dang*/ bstod tshogs su sngar bshad pa ltar ro// gnyis pa/ sems gsal rig gi chos nyid kyi ldog pa nas rang bzhin gnas rigs su bshad tshul ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo las/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don ni tshig gi don med pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub la ni skye ba'am/ yod pa nyid dam/ med pa nyid dmigs pa ma yin no// dper na/ nam mkha' la bya'i rjes med cing mi dmigs so// zhes dang*/ dkon brtsegs las/ gang la 'du byed cung zad kyang med pa de ni 'dus ma byas pa yin la/ 'dus ma byas pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'phags pa rnams kyi rigs yin te/ rigs de ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pas khyad par med pa'o// zhes so// gsum pa/ zung 'jug chos dbyings kyi ldog pa nas rang (447) bzhin gnas rigs su bshad tshul ni/ phal chen nas/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i rigs zhes bya ba ni chos kyi dbyings lhur len pa nam mkha' ltar yangs pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ste/

zhes so// rje btsun gyis/ sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa la/ kha cig dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos nyid gang zhig dri med du gnas gyur pa na ngo bo nyid skur 'gyur rung dang*/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i shes pa'i chos nyid gang zhig der 'gyur rung dang*/ thog ma med pa nas rgyun ma chad par yod pa'i chos can dang*/ chos nyid gang rung gis bsdus pa gang zhig dri ma dang bral ba'i tshe rang don chos skur 'gyur rung zer/ stong nyid yin na/ sems kyi chos nyid yin dgos par thal/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems byung bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos nyid yin (448) pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ rang bzhin gnas rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i chos nyid chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ khyod yod pa gang zhig khyod yod na khyod de yin dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ theg chen 'phags pa'i 'gog bden la dag pa gnyis ldan gyi stong nyid bcu drug du bshad pa mi 'thad pa thal/ 'dod na/ lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so// zhes sogs rtsa 'grel dang 'gal lo// gsum pa la'ang skyon snga ma de nyid 'jug go /rang lugs la/ rang gi rigs 'dra thog med nas gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs gang zhig dri med du gnas gyur pa na rang don chos skur 'gyur rung*/ rgyud blar/ gter dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin du// rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste// thog med rang bzhin gnas pa dang*// yang dag blangs pa mchog nyid do// zhes pa (449) ltar ro// dbye na/ mtshan gzhi dang*/ byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la 'dus byas rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ 'dus ma byas rang bzhin gnas rigs gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/

rang bzhin gnas rigs gang zhig dri med du gnas gyur pa na rtogs ye chos skur 'gyur rung*/ mtshan gzhi/ tshogs brgyad kyi nang nas dbang shes la mi 'jog ste/ de ni gzugs med khams la sogs par rig 'dra rgyun chad pa'i phyir/ nyon yid dang kun gzhi la mi 'jog ste/ de dag ni rnam mkhyen thob pa'i tshe/ rigs 'dra rgyun chad pa'i tshul gyis spang dgos pa'i phyir/ des na dri bcas kyi yid kyi rnam par shes pa gsal rig tsam la 'jog ste/ rigs 'dra sems can thams cad la khyab pa dang*/ mthar thug rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu byed nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin gnas rigs gang zhig dri med du gnas gyur pa na ngo bo nyid skur gyur rung*/ mtshan gzhi (450) dri ma dang bcas pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid lta bu/ gnyis pa la/ bsgrub pa'i rten byed pa dang*/ mi byed pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs gnyis dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin gnas rigs gang zhig rang gi rten chos sgrub pa'i rten gzhi byed pa/ dbye na/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg dman slob pa'i rgyud kyi sems kyi chos nyid lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen slob pa'i rgyud kyi sems kyi chos nyid lta bu/ 'dir bstan gyi sgrub pa bcu gsum gyi rten byed pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs bcu gsum yod/ gnyis pa ni/ lam ma zhugs kyi dri bcas sems kyi chos nyid lta bu/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi rigs 'dra rkyen gyis gsar du blangs pa las byung ba'i dge rtsa gang zhig dri med du gnas gyur pa na rtogs ye chos skur 'gyur rung*/ dbye na/ lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i (451) rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen slob pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pas zin pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi dge rtsa lta bu/

gnyis pa la/ so so'i rang bzhin dang 'gal mi 'gal la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ theg chen gyi rigs dang*/ theg dman gyi rigs gnyis/ mtshan nyid la/ kha cig sangs rgyas kyi rigs gang zhig theg chen dang*/ theg dman gyi rgyud la ldan pa/ zer na/ dang po la/ dang po nyid nas theg chen du rigs nges pa'i stobs kyis theg chen tshogs lam du dngos su 'jug kha ma'i rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rig chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi nges pa'i rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi dri ma dang bcas pa'i shes pa'i chos nyid chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ (452) mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la theg chen gyi rigs yod par 'gyur ro// kha cig sangs rgyas kyi rigs gang zhig gzhan don du rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi dang*/ rang don du theg dman gyi byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pa dang ldan pa/ zer na/ theg chen gyi lam du dngos su 'jug kha ma'i nyan thos med par thal/ gzhan don du rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi nyan thos med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de'i rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi ma nges/ gnyis pa yang*/ theg dman gyi lam du dngos su 'jug kha ma'i byang sems so skye med par thal/ rang don du theg dman gyi byang chub don gnyer gyi byang sems so skye med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de'i rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs kyis ma nges/ rang lugs la/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs gang zhig rang gang la ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag theg chen gyi rigs can du mtshon par byed nus kyi sems chos/ dbye na/ theg (453) chen gyi lam thob pa dang*/ ma thob pa'i theg chen gyi rigs gnyis/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag theg dman gyi rigs can du mtshon par byed nus kyi sems chos/ dbye na/ theg dman gyi lam thob pa dang*/

ma thob pa'i theg dman gyi rigs gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig de gnyis mi 'gal te/ nyan thos tshogs lam pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs de theg chen gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ mthar thug la ltos te theg chen gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ mthar thug bla med byang chub kyi rgyu byed nges yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis mi 'gal bar thal/ theg dman gyi rgyud la theg chen gyi rigs yod pa'i phyir te/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyang rang bzhin gnas rigs de theg chen gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ de yin par thal/ theg pa che chung gang (454) rung gi rigs yin pa gang zhig phyi ma ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ dang po la gnas skabs theg dman du rigs nges pa'i nyan thos tshogs lam pa chos can/ theg chen du rigs nges pa'i gang zag du thal/ mthar thug de'i phyir te/ mthar thug bla med byang chub mngon du byed nges kyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rnams khas/ de'i rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs chos can/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs su thal/ theg chen gyi rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ sgrub pa'i rten byed pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa med par 'dzin pa'i phyi rol pas/ theg pa che chung gang rung gi byang chub don du gnyer ba yod par thal/ de theg pa che chung gang rung gi rigs can yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud kyi rang bzhin gnas rigs de de

(455) gang rung gi rigs yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ de gnyis 'thad de/ theg pa che chung gi gang zag gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ nges pa'i rigs dang*/ ma nges pa'i rigs gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ thog ma nyid nas rang gi thob bya byang chub kyi rgyur nges pa'i stobs kyis gnas skabs su/ rkyen gyis lam gzhan du bkrir mi thub pa'i rigs/ dbye na/ theg dman du nges pa'i rigs dang*/ theg chen du nges pa'i rigs gnyis/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs gang zhig dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis gnas skabs lam gzhan du bkrir rung ba/ dbye na/ theg chen dang*/ theg dman gyi ma nges pa'i rigs gnyis/ rgyan las/ rigs ci nges dang ma nges dang*// rkyen rnams kyis ni mi 'phrogs dang*// 'phrogs pa nyid de mdor na rigs// dbye ba 'di (456) ni rnam pa bzhi// zhes so// bzhi pa la/ ming tsam mthun pa'i sgo nas dbye ba dang*/ mtshon byed dpe'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la gzhi dus kyi/ rgyu dus kyi/ 'bras dus kyi bde gshegs snying po dang gsum/ dang po ni/ brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa'i snang stong zung 'jug gi chos dbyings lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi gsal stong zung 'jug gi chos dbyings lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings mthar thug lta bu/ de yang dang po la mtshan btags gnyis ka yod/ phyi ma gnyis mtshan nyid pa yin no// gnyis pa la/ rtsa ba'i sgo nas chos sku/ de bzhin nyid/ rigs gsum ste/ rgyud blar/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*// de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*// rigs yod phyir na lus can kun// rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes so// yan lag gi sgo nas/ dang po la/ chos dbyings shin tu dri (457) ma med pa'i/ zab pa'i/ rgya che ba'i chos sku dang gsum/ gsum pa la/

ngo bo'i sgo nas rigs gnyis/ nus pa'i sgo nas sku gsum ste lnga yod de/ rgyud blar/ 'di yi rang bzhin chos sku dang*// de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyang ste// de ni dpe gsum gcig dang ni// lnga rnams kyis ni shes par bya// zhes dang*/ chos sku'i rgyas bshad du/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste// chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang*// de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang*// sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa'o// zhes dang*/ rigs kyi rgyas bshad du/ gter dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin du// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dag mtshon par byed pa'i dpe de la yang dgu yod cing*/ dang po gsum mtshon pa'i dpe ni/ pad+ma'i nang na yod pa'i sangs rgyas/ sbrang ma la yod pa'i sbrang rtsi/ spun pa la yod pa'i snying po/ mi gtsang ba'i nang na yod pa'i gser ni/ de bzhin nyid kyi dpe/ phyi ma (458) lnga'i dpe ni/ sa 'og gi gter/ ljon shing skyed pa'i 'bras bu ni/ rigs gnyis kyi dpe/ gos hrul gyi nang na yod pa'i sku gzugs/ bud med ngan ma'i lto ba na yod pa'i 'khor los bsgyur rgyal/ sa 'dam gyi nang na yod pa'i sku gzugs ni/ sku gsum gyi dpe yin te/ rgyud blar/ sangs rgyas pad nang sbrang rtsi'i sbrang ma la// spun la snying po mi gtsang nang na gser// sa la gter dang myug sogs 'bras chung dang*// gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni// bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang*// sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta ba// glo bur nyon mongs dri mas bsgribs pa yis// sems can rnams la de bzhin khams 'di gnas// zhes so// gsum pa la/ rigs sad tshul dang*/ rigs su 'gyur tshul gnyis/ dang po la rigs sad pa'i rtags/ de'i gegs/ de'i phan yon dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lam la sbyor ba'i sngon du bsam pa'i yon tan rang bzhin gyi snying rje (459) che ba/ theg chen gyi chos la mos pa/ sbyor ba'i yon tan chos sgrub pa'i dka' spyad la sran bzod pa/

sbyin sogs kyi dge ba yang dag par spyod pa ste/ rgyan las/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang*// mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang*// dge ba yang dag spyod pa ni// rigs kyi rtags su nges par bshad// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ nyon mongs pa shas chen goms pa/ grogs ngan pa dang 'grogs pa/ chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen gyis 'phongs pa/ mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pa ste/ rgyan las/ nyon mongs goms dang grogs ngan dang*// 'phongs dang gzhan gyi dbang nyid dang*// 'dor na rigs kyi nyes dmigs ni// rnam pa bzhir ni shes par bya// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ theg chen gyi rigs ni shing gi rtsa ba bzang po lta bu yin te/ de la sdong po/ lo 'dab/ 'bras bu gsum 'byung ba bzhin du/ de las kyang byang chub (460) kyi shing*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i lo 'dab/ bdag gzhan phan bde sgrub pa'i 'bras bu gsum 'byung ba'i phyir ro// rgyan las/ yon tan shin tu rgya che byang chub shing bskyed phyir// bde dang sdug bsngal chen po zhi ba thob bya'i phyir// bdag dang gzhan la phan bde byed pa 'bras bu'i phyir// rigs mchog de ni rtsa ba bzang po lta bu yin// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ rten gyi sgo nas/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas rigs su 'gyur tshul lo// dang po ni/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i shes pa'i chos nyid rten gyi sgo nas rigs su 'gyur te/ theg chen gyis sgrub pas chos nyid la brten nas dri ma rnams rim gyis sbyangs te/ bla med byang chub bsgrub par byed pa'i phyir/ dpe ji ltar na 'khor ba'i phung khams skye mched ni las nyon la brten/ de tshul min yid byed kyi rnam rtog la brten/ de sems 'od gsal gyi chos dbyings la brten pa ltar/ theg chen sgrub (461) pa byang sems la brten/ de nang gi skye mched la brten/ skye mched dang po lnga yid kyi skye mched la brten/

de sems kyi chos nyid la brten pa yin te/ rgyud blar/ de bzhin phung po khams dbang rnams// las dang nyon mongs dag la gnas// las dang nyon mongs tshul bzhin min// yid la byed pa rtag tu gnas// tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni// sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas// sems kyi rang bzhin chos rnams ni// thams cad la yang gnas pa med// ces dang*/ rtsa bar/ 'jug pa'i rten la rigs shes bya// zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ sgrub pa'i chos kyi gnas skabs tha dad pa'i bye brag gis byang chub sems pa'i rnam pa bcu gsum po ji skad du bshad pa'i chos kyi gzhir gyur pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kho na la rigs zhes bstan to// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas rigs su 'gyur te/ theg chen gyi sgrub pas chos (462) dbyings la dmigs shing goms par byas pa la brten nas dri ma rnams rim gyis sbyangs nas dri ma dang bcas pa'i shes pa'i chos dbyings de mthar dag pa gnyis ldan gyi rang don chos skur 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ji ltar nyan thos kyi theg pa la sogs pa'i rtogs pa'i rim gyi dmigs pa de bzhin du/ 'phags pa'i chos rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings rgyu'i ngo bor rnam par 'jog pa'i sgo nas rigs nyid du tha snyad 'dogs so// zhes pa'i don to// gnyis pa ni/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi dri ma dang bcas pa'i shes pa'i chos dbyings chos can/ sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs yin te/ rang gi brten pa theg chen sgrub pa'i rten gzhir gyur pa'i dri ma dang bcas pa'i shes pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de'i 'og tu bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ grangs nges kyi rnam bzhag spyir bstan pa/ dgongs ldem (463) dgongs bye brag tu bshad pa/ gdul bya bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ grangs nges ngos bzung ba/

grangs nges kyi dbye ba/ mtshan nyid bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa la drang don zhes bya ste/ gdul bya nges don rtogs pa la kha drang pa'i phyir du 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du gsungs pa'i phyir/ rab tu sgron gsal las/ skal med rnams la rgyal ba yis// sbas te gsungs pa drang ba'i don// zhes dang*/ rtsa sher las/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par// dam pa'i don ni bstan mi nus// zhes so// don dam bden pa la nges don zhes bya ste/ yul gyi gnas lugs mthar thug du nges pas de las gong du rtogs bya gzhan med pa'i phyir/ sgron gsal las/ yang dag de ni rab ston phyir// nges pa'i don yang brjod par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ brjod byed kyi/ brjod bya'i/ gdul bya'i/ grub mtha'i dbang (464) du byas pa'i grangs nges dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rang gi brjod bya sgra ji bzhin par khas blangs du mi rung ba dang rung ba'i mdo lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ kun rdzob gtso bor ston pa'i mdo dang*/ don dam gtso bor ston pa'i mdo lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ gdul bya gang dag lam la dang*/ 'bras bu la 'jug pa'i ched du gtso bor gsungs pa'i mdo lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ sde pa rang rang gi grub mtha' dang mi mthun pa'i don gtso bor ston pa dang*/ de dang mthun pa'i don gtso bor ston pa'i mdo lta bu'o// de yang*/ chos thams cad bden stong du ston pa'i mdo ni/ sems tsam pa la drang don/ dbu ma pa la nges don gyi mdo yin pa lta bu/ de dag gi nang nas brjod bya'i dbang du byas pa grangs nges mtshan nyid pa yin la/ gzhan rnams ni btags pa ba yin te/ dkon brtsegs las/ mdo gang dag kun rdzob sgrub par byed pa de dag ni drang pa'i don zhes bya'o// mdo gang dag don dam ston pa de dag nges don zhes bya'o// zhes dang*/ zla ba (465) sgron me'i zhus pa'i mdo las/ stong pa bde bar gshegs pas bstan pa ltar// nges don mdo sde dag gi bye brag shes// zhes dang*/

gang la sems can gang zag skyes bu bstan// chos de thams cad drang ba'i don du shes// zhes so// gsum pa la/ kha cig rang gi brjod bya sgra ji bzhin du khas blang du mi rung ba'i mdo dang*/ rung ba'i mdo/ zer na/ gzugs mi rtag par dngos su ston pa'i mdo chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ kun rdzob bden pa gtso bor dngos su ston pa'i mdo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yang des khegs/ kha cig kun rdzob bden pa tshig zin la ston pa'i mdo dang*/ don dam bden pa tshig zin la ston pa'i mdo/ zer na/ dang po la/ bdag yod par ston pa'i mdo dang*/ gnyis pa la/ gzugs stong pa'o// zhes sogs sher phyin gyi mdos ma nges/ kha cig kun rdzob (466) bden pa gtso bor ston pa'i mdo dang*/ don dam bden pa gtso bor ston pa'i mdo/ zer na/ bden gnyis zung 'jug du gtso bor ston pa'i mdo chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gnyis pa'i mtshon byar thal/ mtshan nyid kyi phyir/ rtags chos can gyi grub/ rang lugs/ bden pa gnyis kyi nang nas kun rdzob bden pa rang gi zhen pa'i brjod bya'i gtso bor dngos su ston pa'i mdo/ de gnyis kyi nang nas don dam bden pa rang gi zhen pa'i brjod bya'i gtso bor dngos su ston pa'i mdo// dang po la/ dbye na/ drang don gyi drang don gyi mdo dang*/ de'i nges don gyi mdo gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang gi tshig zin gyi brjod bya sgra ji bzhin du khas blang du mi rung ba/ mtshan gzhi ni/ yongs grub rang bzhin gyis yod par gsungs pa'i mdo lta bu'o// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang gi tshig zin gyi brjod bya (467) sgra ji bzhin du khas blang du rung ba/ mtshan gzhi/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa/ dngos su ston pa'i mdo lta bu/ gnyis pa la/ dbye na/ nges don gyi drang don gyi mdo dang*/ de'i nges don gyi mdo gnyis/ mtshan nyid dang*/

mtshan gzhi snga ma las dpags te shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ dgongs pa can gyi mdo/ ldem por dgongs pa'i mdo/ de gnyis kyi khyad par bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mnyam pa nyid/ don gzhan/ dus gzhan/ gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa'i mdo dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas la brnyas pa'i gnyen por mnyam pa nyid gsum la dgongs nas/ nga nyid sangs rgyas rnam gzigs so// zhes gsungs pa'i mdo lta bu/ mnyam pa nyid gsum ni/ rgyu tshogs gnyis/ 'bras bu chos sku/ gzhan don 'phrin las mnyam pa ste/ mdzod las/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs dang ni// chos (468) sku 'gro ba'i don spyod pas// mnyam pa nyid de sku tshe dang*// rigs dang sku bong tshad kyis min// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ chos la brnyas pa'i gnyen por don gzhan la dgongs nas/ pha dang ma ni bsad bya zhing*// rgyal po gtsang sbra can gnyis dang*// yul 'khor 'khor dang bcas bcom na// mi de dag pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes so// don gang la dgongs snyam na/ pha dang ma smros pa ni/ zag bcas kyi las dang sred pa la dgongs te/ pha mas bu tsha skyed pa bzhin du de gnyis kyi 'khor ba'i snang ba sna tshogs skyed pa'i phyir/ rgyal pos/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes mtshon te/ rgyal pos mnga' 'bangs kyi rten byed pa bzhin du/ des kyang zag bcas kyi chos rnams kyi rten byed pa'i phyir/ gtsang sbra can lha dang bram ze gnyis kyis lta ba dang tshul khrims mchog 'dzin gnyis mtshon te/ mchog ma yin pa la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i phyir/ yul 'khor 'khor dang bcas pas ni/ (469) zag bcas kyi skye mched drug yul dang bcas pa mtshon te/ grong yul gyis skyes bu'i rten byed pa ltar/ skye mched kyi rnam shes kyi rten byed pa'i phyir/ las dang sred pa spang bya zhing*// sbyor ba'i rnam shes mchog 'dzin gnyis// skye mched spyod yul bcas bcom nas// mi de dag pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes pa'o// gsum pa ni/

le lo can 'ga' zhig rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du/ dus gzhan ma 'ongs pa la dgongs nas bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam tshig gcig gis der skye bar gsungs pa'i mdo lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ mchog 'dzin bzlog pa'i phyir du sbyin pa la smad nas tshul khrims kyi bsngags pa brjod pa'i lta bu/ rgyan las/ mnyam pa nyid dang don gzhan dang*// de bzhin du ni dus gzhan dang*// gang zag gi ni bsam pa la// dgongs pa rnam pa bzhir shes bya// sangs rgyas chos la brnyas pa dang*// le lo cung (470) zad mchog 'dzin dang*// nga rgyal 'dod chags spyod pa dang*// 'gyod dang ma nges ldog pa ni// sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa ste// de yi gnyen por theg mchog gsungs// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ gzhug pa/ mtshan nyid/ gnyen por/ bsgyur ba ldem por dgongs pa'i mdo dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ nyan thos pa theg chen gyi lta ba la kha drang pa'i phyir du gzugs sogs phyi'i skye mched rang bzhin gyis yod pa gsungs pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sems tsam pa dbu ma'i lta ba la kha drang pa'i phyir du yongs grub rang bzhin gyis yod par gsungs pa'i mdo lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i mdo bzhi lta bu/ bzhi pa la/ snying po med pa snying por shes// phyin ci log la legs par gnas// nyon mongs pas ni rab nyon mongs// byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur// zhes pa lta bu/ dngos su gsungs pa'i don de nyid gzhan du bsgyur nas 'chad dgos pa'i mdo lta bu/

(471) ji ltar bsgyur na/ snying po ni rnam g.yeng*/ de med pa ni lhag pa ting 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ phyin ci log ni rtag sogs su 'dzin pa las/ phyin ci log mi rtag pa la sogs pa rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa/ nyon mongs pas ni dka' spyad de/ des rab tu nyon mongs pa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'o// des na/ bslab pa gsum la gnas nas byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur/ zhes pa'i don du bsgyur ro// rgyan las/ gzhug pa ldem por dgongs pa dang*// mtshan nyid ldem por dgongs pa dang*// gnyen por ldem por dgongs pa dang*// bsgyur ba ldem por dgongs pa ste// nyan thos dang ni ngo bo nyid// de bzhin nyes pa 'dul ba dang*// brjod pa zab pa nyid la ni// ldem por dgongs pa 'di rnam bzhi// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ dgongs gzhi don gzhan la dgongs nas gtso bor gsungs pa'i drang (472) don gyi mdo ni/ dgongs pa can gyi mdo yin la/ dgongs pa khyad par can 'ga' zhig gi ched du/ gtso bor gsungs pa'i drang don gyi mdo ni ldem dgongs kyi mdo yin zhing*/ de gnyis 'gal ba ma yin te/ dgongs pa can gyi mdo bzhi ka yang gnyen po ldem por dgongs pa'i khongs su 'dus pa'i phyir/ mdo thams cad brgyad po 'dis bsdus pa'ang ma yin te/ 'di dag drang don gyi mdo tsam gyis dbang du byas nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ ston pa bzhi'i sgo nas gdul bya rnams bstan pa la 'jug ste/ dang por/ gang zag la mi ston chos la ston/ chos la yang*/ tshig la mi ston don la ston/ don la yang*/ drang don la mi ston nges don la ston/ yul can la yang*/ rnam shes la mi ston ye shes la ston pa'i tshul gyis 'jug gnyis pa ni/ sa bcu pa'i ye shes chos can/ gzhan don go rim du byed pa'i sgrub (473) pa yin te/ dgongs ldem dgongs brgyad kyi sgo nas gdul bya rnams theg pa gsum gyi lam la 'god par byed pa'i sa bcu pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de// zhes pa'i skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ go rim dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ theg chen sgrub pas sgro 'dogs bcad par bya ba'i gzhir gyur pa'o// gnyis pa la/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos zag bcas dang zag med/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan te/ bcu gcig gsum pa la/ spyir bstan gsum/ bye brag tu bshad pa brgyad/ dang po la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid mi 'thad pa dang*/ mtshan (474) gzhi mi 'thad pa dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig rnam par dka' ba'i ngo bor lung du bstan pa dang*/ rnam par gnag pa'i ngo bor lung du bstan pa dang*/ dkar nag gang du yang lung du bstan du med pa'i chos/ zer na/ dang po la/ ngo bo nyid sku chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ rnam dkar gyi yon tan mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang 'bras yid du 'ong ba 'byin pa'i rigs gnas su 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la/ khong khros kun nas bslangs pa'i srog gcod pa'i lus kyi rig byed chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzugs can ma yin par 'gyur ro// gsum pa la/ ngo bo nyid sku chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig skyes bu dam pas bsngags par 'os pa/ des smad par bya ba dang*/ des btang snyoms su bzhag par bya ba zer na (475) sngar bshad pa des khegs so// kha cig lung du bstan pa gang zhig rang 'bras bde ba skyed byed/ de gang zhig rang 'bras sdug bsngal skyed byed/ rang 'bras bde sdug gang yang skyed par mi nus pa'i chos zer na/ dang po la/ gzugs med khams su 'thon par byed pa'i dge ba chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/

gzugs med kyi sas bsdus kyi tshor ba bde ba yod par 'gyur/ gnyis pa la/ rang nyid skad cig gnyis par gnyen po stobs ldan gyis 'joms par nges pa'i mi dge bas ma nges/ gsum pa la/ tshor ba bde ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi mig gi rnam par shes pa'i dngos rgyur gyur pa'i dbang po gzugs can pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ rang 'bras tshor ba bde ba skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig dge (476) mi dge dang bem po'i gzhi mthun yod de/ lus de dag gi dge ba dang mi dge ba bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na/ dge ba yin na/ yid kyi dge ba yin dgos par thal/ de yin na shes pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zer na/ so thar gyi sdom pa gzugs can du bshad pa de sgra ji bzhin du khas len rigs par thal/ dge ba dang bem po'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin yin na/ shes pa yin pas ma khyab par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi sdom pa dang bem po'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa la// tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad// zhes pa dang 'gal/ sdig pa dang gzugs can gyi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ mi dge ba dang de'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam 'grel las/ lus can min phyir sdig lci min// zhes pa dang 'gal/ gzhan yang*/ mdo (477) las/ gang gzugs bde ba dang mi dge bar smra ba de ni/ shākya'i bu ma yin/ shākya'i sras ma yin/ zhes bshad pa mi 'thad par 'gyur ro// kha cig lung ma bstan yin na/ las yin dgos te/ rab dbye las/ las la dge sdig lung ma bstan// yin zhes rgyal bas mdo las gsungs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ chos thams cad dge sogs gsum gyis bsdus pa ma yin par thal/ bem po dang 'dus ma byas lung ma bstan ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de// de yang dge la sogs pa yin// zhes pa dang 'gal/

rang lugs/ dge ba la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ lung du bstan pa gang zhig rang gi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yid du 'ong ba 'byin pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i rnam dkar gyi las/ gnyis pa la/ ming tsam mthun pa'i sgo nas dbye ba dang*/ (478) sgo gsum gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo nyid kyi/ mtshungs ldan gyi/ kun slong gi don dam pa'i dge ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ dad sogs dge ba bcu gcig lta bu yin te/ mtshungs ldan grogs kyi dbang gis dge bar skyes pa tsam ma yin par/ rang gi ngang gi dge ba'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dad pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i gtso bo sems dang*/ kun 'gro lnga lta bu ste/ mtshungs ldan grogs kyi stobs kyi dge ba'i ngo bo skyes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ de dag gis kun nas bslangs ba'i lus ngag gi rig byed lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid lta bu/ de yang dang po gnyis ni/ dge ba mtshan nyid pa yin la/ phyi ma gnyis btags pa ba yin te/ dge ba'i 'bras bu dang*/ de'i dmigs pa la de'i ming gis btags nas bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ lus kyi/ ngag gi yid kyi dge ba dang gsum/ (479) dang po ni/ lus kyi mi dge ba'i 'gal zlar gyur pa'i lus kyi rig byed dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i dge ba lta bu/ dbye na/ srog gcod spong ba'i/ ma byin len spong ba'i/ log g.yem spong ba'i dge ba dang gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ ngag gi mi dge ba'i 'gal zlar gyur pa'i ngag gi rig byed dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i dge ba lta bu/ dbye na/ bden par smra ba/ mthun par smra ba/ snyan pa smra ba/ nyon mongs pa med par smra ba'i rig byed dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i dge ba dang bzhi/ gsum pa ni/ yid dge ba la g.yo bar byed pa'i sems pa'i las lta bu/ dbye na/ brnab sems med pa'i sems byung*/ gnod sems med pa'i/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang gsum/

mi dge ba la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ lung du bstan pa gang zhig rang gi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yid du mi 'ong ba 'byin pa'i rigs gnas/ (480) dbye na/ ming tsam mthun pa'i/ sgo gsum gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo nyid kyi/ mtshungs ldan gyi/ kun slong gi don dam pa'i mi dge ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ khong khro cha rtogs dang bcas pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ khong khro dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi rig byed lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ 'khor ba lta bu/ dang po gnyis mtshan nyid pa/ gsum pa btags pa ba/ bzhi pa la btags pa ba dang*/ mtshan nyid pa gnyis ka yod/ gnyis pa la lus kyi/ ngag gi yid kyi mi dge ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lus kyi dge ba'i 'gal zlar gyur pa'i lus kyi rig byed dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i mi dge ba lta bu/ dbye na/ srog gcod pa/ ma byin len/ log g.yem gyi mi dge ba dang gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ ngag gi (481) dge ba'i 'gal zlar gyur pa'i ngag gi rig byed dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i mi dge ba lta bu/ dbye na/ rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i mi dge ba dang bzhi/ gsum pa ni/ yid rang gi ngang gis mi dge ba la sbyor bar byed pa'i sems pa'i las lam lta bu'o// dbye na/ brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta dang gsum/ lung ma bstan la mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dge mi dge gang rung du lung du bstan du med pa'i chos/ dbye na/ ngo bo nyid kyi/ mtshungs ldan gyi/ kun slong gi don dam pa'i lung ma bstan dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ kun gzhi dang*/ nyon yid lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ de dag dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems byung lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi rig byed lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ nam mkha' dang so sor rtags min gyi 'gog pa lta (482)

bu/ bzhi ka'ang lung ma bstan mtshan nyid pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ gzhan rnams go sla zhing zag bcas kyi mtshan nyid/ zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung gis bsdus pa/ mtshan gzhi/ 'khor ba lta bu/ zag med kyi mtshan nyid/ des ma bsdus pa/ mtshan gzhi/ 'gog bden/ lam bden/ 'dus ma byas mtha' dag go /sgo drug ni/ zag pa'i bdag nyid/ zag pas bcings pa/ zag pa dang 'brel ba/ zag pa dang rjes su 'brel ba/ zag pa dang rjes su mthun pa/ zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ theg chen du rigs sad pa'i gang zag gis dmigs pa nyams su len pa la 'jug pa'i dbang du byas nas dmigs pa bcu gcig gi go rim 'di ltar du bstan pa yin no// de yang dang por/ dge sogs gsum 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ des lam nyams su len pa'i tshe/ bdag gi blang bya ni gang*/ dor bya ni gang*/ btang snyoms su bzhag (483) bya ni gang yin snyam du spyod par byed la/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas dge ba/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas mi dge ba/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas lung ma bstan bzhag pa'i phyir/ de'i 'og tu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gnyis 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dge ba blang byar shes pa na/ dang por blang bya'i dbang du byas nas 'jig rten pa'i lam/ phyi ma blang bya'i dbang du byas nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bzhag pa'i phyir/ de'i rjes su zag bcas zag med gnyis 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyi spang bya ngo shes pa'i dbang du byas nas zag bcas/ lam rang gi ngo bo'i dbang du byas nas zag med bzhag pa'i phyir/ de'i rjes su 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam rjes thob kyis 'dus byas kun rdzob kyi bden pa rtogs par byed/ (484) mnyam bzhag gis 'dus ma byas don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs par byed pa'i phyir/ de'i 'og tu thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gnyis 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

kun rdzob kyi bden pa rtogs pa la brten nas thun mong ba'i yon tan 'byung*/ don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs pa la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan 'byung ba'i phyir/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum chos can/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin te/ de'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gzhir skyes pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sems can kun mchog nyid sems dang*// zhes skabs su gnyis kyi dang po theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ grangs nges/ go rim dang lnga/ dang po la/ kha cig theg chen sgrub pa'i thob bya mthar thug zer na/ longs sku'i dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid (485) de'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur ro// rang lugs/ theg chen sgrub pa'i thob bya mthar thug tu gyur pa'i bla na med pa'i byang chub/ dbye na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba gnyis/ gsum pa la/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen sgrub pa'i gnas skabs kyi thob byar gyur pa'i yon tan/ mtshan gzhi/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam skad cig gnyis pa nas rgyun mtha'i bar gyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan lta bu/ gnyis pa mthar thug la/ rang don chos sku dang*/ gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis/ dang po la/ sems chen po/ spong ba chen po/ rtogs pa chen po dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag sems can kun gyi nang nas mchog nyid du byed pa'i mthar (486) thug gi sems bskyed/ ming tsam mthun pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi sems chen po gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen slob pa'i sems bskyed/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i gtso sems mtha' dag go /de la dbye na/ mdo las/ rdo rje lta bu'i/ brlabs po che'i/ mi sgul ba'i/

phan bde'i/ dmigs pa med pa'i sems dang lnga bshad/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag sems can kun gyi nang nas mchog nyid du byed pa'i mthar thug gi spangs pa/ dbye na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi spangs pa chen po gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang 'phags kyi 'gog bden lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i de lta bu/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag sems can kun gyi nang nas mchog nyid du byed pa'i mthar thug gi rtogs pa/ dbye na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi rtogs pa chen po gnyis/ (487) dang po ni/ byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam mkhyen lta bu/ de la dbye na/ brgyad stong pa las/ byang chub kyi/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i/ zag pa med pa'i/ mnyam pa med pa'i/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i/ nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sems dang drug bshad/ gal te/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ khyod rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de sems can gyi nang tshan du thal/ mtshan nyid de yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ gnas skabs kyi rtogs pa chen po yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ kho rang gi dam bca' der thal/ khyod rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de sems can kun gyi nang nas mchog nyid du gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ byang chub chen

(488) por thal/ gnas skabs kyi de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de byang chub don gnyer gyi gang zag ma yin par thal lo// bzhi pa ni/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba la sems chen po la sogs pa gsum du grangs nges pa ma yin te/ gzhan don gzugs sku yang de yin pa'i phyir/ des na 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba la sems chen po la sogs pa gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ des gzhan gyi 'gran zla med par mchog nyid du byed pa/ spang bya mi mthun phyogs ma lus par bcom pa/ thob bya yon tan rdzogs par thob pa gsum du nges la/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas sems/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas spongs pa/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas rtogs pa chen por bzhag pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rgyal po g.yul du 'jug pa'i ched du bya ba ni/ 'gran zla med par rang nyid mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ mi mthun phyogs dgra (489) bo ma lus par 'joms pa dang*/ mkhar gzhis la sogs pa yul 'khor gyi khyad par thob pa gsum du nges pa bzhin no// 'grel chen las/ de ni mi pham mgon pos bstan pa dang mthun par byang chub sems dpa'i sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba rnam pa gsum bstan pa yin par shes par bya'o// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ sems chen po la sogs pa'i go rim 'di ltar 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba'i gtso bo ni gzhan don yin pas dang por sems chen po bstan/ gzhan don phun tshogs 'grub pa yang*/ sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs pa la rag las pas/ de'i 'og tu spong ba chen por bstan/ spangs pa mthar thug thob pa yang rtogs pa phun tshogs thob pa la rag las pas/ de'i 'og tu rtogs pa chen po bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sems chen po/ spong ba chen po/ rtogs pa chen po gsum chos can/ (490) theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba yin te/

theg chen sgrub pa'i thob bya mthar thug du gyur pa'i bla na med pa'i byang chub yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ sgrub pa so so la 'phros pa'i don gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar ji lta ba bzhin du/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ theg chen sgrub pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ grangs nges/ go rim nges pa/ sa mtshams dang drug dang po ni/ khyad par bzhi ldan gyi byang sems kyi nyams len/ khyad par bzhi ni/ rkyen theg pa chen por rigs sad pa dang*/ theg chen sems bskyed la gnas pa/ rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la brtson pa/ 'bras bu byang chub chen po 'byin par byed pa ste/ rgyan las/ gnas rtsom 'bras bu 'byung ba che bdag nyid// rgyal sras rnams kyi sgrub pa yin par 'dod// rtag tu len pa che dang bzod pa ste// don chen yang dag sgrub pa'i bya ba byed// ces so// gnyis pa la/ (491) yul dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ yul mkhyen gsum gyi sgrub pa dang*/ yul can sbyor bzhi'i de gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum thob bya thob byed blang dor bya ba'i yan lag tu thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad de nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na/ rnam mkhyen thob bya'i 'bras bur/ lam shes thob byed kyi rgyur/ gzhi shes blang dor bya ba'i yan lag tu nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa dang gsum/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ sbyor bzhi phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa'i sems pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na/ rnam kun gyi sbyor ba nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa sogs bzhi/ gnyis pa la/ go cha'i/ 'jug pa'i/ tshogs kyi/ nges 'byung sgrub pa dang bzhi/ gsum pa so so'i rang bzhin la bzhi las/ dang po go sgrub la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ (492) dang po la/ kha cig pha rol tu phyin pa re re yang phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa'i bsam pa'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa/
