zer na/ de yin na brtson 'grus yin dgos par thal/ de yin na bsam pa'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ phar phyin re re yang phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na/ sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab kyi phar phyin gyi go sgrub dang drug dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyis sbyin pa'i go sgrub nas/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi shes rab gyi go sgrub kyi bar drug dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sbyin pa'i de'i go sgrub gang zhig sbyin pa la spyod pa'i gnas skabs su/ sbyin pa nyid chos gsum ldan (493) du nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig sbyin pa la spyod pa'i gnas skabs su/ gzhan la gnod 'tshe spong ba'i tshul khrims chos gsum ldan gyi tshul du nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ chos gsum ni/ sbyor ba rnam mkhyen yid byed dang ldan pa/ dngos gzhi 'khor gsum du mi dmigs pa/ rjes dge rtsa bla med byang chub tu bsngo ba'o// des lhag ma rnams la 'gre/ gnyis pa 'jug sgrub la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig rang gi 'jug yul du gyur pa'i theg chen nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ rang gi 'jug yul du gyur pa'i theg chen nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus gyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ zer/ dang po la/ de yin na/ brtson 'grus yin pas khyab par thal ba (494) dang*/ gnyis pa la/ rnam mkhyen gtso bor nyams su len pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi brtson 'grus kyis ma nges/ rang lugs/ rang gi 'jug yul du gyur pa'i theg chen gtso bor nyams su len pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod yan chad kyis bsdus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/

mtshan gzhi theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar gyi mkhyen pa rnams so// dbye na/ bsam gtan gzugs med la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ sbyin sogs la/ lam la/ byams sogs tshad med la/ dmigs pa med pa'i theg chen la/ 'khor gsum rnam dag gi theg chen la/ ched du bya ba la/ mngon par shes pa la/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang dgu'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'jug sgrub gang zhig bsam gtan gzugs med kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas (495) nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ lhag ma rnams la 'gre/ de yang bsdu na/ 'bras bu'i theg chen nyams su len pa'i/ sgrub pa dang*/ rgyu'i de gnyis su 'dus/ dang po ni/ ched du bya ba la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ rnam mkhyen la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ lhag ma rnams so// gsum pa tshogs sgrub la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig byang chub chen po 'byin par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ byang chub chen po dngos su 'byin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ tshogs gnyis kyi dpung rgya chen po bsog par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zer/ dang po la/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam gyis ma nges/ gnyis pa la/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chen po chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen (496) gyi mthong lam byang chub chen por 'gyur/ gsum pa la/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis dngos su bsogs pa la brtson bzhin pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod kyis ma nges/ rang lugs/ zab pa dang rgya che ba la spro ba'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis kyi dpung rgya chen po bsog par byed cing rang gi dngos 'bras theg chen gyi 'phags lam dngos su 'byin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ mtshan gzhi/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog skad cig tha ma nas rgyun mtha'i bar gyi mkhyen pa lta bu/

dbye na/ snying rje chen po'i tshogs sgrub/ sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar drug zhi gnas kyi/ lhag mthong gi zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi/ thabs la mkhas pa'i/ ye shes kyi/ bsod nams kyi/ lam gyi/ gzungs kyi/ sa'i/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dang bcu bdun/ bsdu na/ 'das lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i tshogs sgrub dang*/ 'jig rten pa dang (497) thun mong ba'i de gnyis su 'dus/ dang po ni/ sa dang*/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ dang po bco lnga lta bu/ bzhi pa nges 'byung sgrub pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig rang gi nges par 'byung sa brgyad po gang rung gdon mi za bar 'byin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ de dngos su 'byin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zer/ dang po la/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam gyis ma nges/ gnyis pa la/ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam gyi yul can gyi nges 'byung dang*/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid kyi nges 'byung gang rung dngos su 'byin byed du thal/ de yang 'dod na/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes dang*/ rnam mkhyen gang rung gi dngos rgyur thal lo// rang lugs/ rang gi nges par 'byung (498) sa brgyad po gang rung gdon mi za bar 'byin par byed pa'i dag sa'i rnal 'byor/ mtshan gzhi/ dag pa sa gsum lta bu/ dbye na/ ched du bya ba'i mnyam pa nyid kyi/ sems can don byed kyi/ 'bad med lhun grub kyi/ mtha' gnyis las 'das pa'i/ theg pa gsum gyi don thob pa'i rnam kun mkhyen nyid kyi/ lam gyi yul can gyi nges 'byung sgrub pa dang brgyad do// de yang bsdu na/ gnas gang du nges par 'byung ba dang*/ tshul ji ltar du nges par 'byung ba gnyis su 'dus/ dang po la/ mi slob lam mthar thug du nges par 'byung ba'i dbang du byas nas/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid kyi nges 'byung sgrub pa/ slob lam mthar thug du nges par 'byung ba'i dbang du byas nas lam gyi yul can gyi nges 'byung sgrub pa bzhag

gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas lhag ma drug bzhag pa yin no// des na 'di la nges par 'byung ba yin la/ nges 'byung sgrub pa ma yin pa'i mu/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin pa la/ nges (499) par 'byung ba ma yin pa'i mu/ gnyis ka yin pa'i mu/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mu dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sa brgyad pa nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bar gyi mkhyen pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ ma dag sa lta bu'o// bzhi pa la/ spang bya spong ba'i/ thob bya thob pa'i dbang du byas pa'i grangs nges gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang chub sems dpas spang bya sgrib gnyis spong ba'i dbang du byas nas theg chen gyi sgrub pa la bzhir bzhag ste/ sgrib gnyis kyi dgra las rgyal bar byed pa'i byang chub sems dpas dang por sgrib gnyis spong phyir du bsam pas go cha gyon/ de nas sgrib gnyis spong ba'i phyir sbyor bas g.yul du 'jug de nas sgrib gnyis kyi gnyen po tshogs gnyis kyi dpung rgya chen po bsags te/ gnyen po la goms par byas pas sgrib pa kun las rgyal ba'i yon tan la dbang (500) 'byor ba'i phyir/ dper na/ dgra 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pa'i dmag dpon gyis/ go cha gyon pa dang*/ g.yul du 'jug pa dang*/ sde srid kyi dpa' bo'i dpung rgya chen po bsags pa'i byed pas pha rol gyi dgra'i sde bcom nas rgyal srid la dbang 'byor bar byed pa bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpas thob bya'i 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i dbang du byas nas theg chen gyi sgrub pa la bzhir bzhag ste/ byang chub sems dpas thob bya'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa thob par bya ba'i phyir du dang por bsam pas go cha gyon/ de dang mthun par lam nyams su len pa la 'jug de'i rjes su tshogs gnyis kyi dpung rgya chen po bsog par byed/ de dang mthun par spang bya la nges par 'byung ba'i lam nyams su blangs pas ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thob par byed nus pa'i phyir/

lnga pa ni/ rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim yin te/ snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma 'byung ba'i phyir/ drug pa la/ kha cig (501) sgrub pa bzhi'i sa mtshams/ rim bzhin/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ khyad par gyi lam nas yod de/ 'dir sbyor ba dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ sgom pa dang*/ khyad par gyi lam zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer/ theg chen tshogs lam pa'i rgyud la/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa med par thal/ de'i rgyud la de bzhi po gang rung med pa'i phyir/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud la sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyi sgo nas theg chen gyi lam nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa med par thal ba dang*/ theg chen mthong lam pa'i rgyud la rang 'bras 'phags lam gyi dngos rgyu byed pa'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i nyams len med par thal ba'i skyon gnas so// kha cig de gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa'i sa mtshams yin cing*/ de yang go sgrub sbyor lam nas gtso che ste/ sbyor lam du thob pa tsam tshogs lam du ma thob pa'i phyir zer/ go (502) sgrub sgom lam du gtso che bar thal/ sgom lam du thob pa tsam lam 'og mar ma thob pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ sbyor ba dang zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i sbyor ba la mthong lam la rgyud nas sbyor ba dang*/ nye bar sbyor ba/ mngon sum du sbyor ba gsum yod la/ dang po tshogs lam yin cing*/ de na go sgrub yod/ gnyis pa sbyor lam yin cing*/ de na 'jug sgrub yod/ gsum pa chos mchog chen po yin la/ de na tshogs sgrub dang po bco lnga yod/ tshogs sgrub phyi ma gnyis ni/ mthong bsgom gyis bsdus/ 'di'i khyad par gyi lam/ lo chen ni/ rgyun mtha' dang de'i snga logs kyi mkhyen pa kho na la bzhed/ ṭī ka'i lugs la/ dag sa'i ye shes yin la/ de na nges 'byung bsgrub pa'i sa mtshams yod pa ni/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa mthar thug yin te/ 'grel chen las/ de la 'phags pa thogs med kyis go cha dang*/

'jug pa'i sgrub pa la ni go (503) rim bzhin du gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dang*/ mngon du sbyor ba'i rang bzhin gyi tshogs dang*/ mos pa spyod pa'i sas bsdus pa yin no// tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni brtse ba nas brtsam ste/ gzungs kyi bar gyis mngon sum du sbyor ba'i lam gyi rang bzhin chos kyi mchog chen pos bsdus pa yin no// sa dang po rab tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin/ mthong ba'i lam gyi bdag nyid can ni tshogs kyi sgrub pa yin no// bsgom pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin sa gnyis pa la sogs pa'i rang gi ngo bo gnyen po'i phyogs kyi bdag nyid can yang tshogs kyi sgrub pa yin pas lam gnyis ka'i spyod yul can yin no// nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa ni/ bsgom pa'i lam la brten pa yin no// zhes bshad do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ sgrub pa bzhi'i sa mtshams so sor nges pa yin te/ go sgrub tshogs lam/ 'jug sgrub

(504) sbyor lam drod/ tshogs sgrub chos mchog skad cig tha ma/ nges 'byung sgrub pa sa brgyad pa nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ go sgrub/ 'jug sgrub/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa la 'phros pa'i don dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ yul can go sgrub dang*/ yul pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang po gong du bshad zin/ gnyis pa la/ so so'i ngo bo/ sgra don/ grangs nges/ go rim/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu'o// dang po la/ rgyan las bshad tshul dang*/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa'o// dang po ni/ khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi gtong ba'i sems pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o// sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin pa nas/ khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ shes rab kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ (505) khyad chos bzhi ni/ mi mthun phyogs ser sna sogs dang bral ba/ grogs stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mi rtog ye shes dang ldan pa/ byed las gzhan gyi 'dod don rdzogs par byed pa/ gdul bya rnams theg pa gsum gyi byang chub tu smin par byed pa yin te/ rgyan las/ sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang*// rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan// 'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed// sems can rnam smin byed rnams gsum// de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la'ang bshad de/ gnyis pa/ slob dpon gyi lugs ni/ drug ka'ang sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar 'jog dgos te/ sher phyin sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar bshad cing*/ rgyu mtshan gzhan rnams la'ang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ srid zhi pha rol tu son pa mthar thug pa'i gtong ba'i sems pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ rgyu'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin (506) pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i de gnyis/ sbyin pa tsam la dbye na/ zang zing*/ chos/ mi 'jig pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa dang bzhi/

gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa mthar thug pa'i spong ba'i sems pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ dge ba chos sdud kyi/ sems can don byed/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang gsum/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa mthar thug pa'i mi 'khrug pa'i sems pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ sdug bsngal dang len/ gnod pa la ji mi nyams pa/ chos la nges rtog gi bzod pa dang gsum/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa mthar thug pa'i dge ba la spro ba'i brtson 'grus mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ go cha/ sbyor ba/ mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa mthar thug pa'i dmigs pa la sems rtse (507) gcig tu gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i/ yon tan khyad par can sgrub pa'i/ sems can don byed kyi bsam gtan dang gsum/ drug pa'i mtshan nyid/ srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa mthar thug pa'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab gsum/ gsum pa ni/ dbul ba 'dor ba'i don gyis na sbyin pa/ nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung bsil bas na tshul khrims/ khong khro la bzod pas na bzod pa/ 'bras bu la sbyor bas na brtson 'grus/ yid rtse gcig tu 'dzin pas na bsam gtan/ don dam pa'i gnas lugs shes par byed pas na shes rab ces bya ste/ rgyan las/ dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang*// bsil ba thob dang khro bzod dang*// mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang*// don dam shes pa'i (508) phyir bshad do// gnyis pa la/ sgrub bya la ltos pa'i/ don gnyis la ltos pa'i/ bslab pa gsum la ltos pa'i grangs nges dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgrub bya mngon mtho dang nges legs sgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug bzhag ste/

mngon mtho sgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas dang po gsum/ nges legs sgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas phyi ma gnyis/ de gnyis mthar phyin pa'i dbang du byas nas brtson 'grus bzhag pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ mngon mtho la/ longs spyod/ lus/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa gsum yod la/ dang po sgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas sbyin pa/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas tshul khrims/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas bzod pa gzhag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de yin te/ bsam gtan gyis sems nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi 'gro ba'i sgo nas spang bya mngon 'gyur ba 'doms par byed/ shes rab kyis gnas lugs shes pa'i sgo (509) nas spong bya'i sa bon bcom ste byang chub sgrub par byed pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/ longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang*// 'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang*// rtag tu nyon mongs dbang nyid mi 'gro dang*// bya ba rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ don gnyis sgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas drug tu bzhag ste/ dang po gsum gyis gzhan don gtso bor sgrub/ phyi ma gnyis kyis rang don gtso bor sgrub/ brtson 'grus kyi de gnyis mthar phyin pa'i grogs byed pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ sbyin pas gzhan la yo byad kyi dngos po gtong bar byed/ tshul khrims kyis gzhan la gnod 'tshe spong bar byed/ bzod pas gzhan gyis byas pa'i gnod pa las bzlog par byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yin te/ bsam gtan gyis sems rtse gcig tu gnas par byed/ shes rab kyis spong (510) bya las grol ba'i rnam grol la sbyor ba'i phyir/ rgyan las/ sems can don la rab brtson pa// gtong dang mi gnod bzod pas byed// gnas dang grol ba bzhir bcas pas// rang don rnam pa thams cad spong*// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ bslab pa gsum sgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas drug tu bzhag ste/ dang po gsum gyi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/

bsam gtan gyis sems kyi bslab pa/ shes rab kyis shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor sgrub par byed cing*/ brtson 'grus ni gsum ka mthar phyin pa'i grogs yin pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ sbyin pas lus longs spyod la ma chags pa'i sgo nas tshul khrims la 'jug pa'i rten byed/ tshul khrims kyis gnod pa spong ba'i sgo nas de gnas par byed/ bzod pas gzhan gyi gnod pa dang du len pa'i sgo nas de gong 'phel du byed pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni// rgyal bas pha rol phyin (511) pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum// tha ma gnyis kyis rnam pa gnyis// gcig ni gsum char la yang gtogs// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma 'byung bas rgyu 'bras kyi rim pa yang yod la/ dman pa dang rags pa sngar bstan nas/ mchog dang phra ba phyis ston pas dman mchog gi go rim yin te/ rgyan las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma ste// dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*// rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir// de dag rim par bstan pa yin// zhes so// lnga pa la gnyis las/ dang po/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ rin chen phreng bar/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyi bde// bzod pas mdangs ldan dge bas brjid// bsam gtan gyis zhi blo yi grol// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni de nyid las/ ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab yul// (512) rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid 'thob// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam chos can/ go sgrub yin te/ sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa re re yang phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ tshad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ sgom tshul/ sgom pa'i 'bras bu'o// dang po la lus rten dang*/

sems rten gnyis/ dang po la/ gang zag gang gis skyed pa dang*/ khams gang du skyed pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i lam ma zhugs dang*/ lam zhugs gnyis ka'i rten la dngos su skyed rung ste/ kun btus su/ 'di'i lus rten la phyi rol pa dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ byang sems gsum ka yod par bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar med gsar du skye ba 'dod pa'i rten la skye dgos te/ (513) dang por pha rol po sdug bsngal gyi mnar ba sogs mthong nas de dang bral bar 'dod pa'i sgo nas skyed dgos pa'i phyir/ thob zin gnas pa gzugs kyi rten la'ang yod la/ gzugs med khams na med de/ der pha rol dmigs yul du byas nas sdug bsngal bsal 'dod kyi blo dngos su skye mi nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi gang rung la brten te/ de ltar du kun btus su bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba/ grangs nges/ sa mtshams so// dang po ni/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas sems can tshad med pa la brtse ba'i bsam pa phun tshogs/ gnyis pa ni/ dmigs yul sems can tshad med pa la dmigs nas 'bras bu tshogs gnyis tshad med pa bsog pas na tshad med pa zhes bya'o// gsum pa la/ byams pa/ snying rje/ dga' ba/ btang (514) snyoms tshad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang bzhi/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas sems can tshad med pa bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten pa sems can tshad med pa sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas sems can tshad med pa bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/

bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la brten nas/ sems can tshad med pa chags sdang nye ring dang bral bar 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ rgyan las/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can// phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can// mi 'bral bde ba'i dgongs pa can// phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// rnam pa'i (515) sgo nas de re re la yang sems can la/ chos la/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'i byams pa tshad med sogs gsum gsum yod/ 'di dag gi mtshan nyid la kha cig byams pa tshad med kyi ting nge 'dzin gang zhig bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa'i sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ de gang zhig gang zag gi bdag med kyis khyad par du byas pa'i sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ de gang zhig bden med kyi khyad par du byas pa'i sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa zer/ phyi rol pa'i rgyud kyi byams pa tshad med kyi ting nge 'dzin chos can/ chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa tshad med du thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ tshad med kyi ting nge 'dzin gang zhig khyod kyi dmigs yul du gyur pa'i sems can gang zag gi bdag med kyis khyad par du byas pa yin pa'i phyir (516) dang*/ khyod kyis gang zag gi bdag med kyis khyad par du byas pa'i sems can la dmigs pa dang*/ des khyad par du ma byas pa'i sems can la dmigs pa gang rung gang zhig phyi ma de ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs par thal lo// gsum pa la/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi byams pa tshad med kyi ting nge 'dzin chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ rtags sngar ltar sgrub/ 'dod na/ bden med rtogs par thal lo// rang lugs/ byams pa tshad med kyi ting nge 'dzin gang zhig

bde ba don gnyer gyi sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ sems can la dmigs pa'i tshad med pa phyi ma gsum gyi mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ dbye gzhi gang zhig sdug bsngal gyis nyams thag pa'i sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i dbye gzhi gang zhig bde ba dang ldan pa'i sems can la dmigs nas de dang mi 'bral bar (517) 'dod pa'i/ chags sdang dang ldan pa'i sems can la dmigs nas/ de dang bral bar 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ byams pa tshad med phyi ma gnyis kyi mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ de gang zhig gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i sgo nas bdag med kyis khyad par du byas pa'i sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ de gang zhig bden med rtogs pa'i sgo nas bden med kyi khyad par du byas pa'i sems can la dmigs nas bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ des lhag ma rnams la rigs 'gre/ sems can la dmigs pa'i tshad med phyi ma gsum gyi dmigs yul ni sdug bsngal gyi nyams thag pa'i sems can dang*/ bde ba dang ldan bzhin pa'i sems can dang*/ chags sdang mngon gyur ba dang ldan bzhin pa'i sems can la dmigs pa yin te/ rgyan las/ brtan pa rnams kyi de dag bde 'dod dang*// sdug bsngal gyis nyams (518) thag dang bde ba dang*// nyon mongs can dang de dag bstan bcos dang*// de yi de bzhin nyid la rab tu 'jug /ces dang*/ 'jug par/ dang por nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing*// bdag gi 'di zhes dngos la chags bskyed pa// zo chun 'phyan ltar rang dbang med pa yi// 'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud// 'gro ba g.yo ba chu'i nang gi zla ba ltar// g.yo dang rang bzhin nyid kyis stong par mthong ba yi// zhes so// de yang rgyan gyi/ brtan pa rnams kyi zhes pa nas/

nyon mongs can dang zhes pa'i bar gyis/ sems can la dmigs pa'i byams sogs tshad med bzhi'i dmigs rkyen bstan/ de dag bstan bcos dang*/ zhes pa dang*/ de yi de bzhin nyid la rab tu 'jug /ces pas phyi ma gnyis kyi dmigs rkyen bstan/ 'jug pa'i sh+lau ka dang pos sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs rnam bstan/ tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis kyis chos la dmigs pa/ dmigs med pa la dmigs (519) pa'i snying rje tshad med kyi dmigs rnam bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ tshad med pa'i ting 'dzin la bzhir 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de'i mi mthun phyogs la gnod sems/ rnam 'tshe/ yid mi bde/ chags sdang mngon gyur ba bzhi yod la/ de dag gi gnyen po'i dbang du byas nas tshad med bzhi rim bzhin bzhag pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ tshad med pa ni bzhi yin no// gnod sems la sogs gnyen po'i phyir// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ sems can la dmigs pa'i tshad med pa bzhi lam ma zhugs nas/ chos la dmigs pa ni nyan thos kyi tshogs lam nas/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa ni theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar ro// gsum pa ni/ rang gi mdza' bshes la bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi bsam pa dang por sgom/ de nas tha mal gyi gang zag gzhan la sgom/ mthar rang la gnod byed kyi dgra bo la dmigs ste de ltar bsgom nas/ sems can

(520) thams cad brtse ba'i ma dang khyad par med par ma gyur gyi bar du rtse gcig tu bsgom/ bzhi pa la/ so so'i 'bras bu dang*/ thun mong gi de gnyis/ dang po ni/ byams pas rnam mkhyen myur du sgrub pa dang*/ snying rjes sems can rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ dga' bas gzhan don sgrub pa'i gnas skabs su 'khor ba la skyo ba med pa dang*/ btang snyoms kyis chags sdang gi skyon mtha' dag dang bral bar byed de/ ma dros pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems mnyam pa// rtag tu thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems 'dzin cing*// snying rjes sems can rnams ni mi gtong dang*// dga' bas 'khor ba na ni skyo ba med// btang snyoms chen pos skyon rnams spangs pa ste// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ byams sogs tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pas 'bras bu lnga 'byin te/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ji ltar 'dod pa'i gnas su skye ba/ bdag po'i 'bras bu tshogs rdzogs par byed pa/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras (521) bu/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pa/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ tshe rabs kun tu tshad med bzhi dang mi 'bral/ bral ba'i 'bras bu mi mthun phyogs gnod sems sogs dang bral bar byed de/ rgyan las/ tshangs pa'i gnas pas gnas pa yi// blo ldan rtag tu 'dod pa skye// des ni tshogs rnams rdzogs byed cing*// sems can rnams kyang rnam smin byed// kun tu tshangs dang mi 'bral la// de yi mi mthun phyogs dang rgyal// bag med gyur kyang de yi rkyen// mi bzad pas kyang mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i tshad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ khyod la dbye na bzhir yod de khyod la byams pa tshad med/ snying rje tshad med/ dga' ba tshad med/ btang snyoms tshad med dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ gzungs kyi tshogs/ ye shes kyi tshogs/ sa'i tshogs dang gsum/ dang po ni/

tshig la sogs pa'i gzungs dang*/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang (522) po/ gzungs la rgyu/ ngo bo/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ bdag po'i rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi yin la/ sngon dge ba rgya chen por goms pa/ tshe 'dir gsung rab mang du thos pa/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pa ni nye ba'i rgyu yin no// gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ so so'i rang bzhin/ byed las/ grangs nges/ sa mtshams so// dang po ni/ rang nyid gzungs su 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu phun tshogs la brten nas/ gsung rab dpag tu med pa'i tshig don ci rigs pa 'dzin par nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa ni/ chos rnams kyi tshig don dang legs pa'i lam 'dzin pas na gzungs zhes bya ste/ de'i skad dod du dha ra zhes 'byung la/ de'ang 'dzin par byed pa la 'jug pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ tshig gi don gyi/ bzod pa'i/ gsang sngags kyi gzungs dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ gzungs (523) bzhi'i nang tshan gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab dpag tu med pa'i tshig mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig gsung rab dpag tu med pa'i/ don 'dzin par nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ 'di gnyis la lung gi chos kyi spyan dang*/ chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin du 'jog pa yin no// dbye na/ dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin la brten pa'i/ gsung rab mang du thos pa la brten pa'i/ bden med rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la brten pa'i/ tshig dang don gyi gzungs gsum/ dang po gnyis ni/ lam du ma zhugs pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la'ang yod pas chung ngu zhes bya la/ phyi ma lam zhugs kho na la yod pas chen po yin la/ de la'ang mos spyod kyi gnas skabs kyis bsdus pa chung ngu dang*/ ma dag sas bsdus pa 'bring po dang*/ dag pa sas bsdus pa chen po

(524) gsum ste/ rgyan las/ rnam smin thos pa goms pa dang*// ting nge 'dzin gyi gzungs dag ni// chung ngu dang ni chen po ste// chen po de yang rnam pa gsum// blo ldan ma zhugs zhugs pa yang*// ma dag sa pa rnams kyis ni// chung ngu dang ni 'bring po ste// dag pa'i sa pa'i gzungs chen yin// zhes so// gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig stong pa nyid la mi skrag pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ stong nyid la mos pas spyod pa'i bzod pa'i gzungs dang*/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i bzod pa'i gzungs gnyis/ gnyis ka yang mtshan nyid pa yin par dka' 'grel las bshad/ ṭī ka las/ bzod pa rgyur gyur gyi gzungs dang*/ bzod pa dngos kyi gzungs gnyis/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhig bden med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas rang 'bras su gyur pa'i sngags kyi tshig rnams 'bras bu 'byin nus su byin gyis (525) rlob par nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ sngags kyi tshig gzungs su bshad pa ni 'bras bu la rgyu'i ming gi btags pa'o// dbye na/ bden med don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i sngags gzungs dang*/ mngon sum du rtogs pa'i don gnyis/ bzhi pa ni/ tshig dang don gyi chos rang nyid kyis 'dzin cing gzhan la ston pa'i byed las dang ldan te/ rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dang yang*// de la yang dag brten nas ni// rtag tu dam pa'i chos dag kyang*// rab tu ston cing 'dzin par byed// ces so// lnga pa ni/ gzungs la bzhir 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de'i yul la tshig don/ yul can ye shes gsum du yod la/ dang po 'dzin pa'i dbang du byas nas tshig gzungs/ gnyis pa 'dzin pa'i dbang du byas nas don gzungs/ gsum pa la/ rang don du rgyu tshogs sgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas bzod (526) pa'i gzungs/ gzhan don gyi ched du byas nas gsang sngags kyi gzungs bzhag pa'i phyir/

drug pa ni/ tshig dang don gzungs lam ma zhugs nas kyang yod la/ phyi ma gnyis theg chen gyi tshogs lam yan chod nas yod de/ byang sar/ snga nas smon lam dang bsam gtan gyi dbang gis thob kyang*/ bstan pa dang rgya che ba ni ma yin no// zhes smon lam dang bsam gtan gyi dbang gis thob pa sngar lam ma zhugs nas thob pa dang*/ bstan pa dang rgya che ba'i gzungs lam zhugs kho na la yod par bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dang por yi ge a lta bu la dmigs nas dang por gang nas byung*/ mthar gang du 'gag rang gi ngo bo ji ltar gnas pa/ bden med du gtan la phab nas rtse gcig tu yid la byed/ de bzhin du chos thams cad bden pa'i skye med du gtan la phab nas rtse gcig tu yid la byed pa'i tshul gyis sgrub par byed do// mdo las/ a zhes bya ba ni skyes pa'i phyir/ (527) chos thams cad kyi sgo'o// zhes dang*/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyis mchog /khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ gzungs kyi tshogs chos can/ khyod la bzhir yod de/ khyod la tshig gi gzungs/ don gyi gzungs/ bzod pa'i gzungs/ gsang sngags kyi gzungs dang bzhir yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de la ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ ye shes kyi tshogs la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang 'bras byang chub kyi rgyu byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sgo nas bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes/ dbye na/ theg dman gyi dang*/ theg chen gyi ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang 'bras theg dman gyi byang chub kyi rgyu byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sgo nas/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes/ (528) mtshan gzhi/ theg dman gyi lam lnga lta bu/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang 'bras chos sku'i rgyu byed pa'i sgo nas/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes/ mtshan gzhi theg chen gyi lam lnga lta bu/ rang 'bras theg chen 'phags lam gyi dngos rgyu byed pa'i stong nyid sgom byung gi sgo nas gtso bor rtogs pa'i ye shes/

skabs 'dir dngos bstan gyi ye shes kyi tshogs kyi mtshan nyid/ de dang ye shes kyi tshogs sgrub don gcig dbye ba la/ sa mtshams dang*/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ stong nyid thos bsam gyi sgo nas don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i/ sgom byung gi sgo nas don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i/ mngon sum du gsar du gtogs pa'i/ mngon sum du rtogs zin rgyun du sgom par byed pa'i/ mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs dang lnga/ gnyis pa la/ nang*/ phyi/ gnyis ka stong pa/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid/ chen po/ (529) don dam pa/ 'dus byas/ 'dus ma byas/ mtha' las 'das pa/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa/ dor ba med pa/ rang bzhin/ chos thams cad/ rang gi mtshan nyid/ mi dmigs pa/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid/ dngos po/ dngos med pa/ rang gi ngo bo/ gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs dang nyi shu'o// gsum pa la/ 'grel pa rnams las bshad tshul dang*/ de'i dgongs pa dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'grel chen dang*/ thub pa dgongs rgyan sogs su/ dang po gsum mos spyod/ bzhi pa sbyor lam/ chen po stong pa nyid nas/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi bar ma dag sa bdun/ rang bzhin dang*/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid sa brgyad pa/ de nas gnyis sa dgu pa/ de nas gnyis sa bcu pa/ tha ma gnyis sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod/ gnyis pa la/ lo chen gyis/ mos spyod kyi sa tshogs lam la bshad nas lhag (530) ma rnams sgra ji bzhin par bzhed/ 'dre ar gyi/ mos spyod kyi sa tshogs lam yin par bkag nas/ de sbyor lam tsam dang*/ sbyor lam ni chos mchog la bzhed cing*/ lhag ma rnams sgra ji bzhin par bzhed/ 'thad pa ma yin te/ sa dang po nas kyang stong nyid nyi shu thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis tshogs yod pa'i phyir te/ don stong nyid mngon sum du gsal bar rtogs pa'i ye shes yod pa'i phyir/

des na 'grel pa rnams kyis dgongs pa ni/ stong nyid de dang de la log phyogs su/ 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod nas stong nyid de dang de la nges pa rnyed pa'i sa mtshams dgongs pa yin no// dper na/ stong nyid tha ma gsum la log phyogs su 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs bag chags dang bcas pa bcom nas de gsum rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug la dgongs nas sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhag pa yin gyi/ de gsum rtogs pa tsam gyi dbang du byas pa'i sa mtshams ma yin te/ 'grel chen las/ (531) stong pa nyid gsum po 'di dag ni go rim bzhin du nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa la brten pa nyid yin pa'i phyir dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa la brten pa nyid yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rang byung nyid yin pa'i don gyis na sangs rgyas kyi sa yin par shes par bya'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ 'dir bstan ye shes kyi tshogs chos can/ khyod la dbye na nyi shur yod de/ nang stong pa nyid nas/ gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sa'i tshogs las gang zhig ces skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ sa'i rnam bzhag spyir bstan pa dang*/ 'dir bstan gyi sa bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'byung bas bsdus pa'i sa/ spang byas bsdus pa'i sa/ lam gyi bsdus pa'i sa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa'i rten byed pa'i sra shing (532) 'thas pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sems can rnams kyi spyi mthun gyi las kyis 'phangs pa'i 'khor ba lta bu/ gsum pa la/ theg dman gyi sa dang*/ theg chen gyi sa gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg dman rang lugs kyi yon tan khyad par can gyi rten byed pa'i theg dman gyi mkhyen pa lta bu/ de la/ rigs kyi/ brgyad pa'i/ mthong ba'i/ bsrabs pa'i/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i/ byas pa rtogs pa'i/ nyan thos kyi/

rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang brgyad/ dang po ni/ gnas skabs theg dman du rigs nges pa'i nyan thos so skye'i mkhyen pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i mkhyen pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ de 'bras gnas kyi mngon rtogs lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi/ lnga pa ni/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas kyi/ drug pa ni/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi/ bdun pa ni/ zhugs pa phyi ma gsum gyi mngon rtogs lta bu'o// brgyad (533) pa ni/ rang rgyal 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs lta bu/ gnyis pa la/ mos spyod kyi/ byang sems kyi/ sangs rgyas kyi sa dang gsum du yod cing*/ dang po ni/ byang sems tshogs sbyor ba'i/ gnyis pa ni/ byang 'phags kyi/ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa lta bu/ de dag gi nang nas 'dir bshad bya'i sa ni/ byang sems kyi sa yin te/ bsgrub bya tshogs bcu bdun gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i sa'i tshogs ni byang sems kyi sa kho na la bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'dir bstan gyi sa la/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ khyad chos so// dang po ni/ spyan dang mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can gyi rten byed pa'i stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen slob pa'i mngon rtogs/ gal te/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir te/ de'i mos spyod kyi sa yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ byang sems (534) sbyor lam pa chos can/ sar gnas kyi byang sems su thal/ mos spyod kyi sa la gnas pa'i byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen tshogs lam sa dang po dang*/ de'i mthong lam la sa gsum par 'jog rigs par thal/ theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor gnyis po de byang sems kyi sa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'byung po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la 'jigs pa med pa ster bar byed pa dang*/ yon tan dpag tu med pa'i rten byed pa dang*/ rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'gro ba dang*/

ldan pas na sa zhes bya ste/ rgyan las/ 'byung po dpag med 'jigs med phyir// dpag tu med pa de dag la// phyi phyir gang du 'gro ldan phyir// de dag nyid ni sar 'dod do// zhes so// gsum pa la/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba la sogs sa bcu'o// bzhi pa la/ sa dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sgra don no// dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ sa gnyis pa'i ye shes ma (535) skyes gong gi rab tu dga' ba'i ming can gyi mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ sa dang po'i bar chad med lam/ rnam grol/ khyad par gyi lam mo// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mthong spangs shes sgrib dngos su spong bar byed bzhin pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs/ mtshan gzhi/ theg chen mthong lam pa dbang rtul gyi rgyud kyi bzod pa brgyad lta bu/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi mthong spangs shes sgrib las grol ba'i rten gnyen pos bsdus pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs/ mtshan gzhi/ theg chen mthong lam pa dbang rtul gyi rgyud kyi shes pa brgyad lta bu/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi lam rjes shes rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ mthong lam gyi rtogs rigs gong 'phel du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na/ sa dang po rang gis bsdus pa'i khyad par gyi lam dang*/ sa gong mas bsdus pa'i de gnyis/ dang po ni/ sa dang po'i rjes

(536) thob dang*/ mnyam gzhag seng ge rnam bsgyings lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sa gnyis pa yan chad kyi mkhyen pa lta bu/ sa gong ma rnams la yang dbye ba 'di bzhin du shes par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ sa dang po la rab tu dga' ba ces bya ste/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la rgyu'i nus pa nye ba dang*/ sems can mang po'i don sgrub pa'i nus pa mthong nas/ dga' spro rgya chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/ byang chub dang ni nye ba dang*// sems can don sgrub mthong ba la// rab tu dga' ba skye 'gyur te// de phyir rab dga' zhes brjod do// zhes so// gnyis pa la yang gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni/ sa dang po rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ sa gsum pa ma skyes gong gi dri ma med pa'i ming can gyi mngon rtogs/ dbye na gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi ngos skal gyi 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi/ sgom spangs shes sgrib chen po'i sa bon dngos su spong bar byed bzhin pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la (537) mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi sgom spangs shes sgrib chen po'i chen po/ de'i 'bring*/ de'i chung ngu dngos su spong bar byed pa'i bar chad med lam gsum/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi sgom spangs shes sgrib chen po las grol ba'i rten gnyen pos bsdus pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi sgom spangs shes sgrib chen po skor gsum las grol ba'i rnam grol lam gsum/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba sngar ltar ro// gsum pa sgra don ni/ sa gnyis pa la dri ma med pa zhes bya ste/ 'chal ba'i tshul khrims kyi rgyu nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i phyir/ rgyan las/ 'chal tshul rtsol ba'i dri bral phyir// dri ma med pa'i sa zhes bya// zhes so// sa lhag ma rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang dbye ba sngar las dpag ste shes par bya'o//

(538) sgra don ni/ sa gsum pa la/ 'od byed pa zhes bya ste/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba rgya chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir/ chos kyi snang ba chen po ni// byed pa'i phyir na 'od byed pa'o// zhes so// bzhi pa la/ 'od 'phro ba zhes bya ste/ byang chub phyogs mthun rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi 'od zer gyis sgrib gnyis kyi bud shing bsreg par byed pa'i phyir/ 'di ltar byang chub phyogs mthun chos// rab tu bsreg byed 'od lta bu// de dang ldan phyir sa de ni// gnyis bsreg pas 'od 'phro can// zhes so// lnga pa la/ sbyang dka' ba zhes bya ste/ sems can smin pa dang*/ rang gi sems bsrung ba'i sbyang dka' ba'i yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyir/ sems can rnams yongs smin byed cing*// rang gi sems kyang bsrung ba'i phyir// blo ldan rnams kyis sbyang dka' ba// de phyir sbyang dka' zhes bya 'o// zhes so// drug pa la mngon du gyur pa zhes bya ste/ 'khor 'das kyi gnas lugs (539) mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab mngon 'gyur du ldan pa'i phyir/ shes rab pha rol phyin brtan nas// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis 'di mngon du gyur pa'i phyir// mngon du gyur pa'i sa zhes bshad// ces so// bdun pa la ring du song ba zhes bya ste/ mnyam rjes bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam sa brgyad pa dang dngos rgyu dngos 'bras su 'brel ba'i stobs kyis mtshan 'dzin gyi rnam rtogs las ring du song ba'i phyir/ bgrod gcig lam dang 'brel ba'i phyir// ring du song ba'i sar 'dod do// zhes so// brgyad pa la mi g.yo ba zhes bya ste/ mtshan 'dzin dang rang don yid byed kyi 'du shes gnyis kyi/ g.yo ba mi nus pa'i phyir/ 'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo'i phyir// mi g.yo ba zhes nges par brjod// ces so// dgu pa la legs pa'i blo gros zhes bya ste/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi rjes mthun pa brnyes pas/

gsung rab kyi tshig don la blo gros thogs med du 'jug pa'i phyir/ (540) so so yang dag rigs blo bzang*// sa de legs pa'i blo gros yin// zhes so// bcu pa la/ chos kyi sprin zhes bya ste/ gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sprin gyi sems nam mkha' lta bu la khyab pa'i phyir/ sprin bzhin gnyis kyis nam mkha'i chos// khyab pa'i phyir na chos kyi sprin// zhes so// lnga pa la/ bsdu ba/ grangs nges/ shes bya mkhyen tshul/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ rnam smin gyi lus 'dzin pa'i tshul lo// dang po la/ ma dag sa dang*/ dag pa sa gnyis 'dus te/ sa bdun pa man chad ni/ 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan mas ma dag sa dang*/ brgyad pa yan chod des dag pa'i sa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu'i sa dang 'bras bu'i sa gnyis su yang 'dus te/ dang po dgu rgyu'i dang*/ bcu pa 'bras bu'i sar bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bslab pa'i nyams su blang bya'i/ spang bya'i dbang du byas pa'i grangs nges so// dang po ni/ bslab pa gsum gyi rgyu ngo bo 'bras bu'i dbang du byas nas sa (541) bcur bzhag ste/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas sa dang po/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas sa gnyis pa nas drug pa'i bar/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas lhag ma bzhi bzhag pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ sa dang por/ bslab pa'i rgyu sbyin pa'i phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yin te/ sa gnyis pa ni/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i rang bzhin/ gsum pa sems kyi bslab pa'i rang bzhin/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa/ drug pa ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun/ bden bzhi/ rten 'brel rtogs pa'i shes rab la gtso bor spyod pas shes rab kyi bslab pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yin te/ sa bdun par/ mtshan 'dzin mngon gyur pa las ring du song*/ brgyad par 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma nye bar zhi/ dgu pa so so yang dag par rigs pa brnyes/ bcu pa gzungs dang ting 'dzin gyi yon tan gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ (542) nyams su blang bya pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i dbang du byas nas sa bcu bzhag ste/ sa dang por sbyin pa'i phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa nas/ sa bcu par ye shes kyi phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir te/ dbus mtha' las/ sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan dang ni shes rab thabs// smon lam stobs dang ye shes dang*// 'di dag pha rol phyin bcu'o// zhes dang*/ khyad par can dang khyad med ni// sa bcu rnams su shes par bya// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ spang bya sgrib pa bcu'i gnyen por sa bcu bzhag ste/ dbus mthar ro// chos kyi dbyings la ma rig pa// nyon mongs can min sgrib pa bcu// sa bcu mi mthun phyogs rnams kyi// gnyen po dag ni sa yin no// zhes so// gsum pa la/ shes bya rtogs pa'i rim pa dang*/ ji ltar du rtogs tshul lo// dang po la/ rang bzhin rnam dag rtogs pa'i rim pa dang*/ glo bur rnam dag rtogs (543) pa'i rim pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs su rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid mthong tshul la khyad par med de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod kyis sdug bsngal bden pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i dus su/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i phyir te/ de chos nyid la sgrub pas 'jug pa'i mngon sum gang zhig rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid la rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa lhas/ gang gis dngos gcig de bzhin nyid mthong ba// de yis dngos kun de bzhin nyid du mthong*// zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ de phyir dngos po mthong ba yis// yon tan mtha' dag mthong ba nyid// ces so// gal te/ des ngo bo nyid sku mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rnam dag (544) gi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/

gzhan yang*/ de chos can/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid yin na/ khyod kyis mngon sum du rtogs pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyi rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir te/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ sa 'og mas ma thob pa'i yon tan gong mas thob rgyu med par thal/ der rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid mthong tshul la khyad par med pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ dang po la skyon med de/ ngo bo nyid sku de rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid tsam la 'jog pa ma yin par/ glo bur gyi dri ma ma lus par spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ bden par med pa'i chos nyid yin na/ khyod kyi mthong bas khyab par thal/ khyod kyis bden par med pa'i (545) chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ skyon med de/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid mthong tshul la khyad par med kyang*/ chos can so so ba dang 'brel ba'i chos nyid la nges pa mi 'dra ba 'dren pa'i sgo nas log phyogs su 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs rim bzhin gcod pa'i phyir/ de yang sa dang por/ chos dbyings kun 'gro'i tshul du rtogs pa dang*/ gnyis par mchog don du/ gsum par rgyu mthun don gyi mchog tu/ bzhi par 'dzin med kyi don du/ lnga par rgyud pa dang med pa'i don du/ drug par kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'i don du/ bdun par tha dad med pa'i don du/ brgyad par rnam par mi rtog pa la dbang ba'i don du/ dgu par ye shes la dbang ba'i don du/ bcu par chos dbyings 'phrin las la dbang ba'i don du rtogs pa'i phyir/ dbus mtha' (546) las/ kun tu 'gro don mchog gi don// rgyu mjug don gyi mchog nyid dang*// yongs su 'dzin pa med don dang*// rgyud rnams tha dad med don dang*// nyon mongs rnam dag med don dang*// tha dad med pa'i don nyid dang*// 'grib med 'phel ba med don dang*// dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yi gnas// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/

sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs su/ glo bur rnam dag gi chos nyid mthong tshul la khyad par yod de/ der glo bur gyi dri ma re re dang bral ba'i chos nyid gsal mthong re re yod pa'i phyir te/ sa dang por mthong spangs spangs pa'i glo bur rnam dag gi chos nyid gsar du mthong ba nas sangs rgyas kyi sar sgrib pa ma lus pa dang bral ba'i chos dbyings mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i phyir/ mdo las/ sprin mthong mkha' la nyi bzhin 'dir khyod phyogs gcig blo gros can// blo mig dag pa'i 'phags kun gyis kyang thams cad mthong ma lags// (547) bcom ldan 'das khyod chos sku gang dag blo gros mtha' yas pa// shes bya mtha' med mkha' dbyings khyab pa de dag gis kun mthong*// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ dgag bzhag spangs gsum mo// dang po la kha cig sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs su blo med de/ der spros pa'i mtshan ma mtha' dag dang bral ba'i phyir/ kha cig blo yod kyang kun rdzob dngos yul du mi byed de/ spros bral gyi chos nyid la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i phyir dang*/ kun rdzob ni ma rig pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i 'khrul snang tsam yin/ zer/ dang po mi 'thad de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam de/ chos nyid mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i lam ma yin par thal ba dang*/ de na sgrib pa dngos su spong byed kyi gnyen po med par thal ba sogs kyi skyon yod/ gnyis pa la/ sa bcu'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su ma rig pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i (548) 'khrul snang gong 'phel du 'gyur bar thal/ der kun rdzob bden par mthong tshul gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rang lugs/ sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag gis bden gnyis zung 'jug gi tshul gyis 'jal te/ lta bas mthong ba'i steng du spros pa gcod cing*/ sgom pas kyang snang ba la dmigs nas rang bzhin med par sgom pa'i phyir/ rjes thob kyis kyang bden gnyis zung 'jug tu 'jal te/

'dus byas kyi chos 'di dag snang la rang bzhin med par sgyu ma lta bur 'jal ba'i phyir te/ rtsa bar/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can// de yi byed pa mchog yin no// de ni dmigs med rnam pa can// phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do// zhes dang*/ dag pa 'jig rten pa bzung ba dang 'dzin par mngon par ma zhen pa'i rnam pa/ zhes dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i bdag nyid du snang ba'i blo/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'jal tshul la khyad par yod de/ mnyam bzhag du don dam 'dzin stangs (549) kyi yul du byed cing*/ kun rdzob dmigs yul tsam du byed/ rjes thob tu kun rdzob 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byed cing*/ don dam dmigs yul du byas pa'i sgo nas 'jal bar byed pa'i phyir/ de la kho na re/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ bden gnyis gcig char du mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ don dam bden pa mngon sum du rtogs pa gang zhig kun rdzob bden pa dngos yul du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bden gnyis ngo bo gcig tu rtogs pa la sgrib byed kyi dri ma spangs par thal/ 'dod na/ sgrib pa spangs par thal lo// gzhan yang*/ theg chen slob pa'i mnyam bzhag las logs su rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa dgos med du thal/ mnyam bzhag gi mkhyen pas kun rdzob dngos yul du byed pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ dang po la/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ chos can dang chos nyid gcig char (550) du mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ chos can mngon sum du rtogs pa gang zhig chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod kyis rtogs byar gyur pa'i chos de chos can yin pa'i phyir te/ de rang gi chos nyid kyi chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig tu rtogs pa la sgrib byed kyi dri ma spangs par thal/ 'dod na/ sgrib gnyis spangs par thal/ rim bzhin 'khor gsum/ gnyis pa la/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen las logs su ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen dgos med du thal/

des ji lta ji snyed kyi chos ma lus pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ sa dang po'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin par thal/ dus skad cig la sangs rgyas brgya mngon sum du mthong nus pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma (551) grub na/ kun rdzob bden pa mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur/ bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes chos can/ nyan thos kyi lam de bden med du ma rtogs par thal/ don dam bden pa ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ rtogs par thal/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rnam par mi dmigs sgo nas ni// nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya// zhes so// bden med kyi rnam pa can gyi byang 'phags kyi rjes thob bzhi ma grub par thal/ bden gnyis cig char du rtogs pa'i byang 'phags kyi rjes thob gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can// zhes sogs dang 'gal lo// bzhi pa la/ ma dag sa dang*/ dag pa sa la ldan pa'i yon tan gnyis/ dang po la/ sa dang po la ldan pa'i yon tan

(552) zhib tu bshad pa dang*/ des lhag ma mtshon tshul lo// dang po la/ sdom tshig dang de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mthong dang byin brlabs gnas dang 'jug /'jug ldang g.yo dang snang dang smin// bgrod dang chos sgo lus ston 'khor// yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis so// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ dus skad cig ma gcig la zhes pa gang gsal byed du sbyar te/ sangs rgyas brgya mthong bar nus/ des byin gyis rlob par byed/ bskal pa brgyar gnas nus/ de'i sngon mtha' dang phyi mtha' la 'jug par nus/ ting nge 'dzin brgya la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang bar nus/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar nus/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya snang bar byed nus/ sems can brgya smin par byed nus/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyar bgrod nus/ chos kyi sgo brgya 'byed nus/ rang gi lus brgyar ston nus/ de re re yang 'khor brgya phrag re re dang ldan par ston nus pa (553) ste/ mdo sde sa bcu pa'i don 'jug par tshigs su bcad pa ni/ de tshe 'di yis sangs rgyas brgya mthong zhing*// de dag byin gyis brlabs kyang 'di yis rtogs// de nyid tshe na bskal pa brgyar gnas shing*// sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' yang yang dag 'jug /blo ldan ting 'dzin brgya phrag snyoms par 'jug cing gtong byed de// 'jig rten khams brgya 'di yis kun nas g.yo zhing snang bar nus// de bzhin rdzu 'phrul gyis de sems can brgya phrag smin byed cing*// brgya phrag grangs dang rjes 'brel zhing dag tu'ang 'gro bar 'gyur// des ni chos kyi sgo rnams yang dag 'byed byed thub dbang sras// rang gi lus la lus rnams kun nas ston par byed pa'ang yin// rang gi 'khor dang bcas pas mdzes 'byor lus ni re re zhing*// rgyal ba'i sras po brgya phrag dag dang rjes su 'brel ba'ang ston// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sa gnyis par yon tan de dag stong 'gyur/

gsum par 'bum 'gyur/ (554) bzhi par bye ba phrag brgyar 'gyur/ lnga par bye ba stong 'gyur/ drug par bye ba brgya phrag stong 'gyur/ bdun par bye ba phrag khrig brgya'i 'gyur thob par bshad/ gnyis pa la/ sa brgyad pa stong gsum 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yon tan/ dgu par sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yon tan no// bcu par sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yon tan thob ste/ 'jug par/ mi g.yo ba'i sar gnas rnam rtog med pa des// stong gsum brgya phrag stong sdoms 'jig rten na// rdul tshad ji snyed yod pa de rnams dang*// grangs mnyam yon tan dag ni 'thob par 'gyur// legs pa'i blo gros sa la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems des sngar bstan yon tan dag /grangs med brgya phrag stong du yang dag par// sdoms pa phrag bcu'i rdul tshad 'thob par 'gyur// re zhig bcu pa 'dir de'i yon tan dag /ngag gi spyod (555) yul las ches 'das gyur cing*// ngag gi spyod yul ma yin sdoms rnams na// rdul dag ji snyed yod pa de snyed 'gyur// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ sa dang por 'dzam gling gi rgyal po/ gnyis par gling bzhi la dbang ba'i rgyal po/ gsum par brgya byin/ bzhi par 'thab bral/ lnga par dga' ldan/ drug par 'phrul dga'/ bdun par gzhan 'phrul man chad la dbang ba'i rgyal po/ brgyad par stong gi bdag po tshangs pa/ dgu pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i bdag po tshangs pa chen po/ bcu par 'og min man chad la dbang ba'i lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po'i tshul bzung nas sems can rnams kyi ji ltar 'dod pa'i don sgrub par bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis// zhes sogs kyi gzhung gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sa'i yongs sbyong gi rab dbye bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/
legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho las rnam mkhyen bshad pa'i skabs te dang po'o// // 1$0000220༈ /bal yul nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las gu rus spel/// /1$0000270
